examples.en: It is often crucial that assistance should be provided right away if a disaster strikes a community.
examples.zh: 如果社区受灾，及时提供救援常常是最关键的一环。

examples.en: We can't abandon our unique cultural features when we learn from the West.
examples.zh: 我们在向西方学习的时候，不能丢弃自己独特的文化特征。

examples.en: Many people are totally ignorant of their potential abilities.
examples.zh: 很多人对他们自己的潜能一无所知。（黄浦）

a.name: have the ability to do sth.
do sth. to the best of one's ability
do sth. beyond one's ability
trans: 做超越某人能力的某事

examples.en: Everyone is able to pass the test as long as he or she practices hard.
examples.zh: 只要努力练习，每个人都能通过考试。

items.explanation: 一般指人，表示“现在确实有做某事的能力”，有时意味着“有高超的能力或技艺”。它常用在词组 be able to do sth. 中。

examples.en: We shall be able to finish the work tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我们明天可以完成这项工作。

items.explanation: 指人或指物均可，表示“一般要求的能力”。它所表示的能力显得比 able 弱，常用在词组 be capable of doing sth. 中。

examples.en: He is hardly capable of executing such a difficult task.
examples.zh: 他仅能勉强执行这样艰巨的任务。

examples.en: abnormal weather conditions
examples.zh: 反常的天气

examples.en: We went/climbed aboard.
examples.zh: 我们上了船（或飞机、车等）。

examples.en: He was already aboard the ship.
examples.zh: 他已经上船了。

examples.en: The report about that family on TV has caused the concern of society about the weak group.
examples.zh: 电视里关于那个家庭的报道引起了社会对弱势群体的关心。

examples.en: They often saw me out and about.
examples.zh: 他们经常看见我四处奔波。

discriminations.intro: 这两个介词都作“关于”解，但在表达意义上存在一定差异。

items.explanation: 指关于非严肃的、随便的、泛泛而谈的内容。

examples.en: He told us a story about Lei Feng.
examples.zh: 他告诉我们一个关于雷锋的故事。

items.explanation: 指关于严肃的、专题性的、系统性的内容。

examples.en: a report on the international situation
examples.zh: 关于国际形势的报告

examples.en: There was a small suitcase on the rack above his head.
examples.zh: 他头上的行李架上放着一只小箱子。

examples.en: As has been stated above, we can come to the conclusion that the happier your family is, the longer you will live.
examples.zh: 综上所述，我们可以得出这样一个结论：家庭越幸福，你就会越长寿。

items.explanation: 在……上面（没有垂直关系，不一定是正上方，反义 below）

examples.en: Our plane flew above the clouds.
examples.zh: 我们的飞机在云上飞行。

items.explanation: 在……上面（表示在垂直的上方，反义 under）

examples.en: There is a bridge over the river.
examples.zh: 河上有一座桥。

examples.en: Do you think it necessary to send the children who have not graduated from senior high school to study abroad?
examples.zh: 你觉得有没有必要把高中未毕业的孩子送到国外留学？

examples.en: I want to ask for a leave of absence.
examples.zh: 我想请假。

examples.en: Tom is absent from school today because he is infected with a flu.
examples.zh: 汤姆今天没来上学，因为他染上了流感。

examples.en: You must not be absent from the meetings without good reason.
examples.zh: 你不得无故缺席这些会议。

examples.en: Attorneys are ethically and legally bound to absolute confidentiality.
examples.zh: 道德和法律都要求律师绝对保密。

examples.en: It's absolutely freezing outside.
examples.zh: 外面冷得不得了。

examples.en: They are so absorbed in the experiment that they are ignorant of what's going on outside the lab.
examples.zh: 他们全神贯注地投入实验中，以至于对实验室外正在发生的事情一无所知。

examples.en: She sat on the ground absorbed in her studies.
examples.zh: 她坐在地上专心学习。

examples.en: Self-perfection is an abstract ideal, incapable of motivating some students to actually struggle against laziness.
examples.zh: 自我完善是一个抽象的理想，无法激励一些学生真正对抗惰性。

examples.en: Please read the abstract of the lecture.
examples.zh: 请阅读讲演的摘要。

examples.en: What she did was an abuse of her position as manager.
examples.zh: 她的所作所为是滥用经理职权。

examples.en: The relationship between parents can greatly affect their kid's academic scores.
examples.zh: 父母之间的关系会大大影响孩子的学习成绩。

examples.en: He had developed a slight American accent.
examples.zh: 他说话带上了一点轻微的美国口音。

examples.en: There is no doubt that more and more companies will accept the sharing economy.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，越来越多的公司会认可共享经济。

items.explanation: 收到（只表示收到的动作，但不说明结果是否接受）

examples.en: When we are off sick, we only receive half pay.
examples.zh: 我们请病假的时候只能拿一半薪水。

items.explanation: 收到（表示主动而且高兴地接受）

examples.en: She has received his present, but she will not accept it.
examples.zh: 她收到了他的礼物，但她是不会接受的。

examples.en: Do keep your password safe, or others can have access to the important information stored in your computer.
examples.zh: 务必保管好你的密码，否则别人会获取你储存在电脑中的重要信息。

examples.en: Accumulator and index register can be accessed by the programmer.
examples.zh: 程序员可以对累加器和变址寄存器进行存取。

examples.en: Students at this school have access to excellent sports facilities.
examples.zh: 这所学校的学生可以使用极好的体育设施。

examples.en: The accident caused by ignoring the rules is worth our reflection.
examples.zh: 这场因无视规则引发的事故值得我们深思。（浦东）

items.explanation: 意外事情；事故

examples.en: There have been many railway accidents this year.
examples.zh: 今年发生了多起铁路事故。

items.explanation: 小事；事情

examples.en: He told me of the incident that happened the day before.
examples.zh: 他给我讲了前一天发生的事。

items.explanation: （强调重大的）事件；事变

examples.en: The revolution was one of the most important political events in history.
examples.zh: 这场革命是历史上最重要的政治事件之一。

examples.en: I don’t know whether they did it by accident or by design.
examples.zh: 我不知道他们这样做是不小心的，还是故意的。

examples.en: This hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
examples.zh: 这家酒店至多可入住500位客人。

examples.en: Hotel accommodation is scarce.
examples.zh: 旅馆的房间供不应求。

examples.en: In order to accompany their kids through the precious childhood, many mothers have given up their career of promising prospect.
examples.zh: 为了能陪伴孩子度过珍贵的童年时期，许多妈妈放弃了前景良好的事业。

examples.en: She accompanied magnificently.
examples.zh: 她伴奏得精彩极了。

examples.en: Work hard, or you'll accomplish nothing.
examples.zh: 要努力，否则你将一事无成。

examples.en: It's an amazing accomplishment and one we cannot achieve without generous support.
examples.zh: 这是一项了不起的成就，如果没有大家的慷慨支持，我们是无法取得这一成就的。

examples.en: According to the data released, the housing prices in cities keep rising instead of falling.
examples.zh: 根据已公布的数据，城市的房价不跌反涨。

examples.en: Not until the problems arose did he realize that he had failed to take certain factors into account in his design.
examples.zh: 直到问题产生，他才意识到，他在设计中没有将某些因素考虑在内。

examples.en: This is accounted to the side effects of the medicine.
examples.zh: 这是由于药物的副作用。

examples.en: His lack of learning awareness accounts for his failure in the exam last week.
examples.zh: 缺乏学习意识是他上周考试中失败的原因。

examples.en: How do you account for losing five games in a row?
examples.zh: 你如何解释一连输了5场比赛呢？

examples.en: These products, in total, account for about 80% of all our sales.
examples.zh: 这些产品总共约占我们全部销售额的80%。

a.name: on any account
trans: 无论如何（一般用于否定句）

examples.en: We must take into consideration our ability to pay when we import goods.
examples.zh: 我们进口商品时必须考虑我们的支付能力。

examples.en: He wants to be an accountant in the future.
examples.zh: 他将来想做一名会计。

examples.en: The manager impressed on his office staff the importance of keeping accurate records.
examples.zh: 经理让办公室职员深刻认识到精确记录的重要性。

examples.en: The police accused him of murder.
examples.zh: 警方指控他谋杀。

examples.en: I don't think anyone can accuse him of not being frank.
examples.zh: 我认为谁也不能说他不坦率。

examples.en: She found it necessary to accustom her child to getting up early.
examples.zh: 她觉得必须让孩子养成早起的习惯。

examples.en: It took him a long time to get accustomed to the fast pace of life in the big city.
examples.zh: 他花了很长时间才习惯了大城市的快节奏生活。

examples.en: My tooth aches.
examples.zh: 我牙疼。

examples.en: I have an ache in my stomach.
examples.zh: 我胃疼。

items.explanation: 指身体局部较持续的疼痛，通常是隐痛，如耳痛、牙痛、胃痛、头痛等。ache 与身体某部分可组成复合名词，如：headache、toothache 等。ache 后接疼痛部位时，要在 ache 前加 an，构成 an ache in the stomach (one's head、a tooth、the ear) 词组。

examples.en: He felt an ache in his left leg.
examples.zh: 他左腿疼。

items.explanation: 指由于受伤或疾病而产生的疼痛，既可指一般的疼痛，也可指突然的剧痛，有时指局部疼痛影响到全身，程度比 ache 重。pain 可作及物动词，也可作不及物动词；ache 只可作不及物动词。pain 还可引申指精神上的痛苦；ache 则没有此义。

examples.en: The boy cried with pain.
examples.zh: 男孩痛得大叫。

examples.en: Only by cooperating with each other can the whole team achieve success, and that is one of the reasons why Shanghai Shenhua Football Club won the match that time.
examples.zh: 整支球队只有相互配合，才能取得成功，这是上海申花足球队赢了那次球赛的原因之一。

examples.en: Flying across the Atlantic for the first time was a great achievement.
examples.zh: 首次飞越大西洋是一项伟大的成就。

examples.en: Such a goal was impossible of achievement.
examples.zh: 这样的目标是不可能实现的。

examples.en: A lemon is an acid fruit.
examples.zh: 柠檬是一种酸性水果。

examples.en: Some acids burn holes in wood.
examples.zh: 有些酸能把木头烧出洞来。

examples.en: He acknowledged his own faults.
examples.zh: 他承认自己的过失。

trans: 告知（或确认）（信件等的）收到

examples.en: The university is a good place where students can acquire knowledge in various fields.
examples.zh: 大学是一个好地方，学生在这里可以学习各个领域的知识。

examples.en: To my parents' satisfaction, they can see the Century Park across the street from the dining-room of this apartment and so can they from the living-room.
examples.zh: 让我的父母非常满意的是，从这个公寓的餐厅可以看到街对面的世纪公园，从起居室也可以。（上海高考）

examples.en: The river is 50 metres across.
examples.zh: 这条河宽50米。

items.explanation: across 和 over 两个词表示横过道路、河流等“细长物”的情形时，可互用。但 over 不可指在水中横渡。从房间、原野、海洋等“平面延伸”的一端横越到另一端时，也不能用 over。

examples.en: She went across/over the bridge.
examples.zh: 她过桥。

examples.en: She swam across the Strait of Dover.
examples.zh: 她游泳渡过多佛海峡。

examples.en: We drove across the desert.
examples.zh: 我们开车穿过沙漠。

items.explanation: 表示“通过，穿过”，侧重于动作在某一物体空间里进行，含有从中间通过之意。

examples.en: The bus went through a tunnel.
examples.zh: 汽车穿过隧道。

examples.en: I acted as a simultaneous interpreter.
examples.zh: 我担任同声翻译。

examples.en: The actor who acted the part of Hamlet has a real talent.
examples.zh: 出演哈姆雷特的男演员非常有天分。

examples.en: a noble act
examples.zh: 高尚的行为

examples.en: The news report should act as a warning to other potential buyers.
examples.zh: 这篇新闻报道应该对其他潜在的购买者起到警示作用。

examples.en: The book which a person is reading at present as well as his daily words and actions clearly indicates what kind of person he is.
examples.zh: 不只是一个人的日常言谈举止，就连他目前正在读的那本书，都清楚地向我们表明了他是一个怎样的人。（虹口）

examples.en: They took an active part in the singing competition yesterday.
examples.zh: 他们昨天积极参加了歌唱比赛。

examples.en: Students should be encouraged to take an active part in classroom activities.
examples.zh: 应该鼓励学生积极参加课堂活动。

examples.en: Nowadays too many boys want to become actors.
examples.zh: 现在有太多男孩想成为演员。

examples.en: It was because she failed to resist the temptation of money and fame that the famous actress broke the laws and in the end had to pay a high price for it.
examples.zh: 正是因为没有抵制住金钱和名誉的诱惑，那位知名女演员犯了法，最终她不得不为此付出惨重的代价。（松江）

examples.en: I can not give the actual figures.
examples.zh: 我不能举出实际数字。

items.explanation: 作“真实的，真正的”解，是指所形容的物品的外貌与实际情况相符，或某种事物是客观存在的，不是虚假的。

examples.en: It is a real diamond.
examples.zh: 这是一颗真钻石。

examples.en: He was asked to give his real reason for being late.
examples.zh: 他被要求说出迟到的真实理由。

items.explanation: 作“真的，确实的”解，是指和事实相符。形容人时，是指“忠实的”。

examples.en: This is a true story in real life.
examples.zh: 这是现实生活的真实故事。

examples.en: A true friend is one who will always stand by you when in need.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友总是在需要时站在你身边的。

items.explanation: 作“实际的，现实的”解，是指所形容之物在事实上已发生和存在。

examples.en: In actual life, things are not so simple.
examples.zh: 在现实生活中，事情总没那么简单。

items.explanation: 作“真正的，非伪造的”解，是指所形容之物是地道的，不是冒充的，以及所形容的感情是真诚的，而不是虚伪的。

examples.en: It’s a genuine Picasso.
examples.zh: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。

examples.en: He showed genuine sorrow at the death of his dog.
examples.zh: 狗死的时候，他流露出真实的悲伤。

examples.en: That’s the only reason why I’m actually going.
examples.zh: 这是我确实要走的唯一理由。

examples.en: Although he is a newcomer, he is quick to adapt himself to new circumstances.
examples.zh: 虽然他是新来的，但他很快适应了新环境。

examples.en: This popular song is adapted from an old folk song.
examples.zh: 这首脍炙人口的歌曲改编自一首古老的民歌。

a.name: adapt oneself to
trans: 使自己适应或习惯于某事

examples.en: Young animals adapt (themselves) quickly to a new environment.
examples.zh: 动物幼崽很快就适应新的环境。

examples.en: They’re paying you ten grand now for those adaptations of old plays.
examples.zh: 他们现在打算付你一万美元作为改编老剧本的报酬。

examples.en: Don’t add too much salt to the soup, or it will be too salty.
examples.zh: 汤里不要加太多盐，否则会太咸。

examples.en: The music added to our enjoyment of the film.
examples.zh: 配乐让我们看这部电影时体验更佳。

examples.en: For a hit show, profits can add up to millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 一场热门演出的利润可达数百万美元。

examples.en: So addicted to online shopping are many people that they visit shopping websites every hour.
examples.zh: 许多人如此沉溺于网络购物，以至于每个小时都要访问购物网站。

examples.en: She is a TV addict and watches as much as she can.
examples.zh: 她是个电视迷，看起电视来没完没了。

examples.en: In addition to the application in the medical field, X-rays are employed to identify oil paintings and coins.
examples.zh: 除了在医学领域的应用外，X 光还被用来鉴别油画和钱币。

examples.en: Dr. John emphasizes exercise in addition to a change in diet.
examples.zh: 约翰医生强调，不仅要改变饮食还要锻炼身体。

examples.en: An additional charge is made for heavy bags.
examples.zh: 重的行李要额外收费。

examples.en: I will write to him at his home address.
examples.zh: 我将按他的住址写信给他。

examples.en: He will address a talk to a teenage audience.
examples.zh: 他将对一群青少年听众讲话。

trans: 在(信封等)上写姓名地址

examples.en: We took adequate food for the holiday.
examples.zh: 我们为假期带足了食物。

discriminations.intro: 这三个词都含有“充分的，足够的”的意思。

items.explanation: 系常用词，常可与 sufficient 互换。它除表示“足以满足需要的”外，还含有“数量很多使人感到心满意足的”的意思。

examples.en: We have enough money to spend.
examples.zh: 我们有足够的钱可花。

items.explanation: 用于正式文体中，指“分量或数量足以满足需要的”。

examples.en: The food is sufficient for a week.
examples.zh: 这些食物足够维持一周。

items.explanation: 指“足够符合特定(有时可指最低)的资格、分量、才能等”，着重表示“符合一个客观要求或标准”。

examples.en: To be healthy one must have an adequate diet.
examples.zh: 一个人想要健康，必须有足够的规定饮食。

examples.en: We have ordered some desks which can be adjusted to the height of different children.
examples.zh: 我们订购了一些可以根据孩子身高任意调节的椅子。

examples.en: The company developed rapidly under Mr. Brown’s administration.
examples.zh: 在布朗先生的管理下，公司发展得很快。

examples.en: I admire him for his courage in face of difficulty.
examples.zh: 他面对困难的勇气令我佩服。

examples.en: Your sincerity is your admission to my class.
examples.zh: 你的诚心就是你到我班上学的许可证。

examples.en: To her delight, she has been admitted to Fudan University.
examples.zh: 令她开心的是，她被复旦大学录取了。

examples.en: This ticket will admit one adult and two kids to the show.
examples.zh: 这张票允许一个大人和两个小孩入场观展。

examples.en: I believe this is a common habit of children and adolescents.
examples.zh: 我认为这是儿童和少年的常见习惯。

examples.en: The adolescent crisis is most important.
examples.zh: 青春期危机是非常要紧的。

examples.en: In the depth of her heart always lies a suspicion that she might have been adopted by her parents eighteen years ago.
examples.zh: 她的内心深处一直存着一个疑惑，她可能是 18 年前被父母领养的。

examples.en: The child is really adorable.
examples.zh: 这孩子着实讨人喜欢。

examples.en: People adore her for her noble character.
examples.zh: 人们因她的高贵品质而敬爱她。

examples.en: You have spent your whole childhood in one country, and you are becoming an adult in another country.
examples.zh: 你整个童年都在一个国家生活，而将在另外一个国家步入成年。

examples.en: in sb.’s adult life
examples.zh: 在某人的成年生活阶段

examples.en: Let us join hands and advance together.
examples.zh: 让我们携起手来，共同前进。

examples.en: We advanced the date of the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们把会议日期提前了。

examples.en: It is considerate of you to inform me in advance that the meeting has been cancelled.
examples.zh: 你提早通知我会议取消，考虑真周到。

examples.en: Is it necessary to book the tickets in advance?
examples.zh: 有必要提前订票吗？

examples.en: The more advanced the development of modern Internet technology is, the more distant the relationships between people are likely to be in the real world.
examples.zh: 现代互联网技术的发展越先进，人们在现实生活中的人际关系可能就会越疏远。

examples.en: He took advantage of her ignorance, and made off with her money.
examples.zh: 他利用她的无知，带着她的钱逃走了。

examples.en: Such an action will advantage our cause.
examples.zh: 这样的行动有益于我们的事业。

examples.en: She told us her adventure in South America.
examples.zh: 她向我们讲述她在南美的冒险经历。

trans: 激动人心的活动(或经历)

examples.en: The group has adventured as far as the Austrian Alps.
examples.zh: 该队伍的探险之旅远至奥地利的阿尔卑斯山。

items.explanation: 指非常激动人心的或有一定危险性的经历，主要指探险、旅行、勘探等活动，带有刺激性的冒险或冒险经历。

examples.en: Where is your sense of adventure?
examples.zh: 你的冒险精神哪里去了？

items.explanation: 主要指工业、商业中的冒险投机活动。

examples.en: commercial venture
examples.zh: 商业冒险

examples.en: I need to advertise my new product in order to attract more customers.
examples.zh: 我需要为新产品做广告，以便吸引更多客户。

examples.en: If an advertisement claims that a certain medicine can cure anybody of any disease, it must be false.
examples.zh: 假如一个广告声称某种药能治愈一切疾病，那肯定是假的。

examples.en: According to the advice from educators and experts, parents can have a better understanding of children’s psychology and personality.
examples.zh: 根据教育家和专家的建议，家长可以更好地了解孩子的心理和性格。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to take a good rest.
examples.zh: 医生建议他好好休息。

a.name: advise sb. not to do sth.
advise that ...
trans: 建议（从句中用 should + do，should 可省略）

examples.en: To develop science, we must allow free exploration of new things and advocate academic debate.
examples.zh: 要想发展科学，要允许自由探索，提倡学术争鸣。

examples.en: He is an advocate of early rising.
examples.zh: 他是个主张早起的人。

examples.en: He took an aeroplane to China.
examples.zh: 他搭飞机去中国。

examples.en: In western countries, never ask a person about any private affairs like salary.
examples.zh: 在西方国家绝对不要询问有关工资这样的隐私问题。

discriminations.intro: 这四个词都有“事情”的意思。

items.explanation: 所表示的“事情”在含义上比较模糊，通常指客观存在的或有待处理的问题。

examples.en: Education in the wilderness is not a matter of monetary means.
examples.zh: 落后地区的教育不是钱财问题。

items.explanation: 以单数形式出现时，通常指一般的“事情”；而以复数形式出现时，通常指重大的“事情”或泛指“情形”。不管单、复数，这个词所表示的“事情”都包含着“在进行中”“处在过程中”或“交易、交往”的意思。

examples.en: The boss asked her how affairs stood.
examples.zh: 老板问她情形怎样。

items.explanation: 在含义上比 matter 还要模糊，有时为了含糊其词而有意用 thing。

examples.en: The most frightening thing of all was that not a sound could be heard.
examples.zh: 最为吓人的事情是一点声音也听不到。

items.explanation: 所表示的“事情”或“事务”多与“职务”有关，有时这个词表示以赚取利润为目的的“生意商务”。

examples.en: She left for Qingdao on business.
examples.zh: 她去青岛出差。

examples.en: Educators generally believe that negative attitudes towards study will affect students’ attention in class.
examples.zh: 教育者普遍认为，对学习的消极态度会影响学生上课的注意力。

examples.en: He felt great affection for his sister.
examples.zh: 他非常怜爱妹妹。

examples.en: Nowadays more and more Chinese people can afford to travel abroad.
examples.zh: 如今，越来越多的中国人负担得起去国外旅游的费用。

examples.en: I am afraid you won’t get the job unless you’re the best.
examples.zh: 我恐怕你得不到那份工作，除非你是最好的。

items.explanation: 对……害怕，担心；害怕可能发生的某种后果
因为害怕不敢做……

examples.en: She was afraid to tell her father the truth, because she was afraid of being punished.
examples.zh: 她不敢告诉她父亲真相，因为她害怕会被惩罚。

examples.en: She described her experiences in Africa very movingly.
examples.zh: 她十分动人地描述了她在非洲的经历。

examples.en: The African man is always making his own programme on TikTok every day, and he has a lot of fans, which might be the concrete reason why he is so fascinated with TikTok.
examples.zh: 那个非洲人每天都要上抖音做节目，他有不少粉丝，这可能是他如此痴迷于抖音的具体原因吧。

examples.en: She is the first woman and first African to lead the WTO.
examples.zh: 她是世贸组织的第一位女性和非洲领导人。

examples.en: Neither he nor his classmates like taking extra classes after school.
examples.zh: 他和他的同学都不喜欢放学后补课。

examples.en: After he suffered a serious illness, he realized that life is priceless.
examples.zh: 经历了一场大病后，他明白了生命无价。（宝山）

items.explanation: 通常指“时间的先后”。

examples.en: She succeeded in solving the problem after hard work.
examples.zh: 她努力工作，终于解决了那个问题。

items.explanation: 通常指“位置的前后”，也可指“落后于，不如”。

examples.en: There is a tree behind the house.
examples.zh: 房子后面有一棵树。

examples.en: behind the times
examples.zh: 落后于时代

examples.en: I was so tired this afternoon as to cancel the appointment with Mr. Smith.
examples.zh: 今天下午我太累了，就取消了和史密斯先生的会面。

examples.en: Soon afterward, I received a Christmas present from them.
examples.zh: 不久后，我收到了他们的圣诞节礼物。

examples.en: To our great disappointment, he broke his promise once again.
examples.zh: 使我们大为失望的是他又失约了。

examples.en: In the recent struggle against Ebola, many medical workers have devoted themselves to saving the patients without thinking of their own safety.
examples.zh: 在最近抗击埃博拉的斗争中，许多医务工作者没有考虑自己的安危，献身于救治病人。

examples.en: Her parents were busy with work, so she learned to look after herself at an early age.
examples.zh: 她的父母忙于工作，因此她在年幼时就学会了照顾自己。

examples.en: His health began to fail with age. In addition, he aged quickly because of his illness.
examples.zh: 由于上了岁数，他的健康开始衰退。此外，疾病使他老得很快。

a.name: We should learn a lesson from this incident: an idle youth, a needy age.
trans: 我们应从这次事件中吸取教训：少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。

examples.en: The aged people in the community celebrated their eightieth birthday together last week.
examples.zh: 上周这个社区的老年人一起庆祝他们的 80 大寿。

examples.en: She is looking for an employment agency.
examples.zh: 她正在找一家职业介绍所。

examples.en: We must put this item on the agenda.
examples.zh: 我们必须将此事提上日程。

examples.en: He was once an insurance agent.
examples.zh: 他曾是一个保险经纪人。

examples.en: A good student must be aggressive.
examples.zh: 要做个好学生，一定要有进取心。

examples.en: He transferred to a boarding school half a year ago, but he found it hard to adapt himself to the new environment there.
examples.zh: 他半年前转到一所寄宿制学校，但发现自己难以适应那里的新环境。

examples.en: Do you agree creativity always occurs when you are in a good mood?
examples.zh: 你是否赞同，创意总是出现在你心情愉快的时候？

examples.en: We couldn't agree on a date of the talk.
examples.zh: 关于谈判日期，我们未能取得一致意见。

examples.en: I find it impossible to agree to the terms of the contract.
examples.zh: 我无法接受这个合同的条款。

a.name: agree to sth.
trans: 同意某一建议（或安排等）（后面常跟表示“安排、建议、计划”等意思的名词）

examples.en: I agree with you on how to deal with it.
examples.zh: 关于此事如何处理，我同意你的看法。

examples.en: Please stop taking the medicine if it doesn't agree with you.
examples.zh: 如果对药物感到不适，请停止服用。

examples.en: We spent a most agreeable day together.
examples.zh: 我们在一起度过了非常愉快的一天。

examples.en: The new trade agreement should facilitate more rapid economic growth.
examples.zh: 新贸易协定应当加快经济发展。

examples.en: They know that this opportunity doesn't come easy, so they work together, develop creative thinking and resolve to build their hometown into a model village with intelligent agriculture at its core.
examples.zh: 他们知道这个机会来之不易，因此，他们通力合作，创新思路，决心把家乡建设成以智慧农业为核心的示范村。（崇明）

examples.en: As far as I know, predicting specific quakes ahead of time has been a goal difficult to achieve.
examples.zh: 据我所知，提前预报地震仍是一个难以达到的目标。

examples.en: The project is to go ahead following renewed promises of aid from the UN.
examples.zh: 在联合国再次承诺提供帮助之后，这个项目将得以推进。

examples.en: I aided him with money.
examples.zh: 我资助了他。

examples.en: In the effort to understand AIDS, attention is moving from the virus to the immune system.
examples.zh: 为了解艾滋病，人们的注意力从艾滋病病毒转向了免疫系统。

examples.en: aim a gun at sb.
examples.zh: 把枪对准某人

examples.en: The contest aims at encouraging young people to inherit the Chinese cultural tradition.
examples.zh: 这个比赛旨在鼓励年轻人继承中华文化传统。

examples.en: It was because she realized one after another short-term aims step by step that she could make scientific breakthroughs constantly.
examples.zh: 正因为她按部就班地实现一个个短期目标，她才会在科学领域获得不断的突破。

examples.en: The factory will aim at increasing production next year.
examples.zh: 工厂明年将以提高生产为目标。

examples.en: Only when the government takes serious measures can we expect the real improvement in air quality.
examples.zh: 只有政府采取严厉的措施，我们才有望看到空气质量的真正改善。

examples.en: He has decided to air his opinions.
examples.zh: 他决定说出他的观点。

examples.en: Not until he went out of the air-conditioned room did he realize how cold it was today.
examples.zh: 直到他走出空调房间，才意识到今天有多冷。

examples.en: an assortment of fighter aircraft
examples.zh: 各种战斗机

examples.en: He operates a private airline.
examples.zh: 他经营一家私人航空公司。

examples.en: send a letter by airmail
examples.zh: 寄航空邮件

examples.en: The reason why Eric didn't come to the party yesterday was that he went to the airport to see his friend off.
examples.zh: 艾里克之所以没能出席昨天的晚会，是因为他去了机场给朋友送行。

examples.en: give/raise/sound the alarm
examples.zh: 发出警报

examples.en: We were much alarmed by the fire in the forest.
examples.zh: 森林失火使我们大为惊慌。

examples.en: The album reminded her of the days when she was free from all worries.
examples.zh: 这本相册让她想起了那些无忧无虑的岁月。

examples.en: We should clean our hands with soap and water or alcohol-based handrub when we get home.
examples.zh: 到家时，我们应该用肥皂或含酒精的洗手液洗手。

examples.en: You should be alert to danger.
examples.zh: 你应该对危险保持警惕。

examples.en: The authorities were alerted to the danger.
examples.zh: 当局对危险警惕起来。

examples.en: A national police alert was in effect.
examples.zh: 全国警察实行戒备。

examples.en: Andrew and his father walk alike.
examples.zh: 安德鲁和他父亲走路一个样子。

examples.en: The twin brothers are very much alike in appearance but totally different in personality.
examples.zh: 这对孪生兄弟在外貌上非常相似，可在性格上却截然不同。

examples.en: The team's hopes for the championship were still alive.
examples.zh: 团队获胜的希望仍存在。

items.explanation: 活着的（一般作表语，表示虽有死的可能，但仍活着；有时可作后置定语）

examples.en: He saved three children alive at risk of his life.
examples.zh: 他拼命救出了 3 个孩子。

items.explanation: 活着的（多用作定语，the living 意为“活着的人”）

examples.en: He is the greatest living artist. (= He is the greatest artist alive.)
examples.zh: 他是在世的最伟大的艺术家。

items.explanation: 活着的，活生生的（强调生命力，常用于物，作定语）；现场直播

examples.en: There were only a few live trees left after the fire.
examples.zh: 火灾后只有几棵树仍然是活的。

examples.en: It is a live broadcast.
examples.zh: 这是一次现场直播。

items.explanation: 活跃的，充满活力的

examples.en: The patient seems more lively today.
examples.zh: 这位病人今天看上去活跃多了。

examples.en: Almost all students are busy preparing for the coming final exam.
examples.zh: 几乎所有学生都忙着为即将到来的期末考试做准备。

examples.en: It is known to all that he is ambitious for fame
examples.zh: 他野心勃勃想要出名，这是人所共知的。

examples.en: Study is all in all to me.
examples.zh: 对我而言学习第一。

examples.en: There are fifteen books on the first shelf, twenty-one on the second, making thirty-six in all.
examples.zh: 书架的第一层有 15 本书，第二层有 21 本，总共是 36 本。

a.name: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.
trans: 只工作不玩耍，聪明小孩也变傻。

examples.en: Please allow me to tell an interesting story before the lesson.
examples.zh: 请允许我在上课前先讲一个有趣的故事。

discriminations.intro: 这三个词都含有“允许”的意思。

items.explanation: 较正式并含积极意义，它表示准许的一方有正式的权限及持有赞同的态度。它可接名词作宾语，不能接双宾语，可以用于 permit sb. to do sth. 结构。当它作不及物动词时，要与 of 连用。

examples.en: The situation does not permit of any delay.
examples.zh: 情势不容许任何的拖延。

items.explanation: 指听任或默认某人做某事，含有不加阻止、不反对的意思，也可用于正式场合表示客气的请求。可接名词作宾语，或接双宾语用于 allow sb. to do sth. 结构。

examples.en: The nurse allowed the visitors to remain beyond the hospital hours, though it was not permitted.
examples.zh: 护士让探望者待到超过该院规定的探望时间，尽管这是不允许的。

items.explanation: 作“允许”解，常用于口语。它常用于 let sb. do 结构，作宾语补足语的不定式不带 to。

examples.en: Open the window and let in some fresh air.
examples.zh: 打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: Many children first learn the value of money by receiving an allowance.
examples.zh: 很多孩子首先通过领取零花钱来学习金钱的价值。（嘉定）

examples.en: Almost everyone came inevitably down with the virus.
examples.zh: 几乎所有人都不可避免地由于这种病毒而病倒了。

items.explanation: 这两个词是同义词，意为“几乎，将近”，在修饰 n.、v.、adv.、adj. 时，可互换。在和 no、none、nothing、never 等词连用时，只能用 almost，相当于 hardly any。

examples.en: It's almost/nearly midnight.
examples.zh: 将近半夜了。

examples.en: Almost no one (= Hardly anyone) knew what had happened.
examples.zh: 几乎无人知道发生了什么。

examples.en: Almost none (= Hardly any) of these shirts fits him well.
examples.zh: 这些衬衫几乎没有一件合他的身。

items.explanation: 表示“相差甚远，远不及”，而不是“几乎不”。

examples.en: That novel is not nearly interesting as this one.
examples.zh: 那部小说远不及这部有趣。

examples.en: I am not alone in this opinion.
examples.zh: 不只是我一个人有这想法。

examples.en: The book alone will bring him lasting reputation.
examples.zh: 仅仅那本书就可以让他流芳百世。

examples.en: Walking slowly along the Bund, you can appreciate all kinds of European architecture.
examples.zh: 沿外滩一路缓步走来，你可以欣赏到各种风格的欧式建筑。

examples.en: He sang loudly as he walked along.
examples.zh: 他边向前走边大声唱着歌。

examples.en: The two ships lay alongside of each other.
examples.zh: 两条船并排靠着。

examples.en: The car drew up alongside the road.
examples.zh: 小汽车在路边停下来。

examples.en: He read the poem aloud.
examples.zh: 他大声朗诵那首诗。

items.explanation: adv. 指出声，让人听得见，但声音不一定大。

examples.en: Please read the text aloud.
examples.zh: 请朗读课文。

items.explanation: 可用作形容词和副词，表示“声音响亮”，用作副词时，常与 laugh、read、speak、talk 等动态动词连用，并置于动词后。

examples.en: Could you speak a bit louder?
examples.zh: 你能说得大声点吗？

examples.en: They sang in a loud voice.
examples.zh: 他们歌声嘹亮。

items.explanation: adv. 与 loud 基本同义，但一般不能替换用，它多少含贬义，尤指“吵闹地，喧嚷地”，可与任何表示声响的动词搭配，置于其前或后。

examples.en: Someone knocked loudly at the door.
examples.zh: 有人大声敲门。

senses.trans: （一种语言的）全部字母，字母表

examples.en: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
examples.zh: 英语字母表中有 26 个字母。

examples.en: There is no need for you to tell me the truth, for I have already known it.
examples.zh: 你没必要告诉我真相，因为我已知晓。

examples.en: Not only did that suspect escape from the police station successfully, but he also drove a police car all the way to the border.
examples.zh: 那个嫌犯不仅成功地从警局逃脱了，而且开着警车一路跑到边境。

examples.en: He altered his mind.
examples.zh: 他改变主意了。

examples.en: How much of your time is spent on developing alternative sources of energy?
examples.zh: 你们在开发替代能源方面投入了多少时间？

examples.en: At present, the company has no alternative but to give up the project.
examples.zh: 目前该公司别无选择，只好放弃了那个项目。

trans: 两者（或在两者以上之间）择一，抉择

discriminations.intro: 这两个词都有“选择，挑选”的意思。

items.explanation: 着重指从互相排斥的两个（或多个）中选择一个，暗示条件或环境不容许其他可能。

examples.en: The president had no alternative but to yield.
examples.zh: 总统别无选择，只好让步。

items.explanation: 指有权从许多个中任意挑选一个。

examples.en: His father gave him a choice between a scooter and a bicycle.
examples.zh: 他的父亲给了他两个选择：滑板车和自行车。

examples.en: Although this product is in favor of environmental protection, few people show interest in it because of its high price.
examples.zh: 虽然这种产品有利环保，但因其价格昂贵，几乎无人问津。

items.explanation: although 和 though 作“尽管，虽然”解时，用法基本相同，但 although 更为书面化，更正式。

examples.en: She kept on working although she was tired.
examples.zh: 她虽疲劳但仍继续工作。

items.explanation: 作连词时相当于 although 和 as；作副词时，要放在句末。

examples.en: Old though/as he is, he still works in the factory.
examples.zh: 他虽然那么大年纪，但仍在工厂工作。

examples.en: He's not altogether sure what to do.
examples.zh: 他并不完全清楚该做什么。

examples.en: If you always go your own way, you will have to pay for what you have done.
examples.zh: 如果你总是一意孤行，你将为你的所作所为付出代价。
现在是上午 10 点。

examples.en: These photos were taken by both amateurs and professionals.
examples.zh: 这些照片是由业余爱好者和专业摄影师拍摄的。

examples.en: We made a rather amateur job of painting the house.
examples.zh: 我们把房子油漆了一遍，漆得很不在行。

examples.en: Standing at the top of the mountain and looking as far as the eye can see, we are amazed at the magnificence of nature.
examples.zh: 站在山顶，极目远望，大自然的壮美让我们惊叹不已。

examples.en: She was amazed how little he had changed.
examples.zh: 她惊诧的是他竟然没怎么变。

examples.en: She has amazing powers of recall.
examples.zh: 她有惊人的记忆力。

examples.en: His ambition to win Nobel Prize is not likely to be realized.
examples.zh: 他想获得诺贝尔奖的愿望不大可能实现。

examples.en: One may be poor but never ceases to be ambitious.
examples.zh: 人穷志不穷。

examples.en: We called an ambulance immediately when he fainted.
examples.zh: 他晕过去后我们马上叫了救护车。

examples.en: Maize is widely planted in America.
examples.zh: 玉米在美洲广泛种植。

examples.en: He’s an American.
examples.zh: 他是美国人。

examples.en: The American economy is on course for higher inflation than Britain by the end of the year.
examples.zh: 美国经济很可能在今年年底前出现比英国更高的通货膨胀。

examples.en: He finished his speech amid tremendous applause.
examples.zh: 他在雷鸣般的掌声中结束了演讲。

examples.en: A good command of English and years of volunteer experiences made him stand out among a large number of graduates.
examples.zh: 良好的英语和多年的志愿者经历让他在众多的毕业生中脱颖而出。

examples.en: According to my experience, drinking a moderate amount of coffee can refresh you instead of doing harm to your health.
examples.zh: 根据我的经验，适量喝点咖啡能够提神，而不会对你的健康有害。

examples.en: Their traveling expenses amount to seven hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 他们的旅费共达 700 美元。

examples.en: His speech amused everyone.
examples.zh: 他的讲话逗乐了每个人。

examples.en: Only by facing the reality and analysing the situation seriously can we find the solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 我们只有面对现实，认真分析形势，才能找到解决问题的办法。

examples.en: The developing trend of adolescent problems deserves our attention and analysis, which also deserves the joint efforts of the whole society to find solutions.
examples.zh: 青少年问题的发展趋势值得我们关注和分析，也值得整个社会群策群力，共商对策。（黄浦、虹口）

examples.en: Their ancestors came to France as refugees.
examples.zh: 他们的祖先以难民身份来到法国。

examples.en: The ship lay at anchor two miles off the rocky coast.
examples.zh: 船在离岩岸两英里处抛锚停泊。

trans: 主持（电视或电台节目，尤指新闻节目）

examples.en: The child seat belt was not properly anchored to the car.
examples.zh: 儿童座椅的安全带并未正确地固定到车上。

examples.en: So absorbed is he in the study of ancient cultures that he has persevered in working at the cost of his health these years.
examples.zh: 他如此醉心于古文化研究，这些年一直以健康为代价坚持工作着。（奉贤）

examples.en: The ancients believed that the sun and moon were planets.
examples.zh: 古人相信太阳和月亮都是行星。

examples.en: All the lights in the classroom are on day and night, which will be a great drain on electricity.
examples.zh: 教室里所有的灯日日夜夜地开着，这会大量消耗电力。

examples.en: He was filled with anger at the way he was being treated.
examples.zh: 他对于自己受到如此待遇而怒火中烧。

examples.en: She was angered by the harsh treatment she received.
examples.zh: 她因自己被粗暴对待而发怒。

examples.en: Try to look at the affair from another angle.
examples.zh: 试从另一个角度来看这件事。

examples.en: The customer was angry with the waitress for her bad service.
examples.zh: 这位顾客因服务员服务不好而生气。

examples.en: Some animals have disappeared, because they failed to adapt themselves to the changing environment.
examples.zh: 有些动物灭绝是因为它们无法适应不断变化的环境。

examples.en: I hurt my ankle yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天把脚踝扭伤了。

examples.en: We held a grand party in celebration of our school’s fiftieth anniversary.
examples.zh: 我们举行了一个盛大的聚会来庆祝我们学校成立 50 周年。

examples.en: anniversary celebrations
examples.zh: 周年庆典

examples.en: The captain announced that the plane was going to land.
examples.zh: 机长宣布飞机就要着陆了。

examples.en: Sir Robert made his announcement after talks with the President.
examples.zh: 在与总统会谈之后，罗伯特爵士发表了声明。

examples.en: A radio announcer may have an audience of millions.
examples.zh: 一个广播员可能拥有数百万名听众。

examples.en: He was so busy looking for a job these days that he failed to pass the final exam, which annoyed his teacher.
examples.zh: 他最近忙于找工作，结果没有通过期末考试，这让他的老师很生气。

items.explanation: 令人厌烦

examples.en: He bored his students with repeated stories about his travels in Europe.
examples.zh: 他总是大谈他在欧洲的旅游，令学生们感到厌烦。

items.explanation: 四个词均有“因某人或某事而打扰”的意思。注意：在表示客气、婉转的请求时，一般不用 worry，其他三个词可以互用。指病痛给人带来烦恼时，多用 trouble。在用于否定句时，这四个词的意义有所不同。

examples.en: May I bother/disturb/trouble you to close the window?
examples.zh: 劳驾您把窗子关上好吗？

examples.en: I have been troubled by a bad tooth recently.
examples.zh: 近来我因为一颗坏牙备受折磨。

examples.en: Don’t bother/trouble, thanks.
examples.zh: 别费心了，谢谢。

examples.en: Don’t disturb.
examples.zh: 请勿打扰。

examples.en: Don’t worry.
examples.zh: 别担心。

items.explanation: 使烦恼；打扰（指一次又一次地去打扰某人，而且通常是些小的、无关紧要的事）

examples.en: What annoys me most about my little brother is that he asks so many questions.
examples.zh: 我对我弟弟感到最烦的事是他老爱问问题。

a.name: be annoyed with sb. at sth.

examples.en: She will help Wendy prepare her annual report.
examples.zh: 她将帮助温迪准备她的年度报告。（普陀）

examples.en: a college annual
examples.zh: 大学年刊

examples.en: Would you like another orange?
examples.zh: 你还想要个橙子吗？

examples.en: The project was originally intended to raise money to help those children who couldn’t afford to go to school, but for one reason or another, it was given up halfway.
examples.zh: 这个项目的初衷是募资帮助那些上不起学的孩子，但由于种种原因半途而废了。

items.explanation: （泛指）另一个［作主语、宾语］；再，又，还

examples.en: I don’t want this bag. Show me another.
examples.zh: 我不要这只包，给我看看别的。

items.explanation: （泛指）别的［作定语］

examples.en: Other people may like it.
examples.zh: 别人也许喜欢它。

items.explanation: （泛指）别的人或物［作主语、宾语］

examples.en: Others may like it.
examples.zh: 其他人也许喜欢它。

a.name: It is good to learn at another man’s cost.

examples.en: Please remind me to answer that letter.
examples.zh: 请提醒我回复那封信。

examples.en: The maths teacher wonders if anyone knows the answer to the question.
examples.zh: 数学老师想知道是否有人知晓这个问题的答案。

items.explanation: 作名词和不及物动词，后接介词 to，多指经过考虑，对对方的问题和论点进行答复（较正式）。

examples.en: reply to the letter
examples.zh: 回信

items.explanation: 作名词和及物动词，是一般用词。

examples.en: answer the phone
examples.zh: 接电话

examples.en: There are many ants under the tree.
examples.zh: 这树下有许多蚂蚁。

examples.en: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.
examples.zh: 我们预料明年销售量将会增加。

examples.en: I just wrote an essay on antipollution.
examples.zh: 我刚刚就防止污染写了篇文章。

examples.en: The room is filled with antiques collected by the owner from all over the world.
examples.zh: 房间里堆满了主人从世界各地收集来的古董。（徐汇）

examples.en: This two-story hotel, whose antique charm is preserved, is located halfway up the mountain. Guests can easily reach the summit and visit the memorial hall at off-peak times.
examples.zh: 这个两层楼的酒店古色古香，坐落于半山腰，住店客人可以轻松登顶，并错峰参观纪念馆。（上海春考）

examples.en: He was waiting for his brother’s return with anxiety.
examples.zh: 他焦虑地等着兄弟归来。

examples.en: When I worked as a volunteer in Africa, my relatives and friends were anxious for my safe return.
examples.zh: 当我在非洲做志愿者工作时，我的亲朋好友都盼望我平安归来。

examples.en: There is no need to be anxious about the result.
examples.zh: 不必为结果而担心。

examples.en: We shouldn’t make friends with any dishonest persons.
examples.zh: 我们不应该和任何不诚实的人交朋友。

examples.en: Anybody can do if they try.
examples.zh: 如果肯尝试，人人都能做的。

examples.en: The cassettes were lying on the desk just anyhow.
examples.zh: 磁带都乱放在桌上。

examples.en: He noticed that he didn’t think about smoking anymore.
examples.zh: 他注意到自己不再想吸烟了。（徐汇）

examples.en: Only by reciting words is it impossible for anyone to get a good grade in the exam, not to mention the ability to communicate with foreigners.
examples.zh: 任何人仅凭背单词是不可能考出好成绩的，更不用说具有和外国人交流的能力了。

examples.en: Alice didn’t say anything at the meeting last week, did she?
examples.zh: 在上周的会议上爱丽丝什么都没说，是吗？

examples.en: Anyway, let’s face the reality.
examples.zh: 不管怎样，让我们面对现实。

examples.en: You can go anywhere you like.
examples.zh: 你可以去你喜欢的任何地方。

examples.en: The two buildings stand 500 metres apart.
examples.zh: 那两幢大楼相距 500 米。

examples.en: Apart from the fact that we went to the same school, we had absolutely nothing in common.
examples.zh: 除了上同一所学校这个事实以外，我们完全没有共同之处。

examples.en: As the housing price keeps rising sharply, many people who were born in the 1980’s have no alternative but to rent an apartment.
examples.zh: 随着房价的一路猛涨，许多八零后别无选择只得租房。

examples.en: Men descended from apes.
examples.zh: 人类起源于类人猿。

examples.en: We can’t ape their system.
examples.zh: 我们不能完全仿效他们的体系。

examples.en: You should apologise to the people present for what you have just done.
examples.zh: 你该就刚才的所作所为向在场的人道歉。

examples.en: He made an apology to the teacher for being late.
examples.zh: 他因迟到向老师道歉。

a.name: make/give/offer an apology to sb. for sth.

examples.en: You will need a little setup before you use the app offline.
examples.zh: 在离线使用这款应用程序前你需要先设置一下。

examples.en: It becomes apparent that he is going to die.
examples.zh: 很明显，他快要死了。

examples.en: Apparently, the elder sister differs completely from the younger one in appearance and character.
examples.zh: 很显然，姐姐在外貌和性格上与妹妹截然不同。

examples.en: Going abroad doesn’t appeal to the senior high school students at all.
examples.zh: 出国对于这些高中生来讲根本没有吸引力。

examples.en: The new fashion soon lost its appeal.
examples.zh: 那种新式样不久就失去了吸引力。

examples.en: They are appealing to local business for sponsorship money.
examples.zh: 他们正请求当地企业提供赞助资金。

examples.en: Does the idea of working abroad appeal to you?
examples.zh: 你对去国外工作这一想法感兴趣吗？

a.name: appeal to sb. to do sth.

examples.en: It appears that almost everyone is anxious to know the cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 看来，几乎人人都迫切想要了解事故的起因。

examples.en: The reason why The Voice of China appealed to audience of all ages was that it didn’t judge a person by his appearance.
examples.zh: 各年龄层的观众都喜欢《中国好声音》的原因是它不以貌取人。

examples.en: Experts suggest that elderly people should drink a little wine each day, because it can stimulate their appetite and help digestion, which is good for their health.
examples.zh: 专家建议上了年纪的人每天喝少许葡萄酒，因为葡萄酒可以开胃消食，有益健康。

examples.en: The audience warmly applauded the performers.
examples.zh: 观众向演员们热烈鼓掌。

examples.en: applaud loudly
examples.zh: 大声鼓掌

examples.en: Never had it occurred to him that he could stand out in the fierce competition and win so much applause and encouragement after over ten years of hard work.
examples.zh: 他从未想到自己经历十多年的努力后，终于能在激烈的竞争中脱颖而出，并赢得这么多的掌声和鼓励。

examples.en: I like apples better than pears.
examples.zh: 和梨比起来，我更爱吃苹果。

a.name: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
trans: 一天一苹果，医生远离我。

examples.en: Electrical appliances are very popular in China.
examples.zh: 电器在中国非常普及。

examples.en: It was his working experience in an IT company that enabled him to stand out among so many applicants.
examples.zh: 正是他在一家信息技术公司的工作经历才使他在众多的申请者中脱颖而出。

examples.en: The application of tablets to teaching may bring some benefits, but it will never completely replace the traditional way of learning.
examples.zh: 将平板电脑运用于教学会带来一些好处，但它无法完全替代传统的学习方式。

examples.en: New scientific discoveries are often applied to the production in industry and agriculture.
examples.zh: 科学新发现经常被用于工农业生产。

examples.en: The principle of diligence and frugality applies to all undertakings.
examples.zh: 勤俭节约的原则适用于一切事业。

examples.en: In this way they can better apply theory to practice.
examples.zh: 这样他们就能更好地把理论运用到实践中去。

examples.en: You have to apply to the school board for a scholarship.
examples.zh: 你得向校董事会申请奖学金。

examples.en: It is announced that Dr. Smith has been appointed to be president of that famous university.
examples.zh: 据宣布，史密斯博士已被任命为那所著名大学的校长。

examples.en: Have you an appointment?
examples.zh: 你有约了吗？

examples.en: We appreciate their effort in protecting the Shanghai dialect very much.
examples.zh: 我们非常感激他们为保护上海方言所付出的努力。

items.explanation: 指具有较高的修养，面对事物有深入的理解力。

examples.en: It is not easy to appreciate that symphony.
examples.zh: 这首交响乐不容易欣赏。

items.explanation: 仅指感官或智力上的乐趣和满足，“享受”的意味较强。

examples.en: Normally he enjoyed these fits of Irish.
examples.zh: 他通常很欣赏爱尔兰情调。

examples.en: Appreciation of works of art is bound to be dominated by a particular kind of interest.
examples.zh: 对于艺术作品的欣赏必然受到一种特别的兴趣爱好的支配。

examples.en: It is not surprising that shopping centres are crowded with people when Christmas is approaching.
examples.zh: 圣诞节来临，购物中心人潮涌动，这已经不足为奇了。

examples.en: My own work follows this approach.
examples.zh: 我自己的研究工作就遵循这个方法。

examples.en: Sports shoes are not appropriate for a formal meeting.
examples.zh: 在正式会面中穿运动鞋是不合适的。

examples.en: The mayor was assured that the new policy would benefit the citizens a lot, so he approved it in spite of the objection from other government officials.
examples.zh: 市长相信新政策能让市民获益良多，因此不顾其他政府官员的反对而批准了它。

examples.en: She approved of the scheme but not without several qualifications.
examples.zh: 她批准了这项计划，但附加了几个条件。

examples.en: China is the world's most populous country with a population of 1.4 billion, which makes up approximately one fifth of the world population.
examples.zh: 中国是世界人口最多的国家，有14亿，约占世界总人口的五分之一。

examples.en: We went to France last April.
examples.zh: 去年4月我们去了法国。

examples.en: That arch has a span of 70 metres.
examples.zh: 那个拱的跨度为70米。

examples.en: Don't arch your back, keep your spine straight.
examples.zh: 别佝着背，把腰挺直。

examples.en: I heard that he was an architect.
examples.zh: 我听说他是位建筑师。

examples.en: He majored in architecture when he was studying in the university.
examples.zh: 他上大学时的专业是建筑学。

examples.en: It takes a large amount of money to explore the Arctic Ocean.
examples.zh: 探索北冰洋需要巨大的费用。

examples.en: They flew over the unlimited reaches of the Arctic.
examples.zh: 他们飞过了茫茫无边的北极上空。

examples.en: China is large in area and population, and there are fifty-six nationalities.
examples.zh: 中国地域广阔，人口众多，有56个民族。

items.explanation: 范围；区域；面积；地区；空地（指自然分界的地区）

examples.en: mountainous area
examples.zh: 多山地区

items.explanation: 区域；地方；（世界上某个特定的）地区；（艺术、科学等的）领域；（大气、海水等的）层

examples.en: an autonomous region
examples.zh: 自治区

items.explanation: 区域；地方；管区；行政区

examples.en: She doesn't live in this district.
examples.zh: 她不住在这个区。

items.explanation: 区域；地带；地区；环带，圈（指有某一特征、目的或用途的地区）

examples.en: the torrid zone
examples.zh: 热带

examples.en: Nowadays, an increasing number of people argue that seeking fashion too much is equal to abandoning one's freedom of choice.
examples.zh: 现在有越来越多的人认为，过分地追求时尚其实是放弃了自己的选择自由。

examples.en: The argument contained herein takes exactly the opposite point of view.
examples.zh: 本文所持的论点恰恰是站在相反的立场。

examples.en: Some problems have arisen in the process of project investment.
examples.zh: 在项目投资的过程中出现了一些问题。

items.explanation: 作“出现，发生”解时，主语多为较抽象概念的东西。如：situation、difficulty、question、problem 等。

examples.en: Whatever troubles arise, we'll have peace of mind amidst seeming chaos.
examples.zh: 无论出现什么样的麻烦，我们都会在貌似混乱的情形中保持平和的心态。

items.explanation: 作“升高，向上去”解时，往往指有形的东西。

examples.en: The sun has risen.
examples.zh: 太阳已经升起。

examples.en: I'm good at arithmetic.
examples.zh: 我对算术很在行。

examples.en: He hurt his arm in the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 他在运动会上伤了手臂。

examples.en: lay down arms
examples.zh: 放下武器

examples.en: She thought that if she armed herself with all the knowledge she could gather she would be able to handle anything.
examples.zh: 她以为，如果获取了所有能学到的知识，就能处理任何事。

examples.en: They joined the army when they were 18.
examples.zh: 他们18岁时参了军。

examples.en: Furniture in the classroom should not be changed around without warning the blind child.
examples.zh: 教室中的桌椅如需要挪动，应事先告诉这个盲童。

examples.en: Around half of the students in school are keen on playing games on cell phones.
examples.zh: 学校里约半数的学生热衷于玩手机游戏。

examples.en: It has aroused a heated discussion among education experts whether the new reform of college entrance examination can reduce students' academic burden.
examples.zh: 新的高考改革能否减轻学生学业负担，这引起了教育专家们的热议。

examples.en: At dawn the farmers began to arouse.
examples.zh: 拂晓时分，农民们开始起身。

examples.en: In order not to be isolated from society, many retired people participate in activities arranged by communities.
examples.zh: 为了不与社会脱节，许多退休人员参与了社区组织的活动。

examples.en: I have arranged with the neighbours about taking care of the cat.
examples.zh: 我已和邻居们商量好照顾猫的事情。

examples.en: Many people have expressed their dissatisfaction with the arrangement.
examples.zh: 许多人对这一安排表示不满。

examples.en: The police arrested three youths yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天警方拘捕了3名青年。

examples.en: The police have the power of arrest.
examples.zh: 警方有权拘捕。

examples.en: You are supposed to pay right after the arrival of the goods.
examples.zh: 货到后，你应立即付款。

examples.en: Whoever arrives the latest will have to pay for today's dinner.
examples.zh: 谁到得最晚，就得为今天的晚餐买单。

examples.en: An arrow is stuck on the wall so that patients won't take the wrong way.
examples.zh: 为防止病人走错，墙上贴了箭头。

examples.en: AI has gradually integrated into creative arts, filling life with a delightful surprise.
examples.zh: 人工智能已经逐渐融入创意艺术，让生活充满惊喜。（青浦）

examples.en: The newly-built art museum will be open to citizens for free from the beginning of next year.
examples.zh: 新建成的美术馆将从明年初开始免费对市民开放。

a.name: Art is long, but life is short.

examples.en: After the interview, the reporter decided to write an article on school buses in China.
examples.zh: 记者在采访后决定写一篇关于中国校车的文章。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is far from all-powerful, both at present time and for the foreseeable future.
examples.zh: 在当前乃至未来的很长一段时间，人工智能远非无所不能。（嘉定）

examples.en: I want to be an artist when I grow up.
examples.zh: 长大后我想当一名艺术家。

examples.en: As is known to all, cutting down a large number of trees has disastrous effects on the balance of nature.
examples.zh: 众所周知，大量砍树对自然平衡有灾难性的影响。

examples.en: As a volunteer, I can help others and make friends with them.
examples.zh: 作为一名志愿者，我能帮助别人，并与他们交朋友。

examples.en: As far as I know, he will be away for three months.
examples.zh: 据我所知，他将离开3个月。

examples.en: Our campus extends as far as the river.
examples.zh: 我们的校园一直延伸到河边。

examples.en: cigarette ash
examples.zh: 烟灰

examples.en: I behaved badly yesterday and I am ashamed of myself now.
examples.zh: 我昨天表现不好，我现在感到很惭愧。

examples.en: He's travelled widely, chiefly in Africa and Asia.
examples.zh: 他游历了许多地方，主要在非洲和亚洲。

examples.en: A brand new revolution is happening in Asian education, which seems that digital transformation is a trend and a must in the future.
examples.zh: 亚洲教育正在发生一场崭新的革命，数字化转型看起来势在必行。

examples.en: There were two little girls, one Asian and one with blonde hair.
examples.zh: 那里有两个小女孩，一个是亚洲女孩，一个是金发女孩。

examples.en: She sets aside some money monthly in case of need.
examples.zh: 每月她都会留出一部分钱以备不时之需。

examples.en: The interviewer asked him many questions during the interview in order to see whether he was capable of doing scientific research.
examples.zh: 考官在面试时问了他很多问题，为的是了解他是否能胜任科学研究工作。

examples.en: It is impolite to ask about the salaries of others.
examples.zh: 打听别人的工资是不礼貌的。

examples.en: You'd better not drink any strong tea before you go to bed, which will make it difficult for you to fall asleep.
examples.zh: 睡觉前最好不要喝浓茶，这会使你难以入睡。

examples.en: This guiding robot, which has improved in many aspects, can not only provide visitors with the information they need, but also take them to their destination.
examples.zh: 这个导览机器人在很多方面有了改进，不仅可以为参观者提供所需的信息，而且能带他们去目的地。（崇明）

examples.en: Aspirin doesn't work on my headache.
examples.zh: 阿司匹林对我的头痛没用。

examples.en: The whole class assembled in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 全班在会议室集合。

examples.en: They assessed a tax of $100 on him.
examples.zh: 他们向他征税100美元。

examples.en: Assign your students to the job.
examples.zh: 派你的学生去完成这项工作。

examples.en: The students assisted the teacher to collect exercise books.
examples.zh: 学生们帮助老师收练习本。

examples.en: From the customer's body language, the shop assistant can exactly know what he wants to buy, which amazes the customer very much.
examples.zh: 从顾客的肢体语言，这个售货员就能知道他想买什么，这让那位顾客十分惊讶。

examples.en: We associate China with the Great Wall.
examples.zh: 我们想起中国，就联想到长城。

examples.en: More than 60 social associations will take part in this art festival, which sounds great.
examples.zh: 有60多个社会团体将参与本次艺术节，这听起来太棒了。

examples.en: Assuming that the work is finished ahead of time, what do you think we should do next?
examples.zh: 假定这份工作提前完成，你认为我们下一步该怎么办？

examples.en: The deal is worth $9 billion including the assumption of debt.
examples.zh: 该交易总价值为90亿美元，包括承担债务在内。

examples.en: The doctor assured the patient that he would be fine as long as he took medicine on time.
examples.zh: 医生向病人保证，只要他按时服药就没有大碍。（金山）

examples.en: He assured us of his ability to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 他向我们保证他有能力解决这个问题。

examples.en: His great scientific discovery astonished the world.
examples.zh: 他的重大科学发现震惊了世界。

items.explanation: (= surprise greatly) 特指因看到不可解释的现象，发生不可能发生的事而惊讶，持续时间较长。

examples.en: Her dedication constantly astonishes me.
examples.zh: 她的奉献精神总是让我震惊。

items.explanation: 语气较弱，多指由于突然的、出乎意料的事而惊奇，常指短暂的惊愕。

examples.en: I was more than surprised. (= I was astonished.)
examples.zh: 我大吃一惊。

examples.en: This female scholar, originally deeply engaged in the field of scientific research, has eventually become an astronaut through her persistent efforts and extremely strict training.
examples.zh: 这位原本深耕于科研领域的女学者，凭借自己坚持不懈的努力，历经极度严苛的训练，最终成为了一名宇航员。（奉贤）

examples.en: That ordinary-looking old man turns out to be a famous astronomer.
examples.zh: 那位相貌平平的老大爷竟是知名的天文学家。

examples.en: He survived the accident, and at that time he narrowly escaped being hit by the car.
examples.zh: 他从车祸中幸存下来，当时他差点被车撞到。

a.name: What may be done at any time will be done at no time.
trans: 明日待明日，明日不再来。

examples.en: Generally speaking, the more athletes there are competing in the game, the more difficult it will be to win a prize.
examples.zh: 一般来说，参加比赛的运动员越多，获得奖项就越困难。

examples.en: They have been given college scholarships purely on athletic ability.
examples.zh: 他们完全是凭体育特长才获得了大学奖学金。

examples.en: the Atlantic (Ocean)
examples.zh: 大西洋

examples.en: Many artists went out onto the streets to spread various art forms and convey positive energy, enriching the city's cultural atmosphere.
examples.zh: 不少艺术家走上街头，传播多种艺术形式的同时，也传递正能量，为城市增添了浓厚的文化氛围。（虹口）

examples.en: the power of the atom
examples.zh: 原子动力

examples.en: a letter attached with a file
examples.zh: 另附文件的信件

examples.en: A moral obligation attaches to high rank.
examples.zh: 道义上的责任是和高级职位联系在一起的。

examples.en: Some areas of Sichuan Province were attacked by violent earthquakes, which took many people's lives.
examples.zh: 四川部分地区遭受了强烈的地震，许多人丧生。

examples.en: Faced with more and more serious terrorist attack, many governments have determined to unite together to eliminate terrorist organizations.
examples.zh: 面对越来越严重的恐怖袭击，许多国家决意联手铲除恐怖组织。

examples.en: One of the educational objectives of school is to attain a balanced development of students.
examples.zh: 学校教育的目的之一是使学生得到均衡发展。

examples.en: The boys attempted to leave for camping but were stopped by their parents.
examples.zh: 男孩们想去野营但被他们的父母拦住了。

examples.en: He failed in his attempt at winning the first prize in the singing contest.
examples.zh: 他试图在歌咏比赛中得头奖，但失败了。

discriminations.intro: 这两个词是同义词，都可以用作动词。

items.explanation: 指做自己希望会成功的事，常常包含冒险的意义。

examples.en: It won't be a long time before any astronaut's landing on Mars can be attempted.
examples.zh: 宇航员试图在火星上着陆不是一件遥远的事。

items.explanation: 指致力于做可能成功也可能失败的某件事。try 比 attempt 普通得多，并不包含冒险的意思。在口语中使用 try 比使用 attempt 显得浅近通俗。但这两个词有着明显的差异：try 表示试一试，意即欲证明或检验某件事，这是 attempt 所不能表达的。

examples.en: You can try on the new coat.
examples.zh: 这件新上衣，你可以试一试。

examples.en: By the way, do you consider attending the concert the day after tomorrow?
examples.zh: 顺便问一下，你考虑去听后天的音乐会吗？

a.name: attend on the very sick patient

examples.en: More and more senior high school students start to pay attention to their career planning.
examples.zh: 越来越多的高中生开始关注他们的职业规划。

examples.en: For the unemployed, what matters is to keep a positive attitude and keep learning to improve their competitiveness in the job market.
examples.zh: 对失业者来说，重要的是保持积极的心态，不断学习，提升自己在就业市场上的竞争力。（崇明）

examples.en: Deepwater Horizon, which is based on a true story, has attracted a large audience with its realistic special effects.
examples.zh: 据真实故事改编的电影《深海浩劫》以其逼真的特效，吸引了许多观众。

examples.en: This movie has sparked the curiosity of the foreign audiences toward the Chinese language and culture.
examples.zh: 这部电影激发了外国观众对汉语及中国文化的好奇心。（青浦）

examples.en: The stage design of the concert is known for its innovation and high-tech elements, bringing the audience a unique audio-visual experience.
examples.zh: 这场演唱会的舞台设计以创新和高科技元素而闻名，给观众带来独特的视听感受。（徐汇）

examples.en: Between July and August, oil product prices fell 0.2 per cent.
examples.zh: 七八月间，石油产品价格下降了0.2%。

examples.en: Aunt May is my mother's younger sister.
examples.zh: 梅姨是我妈妈的妹妹。

examples.en: The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.
examples.zh: 袋鼠原产于澳大利亚。

examples.en: The Australian in lane four is coming up fast from behind.
examples.zh: 第四道的澳大利亚选手正从后面快速追赶上来。

examples.en: She spoke with a strong Australian accent.
examples.zh: 她说话带有浓重的澳大利亚口音。

examples.en: It was in this second-hand bookstore that I came across the author of this book.
examples.zh: 正是在这家二手书店里我偶遇了该书的作者。

examples.en: The teacher has authority in his class.
examples.zh: 这个老师在他班上很有权威。

examples.en: We need a new auto.
examples.zh: 我们需要一辆新车。

examples.en: Audience who attended the industrial exhibition all sang the praises of the family automatic alarm system promoted by this exhibitor.
examples.zh: 参与本次工业展览会的观众无不对这家参展商所推广的家庭自动报警系统赞不绝口。

examples.en: The full name of Xinjiang is Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.
examples.zh: 新疆的全称是新疆维吾尔自治区。

examples.en: Leaves fall off the trees in autumn.
examples.zh: 在秋天，叶子从树上掉下来。

examples.en: Obviously, this kind of information is available on the Internet.
examples.zh: 显然你可以在互联网上获得这种信息。

examples.en: That is Madison Avenue.
examples.zh: 那就是麦迪逊大街。

examples.en: What was the average temperature last week?
examples.zh: 上周平均气温是多少？

examples.en: He is just an average student in the class, but his school work is well above the average.
examples.zh: 他只是班上的一个普通学生，但他的学业远在平均水平之上。

senses.trans: 平均做（或得到、生产、分担等）

examples.en: The writer averages two novels a month.
examples.zh: 那位作家平均一个月写两本小说。

examples.en: We averaged 42 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 我们的平均时速是每小时42英里。

items.explanation: 一般的，普通的（强调中等的、处于平均状态的）

examples.en: He is a young man of average height.
examples.zh: 他是个中等身材的年轻男子。

items.explanation: 普通的，通常的（强调因随处可见而不足为奇）

examples.en: Zhang is the most common name in China.
examples.zh: “张”是中国最普通的姓氏。

items.explanation: 一般的，大体的（强调普遍存在于大多数人或事物之中，较少例外）

examples.en: The police had a general idea about the accident after a careful investigation.
examples.zh: 警察通过认真调查，对事故有了大体的了解。

items.explanation: 普通的，平常的（强调平凡，没有特殊和例外）

examples.en: The foreign guests like to visit some ordinary families in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 外国客人想要拜访一些上海的普通家庭。

items.explanation: 正常的，规范的（强调符合某标准或一般常规）

examples.en: The normal temperature of the human body is 37°C.
examples.zh: 人体的正常体温是37°C。

items.explanation: 规则的，固定的（强调按一定的规律定期发生）

examples.en: She leads a regular life.
examples.zh: 她过着有规律的生活。

examples.en: If people are more careful with/in using home appliances, many accidents can be avoided.
examples.zh: 如果人们使用家电时更小心一些，许多事故是可以避免的。

items.explanation: 指“脱离或避开即将来临或近在眼前的伤害、危险、灾祸等事物”，常作借喻用。

examples.en: escape death
examples.zh: 脱离死亡

items.explanation: 强调“有意识地躲避不愉快的或可能发生危险的事物或情况”。

examples.en: I cannot avoid meeting her.
examples.zh: 我怎么也避不开她。

examples.en: I am awaiting the results of the final examinations.
examples.zh: 我在等待期末考试成绩。

examples.en: He is awake to the serious problem.
examples.zh: 他已意识到了这个严重的问题。

examples.en: awake from sleep
examples.zh: 从睡梦中醒来

examples.en: awake sb.'s sympathy
examples.zh: 唤起某人的同情心

discriminations.intro: 这三个词均可作不及物动词，意为“醒来”；作及物动词，意为“叫醒”；用于引申，意为“唤醒，觉醒”。注意正确掌握这三个词的过去式和过去分词的变化：awake, awoke, awoken/awaked；wake, woke, woken/waked；awaken, awakened, awakened。

items.explanation: 可作不及物动词（醒来）、及物动词（叫醒），用于引申意为“唤醒，觉醒”。过去式和过去分词：awoke, awoken/awaked。

examples.en: Old people usually wake/awake/awaken early in the morning.
examples.zh: 老人通常早晨很早醒来。

items.explanation: 可作不及物动词（醒来）、及物动词（叫醒，常与 up 连用），用于引申意为“唤醒，觉醒”。过去式和过去分词：woke, woken/waked。

examples.en: Don't forget to wake me up (或 awake/awaken me) at 5 a.m. tomorrow.
examples.zh: 别忘了明天早晨5点钟叫醒我。

items.explanation: 可作不及物动词（醒来）、及物动词（叫醒），用于引申意为“唤醒，觉醒”。过去式和过去分词：awakened, awakened。

examples.en: The photo show woke/awoke/awakened my interest in photography.
examples.zh: 这次摄影展唤起了我对摄影的兴趣。

examples.en: People must be awakened to the danger of these chemical weapons.
examples.zh: 一定要让人们认识到这些化学武器的危险性。

examples.en: She usually awakens several times during the night.
examples.zh: 她通常夜里会醒几次。

a.name: awaken sb. to ...
trans: 唤起某人对……的认识，使某人认识到

examples.en: Madam Curie was awarded the 1903 Nobel Prize for Physics for her discovery of the element radium.
examples.zh: 居里夫人由于发现了镭元素而获得1903年诺贝尔物理奖。

examples.en: literary awards
examples.zh: 文学奖项

items.explanation: 作名词：报酬，回报（指因某人付出而得到的回报）；作动词：报答，酬劳

examples.en: Students' good work is the best reward to a teacher.
examples.zh: 学生的优异成绩是对老师最好的回报。

examples.en: We rewarded the lady for her good service in our dormitory building.
examples.zh: 我们为这位女士在我们宿舍楼出色的服务工作予以酬谢。

items.explanation: 作名词：奖品（指某人赢得的奖品，通常是精神奖励）；作动词：授予，给予

examples.en: Jack won the first award in the maths contest.
examples.zh: 杰克在数学竞赛中获得一等奖。

examples.en: The president awarded a doctor's degree to Owen.
examples.zh: 校长向欧文授予博士学位。

examples.en: With the release of the film Interstellar, people are more and more aware of the environmental crisis that the Earth is facing and thus begin to take action together to save the Earth.
examples.zh: 随着电影《星际穿越》的上映，人们越来越意识到地球所面临的环境危机，从而开始一起行动起来去拯救地球。

discriminations.intro: 这三个词都含有“意识到的”的意思。

items.explanation: 侧重指感官所意识到的（外界事物）。

examples.en: Everybody is aware of the importance of environmental protection.
examples.zh: 每个人都意识到了环境保护的重要性。

items.explanation: 侧重指心理感知到的。

examples.en: He is conscious of having made a mistake.
examples.zh: 他感到自己犯了个错误。

items.explanation: 指可用感官察觉到的（较复杂或抽象的事物）。

examples.en: I was sensible of her solemn grief.
examples.zh: 我知道她很悲伤。

examples.en: I am well aware of the difficulties we face.
examples.zh: 我非常清楚我们面临的困难。

examples.en: Remember to keep your cell phone on when you're away from home alone.
examples.zh: 当你独自在外时，记得让手机保持开机状态。

examples.en: The grandeur of the Grand Canyon is awesome.
examples.zh: 科罗拉多大峡谷雄伟壮丽，令人惊叹。

examples.en: awful weather
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气

examples.en: He put me in an awkward position.
examples.zh: 他把我弄得很狼狈。

examples.en: The cost of his children's education is a great drain on his money.
examples.zh: 孩子的教育花了他很多钱。

examples.en: My eyes haven't adjusted to the dark yet.
examples.zh: 我的眼睛还没有适应黑暗。

examples.en: This ticket will admit one adult and two kids to the show.
examples.zh: 这张票允许一个大人和两个小孩入场观展。

examples.en: We managed to fulfill the task ahead of time.
examples.zh: 我们做到了提前完成任务。

examples.en: His parents won't approve of his dropping out of high school.
examples.zh: 他的父母不会赞成他高中辍学。

examples.en: There's just one last favor I need to ask of you.
examples.zh: 还有最后一件事要你帮忙。

examples.en: Don't forget to ask after your aunt when you see Tom this evening.
examples.zh: 你今天晚上看见汤姆时，别忘记问候你的姑母。

a.name: associate A with B
trans: 把 A 和 B 联系起来

examples.en: What do you associate with such a heavy snow?
examples.zh: 你对这样一场大雪有什么联想？

examples.en: We are determined to defend our motherland at all costs.
examples.zh: 我们决心不惜任何代价保卫祖国。

examples.en: Any company that makes only small cars is at the mercy of world gas prices.
examples.zh: 任何一个只制造小型汽车的公司都受到世界汽油价格的支配。

examples.en: The rescue team is searching for the missing ship at the risk of their lives.
examples.zh: 救援队正冒着生命危险搜寻失踪的船只。

examples.en: The field is used by horses from the riding school that is attached to the farm.
examples.zh: 这块地供农场附属骑术学校的马匹使用。

examples.en: Whatever I do, I always attach importance to efficiency.
examples.zh: 无论我做什么，我总是注重效率。

examples.en: He was awarded a medal for his contribution to world peace.
examples.zh: 他由于为世界和平做出贡献而获得一枚奖章。

examples.en: Please walk as gently as possible because her two babies are sleeping in the room.
examples.zh: 走路时请尽量轻一点，因为她的两个小孩正在房间里睡觉。

examples.en: The flat contained the basic essentials for bachelor life.
examples.zh: 那套公寓配有单身生活的基本必需品。

examples.en: My grandma hurt her back.
examples.zh: 我祖母背部受伤了。

examples.en: back onto the road
examples.zh: 倒车驶上公路

examples.en: the back door
examples.zh: 后门

examples.en: Please stand back.
examples.zh: 请往后站。

examples.en: No matter how large the differences are in race, family background, culture and education, we should learn to be tolerant and respect others' thoughts and ideas.
examples.zh: 不论种族、家庭背景、文化和教育的差异有多大，我们都应该学会宽容，学会尊重他人的观念和想法。

examples.en: We often raise money for the people living in backward areas.
examples.zh: 我们时常为贫困地区的人募集钱款。

examples.en: The choice is between the right change and the wrong change, between going forward and going backward.
examples.zh: 要在正确的改变和错误的改变之间，在前进和倒退之间做出选择。

examples.en: She tucked into a breakfast of bacon and eggs.
examples.zh: 她大口地吃着培根和鸡蛋做成的早餐。

examples.en: If you wash your hands with soap, you can get rid of more than ninety-five percent of the bacteria on your hand.
examples.zh: 用肥皂洗手，可以洗掉手上 95% 以上的细菌。

examples.en: It was the bad weather that discouraged many people who had entered for the competition from turning up on the game site.
examples.zh: 正是因为天气糟糕，才让很多已经报名参赛的人没能出现在比赛现场。

examples.en: She went on working though her arm ached badly.
examples.zh: 尽管她的手臂痛得厉害，她仍坚持工作。

examples.en: She's been badly again.
examples.zh: 她又病了。

examples.en: Badminton can be played by two or four people.
examples.zh: 羽毛球可由两人或四人来打。

examples.en: He didn't want to tell me how much the bag cost.
examples.zh: 他不想告诉我这只包他花了多少钱。

examples.en: a baggage check
examples.zh: 行李票

examples.en: The bread is baking.
examples.zh: 面包正在烘烤。

examples.en: This bakery is big.
examples.zh: 这家面包店很大。

examples.en: He kept his balance with his arms on top of desks. A few minutes later, he suddenly lost his balance and fell down to the ground.
examples.zh: 他在桌上用手臂保持平衡。几分钟后，他突然失去平衡，跌倒在地。

examples.en: She can walk while balancing a book on her head.
examples.zh: 她能头顶一本书保持平衡走路。

examples.en: a meat ball
examples.zh: 肉丸

examples.en: a fancy ball
examples.zh: 化装舞会

examples.en: I enjoy the classical ballet very much.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢古典芭蕾。

examples.en: He gave the little girl some balloons.
examples.zh: 他送了一些气球给那个小女孩。

examples.en: Tourists often come to this hill to go ballooning.
examples.zh: 游客经常到这座小山上乘坐热气球。

examples.en: This is a new kind of bamboo.
examples.zh: 这是新品种的竹子。

examples.en: He was banned from entering the city.
examples.zh: 他被禁止入城。

examples.en: Do bear in mind that the government has put a ban on smoking in public places.
examples.zh: 务必牢记政府已经下令禁止公共场所吸烟。

examples.en: Is banana your favorite fruit?
examples.zh: 香蕉是你最喜欢的水果吗？

examples.en: a military band
examples.zh: 军乐队

examples.en: A yellow band of light poured on the street from an open door.
examples.zh: 一束黄色的灯光从开着的门投射到街上。

examples.en: We need more bandages.
examples.zh: 我们需要更多绷带。

examples.en: The doctor bandaged the cut finger for her.
examples.zh: 医生帮她用绷带包扎割破的手指。

examples.en: A river flows between its banks.
examples.zh: 河水在两岸之间流动。

items.explanation: 河岸

examples.en: The old man used to sit on the river bank to fish.
examples.zh: 那位老人过去常常坐在河岸边钓鱼。

items.explanation: 海岸

examples.en: The city of Haikou lies on the coast of South Sea.
examples.zh: 海口市位于南海海岸。

items.explanation: 海滨（尤指度假胜地）

examples.en: Many British people like to go to the seaside for their holidays.
examples.zh: 许多英国人喜欢去海滨度假。

items.explanation: 海滩，海滨

examples.en: The children are playing with sand along the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子们在海滩上玩沙。

items.explanation: 岸，滨

examples.en: They saw a boat about a mile from the shore.
examples.zh: 他们看到在离海岸大约 1 英里处有条小船。

examples.en: Whether he applies to the bank for a loan or borrows money from his friends and relatives, it will be difficult for him to carry out his expansion programme into practice.
examples.zh: 无论是向银行申请贷款还是向亲朋好友借钱，他都很难实施自己的扩建方案。

examples.en: a bar of chocolate
examples.zh: 一条巧克力

trans: 售酒（或食物、饮料）的柜台

examples.en: He invited several friends to the ranch for a barbecue.
examples.zh: 他邀请几位朋友到农场举行烤肉野餐。

examples.en: We barbecued several pieces of chicken for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们烤了几块鸡肉当作晚餐。

examples.en: the barber's
examples.zh: 理发店

examples.en: bare legs
examples.zh: 光腿

examples.en: I barely had time to have breakfast.
examples.zh: 我几乎没时间吃早饭。

examples.en: The cost of tuition and the availability of financial aid are other considerations, with public institutions generally a better financial bargain than private ones.
examples.zh: 学费开销及能否获得经济援助是其他考虑因素，公共机构通常比私人机构更便宜。（闵行）

examples.en: They prefer to bargain with individual clients, for cash.
examples.zh: 在现款方面，他们更愿意同散户打交道。

examples.en: He barked at me, "I can't bear living alone."
examples.zh: 他对我咆哮地说：“我受不了一个人独居。”

examples.en: A policeman held his gun in both hands and barked an order.
examples.zh: 警察双手握枪，厉声发出指令。

examples.en: Instead of a bark, the dog greeted him with a waggle of its tail.
examples.zh: 这条狗见了他没有叫，只是摇了摇尾巴。

examples.en: The football fans broke through the barriers and rushed onto the court.
examples.zh: 足球迷冲破栅栏进入球场。

examples.en: He used the history of the rich family as a base for his novel.
examples.zh: 他把一家大户人家的历史作为他小说的素材。

senses.trans: 把……放置在基座（或底座）上

examples.en: The pop song which is popular with students is based on a charming folk song.
examples.zh: 这首深受学生喜欢的流行歌曲是根据一首动人的民歌创作的。

examples.en: play baseball
examples.zh: 打棒球

examples.en: They live in a basement flat in north London.
examples.zh: 他们住在伦敦北部的一所地下公寓里。

examples.en: basic principles
examples.zh: 基本原则

examples.en: We were given a basin of water to wash our hands in.
examples.zh: 有人给了我们一盆洗手的水。

examples.en: They want all groups to be treated on an equal basis.
examples.zh: 他们希望对待所有的团体都能做到一视同仁。

examples.en: a basket of fruit
examples.zh: 一篮水果

examples.en: I used to play basketball.
examples.zh: 我过去常打篮球。

examples.en: He bat well.
examples.zh: 他是个击球能手。

examples.en: a tennis bat
examples.zh: 一支网球拍

examples.en: The bat isn't a bird.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠不是鸟。

examples.en: She has a bath every day.
examples.zh: 她每天洗澡。

examples.en: For super-soft skin, lather on a light body lotion after you bathe.
examples.zh: 皮肤极柔嫩者，可在沐浴后涂上温和的护肤露。

examples.en: The master bedroom has its own en suite bathroom.
examples.zh: 主卧室带有独立卫生间。

examples.en: In standby mode, the battery lasts about 10 days.
examples.zh: 在待机状态下，电池大约可持续 10 天。

examples.en: Many soldiers died in the battle.
examples.zh: 在这次战役中死了许多士兵。

examples.en: They battle against difficulties.
examples.zh: 他们和困难作斗争。

examples.en: They're also battling the government to win compensation.
examples.zh: 他们也在跟政府交涉以争取补偿。

examples.en: the Bay of Bengal
examples.zh: 孟加拉湾

examples.en: in the year of 500 BC
examples.zh: 在公元前 500 年

examples.en: Being exposed to a great many books contributes to our growth.
examples.zh: 阅读大量书籍有助于我们的成长。

examples.en: Shall we have a picnic on the beach?
examples.zh: 我们去海滩野餐好吗？

examples.en: Soya beans are very nutritious.
examples.zh: 大豆很有营养。

examples.en: With a long history, bean curd is rooted deep in Chinese culture.
examples.zh: 豆腐有悠久的历史，深深地扎根于中国的文化。

examples.en: He bore the pain bravely.
examples.zh: 他勇敢地忍着疼痛。

discriminations.intro: 这三个词都有“忍受”的意思，常可以通用，都可以与 can 连用。用于疑问句或否定句时，表示不忍、不愿，但 endure 一般只用于非常严重的情况，指长时间忍受痛苦。

items.explanation: 作“忍受”解，常可与 stand、endure 通用，可与 can 连用；用于疑问句或否定句时，表示不忍、不愿。

examples.en: I can't bear your nagging.
examples.zh: 我受不了你的唠叨。

items.explanation: 作“忍受”解，常可与 bear、endure 通用，可与 can 连用；用于疑问句或否定句时，表示不忍、不愿。

examples.en: I can stand a certain amount of foolery.
examples.zh: 一定限度的愚蠢行为我尚能容忍。

items.explanation: 作“忍受”解，一般只用于非常严重的情况，指长时间忍受痛苦。

examples.en: She had endured great pain for several years.
examples.zh: 她忍受极大的痛苦已有好多年了。

examples.en: Students are expected to bear in mind what teachers say in class.
examples.zh: 学生应该记住老师在课堂上所讲的内容。

examples.en: What a fierce bear it is!
examples.zh: 多凶猛的熊啊！

examples.en: a man with the beard
examples.zh: 留大胡子的男人

examples.en: The lion is called the king of all beasts.
examples.zh: 狮子被称为百兽之王。

examples.en: We won't be able to beat the opponents unless we work together.
examples.zh: 我们若不齐心协力，将无法战胜对手。

examples.en: His heart beats too fast.
examples.zh: 他的心跳动太快了。

examples.en: It's got four beats to a bar.
examples.zh: 一个小节有 4 拍。

items.explanation: 两词均可指“在竞技、竞争或竞赛中击败对手”，后面跟对手或比赛的队伍。

examples.en: To my amazement, the robot beat/defeated the chess master.
examples.zh: 我感到惊讶，机器人击败了象棋大师。

items.explanation: 赢得（后面常跟比赛、战争等名词）

examples.en: win a game
examples.zh: 赢一场比赛

examples.en: win a war
examples.zh: 赢一场战争

items.explanation: 一般指连续性地击打，也指在游戏、竞赛或战争中击败对方。

examples.en: A caged bird was beating the air with its wings.
examples.zh: 笼中鸟不断拍打着翅膀。

items.explanation: 同义，都有“打击，击中；撞击，冲击”的意思。

examples.en: He was hit/struck by a ball and fell off his bike.
examples.zh: 他被一个球击中，从自行车上跌落。

examples.en: The girl hit/struck her head against the floor when she fell.
examples.zh: 这个女孩跌倒时头撞在地板上。

examples.en: No scenery is more beautiful than what I am enjoying here.
examples.zh: 没有什么风景能比得上我现在看到的景色。

discriminations.intro: 这四个词都有“好看的，漂亮的”的意思。

items.explanation: 可以修饰人（不修饰男人）和物。它所表示的“美丽”包括美学上所讲的美。

examples.en: "Why are you doing that?" Sally asked. "To make myself beautiful," the lady answered.
examples.zh: “你为什么干这个呀？”沙莉问道。“使自己漂亮呀，”那妇人回答道。

examples.en: We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
examples.zh: 我们现在住在农村一座美丽的新房子里。

items.explanation: 修饰的人多半是英俊、健壮的男性，有时用来形容女性的仪态端庄、高贵。

examples.en: He is a handsome man.
examples.zh: 他是一位美男子。

examples.en: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
examples.zh: 最漂亮的汽车之一，是一辆劳斯莱斯银魅汽车。

items.explanation: 不仅含有使人赏心悦目的意思，而且还含有能够刺激强烈感情的意思。这种感情上的喜悦可以是视觉的感受，也可以是嗅觉或触觉的感受。

examples.en: She is a lovely woman.
examples.zh: 她是位美丽动人的女子。

examples.en: It's a lovely vase. Those flowers are lovely, too.
examples.zh: 这是个美丽的花瓶，那些花也美丽。

items.explanation: 表示以其娇嫩、端庄、迷人等品质使人感到愉快，但并不强调外形的完善或风格的典雅，通常不用 pretty 来修饰庞然大物或身材高大的女子，因为这个词暗含小巧玲珑的意思。

examples.en: Those girls are very pretty.
examples.zh: 那些姑娘很漂亮。

examples.en: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢它们就像我们喜欢美丽的窗帘料子一样。

examples.en: The happiest are not those who own all the best things, but those who can appreciate the beauty of life.
examples.zh: 最幸福的人并不一定拥有一切美好事物，只是他们懂得欣赏生活的美好。

examples.en: Everyone should be responsible for his decision, because life is a series of choices.
examples.zh: 每个人都要为自己的决定负责，因为人生就是一系列的选择。

examples.en: What excited people all over the country was that China became the third country to softland an unmanned spacecraft on the surface of the moon.
examples.zh: 令全国人民兴奋的是，中国成为了第三个实现无人宇宙飞船在月球表面软着陆的国家。

examples.en: In order for the athletes to sleep at ease and release their tension of the competition, the Winter Olympic Village provides them with beds that can switch between four modes.
examples.zh: 为了让运动员睡得安心，释放比赛的紧张压力，冬奥村为他们提供了可在四种模式之间切换的床。

examples.en: Grace tapped on the bedroom door and went in.
examples.zh: 格蕾丝轻轻敲了敲卧室的门，走了进去。

examples.en: Don't get the children overexcited just before bedtime.
examples.zh: 临睡前不要让孩子过于兴奋。

examples.en: a bedtime snack
examples.zh: 临睡前的小吃

examples.en: Since he was bitten, he tends to run away every time he sees bees.
examples.zh: 由于被蜜蜂蜇过，每次看到蜜蜂他都会转身就跑。

examples.en: Would you like to have some beef?
examples.zh: 想来点牛肉吗？

examples.en: a barrel of beer
examples.zh: 一桶啤酒

examples.en: B comes before C in the alphabet.
examples.zh: B在字母表里排在C之前。

examples.en: She rushed out of the room before I gave any reply.
examples.zh: 不等我回答，她就冲出了房间。

examples.en: He lives by begging.
examples.zh: 他靠乞讨为生。

examples.en: The beggar shivered in his scanty clothes.
examples.zh: 乞丐穿着单薄的衣服，冻得发抖。

examples.en: She wanted to know when the program would begin.
examples.zh: 她想知道该方案何时开始执行。

examples.en: The Olympic Games begin with a parade of all the competing nations.
examples.zh: 奥运会以所有参赛国列队进场作为开始。

b.name: Well begun is half done.
trans: 良好的开端是成功的一半。

examples.en: Many adults in counseling sessions still recall with gratitude the one time that a stranger stepped in on their behalf.
examples.zh: 许多成年人在做（心理）咨询时仍然感激地回忆起，曾有一位陌生人为了他们的利益而出面干预。（徐汇）

examples.en: MPAA is a nonprofit organization formed by six large studios to work on behalf of the film industry.
examples.zh: 美国电影协会是由6家大型工作室组成的非营利组织，代表电影业工作。（黄浦）

examples.en: He has behaved shamefully towards his wife.
examples.zh: 他以可耻的行为对待他的妻子。

items.explanation: 举止，表现（指以一定的行为准则为依据，也指在特殊的场合或一时的举动）

examples.en: Children should learn how to behave well.
examples.zh: 孩子应该学会举止得体。

items.explanation: 行动，行事（常指行为、反应的方式等。指人一时的行为举止，可与 behave 换用）；扮演（角色）

examples.en: If we act immediately, we will be able to defeat the enemy.
examples.zh: 如果我们立即采取行动，就能打败敌人。

examples.en: She acted the part of Maria.
examples.zh: 她扮演玛丽亚这一角色。

examples.en: While speeding through a yellow light might save you a little time, this behaviour is likely to result in a serious traffic accident.
examples.zh: 尽管加速通过黄灯能省点时间，但这种行为很可能引发严重的交通事故。（徐汇）

examples.en: The boy standing behind you is Peter.
examples.zh: 站在你身后的男孩是彼得。

examples.en: He is running behind.
examples.zh: 他在后面跑。

examples.en: Protecting the environment is protecting the human beings ourselves.
examples.zh: 保护环境就是保护我们人类自己。

examples.en: Only by holding to our beliefs, and getting prepared for failure, can all the problems that seem unconquerable be solved at last.
examples.zh: 只有坚持理想信念，并做好失败的准备，一切看起来不可战胜的困难才终将迎刃而解。（长宁）

b.name: belief in
trans: 对……的真实或正确性具有的信心

examples.en: Believe it or not, most people believe in jogging for health.
examples.zh: 信不信由你，多数人认为慢跑对健康有益。

items.explanation: 相信某人的诚实；相信某事的真实性

examples.en: I believe Harry. He never lies.
examples.zh: 我相信哈里，他从不撒谎。

examples.en: We all believe his words.
examples.zh: 我们都相信他的话。

items.explanation: 信任；信赖某人；相信……的存在，相信……的价值

examples.en: I believe in Harry. He is a very able man.
examples.zh: 我信赖哈里。他是个很能干的人。

examples.en: She truly believes in the power of kindness to change the world.
examples.zh: 她真的相信善良的力量能够改变世界。

examples.en: There is a bell on the wall.
examples.zh: 墙上有个钟。

examples.en: She doesn't belong to any party, and thus she seems not to belong here.
examples.zh: 她不属于任何党派，因此在这儿显得有点格格不入。

examples.en: From the hilltop we saw the blue ocean below.
examples.zh: 从山顶上我们看见了下面的蓝色海洋。

examples.en: Please do not write below this line.
examples.zh: 请不要写在这条线下面。

items.explanation: 在下方（反义 above）
在正下方（反义 over）

examples.en: He buckled the safety belt when the plane was making a landing.
examples.zh: 飞机降落时，他扣上安全带。

examples.en: The old couple is sitting on the park bench.
examples.zh: 那对老夫妻正坐在公园的长凳上。

examples.en: It is impossible for the 5-year-old boy to bend an iron bar.
examples.zh: 要这个5岁男孩把铁棒弄弯是不可能的。

examples.en: She bent and picked up a plastic bucket.
examples.zh: 她弯腰提起一个塑料桶。

examples.en: a quick bend of the body
examples.zh: 一个快速的弯腰动作

examples.en: Her careful make-up hid the sign of age beneath.
examples.zh: 她精心化的妆掩盖了岁月的痕迹。

examples.en: The ship sank beneath the waves.
examples.zh: 船只淹没在浪涛中。

examples.en: A good diet is beneficial to health.
examples.zh: 良好的饮食有益于健康。

examples.en: Compared with consumers of other countries, many Chinese people are not used to paying by credit card, which in part benefits the rapid rise of mobile payment in China.
examples.zh: 与其他国家的消费者相比，很多中国消费者并不习惯用信用卡支付，而这在一定程度上促进了移动支付在中国的迅速崛起。（静安）

examples.en: Did you get much benefit from your holiday?
examples.zh: 度假是否让你受益良多？

examples.en: The patient doesn’t seem to have benefited from the treatment.
examples.zh: 这种疗法对病人似乎并不奏效。

examples.en: sit beside the guests
examples.zh: 坐在客人旁边

examples.en: The task is very difficult; and besides, time presses.
examples.zh: 任务艰巨，而且时间紧迫。

examples.en: When it comes to thanking people, there are many more creative ways besides "thank you".
examples.zh: 谈到向别人表达感谢时，除了“谢谢”外，还有许多更有创意的方式。

items.explanation: 有“包括”的含义，表示“除了……还有……”。

examples.en: Besides the driver, three passengers got injured in the accident.
examples.zh: 除了司机，还有3名乘客在事故中受伤。

items.explanation: 有“排除”的含义，表示总体中有例外。

examples.en: The girl likes all colours except black.
examples.zh: 除了黑色，这个女孩其他颜色都喜欢。

items.explanation: 注意：在否定结构和疑问句中 besides 和 except 可互换使用。besides 可置于句首和句末，except 只能置于句末。

examples.en: Nobody knows the secret besides/except you and me.
examples.zh: 除了我和你，没人知道这个秘密。

examples.en: Do you have any other problems besides/except these?
examples.zh: 除了这些，你还有其他问题吗？

senses.trans: 最好的（good 和 well 的最高级）

examples.en: This is my best friend.
examples.zh: 这是我最好的朋友。

examples.en: The thing I liked best about the show was the music.
examples.zh: 这场演出中我最喜欢的是音乐。

b.name: East or west, home is the best.
trans: 金窝、银窝，不如自己的草窝。

examples.en: make a bet
examples.zh: 打赌

examples.en: He enjoys betting a lot.
examples.zh: 他很喜欢赌钱。

senses.trans: 更好的（good 和 well 的比较级）

examples.en: You must pay extra for a better seat.
examples.zh: 你要坐更好的位子就要加钱。

examples.en: We never doubt that the more we study now, the better we will be able to work in the future.
examples.zh: 我们从不怀疑现在学的东西越多，将来就能工作得越好。

examples.en: There is a striking contrast between what he does and what he says.
examples.zh: 他的所做和他的所说大相径庭。

examples.en: What is beyond?
examples.zh: 再往后是什么？

examples.en: In brief, this bicycle is beyond repair.
examples.zh: 简而言之，这辆自行车已不能修了。

examples.en: He has different versions of the Bible.
examples.zh: 他有不同版本的《圣经》。

examples.en: In terms of population, Washington cannot be regarded as a big city.
examples.zh: 就人口而言，华盛顿还不能算是一个大城市。

examples.en: My father gave me a bike as my birthday present yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我爸爸给我一辆自行车作为生日礼物。

examples.en: He never pays his bill on time.
examples.zh: 他从来没有按时支付他的账单。
