examples.en: There may be billions of stars in the sky.
examples.zh: 天上也许有数以亿计的星星。

trans: 〈英〉万亿（的）（近年来英国日益把 billion 当作“10亿”用）

examples.en: He screwed the paper small and chucked it in the bin.
examples.zh: 他把纸揉成小团，扔进了垃圾桶。

examples.en: They bound his legs so that he couldn't escape.
examples.zh: 他们把他的双腿绑起来，使他无法逃跑。

items.explanation: 捆绑，捆扎；使粘合；使连接；使结合，使关系密切；装订（书籍）；约束

examples.en: The doctor bound up the wounded soldier's arm with bandages.
examples.zh: 医生用绷带包扎伤员的手臂。

examples.en: This dictionary has been nicely bound.
examples.zh: 这本词典装帧得不错。

examples.en: Severe cold will bind the soil.
examples.zh: 严寒会使土壤冻结。

items.explanation: 扎牢，系牢（指用闩、锁、扣、钉、钩、钮、带等使物体固定）

examples.en: The passengers must fasten their seat belts before the plane takes off.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞前乘客必须系好安全带。

items.explanation: 锁上（仅指用锁）

examples.en: Remember to take your key with you so that you won't lock yourself out.
examples.zh: 记得带钥匙，这样你就不至于被关在门外了。

items.explanation: 使固定；安装（强调将某物稳妥地固定在某一位置上，使其不能移动）

examples.en: The seat belt is fixed on your seat.
examples.zh: 安全带固定在你的座位上。

items.explanation: 安装（指安装设备）

examples.en: They have had two telephones installed in their house.
examples.zh: 他们家里装了两部电话。

examples.en: Biology was his favorite subject in school.
examples.zh: 生物是他上学时最喜欢的一门课。

examples.en: There are miles of grassland with no people, just trees and birds.
examples.zh: 方圆几英里的草原上没有人，只有树和鸟。

b.name: Clumsy birds have to start flying early.

examples.en: The baby weighed 7 pounds at birth.
examples.zh: 这个婴儿生下来时重7磅。

examples.en: Is it possible for you to attend my birthday party this evening?
examples.zh: 你今晚能来参加我的生日聚会吗？

examples.en: He had some biscuits before dinner.
examples.zh: 他在正餐前吃了点饼干。

examples.en: Will you give me a bit of time?
examples.zh: 你能给我一点时间吗？

examples.en: Babies who are getting new teeth like something hard to bite on.
examples.zh: 正在出牙的婴儿喜欢咬硬物。

examples.en: eat sth. in one bite
examples.zh: 将某物一口吃下

examples.en: The medicine left a bitter taste in the mouth.
examples.zh: 药在嘴里留下了苦味。

examples.en: This black bag may be that driver's.
examples.zh: 这个黑色的包可能是那位司机的。

examples.en: Mary had to wear her glasses so that she could see the words on the blackboard clearly.
examples.zh: 玛丽不得不戴上眼镜，这样她就能清楚地看到黑板上的字。

examples.en: Anyone dealing with a complicated problem may be blamed for not fully understanding the challenge, though it's impossible to know everything in advance.
examples.zh: 任何处理复杂问题的人都可能因为没有全面了解挑战而受到指责，虽然事先了解一切是不可能的。

examples.en: If you don't do the work well, you will incur blame.
examples.zh: 如果你不把工作做好，你将会招人责难。

examples.en: We can’t really blame him for wanting to leave because he has nothing to do here.
examples.zh: 我们真的不能怪他想要离开，他在这儿实在无所事事。

examples.en: The driver is partially to blame for the accident.
examples.zh: 事故的部分责任应由司机承担。

examples.en: We can’t really blame him for wanting to leave because he has nothing to do here.
examples.zh: 我们真的不能怪他想要离开，他在这儿实在无所事事。

examples.en: The driver is partially to blame for the accident.
examples.zh: 事故的部分责任应由司机承担。

b.name: put/lay the blame on sb. for sth.

examples.en: fill in the blank
examples.zh: 填空

examples.en: He handed in a blank sheet.
examples.zh: 他交了张白卷。

examples.en: Please give me a blanket.
examples.zh: 请给我一条毯子。

examples.en: The boy is bleeding.
examples.zh: 那男孩在流血。

examples.en: She blessed him for his kindness.
examples.zh: 她感激他的好意。

examples.en: He often goes fishing in the park at weekends, turning a blind eye to the “No Fishing” sign.
examples.zh: 他周末常常去公园钓鱼，对“禁止垂钓”的标志视而不见。

examples.en: The soldier had been blinded in the war.
examples.zh: 那士兵已在战争中双目失明了。

b.name: turn a blind eye to sth.
trans: 装作未看见，对……睁一眼闭一眼

examples.en: How could you turn a deaf ear to her cries for help?
examples.zh: 你怎么能对她的求救声置之不理呢？

senses.trans: 街区(四条街道中间的区域)

examples.en: He lives in that block.
examples.zh: 他住在那个街区。

examples.en: A piece of rock fell down, and the only path leading to the village was blocked.
examples.zh: 一块岩石掉下来，堵住了通向村子的唯一一条小路。

examples.en: The blog is like a personal journal to me.
examples.zh: 博客对我而言就像个人日志。

examples.en: It was many years before he gradually forgot that embarrassing episode in his life where he fainted at the sight of blood in public.
examples.zh: 许多年过去了，他才渐渐淡忘人生中那尴尬的一幕：在大庭广众之下，他看到血晕倒了。（杨浦）

examples.en: Those roses have beautiful blooms.
examples.zh: 这些玫瑰花开得真美。

examples.en: That bush will bloom soon.
examples.zh: 那棵矮树即将开花。

examples.en: Rain begins to fall and peach trees blossom.
examples.zh: 开始下雨了，桃树也开花了。

senses.trans: (尤指果树或灌木的)花朵，花簇

examples.en: The trees are in blossom.
examples.zh: 树上鲜花盛开。

senses.trans: (妇女、儿童穿的)短上衣；女衬衫

examples.en: She was wearing a skirt and blouse.
examples.zh: 她穿着裙子和衬衫。

examples.en: In spring the wind blows gently.
examples.zh: 春天里，风轻轻地吹。

examples.en: He struck his enemy a heavy blow on the head.
examples.zh: 他在敌人的头上予以重重的一击。

examples.en: The sky is deep blue.
examples.zh: 天空呈深蓝色。

examples.en: A woman in blue walked into the store.
examples.zh: 一个穿蓝色衣服的女人走进商店。

examples.en: Will you help me to take the size of the board?
examples.zh: 帮忙量一下这木板的尺寸好吗？

senses.trans: 上(船、火车、公共汽车、飞机等)

examples.en: Passengers must board the ship by 6 p.m.
examples.zh: 旅客必须在下午6点之前上船。

trans: 用木板覆盖(或封闭)(up, over)

b.name: on board
trans: 在船(火车、公共汽车、飞机等)上

examples.en: A small boat drifted into the harbour during the night, with no one on board.
examples.zh: 夜间一条小船漂进了港湾，船上空无一人。

examples.en: It was his proud boast that he won the first prize.
examples.zh: 赢得一等奖是他引以为豪的事。

examples.en: He boasted that he had never had a serious illness.
examples.zh: 他自夸从未生过大病。

examples.en: He has his own boat.
examples.zh: 他有自己的小船。

examples.en: They boated us across the bay.
examples.zh: 他们用船把我们送过海湾。

examples.en: A balanced diet provides nutrition for your body.
examples.zh: 均衡的饮食使你的身体获得营养。

examples.en: Is the milk boiling yet?
examples.zh: 牛奶开了没有？

examples.en: I always boil water in this kettle.
examples.zh: 我总是用这个水壶烧水。

examples.en: Bring the soup to the boil.
examples.zh: 把汤烧开。

examples.en: He believes that students should be encouraged to experiment with bold ideas.
examples.zh: 他认为应该鼓励学生们勇于尝试大胆的想法。

examples.en: The enemy bombed the city heavily.
examples.zh: 敌人强烈地轰炸这座城市。

examples.en: The police found a bomb in the building.
examples.zh: 警方在大楼里发现一枚炸弹。

examples.en: We need to enhance mutual understanding to reinforce the bond of mutual trust.
examples.zh: 我们要增进相互理解，以巩固互信纽带。

examples.en: I broke a bone in my leg.
examples.zh: 我的腿骨折断了。

examples.en: I have found that having male nurses is a real bonus, and they definitely have a place in our hospital.
examples.zh: 我发现拥有男护士真是一种红利，他们在我们医院绝对占有一席之地。（浦东）

examples.en: The reference book was not available in the library, so I had to buy one at the bookstore nearby.
examples.zh: 图书馆里借不到这本参考书，我只能去附近书店买。

examples.en: You'd better go to the booking office at once to book early for the football match at the weekends.
examples.zh: 你最好立刻去售票处，早些预定周末足球赛的票。

items.explanation: 预订(座、票等)

examples.en: The flight is fully booked.
examples.zh: 这次航班的票已全部预订完。

items.explanation: 点(菜)；订购

examples.en: She ordered herself two dozen oysters and a pint of stout.
examples.zh: 她自己点了两打牡蛎和一品脱黑啤酒。

b.name: Books are our good teachers and wise friends.
trans: 书籍是我们的良师益友。

examples.en: As the booklet explains, drivers here are in the habit of giving way to pedestrians.
examples.zh: 正如这本小册子介绍的那样，这里的司机都有礼让行人的习惯。

examples.en: I got this book by chance at a second-hand bookshop.
examples.zh: 我恰巧在一家旧书店里买到这本书。

examples.en: a business boom
examples.zh: 商业的繁荣

senses.trans: 发出低沉有回响的声音

examples.en: Stocks may boom today, but droop tomorrow.
examples.zh: 股票可能今天暴涨，但明天又下跌。

examples.en: Winning the prize really boosted her ego.
examples.zh: 获得这个奖项大大增强了她的自信心。

examples.en: a pair of football boots
examples.zh: 一双足球靴

examples.en: Don't cross the border.
examples.zh: 不准越过边境。

examples.en: China borders on DPRK in the northeast.
examples.zh: 中国的东北部与朝鲜接壤。

examples.en: He has bored himself with bridge.
examples.zh: 他玩桥牌玩腻了。

examples.en: bore for water
examples.zh: 凿井取水

examples.en: I get bored easily.
examples.zh: 我易生厌倦。

examples.en: She found her job very boring.
examples.zh: 她觉得自己的工作很无聊。

examples.en: Some people are born with certain talents for sports or music.
examples.zh: 有些人天生就具有一定的体育或音乐天赋。

examples.en: If it is convenient to you, please return the books which were borrowed last week to the library after school.
examples.zh: 你方便的话，放学后请把上周借的书还到图书馆去。

examples.en: His boss spoke highly of him, because he always succeeded in finishing the task.
examples.zh: 老板对他评价很高，因为他总能很好地完成任务。

examples.en: It is an important centre for botanical research.
examples.zh: 它是一个重要的植物学研究中心。

examples.en: I want to be a botanist in the future.
examples.zh: 我将来想当个植物学家。

examples.en: Workshops are very loosely organized and most represent discussions that have been held at Society for Economic Botany (SEB) meetings over a series of years.
examples.zh: 研讨会组织得非常松散，大多数都是基于一些多年来在经济植物学会 (SEB) 会议上进行的讨论。（青浦）

examples.en: Tourists can enjoy wonderful views on both sides of the Huangpu River.
examples.zh: 游客可以欣赏黄浦江两岸的美妙景色。

examples.en: Mass media such as newspapers, television and the Internet keep us informed of what is going on both at home and abroad.
examples.zh: 大众媒体，如报纸、电视和互联网，让我们不断了解国内外正在发生的事情。

examples.en: Tell the children to stop bothering their father.
examples.zh: 告诉孩子们不要打扰他们的父亲。

examples.en: As long as you have tried your best, there is no sense bothering about failure or success.
examples.zh: 只要你尽力了，就没道理为成功或失败而苦恼。

examples.en: How shall we deal with the waste paper, bottles and boxes?
examples.zh: 我们应如何处理这些废纸、瓶子和包装盒呢？

examples.en: Fill in your address at the bottom of the application form.
examples.zh: 把你的地址填写在申请表下端。

examples.en: The ball doesn't bounce well.
examples.zh: 这只球弹性不好。

examples.en: With one bound the dog was over the fence.
examples.zh: 那条狗一跃就跳过了篱笆。

examples.en: Country boundaries are shown on this map as dotted lines.
examples.zh: 这张地图上国界以虚线标出。

examples.en: The actors bowed as the audience applauded.
examples.zh: 演员们向鼓掌的观众鞠躬。

examples.en: He acknowledged the applause with a small bow.
examples.zh: 他微微地鞠了一躬表示对掌声的感谢。

examples.en: hunt with bows and arrows
examples.zh: 以弓箭狩猎

examples.en: He has a big bowl.
examples.zh: 他有个大碗。

examples.en: We'd bowl and booze there.
examples.zh: 我们可以在那儿打保龄球，还可以痛痛快快地喝酒。

examples.en: I go bowling for relaxation.
examples.zh: 我打保龄球是为了消遣。

examples.en: The two kids were rewarded with a box of crayons and a book respectively.
examples.zh: 两个小朋友分别得到一盒蜡笔和一本书作为奖励。（杨浦）

examples.en: give sb. a sound box on the ear
examples.zh: 掴某人一记响亮的耳光

examples.en: Did he box at school?
examples.zh: 他在学校里练过拳击吗？

examples.en: a boxing champion/match
examples.zh: 拳击冠军 / 比赛

examples.en: It's not a good idea to make the boy copy the new words again and again.
examples.zh: 让这个男孩一遍又一遍地抄写生词不是一个好主意。

examples.en: She has a good brain.
examples.zh: 她有个好脑子。

examples.en: The brake is out of control.
examples.zh: 刹车失灵了。

examples.en: He lit a cigarette and braked the car slightly.
examples.zh: 他点燃一支烟，轻踩刹车减速。

examples.en: Tom braked hard when the old lady suddenly appeared in front of him.
examples.zh: 那老妇突然出现在车前时，汤姆猛踩刹车。

examples.en: The bank has formed a British branch in London.
examples.zh: 这家银行在伦敦开设了英国分行。

examples.en: Follow the main road until it branches, and then turn to the right.
examples.zh: 顺着这条大路走，在路的分岔口向右拐。

examples.en: He branched his treatment of the problem into three equal parts.
examples.zh: 他把这个问题分解成三个同等的部分来处理。

examples.en: Which brand of suit do you like?
examples.zh: 你喜欢什么牌子的西装？

examples.en: His unhappy childhood has been branded on his memory.
examples.zh: 他不幸的童年铭刻在了他的记忆里。

examples.en: brass buttons
examples.zh: 黄铜的纽扣

examples.en: We Chinese people are brave and industrious.
examples.zh: 我们中国人是勇敢勤劳的。

examples.en: The author braved the London critics.
examples.zh: 这位作家敢于向伦敦批评界挑战。

examples.en: Mark isn't feeling well now as he had too much bread just now.
examples.zh: 马克现在觉得不太舒服，因为他刚才吃了太多的面包。

examples.en: I broke a leg skiing.
examples.zh: 我在滑雪时摔断了一条腿。

examples.en: Their marriage is said to have broken up and she broke with her husband last month.
examples.zh: 有人说他们的婚姻破裂了，她上月与丈夫分手了。

examples.en: wait for a break in the traffic to cross the street
examples.zh: 等待车流间歇时过马路

examples.en: Our car broke down halfway and we had to draw it to a garage.
examples.zh: 我们的车半路坏了，不得不把它拖到修车厂去。

examples.en: The prediction that war would break out proved true.
examples.zh: 战争会爆发的预言被证实是正确的。

examples.en: At last the sun broke through the clouds.
examples.zh: 最终太阳钻出了云层。

examples.en: You had better let John buy milk and bread for breakfast himself.
examples.zh: 早餐你最好让约翰自己去买牛奶和面包。

examples.en: The baby was feeding from its mother's right breast.
examples.zh: 婴儿正吮吸母亲的右乳。

senses.trans: 把胸部对着，挺胸迎……而上

examples.en: He strode into the ocean, breasting the waves.
examples.zh: 他挺胸顶着波浪大步走进海里。

examples.en: He breasted the tape.
examples.zh: 他以胸撞线（赛跑获胜）。

examples.en: Having taken a deep breath, he went up to the stage with a smile on his face.
examples.zh: 他深吸了一口气，面带微笑地走上了舞台。

examples.en: They reached the company out of breath only to be told they were fired.
examples.zh: 他们上气不接下气地赶到公司，不料却被告知已被开除了。

examples.en: You had to listen hard to hear the old man breathe.
examples.zh: 你要仔细听才能听见老人的呼吸声。

examples.en: a breed of sheep
examples.zh: 一种羊

examples.en: How often do tigers breed?
examples.zh: 老虎多久产一次仔？

examples.en: There is a gentle breeze today.
examples.zh: 今天微风轻吹。

examples.en: take/accept bribes
examples.zh: 接受贿赂

examples.en: It is illegal to bribe the policeman.
examples.zh: 向警察行贿是违法的。

examples.en: This house is built of red bricks.
examples.zh: 这房子是红砖造的。

examples.en: If the brides-to-be think that the wedding dress is the top priority, they have to cut expenses on other items to avoid overspending the wedding budget.
examples.zh: 如果准新娘们认为婚纱是重中之重，那只能削减其他项目的开支，以防婚礼预算超支。（静安）

examples.en: Rarely do brides and bridegrooms realize that what is the most impressive is the strong love between them rather than the luxurious wedding gowns or the grand wedding ceremonies.
examples.zh: 新郎新娘们很少意识到真正令人难忘的是新人之间浓浓的爱意，而非豪华的婚纱，或是盛大的结婚典礼。

examples.en: The bridge fell down several years ago.
examples.zh: 这座桥几年前塌了。

examples.en: The local people are bridging a river.
examples.zh: 当地人正在河上架桥。

examples.en: Let me give you a brief introduction of this book.
examples.zh: 让我简短地介绍一下这本书。

examples.en: Here is the brief of the case.
examples.zh: 这是案件摘要。

examples.en: The company has briefed a top lawyer to defend the case.
examples.zh: 公司已将案件委托给一个最好的律师。

examples.en: The fire had hardly broken out when the fire brigade arrived at the scene.
examples.zh: 火灾一发生，消防队员就赶到了现场。

examples.en: After a week of rain, the weather turned sunny and bright, which was truly delightful.
examples.zh: 下了一周雨后，天气变得晴朗明媚，这真令人愉悦。（黄浦）

examples.en: He was an exceptionally bright child.
examples.zh: 他是个特别聪明的孩子。

examples.en: He has a brilliant brain.
examples.zh: 他有才华横溢的头脑。

examples.en: Online payment brings convenience to consumers at the cost of their privacy.
examples.zh: 网上支付方便了用户，但是牺牲了他们的隐私。（上海高考）

items.explanation: 带来（指从他处带到说话人处来）

examples.en: Do bring your daughter around one evening.
examples.zh: 哪天晚上一定把你的女儿带来。

items.explanation: 带去（指从说话人处带到另一处去）

examples.en: I've just taken him for a long walk.
examples.zh: 我刚带他去散步。

items.explanation: 去拿来（指替别人去别处取过来）

examples.en: I asked her to fetch me an evening paper.
examples.zh: 我要她替我去拿一份晚报来。

items.explanation: 携带，运，载（指随身携带）

examples.en: In Britain policemen never carry guns.
examples.zh: 英国警察从不带枪。

items.explanation: 使某人或某物去、来或被携带，强调让别人送而并非本人亲自送。

examples.en: We'll send the goods by rail.
examples.zh: 我们用铁路运去货物。

examples.en: There is no denying that the exposure of personal information may bring about security risks.
examples.zh: 不可否认，个人信息的泄露可能会带来安全风险。

examples.en: Born and brought up in the countryside, he is interested in biology.
examples.zh: 出生并成长在农村，他对生物很感兴趣。

examples.en: Britain's licensing hours used to be very restricted.
examples.zh: 英国的酒吧营业时间从前受到很严格的限制。

examples.en: The British are said to love tradition.
examples.zh: 据说英国人热爱传统。

examples.en: American English is different from British English.
examples.zh: 美式英语与英式英语有差异。

examples.en: Coronaviruses are a broad family of viruses, but only six (the new one would make it seven) are known to infect people.
examples.zh: 冠状病毒是一个庞大的病毒家族，目前已知会感染人类的有 6 种（新发现的这种是第 7 种）。

items.explanation: 宽的，阔的（侧重本身的宽度；可修饰人的身体部分，也可表示人的心胸宽广）

examples.en: The banana tree has broad leaves.
examples.zh: 香蕉树有着宽大的叶子。

items.explanation: 宽的，阔的（侧重指两边或两地间“宽，阔”的距离；可修饰眼、鼻等，也可引申为“广泛的，渊博的”）

examples.en: He looked at me up and down with wide eyes.
examples.zh: 他睁大眼睛上下打量我。

examples.en: The programme is broadcast at noon.
examples.zh: 这档节目在中午广播。

examples.en: The radio station sets up an overseas broadcast program.
examples.zh: 电台设置了一档海外广播节目。

examples.en: I picked up a brochure about the local tourist attractions at the hotel reception desk.
examples.zh: 我在酒店前台拿了一份关于当地旅游景点的小册子。

examples.en: I often mistake Wang Hai for his twin brother because they look very much alike.
examples.zh: 我常把王海误认为他的双胞胎兄弟，因为他俩长得太像了。

examples.en: mop one's brow
examples.zh: 擦前额

examples.en: In autumn the leaves change from green to brown.
examples.zh: 秋天，树叶由绿色变为棕色。

examples.en: Do you like brown?
examples.zh: 你喜欢棕色吗？

examples.en: browsing among books in the public library
examples.zh: 在公共图书馆浏览各种书籍

items.explanation: （粗略地）看一下，一瞥，扫视

examples.en: I glanced at my watch and told him what time it is.
examples.zh: 我看了一下手表，告诉他几点了。

items.explanation: 粗略地看，浏览；细看；审视

examples.en: He scanned the newspaper while having his breakfast.
examples.zh: 他吃早饭时浏览了一下报纸。

examples.en: She scanned the cloth to make sure it was good.
examples.zh: 她仔细查看布料，以确保其质量良好。

items.explanation: 略读，快读（强调仅注意要点）

examples.en: He skimmed through the book and got a general idea of it.
examples.zh: 他将书粗读了一遍，了解其大意。

items.explanation: 浏览（尤指为了挑书而随意翻阅）

examples.en: One of his hobbies is to browse among the books in a second-hand bookshop.
examples.zh: 他的爱好之一是在旧书店翻看书籍。

senses.trans: 早午餐（晚吃的早餐，用以代替午餐）

examples.en: They eat much the same thing for brunch every day.
examples.zh: 每天早午餐他们总是吃大致相同的东西。

examples.en: I have a brush.
examples.zh: 我有一把刷子。

examples.en: Have you brushed your teeth?
examples.zh: 你刷牙了吗？

examples.en: I graduated from Wuhan Polytechnics University with a BS degree in Mechanical Engineering two years ago.
examples.zh: 两年前我毕业于武汉理工大学，获得机械工程专业的理学学士学位。

examples.en: The child is playing with bubbles when bathing.
examples.zh: 这个小孩在洗澡时玩泡泡。

examples.en: The water is bubbling in the kettle.
examples.zh: 壶中的水沸腾着。

examples.en: a bucket of sand
examples.zh: 一桶沙子

examples.en: It is reported that the government will increase the budget to ban the behaviour of smoking in public environment.
examples.zh: 据报道，政府将增加预算用于禁止在公共场所吸烟的行为。

examples.en: I budgeted for a daily expenditure of 15 dollars.
examples.zh: 我每天的开销预算是 15 美元。

examples.en: Breakfast buffet starts at 7 a.m.
examples.zh: 自助早餐从早上 7 点开始。

examples.en: More underground railways will be built in Shanghai in the years to come.
examples.zh: 未来几年上海将建造更多的地铁。

examples.en: He's described as around thirty years old, six feet tall and of medium build.
examples.zh: 他被描述成一个 30 岁左右、6 英尺高、中等身材的人。

examples.en: On the top of the building you can have a bird's eye view of the whole city.
examples.zh: 在大楼的顶部，你可以俯瞰整座城市。

examples.en: change a bulb
examples.zh: 换灯泡

examples.en: He is as strong as a bull.
examples.zh: 他壮得像头牛。

examples.en: His brother was killed by a single bullet in the heart.
examples.zh: 他的兄弟被一颗子弹射中心脏而死。

examples.en: She bumped against the wall in the dark.
examples.zh: 她在黑暗中撞上墙。

examples.en: We'll probably bump into him.
examples.zh: 我们也许会碰到他。

examples.en: When you walk in a crowded street, you must look around lest you bump into someone.
examples.zh: 在拥挤的街道上行走时，必须四周看看，免得撞到了别人。

examples.en: a bunch of flowers
examples.zh: 一束花

examples.en: It is time to take action to control the quantity of (the) private cars so as to relieve the traffic burden during the rush hours.
examples.zh: 是时候该采取行动控制私车数量，以缓解高峰时期的交通压力。

examples.en: burden oneself with a heavy overcoat
examples.zh: 不必要地给自己加一件厚大衣

examples.en: His face burnt with shame.
examples.zh: 他羞得脸上发烧。

examples.en: We burnt wood to keep warm.
examples.zh: 我们烧柴取暖。

examples.en: She was taken to the hospital with serious burns.
examples.zh: 她严重烧伤，被送进医院。

b.name: We should learn a lesson from this incident: He who plays with fire will surely get burnt.
trans: 我们应该从这次事件中吸取教训：玩火者必自焚。

examples.en: Every student couldn't help bursting out laughing.
examples.zh: 每个学生都忍不住大笑起来。

examples.en: the burst of a bomb
examples.zh: 炸弹的爆炸

examples.en: She burst into tears and ran out of the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她突然哭了，跑出了厨房。

examples.en: They were so moved that they burst into tears.
examples.zh: 他们感动得突然哭了起来。

examples.en: The violent winds buried the village in sand.
examples.zh: 狂风把村子掩埋在沙中。

examples.en: He asked the government to improve school bus safety.
examples.zh: 他要求政府改善校车的安全。

examples.en: The jeep was found lying in a thick bush.
examples.zh: 人们发现吉普车翻倒在一处茂密的灌木丛里。

examples.en: Not all the graduates from key universities are necessarily fit for starting their own business, which involves sharp market sense and good opportunities.
examples.zh: 重点大学的毕业生不一定都适合自主创业，这需要敏锐的市场嗅觉和良好的机遇。

examples.en: However busy we are, we should regularly spend some time talking with our parents.
examples.zh: 无论多忙，我们都应该经常花时间与父母说说话。

examples.en: The purpose of motivating children to read lies not in the number of books but in the cultivation of their love for reading.
examples.zh: 鼓励孩子们阅读的目的不在于读多少本书，而在于培养他们热爱阅读。

examples.en: His grandfather was a butcher.
examples.zh: 他祖父是个屠夫。

examples.en: Would you like some bread and butter?
examples.zh: 你想来点面包和黄油吗？

examples.en: butter the bread
examples.zh: 给面包涂上黄油

examples.en: Jenney's father has a collection of beautiful butterflies.
examples.zh: 詹妮的父亲收集美丽的蝴蝶。

examples.en: There is a button on the wall.
examples.zh: 墙上有一个按钮。

examples.en: It was a risky operation, but might buy more time.
examples.zh: 这是一次冒险的行动，但也许多能换取更多的时间。

examples.en: Now is a good time to buy.
examples.zh: 现在是购买的好时机。

items.explanation: 买，购买（最普通用词，表示日常少量、随意地购物。可用直接宾语表示所购之物，还可用间接宾语表示为谁购买）

examples.en: She bought herself a hamburger and a coke.
examples.zh: 她给自己买了一份汉堡包和可乐。

items.explanation: 购买，购置（尤指大宗购买，也用于在高档商店里购物。一般不用间接宾语）

examples.en: Purchasing a house is always a great business.
examples.zh: 买房子总是一件大事情。

items.explanation: 到商店购物

examples.en: Shop around and compare brands and prices before you buy a product.
examples.zh: 逛逛不同的商店，比较一下品牌和价格，然后再买。

examples.en: More and more people in Shanghai choose to work by underground.
examples.zh: 在上海越来越多的人选择乘地铁上班。

examples.en: He hurried by and disappeared in the wood.
examples.zh: 他匆匆走过，消失在森林里。

examples.en: I have to say bye to everybody.
examples.zh: 我不得不对大家说再见了。

b.name: base ... on ...
trans: 把 ... 放在 ... 的基础上

examples.en: The TV series is based on a real-life story.
examples.zh: 这部电视剧是以一个真实生活故事为基础的。

examples.en: English people are accustomed to driving on the left.
examples.zh: 英国人习惯于靠左边开车。

examples.en: He is more concerned about others than about himself.
examples.zh: 比起关心自己，他更关心他人。

examples.en: I have every reason to be confident of our victory.
examples.zh: 我有充分的理由相信胜利是属于我们的。

b.name: be considerate of sb. to do sth.
trans: 某人做某事考虑得周到

examples.en: It was considerate of you not to play the piano while I was sleeping.
examples.zh: 在我睡觉时你不弹钢琴，真是体贴入微。

examples.en: Contrary to our expectation, the examination turned out to be a piece of cake.
examples.zh: 与我们所预料的相反，这次考试原来容易极了。

examples.en: We are exposed to various sentence patterns and ways of expression through reading.
examples.zh: 通过阅读，我们可以接触各种各样的句型和表达方式。

examples.en: We are now faced with a serious shortage of raw materials.
examples.zh: 我们现在面临严重的原材料短缺。

examples.en: There is no doubt that he is fit for the job.
examples.zh: 他能胜任这项工作，这一点是毫无疑问的。

examples.en: How wonderful it is to be free from all worries and responsibilities!
examples.zh: 能摆脱一切烦恼和责任真是太棒了！

examples.en: The vast majority of citizens are in favour of lifting the ban.
examples.zh: 绝大多数市民都赞成取消禁令。

examples.en: This is an objective law (which is) independent of man's will.
examples.zh: 这是客观规律，不以人的意志为转移。

examples.en: He hasn't yet been infected with the evils of society.
examples.zh: 他还没沾染社会上的不良风气。

examples.en: This design is inferior to the one the German company has proposed.
examples.zh: 这个设计不如那家德国公司所提出的。

examples.en: My sister sat in silence for some time, lost in thought.
examples.zh: 我姐姐一声不响地坐了一会儿，陷入沉思之中。

examples.en: Coffee from Brazil is usually of good quality, so it is exported to many countries in the world.
examples.zh: 巴西的咖啡通常质量很好，因而出口到世界许多国家。

examples.en: Coffee from Brazil is usually of good quality, so it is exported to many countries in the world.
examples.zh: 巴西的咖啡通常质量很好，因而出口到世界许多国家。

examples.en: She has lost some weight since she went on a diet.
examples.zh: 自从节食以来，她已经瘦了一点。

examples.en: She has lost some weight since she went on a diet.
examples.zh: 自从节食以来，她已经瘦了一点。

examples.en: Aunt Mary is so conservative that she is even opposed to women going out to work.
examples.zh: 玛丽姑妈非常守旧，她甚至反对女人外出工作。

examples.en: You shouldn't be so particular about what you wear.
examples.zh: 你不该对穿着这么讲究。

examples.en: We are sure the toys will be popular among children and good for their intelligence.
examples.zh: 我们相信，这些玩具会受到儿童的喜爱并对其智力大有益处。

examples.en: It happened that he had to be present at an opening ceremony that day.
examples.zh: 恰好那天他得去参加一个开幕典礼。

examples.en: Strictly speaking, the applicant is not well qualified for the job.
examples.zh: 严格说来，这位应聘者不能完全胜任这项工作。

examples.en: The new product is resistant to water and high temperature, so it sells well.
examples.zh: 新产品既防水又耐高温，因而很畅销。

examples.en: He is far from being satisfied with the performance of his new car.
examples.zh: 他对新车的工作性能一点也不满意。

examples.en: As far as English is concerned, she is second to none in the class.
examples.zh: 就英语来说，她是班里第一。

examples.en: The editor is short of contributions for the May issue of the magazine.
examples.zh: 编辑缺少稿件来编这份杂志的5月刊。

examples.en: There is no single plastic material that is suitable for all applications.
examples.zh: 没有哪一种塑料材料是万能的。

examples.en: You must give up the idea that you are superior to them in every aspect.
examples.zh: 你必须放弃自己在各方面都优于他们的想法。

examples.en: When she first came to the town, she found it a bit difficult to get used to the life here.
examples.zh: 她刚来小镇的时候，发现有点难适应这儿的生活。

examples.en: When she first came to the town, she found it a bit difficult to get used to the life here.
examples.zh: 她刚来小镇的时候，发现有点难适应这儿的生活。

examples.en: You should educate your children to behave themselves.
examples.zh: 你应该教育你的孩子们守规矩。

examples.en: I believe in your ability to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 我相信你有解决这问题的能力。

examples.en: Believe it or not, it was a hug that changed my mind.
examples.zh: 信不信由你，是一个拥抱改变了我的想法。

examples.en: The very sight of the super star pleased us beyond description.
examples.zh: 单是看到那个超级巨星，就让我们高兴得无法形容。

examples.en: It is beyond his power to sign such a contract.
examples.zh: 他无权签订这种合同。

examples.en: It is beyond his power to sign such a contract.
examples.zh: 他无权签订这种合同。

examples.en: No matter how hard I try, I cannot break away from this invisible net.
examples.zh: 无论我多么努力都挣脱不了这张无形的网。

examples.en: We cannot just sit by while these people break the law.
examples.zh: 我们不能坐视这些人违犯法律。

examples.en: The new treaty will bring the long war to an end.
examples.zh: 新的条约将结束长久的战争。

examples.en: It is said that this doctor is able to bring the dying back to life.
examples.zh: 据说这位医生能起死回生。

examples.en: These vitamin B and C help to build up your resistance to diseases.
examples.zh: 这些维生素B和C有助于增强你对疾病的抵抗力。

examples.en: The problem is by no means as simple as we first thought.
examples.zh: 问题决不像我们当初想的那么简单。

examples.en: We buy tea by the pound, cloth by the yard and eggs by the dozen.
examples.zh: 我们买茶叶是以磅计，买布以码计，买蛋以打计。

examples.en: Only by this means can you make greater progress in your work.
examples.zh: 只有用这种方法，你才能在工作中取得更大的进步。

examples.en: She almost failed in the exam, but her sister, by contrast, did very well.
examples.zh: 她考试差点不及格，而她的妹妹相比之下考得很好。

examples.en: The proposal for planting organic cabbages must be submitted by next Thursday.
examples.zh: 种植有机卷心菜的方案须在下周四前提交。（上海春考）

examples.en: an eight-berth cabin
examples.zh: 一个 8 人铺的船舱

examples.en: The road is being dug up in order to lay cables.
examples.zh: 挖路是为了铺电缆。

examples.en: a cable station
examples.zh: 有线电视台

examples.en: There’s a little café opposite our company.
examples.zh: 在我们公司对面有一家小咖啡馆。

examples.en: I went to the cafeteria with my colleague at noon.
examples.zh: 中午我和同事去了自助餐厅。

examples.en: Inflation is like a tiger — once it is set free, it is very difficult to put it back in its cage.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀就像一只老虎，一旦放出来就很难再关进笼里。

examples.en: Mike’s mother bought him a big cake on his birthday.
examples.zh: 迈克生日那天，他妈妈给他买了一只大蛋糕。

examples.en: Use the formula to calculate the volume of the container.
examples.zh: 用公式计算容器的容积。

examples.en: We can use calculators in the examination.
examples.zh: 我们在考试时可以使用计算器。

examples.en: the next year’s calendar
examples.zh: 明年的日历

examples.en: He hasn’t seen you; call him.
examples.zh: 他没看见你，叫他一声。

examples.en: They called in a detective to help them find their missing son.
examples.zh: 他们请了一个侦探来帮助他们寻找丢失的儿子。

examples.en: In Japan, it is forbidden to make or receive phone calls by mobile on the underground or on the bus.
examples.zh: 在日本，在地铁或公交车上用手机打电话是不被允许的。

examples.en: More work doesn’t necessarily call for more men.
examples.zh: 增加工作不一定需要增加人员。

examples.en: The company has called in the police to investigate the theft.
examples.zh: 公司已请来警察调查偷窃案。

examples.en: With the weather worsening, they called off the search for survivors.
examples.zh: 随着天气越来越糟，他们停止了对幸存者的搜寻工作。

examples.en: The environmentalists called on the residents to live a low-carbon life.
examples.zh: 环保主义者号召居民们进行低碳生活。

examples.en: As each number is called out, you cross it out on your list.
examples.zh: 每叫过一个号码，你就在单子上把它划掉。

examples.en: She constantly tries to employ calligraphy in the design of Peking Opera costumes.
examples.zh: 她不断尝试将书法元素融入京剧的戏服设计中。（上海秋考）

examples.en: In case a fire breaks out, you must keep calm.
examples.zh: 万一遇到火灾，一定要保持冷静。

examples.en: Behind the microphone he stood immovable in a marble calm.
examples.zh: 他站在话筒后面一动也不动，显得极为镇定。

examples.en: The nurses calmed the anxious patient with soothing words.
examples.zh: 护士们说了一些安慰的话，使那个焦灼的病人平静下来。

items.explanation: （天气、海洋等）静的，平静的；（人）镇静的，沉着的

examples.en: The sea was calm after the storm.
examples.zh: 经过这场风暴后，大海平静下来了。

items.explanation: 和平的，平静的

examples.en: find a peaceful settlement
examples.zh: 找到一个和平解决的办法

items.explanation: 静止的；宁静的；从容的

examples.en: a quiet life
examples.zh: 平静的生活

examples.en: A potato has about 90 calories.
examples.zh: 一个马铃薯大约有 90 卡。

examples.en: The camel’s feet, well adapted for dry sand, are useless on mud.
examples.zh: 骆驼的蹄子虽然非常适合在干沙上行走，但碰到泥泞时却无计可施。

examples.en: Now a camera does not cost much and most young people are certainly able to pay for it.
examples.zh: 现在照相机花费不多，所以绝大多数年轻人都能买得起。

examples.en: When I see the picture, it always reminds me of the happy time I spent in the summer camp.
examples.zh: 每当看到那张照片，总会使我想起我在夏令营里度过的快乐时光。

examples.en: The hunters camped near the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 猎人在山顶附近设营。

examples.en: He died in Huaihai Campaign during the war.
examples.zh: 在战争期间他死于淮海战役。

senses.trans: 参加（或发起）运动，参加（或从事）竞选

examples.en: He announced that he would campaign for the senate.
examples.zh: 他宣布他准备参加参议员竞选。

examples.en: As expected beforehand, many parents who attended the parents’ meeting volunteered to take on the responsibility of campus inspectors.
examples.zh: 正如之前预料的一样，参加家长会的很多家长自告奋勇承担了校园检查员的职务。

examples.en: Students are encouraged to participate in the various clubs and activities available on campus.
examples.zh: 鼓励学生们参加校内各种社团和活动。

examples.en: Only by learning to respect interpersonal differences can we avoid misunderstanding and build harmonious relationships with others.
examples.zh: 我们只有学会尊重人际间的差异，才能避免误会，与他人建立和谐的关系。（长宁）

examples.en: This can holds five liters of water.
examples.zh: 这个容器可装 5 升水。

senses.trans: 把（食品等）装罐（或听、瓶等）

examples.en: Mother is canning peaches.
examples.zh: 母亲正在把桃子装瓶贮存。

examples.en: My aunt lives in Canada.
examples.zh: 我的姑母住在加拿大。

examples.en: I think the Canadian is going to come second.
examples.zh: 我认为那个加拿大人会得第二名。

examples.en: Facing the failure of one experiment after another, the Canadian scientist didn’t get discouraged; instead, he kept improving his experiment and finally made a breakthrough.
examples.zh: 面对实验一次又一次失败，这位加拿大科学家并没有气馁，相反，他不断改进实验，最终取得了突破。

examples.en: The Panama Canal provides a shipping link between the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
examples.zh: 巴拿马运河在大西洋和太平洋间提供了一个船运航道。

examples.en: We shouldn’t hurry all the way to the airport, the flight was cancelled because of the foggy weather.
examples.zh: 我们不应该急着去机场，因为有雾，航班被取消了。

examples.en: What other factors are there that have worked wonders on these cancer patients apart from the change in their lifestyles?
examples.zh: 除了生活习惯上的改变，究竟还有其他什么因素在这些癌症患者身上创造了奇迹？

examples.en: It is not book knowledge but practical experience that many candidates lack nowadays.
examples.zh: 现在许多求职者缺乏的不是书本知识，而是实践经验。

examples.en: Don’t be afraid, I will light a candle.
examples.zh: 别怕，我去点支蜡烛。

examples.en: a box of candy
examples.zh: 一盒糖果

examples.en: It’s more convenient to eat in the canteen.
examples.zh: 在食堂里吃饭更省事。

examples.en: A young man in a red cap is reading a newspaper.
examples.zh: 一个戴红色帽子的年轻男子正在看报纸。

examples.en: Snow capped the hills.
examples.zh: 积雪覆盖山顶。

examples.en: In the long run, the wider range of knowledge you have, the more capable you are of dealing with the problems at work.
examples.zh: 从长远来看，你的知识面越广，就越有能力应付工作中的问题。

examples.en: She is perfectly capable of taking care of herself.
examples.zh: 她完全有能力照顾自己。

examples.en: The theatre has a seating capacity of 2,000.
examples.zh: 那座剧院能容纳 2000 名观众。

examples.en: Beijing is the capital of China.
examples.zh: 北京是中国的首都。

examples.en: a capital ship
examples.zh: 一艘主舰

examples.en: If you do not like the taste, take it in capsule form.
examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢这个味道，那么就服用胶囊吧。

examples.en: Tom Zhu is a captain.
examples.zh: 汤姆·朱是一位船长。

examples.en: Two of the soldiers were killed and the others were captured.
examples.zh: 两名士兵被杀，其余被俘。

examples.en: With the capture of the escaped tiger, everyone felt relieved.
examples.zh: 逃出来的老虎被捕获后，大家都松了一口气。

examples.en: At least 50% of the sale of the world’s luxury cars depends on the fast-rising Asian market.
examples.zh: 世界上的豪华汽车至少 50% 的销售依赖于快速崛起的亚洲市场。

examples.en: The two principal combustion products are water vapor and carbon dioxide.
examples.zh: 两种主要的燃烧产物是水蒸气和二氧化碳。

examples.en: People use greeting cards to express feelings and keep in touch with each other.
examples.zh: 人们用贺卡表达情感并保持联系。

examples.en: Actually I don’t care what you do in your spare time.
examples.zh: 实际上我不介意你业余时间干些什么。

examples.en: The old man has no children, but his niece has been taking good care of his daily life.
examples.zh: 这位老人虽无儿无女，但侄女一直在悉心照料着他的起居。（崇明）

c.name: care for
trans: 喜欢，想要［常用于疑问句和否定句］

examples.en: You have to learn to take care of your possessions.
examples.zh: 你得学会保管好自己的财物。

c.name: Care and diligence bring luck.
trans: 谨慎和勤奋才能抓住机遇。

examples.en: We can learn much by reading about the careers of great men.
examples.zh: 阅读伟人一生经历的作品可获益匪浅。

items.explanation: 职业（指谋生的职业生涯，是可数名词）

examples.en: What would you like to do as a career after graduation?
examples.zh: 你毕业后想要从事什么职业？

items.explanation: 工作（指长久性所从事的职业，是较正式的用语）

examples.en: What’s your occupation?
examples.zh: 你从事什么职业？

items.explanation: 职业（尤指受过高等教育及专门训练的职业）

examples.en: His uncle is a lawyer by profession.
examples.zh: 他叔叔的职业是律师。

examples.en: Making a careful plan in advance can help you finish the tough task more efficiently.
examples.zh: 提前做出周密计划可以帮你更有效地完成这项艰巨任务。

examples.en: It’s known to all that careless drivers are a danger to both themselves and others.
examples.zh: 大家都知道，粗心的司机对自己和他人都是危险的。

examples.en: The ship was carrying a cargo of wood from Canada to America.
examples.zh: 这艘船当时正从加拿大运送一船木头到美国。

examples.en: He is a very skilled carpenter.
examples.zh: 他是一个熟练的木匠。

examples.en: She accidentally spilled wine on the carpet.
examples.zh: 她不小心把酒洒在了地毯上。

examples.en: The train carriage was full, so we had to stand.
examples.zh: 火车车厢满了，我们只好站着。

examples.en: You should eat such vegetables as carrot, celery and spinach.
examples.zh: 你应该吃胡萝卜、芹菜和菠菜之类的蔬菜。

examples.en: With a series of favourable policies carried out, the electric vehicle company is optimistic about advancing battery technology into international markets.
examples.zh: 随着一系列优惠政策落地，电动车企业对推动电池技术走向国际市场很乐观。（闵行）

c.name: carry ... away
trans: 使激动而失去自我控制力

examples.en: We expect him to carry out his promise to quit smoking.
examples.zh: 我们期待他履行戒烟的诺言。

examples.en: The farmer conveyed apples in a cart.
examples.zh: 这个农民用大车运苹果。

examples.en: Nowadays science fiction isn’t as popular as cartoon among teenagers.
examples.zh: 如今，在青少年中科幻小说不像漫画那样受欢迎。

examples.en: The country was carved into equal districts.
examples.zh: 这国家被划为几个相等的地区。

examples.en: In most cases, we can get the main idea of the passage by reading it through.
examples.zh: 在大多数情况下，通过通读段落我们可以了解大意。

examples.en: All these rules must be observed in any case.
examples.zh: 无论如何，所有这些规则都必须遵守。

examples.en: In case of emergency, break the glass and press the button.
examples.zh: 遇到紧急情况时，击碎玻璃并按下按钮。

examples.en: In no case can I make an exception to this regulation.
examples.zh: 不管怎样，我决不能对这项规定破例。

examples.en: Mobile payment is playing an increasingly important part in our daily life, saving us the trouble of carrying cash.
examples.zh: 手机支付在我们的日常生活中越来越重要，现在我们出门无需带现金了。

examples.en: Can you cash this cheque for me?
examples.zh: 这张支票你可以给我兑成现金吗？

examples.en: The cashier is adding up her receipts.
examples.zh: 出纳员正把所收的款项加总起来。

examples.en: He casted a stone into the water.
examples.zh: 他把一块石头丢进水里。

examples.en: The cast is complete.
examples.zh: 角色已全部分派好。

examples.en: She always dreams of living in a medieval castle.
examples.zh: 她总是梦想住在一座中世纪的城堡中。

examples.en: His casual manner annoyed her.
examples.zh: 他漫不经心的态度使她恼火。

examples.en: Out of the corner rushed a cat, which frightened the old man back a few steps.
examples.zh: 拐角处突然窜出一只猫，把老人吓得倒退了几步。

examples.en: Students can search the library’s online catalogue and order books.
examples.zh: 学生可以搜索图书馆的在线目录然后订书。

examples.en: Scientists were cataloguing the animal of their regions.
examples.zh: 科学家们将他们区域的动物编入目录。

examples.en: He caught the first opportunity to leave.
examples.zh: 他抓住先机离开了。

examples.en: The lock won’t catch.
examples.zh: 这把锁锁不住。

examples.en: As she passed the shop, a blue dress displayed in the window caught her eye.
examples.zh: 当她走过商店时，橱窗中陈列的一件蓝色连衣裙吸引了她的目光。

examples.en: She caught sight of a figure disappearing into the darkness.
examples.zh: 她看见一个人影在黑暗中消失了。

examples.en: If you hurry, you could catch up with them at the bridge.
examples.zh: 你如果快点，应该能在桥那儿赶上他们。

examples.en: Common bacteria, which have been known to survive in many environments that support no other form of life, fall into this category.
examples.zh: 在许多不支持其他生命形式的环境中存活的常见细菌属于这一类。（徐汇）

examples.en: There are ten head of cattle in her farm.
examples.zh: 她的农场上有 10 头牛。

examples.en: It’s known to all that smoking can cause many diseases.
examples.zh: 众所周知，吸烟会导致多种疾病。

examples.en: Please contact me by phone when it is convenient for you, and I will explain to you in detail the cause of your stomach disorder.
examples.zh: 方便的时候请与我电话联系，我会向你详细解释你肠胃不适的原因。

items.explanation: 起因，原因（一般指导致某事发生的起因或缘由，后接介词 of）

examples.en: I haven’t found out the cause of the engine trouble.
examples.zh: 我还未找到发动机故障的起因。

items.explanation: 理由（指说明事实的理由，后接介词 for）

examples.en: Those who are against the plan must give their reasons.
examples.zh: 那些反对这项计划的人必须说出理由。

items.explanation: 借口，托词（表示对某种行为的辩解或口实）

examples.en: Is that your excuse for your being late for work every day?
examples.zh: 那就是你每天上班迟到的借口吗？

examples.en: Educators urge caution in using a ranking table and emphasize that the better choice for one student may be very different for another.
examples.zh: 教育家们要求谨慎使用排名，并强调对一个学生而言的更佳选择，对另一个学生而言可能并非如此。（黄浦）

examples.en: I must caution you against the danger.
examples.zh: 我必须告诫你谨防危险。

examples.en: They put the food at the entrance to the cave.
examples.zh: 他们把食物放在洞口。

examples.en: I had a nervous breakdown, and everything just seemed to cave in on top of me.
examples.zh: 我曾经有过一次精神崩溃，就好像天塌了一样。

examples.en: CD player is a machine that is used for playing music CDs.
examples.zh: 光盘播放机是用来播放光盘的机器。

examples.en: The company has ceased to exist.
examples.zh: 这家公司已不复存在。

examples.en: We worked without cease to get the project finished on time.
examples.zh: 我们一刻不停地工作，准时完成了项目。

examples.en: He always bumps his head on the low ceiling.
examples.zh: 他的头总撞到低矮的天花板。

examples.en: If you have something to celebrate, something to be proud of and something to look back on when you retire, then your life will be of great value.
examples.zh: 当你退休时，如果有些东西值得庆祝，可以引以为傲，可以回顾，那么你的生活就很有价值。

examples.en: Do you think it necessary for us middle school students to pay so much attention to Internet celebrities?
examples.zh: 你觉得我们中学生有必要那么关注网红吗？（宝山）

examples.en: Microscopic examination of a cell's chromosomes can reveal the sex of the fetus.
examples.zh: 利用显微镜检查细胞染色体，可以发现胎儿的性别。

examples.en: Many people love to record some touching moments which impress them with their cellphones.
examples.zh: 许多人喜欢用手机记录给他们留下深刻印象的动人瞬间。

examples.en: They used cement to repair the cracks in the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 他们用水泥修补了人行道上的裂缝。

examples.en: There is a cemetery near the forest.
examples.zh: 森林旁有一块墓地。

examples.en: It costs 100 cents.
examples.zh: 它值 100 美分。

examples.en: In Finland the temperature is sometimes 40 degrees below zero centigrade.
examples.zh: 在芬兰，温度有时达零下 40 摄氏度。（虹口）

examples.en: He is 180 centimetre high.
examples.zh: 他有 180 厘米高。

examples.en: the central point of argument
examples.zh: 争论的焦点

examples.en: Now we live further away from the city centre.
examples.zh: 现在我们住得离市中心更远了。

examples.en: Our thoughts centre upon this important problem.
examples.zh: 我们的思考集中在这个重要问题上。

examples.en: The end of the 20th century saw great changes in electronic products.
examples.zh: 20 世纪末电子产品发生了巨大的变化。

examples.en: All the stars present at the opening ceremony were willing to donate money to the newly-established charity organization to help children who had dropped out of school.
examples.zh: 出席开幕典礼的明星都愿意捐钱给这个新成立的慈善组织来帮助失学儿童。

examples.en: It is certain that once you are infected with the terrible disease, death is certain to follow shortly after.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，一旦被那可怕的疾病感染，随后肯定很快就会死亡。

examples.en: Certainly, the early years are crucial to a child’s development.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，幼年对儿童的成长至关重要。

examples.en: an examination certificate
examples.zh: 考试通过证书

examples.en: His good character is adequately certificated.
examples.zh: 他的好品德有文件充分为证。

examples.en: He now owns a chain of 970 food stores.
examples.zh: 他现在拥有 970 家连锁食品店。

examples.en: chain a dog
examples.zh: 用链条拴住一只狗

examples.en: A chair consists of a seat with a back.
examples.zh: 椅子是由椅座和椅背组成的。

examples.en: chair a meeting
examples.zh: 主持会议

examples.en: When the chairman of Campbell's retired, McGovern was named as his successor.
examples.zh: 坎贝尔公司的总裁退休后，麦戈文被选定为继任者。

examples.en: a stick of chalk
examples.zh: 一支粉笔

examples.en: The competition is both a challenge and a chance to us.
examples.zh: 这次竞赛对我们来说既是挑战也是机遇。

examples.en: challenge sb. to a fight
examples.zh: 向某人挑战

examples.en: She was at that time challenging for the lead in the Women's Club.
examples.zh: 她那时正在竞选，争当女性俱乐部的领导。

examples.en: a champion boxer
examples.zh: 一个获得冠军的拳击手

examples.en: By 1978 Boitano was the national junior champion in ice skating.
examples.zh: 1978 年以前，博伊塔诺是全国青少年滑冰比赛的冠军。

examples.en: It was a girl student who won the championship of the 2023 campus singer competition.
examples.zh: 荣获 2023 年校园歌手大赛冠军的是一位女生。

examples.en: I really appreciate your giving me this chance of an interview.
examples.zh: 十分感谢你给我这次面试的机会。

examples.en: I chanced to run into an old classmate this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我偶然碰到了一位老同学。

items.explanation: 机会（指有利的时机，符合自己想干某事的意愿、目的、雄心甚至野心）

examples.en: During our stay in England we had more opportunities of practicing our spoken English.
examples.zh: 我们在英国期间有较多练习口语的机会。

items.explanation: 机会，运气（表示幸运或偶然的时机）

examples.en: No one discovers a rarity by chance.
examples.zh: 没有人能侥幸发现一件珍品。

examples.en: Situations are changing continually, so we must study to adapt our thinking to new situations.
examples.zh: 情况在不断地变化，要使自己的思想适应新的情况，就得学习。（徐汇）

examples.en: I have no small change.
examples.zh: 我没有零钱。

examples.en: He changed many channels but still couldn't find any interesting programmes.
examples.zh: 他调了许多频道，但是仍然找不到任何有趣的节目。

examples.en: The chaos may have contributed to the deaths of up to 20 people.
examples.zh: 混乱可能导致多达 20 人丧生。

examples.en: Open your books to Chapter 4.
examples.zh: 把你们的书翻到第 4 章。

examples.en: The characters originating from ancient Chinese literature have gained new lives in this online game.
examples.zh: 那些源自中国古代文学的角色在这个网络游戏中获得了新生。（崇明）

examples.en: The main characteristic of the strike is its longevity.
examples.zh: 这次罢工的主要特点是持续时间长。

examples.en: The leader spoke with characteristic enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 这位领导者以特有的热情说话。

examples.en: The money raised and the relief supplies are in the charge of the organizer, and then they will be sent to the disaster area soon.
examples.zh: 筹集来的钱和救援物资由组织者管理，然后很快会被送往灾区。

examples.en: Even local nurseries charge £ 100 a week.
examples.zh: 连本地托儿所每星期都要收费 100 英镑。

c.name: be in the charge of sb.

examples.en: The charity fund was conducted to promote youth soccer in China.
examples.zh: 这项慈善基金的设立旨在在中国推广青少年足球。

examples.en: She is a woman of great charm.
examples.zh: 她是一个极有魅力的女子。

examples.en: He charmed everyone who knows him.
examples.zh: 所有认识他的人都被他迷住了。

examples.en: a sales chart
examples.zh: 销售图表

examples.en: The police were chasing the criminal.
examples.zh: 警察在追捕罪犯。

examples.en: This is the first time that I have been to a cyber-café, where people can surf and chat freely on the Internet.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次去网吧，在那里人们可以自由地在网上冲浪和聊天。

examples.en: I had a long chat with her about my life.
examples.zh: 关于我的生活，我和她聊了很久。

examples.en: Jack has bought a used car. It's much cheaper than a new one.
examples.zh: 杰克买了一辆二手车。这比买一辆新车要便宜得多。

examples.en: The police warn the citizens not to make friends on the Internet in case they are cheated.
examples.zh: 警方警告市民不要网上交友，以免上当受骗。

examples.en: I don't believe you are a cheat.
examples.zh: 我不敢相信你竟然是骗子。

examples.en: Be sure to check ahead of time what you will need for each activity.
examples.zh: 请务必提前检查每项活动所需的内容。（徐汇）

examples.en: His work will be a check on yours.
examples.zh: 你的工作要对照他的工作来检查。

examples.en: With the development of technology, some of these supermarkets have installed the automatic checkout lanes for customers.
examples.zh: 随着技术的发展，有些超市为顾客开设了自动付款出口。

examples.en: He kissed her on the cheek.
examples.zh: 他亲了亲她的脸颊。

examples.en: Everybody was cheered by the exciting news.
examples.zh: 大家都为这个令人兴奋的消息高声欢呼。

examples.en: What has been puzzling me is what I should do in order to cheer up the students who strive to improve their study but have met with repeated frustrations.
examples.zh: 一直以来困惑我的是，作为老师我应该做些什么，才能使那些努力提高学业成绩而屡次受挫的学生精神振作起来。

examples.en: He's always full of cheer at Christmas.
examples.zh: 圣诞节他总是兴致勃勃。

examples.en: Try to cheer up. Things are not so bad as they seem.
examples.zh: 想法高兴点儿，情况并不像看上去的那样糟。

examples.en: The cheese cake tasted so delicious that the kids asked for more.
examples.zh: 这奶酪蛋糕真好吃，孩子们还想要。

examples.en: The chef is pleased to cater for vegetarian diets.
examples.zh: 主厨非常乐意为客人做素食。

examples.en: The students are doing experiments in the lab with some new chemicals.
examples.zh: 在实验室里学生们正在用一些新的化学品做实验。

examples.en: Qi Yu hopes to do some chemical research in the near future.
examples.zh: 戚宇希望在不久的将来做一些化学研究。

examples.en: She worked as a research chemist.
examples.zh: 她曾经是化学研究员。

examples.en: We make experiments in chemistry every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天都做化学实验。

examples.en: write/sign (sb.) a cheque for $20,000
examples.zh: （给某人）开/签一张 20000 美元的支票

examples.en: Two chess players are playing chess in the park.
examples.zh: 两位棋手在公园下棋。

examples.en: chest pains
examples.zh: 胸部疼痛

examples.en: Have you chewed the meat well before you swallow it?
examples.zh: 你是把肉嚼烂了再吞下去的吗？

examples.en: Mary and Alice like eating chicken, but neither of them likes eating fish.
examples.zh: 玛丽和爱丽丝喜欢吃鸡肉，但她们都不喜欢吃鱼。

examples.en: The chief told him to lead them to the house.
examples.zh: 领导叫他带他们到那栋房子去。

examples.en: His father is the chief engineer of the building project.
examples.zh: 他父亲是这项建筑工程的总工程师。

items.explanation: 主要的，重要的（指事物的某个部分在整体中是最重要、最明显的，起主题作用。一般只用作定语）

examples.en: The two main characters in the play both died in the end.
examples.zh: 两个主角在剧中最后都死了。

items.explanation: 主要的，首要的（指所修饰的对象在等级、地位上较高或较重要，暗示其他的人或事物处于从属或次要地位）

examples.en: Rice is the chief crop of India.
examples.zh: 稻米是印度的主要作物。

items.explanation: 最重要的，主要的（常指大小或地位上优于其他的人或事）

examples.en: Shanghai is a principal city in China.
examples.zh: 上海是中国的主要城市。

examples.en: Medicine should not be kept where it is accessible to children.
examples.zh: 药品不应该放在孩子容易拿到的地方。

c.name: Children and fools speak the truth.

examples.en: She almost died in childbirth.
examples.zh: 她在分娩时几乎死去。

examples.en: He had an unhappy childhood because he was poor and no one took care of him.
examples.zh: 他有一个不幸的童年，因为穷且无人照料。

examples.en: a childish behavior
examples.zh: 幼稚的行为

examples.en: have a chill
examples.zh: 感到一阵寒栗

examples.en: I feel chill.
examples.zh: 我感到寒飕飕。

examples.en: We should clean out the blocked chimney.
examples.zh: 我们应该去疏通这被堵塞的烟囱。

examples.en: In face of the tense and changeable international situation, leaders in China are busy making a series of urgent measures to cope with the possible crisis.
examples.zh: 面对紧张多变的国际形势，中国领导人正忙于制定一系列紧急措施，以应对可能出现的危机。

examples.en: Judy collects blue and white china.
examples.zh: 朱迪收集青花瓷器。

examples.en: The Chinese have made a great contribution to mankind.
examples.zh: 中国人对人类有很大的贡献。

examples.en: The key reason why the Beijing Winter Olympics mascot Bing Dwen Dwen is gaining much popularity is the wide use of Chinese elements in its design.
examples.zh: 北京冬奥会吉祥物冰墩墩广受追捧的关键原因是设计中众多的中国元素。

examples.en: I had fish and chips in a café.
examples.zh: 我在一家小餐馆吃了鱼和炸薯条。

examples.en: There are many chocolates in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱里有许多巧克力。

examples.en: At that time, the bus driver had no choice but to turn to the tourists for help.
examples.zh: 当时，那位大巴司机别无选择，只能求助于游客。

examples.en: He has been singing in the church choir since he was six.
examples.zh: 他从6岁起一直在教堂唱诗班里唱歌。

examples.en: She choked up when she began to talk about her mother.
examples.zh: 她开始谈起母亲时，便哽咽着说不出话来。

examples.en: There is no doubt that everybody has a right to choose his or her own way of living.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问每个人都有选择自己生活方式的权利。

examples.en: chop wood
examples.zh: 劈木头

examples.en: crumple sb. to the ground with a hand chop
examples.zh: 用手砍击将某人打翻在地

examples.en: We eat with chopsticks.
examples.zh: 我们用筷子吃饭。

examples.en: The chorus was singing "The Ode to Joy".
examples.zh: 合唱团在唱《欢乐颂》。

examples.en: With the approach of Christmas, many department stores want to take advantage of this opportunity to promote sales.
examples.zh: 随着圣诞节的临近，许多百货商店都想趁此机会来进行促销。

examples.en: My friends were showing some foreigners around the ancient church this time yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天的这个时候，我的朋友们正在陪一些外国人参观古老的教堂。

trans: [常作 C-] 教会组织；基督教教会（或教派）

examples.en: cigar smoke
examples.zh: 雪茄烟

examples.en: She lit a cigarette.
examples.zh: 她点燃了一支香烟。

examples.en: You shouldn't have got into the cinema unfairly by bribing the ticket collector yesterday evening.
examples.zh: 昨晚你们不应该靠买通检票员混进电影院的。

examples.en: The moon circles the earth.
examples.zh: 月亮绕地球转。

examples.en: The plane circled, awaiting permission to land.
examples.zh: 飞机在天上盘旋，等候着陆许可。

examples.en: They were dancing in a circle.
examples.zh: 他们围成一圈跳舞。

examples.en: The earth takes a year to make a circuit of the sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕太阳运行一圈需要一年的时间。

examples.en: The full moon has a circular form.
examples.zh: 满月呈圆形。

examples.en: Under the circumstances, it is impossible for us to carry on the research.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，我们不可能再继续这项研究了。

examples.en: We took the children to the circus.
examples.zh: 我们带孩子去看了马戏表演。

examples.en: He cites just one example.
examples.zh: 他只引用了一个例子。

examples.en: All the parks in the city should be accessible to citizens for free.
examples.zh: 全市所有的公园都应对市民免费开放。

examples.en: Miss Li has taught English in this school since she moved to this city from her hometown.
examples.zh: 自从李小姐从家乡搬到这座城市，她就一直在这所学校教英语。

examples.en: The country's economy has kept declining since the civil war broke out, because the war is a great drain on its resources.
examples.zh: 自从内战爆发以来，这个国家的经济一路下滑，因为战争大大消耗了它的资源。

examples.en: He is in charge of the civilian side of the UN mission.
examples.zh: 他在联合国使团中负责平民方面的事务。

examples.en: The Chinese civilisation is one of the oldest in the world.
examples.zh: 华夏文明是世界上最古老的文明之一。

trans: （特定地区或国家等的）文化，社会和生活方式

examples.en: We must civilise away the boy's bad habit.
examples.zh: 我们必须教育这孩子，使其改掉恶习。

senses.trans: 对（头衔、财产、名声等）提出要求

examples.en: The medicine was not as effective as what the advertisement had claimed, for it didn't relieve my cough after I took it.
examples.zh: 这种药没有广告说的那么有效，服药后，并没有缓解我的咳嗽。

examples.en: No one turned up to claim on a single article.
examples.zh: 没有人前来认领任何一件物品。

examples.en: The present era makes great claims upon us.
examples.zh: 现在这个时代对我们提出很高的要求。

examples.en: He clapped his son on the back and told him how proud of him he was.
examples.zh: 他拍拍儿子的背并告诉他，他多么为他骄傲。

examples.en: I hope this clarifies my position.
examples.zh: 我希望这能阐明我的立场。

examples.en: On behalf of the whole class, he will express thanks to the teachers at the New Year's Party.
examples.zh: 他将代表全班同学在新年晚会上向老师们表示真诚的感谢。（虹口）

examples.en: I classed him among the top ten Chinese novelists.
examples.zh: 我把他归于中国十大杰出小说家之一。

examples.en: War and Peace is a literary classic.
examples.zh: 《战争与和平》是一部经典文学著作。

examples.en: Whether they are musical pieces or paintings, classic works all have a power that goes beyond time and space.
examples.zh: 无论是音乐还是绘画，经典作品都具有跨越时空的力量。（上海高考）

examples.en: A performer in evening dress plays classical selections on the violin.
examples.zh: 一名身穿晚礼服的表演者用小提琴演奏了几段古典音乐。

examples.en: The books in the library are classified by subject.
examples.zh: 图书馆的书是按科目分类的。

examples.en: It won't be long before my classmates can learn to resist the temptation of online games.
examples.zh: 要不了多久，我的同学们就能学会抵制网络游戏的诱惑。

examples.en: When I got to the classroom just now, I found that Tom was working on a math problem.
examples.zh: 我刚刚到教室时，发现汤姆正在做一道数学题。

examples.en: The boy is playing with clay.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩在玩黏土。

examples.en: Wash your hands and clean your nails.
examples.zh: 洗洗手并把指甲弄干净。

examples.en: It's not easy to make the river clean again, but our government has recently launched a drive to get rid of the river pollution completely.
examples.zh: 使河流变清不是件容易的事，但我们的政府最近发起了一场彻底清除河流污染的运动。

examples.en: He was a window cleaner.
examples.zh: 他是个洗窗工。

examples.en: clear the streets of snow
examples.zh: 清除街上的积雪

examples.en: The neighbour has made it clear that if you play rock music deep into the night, he will complain to the police about it.
examples.zh: 邻居明确表示，如果你播放摇滚乐直到深夜，他要向警方投诉。

examples.en: The car ran clear off the road.
examples.zh: 车子完全驶离了道路。

c.name: clear up
trans: 转晴（表示天气放晴，不用被动）

examples.en: The sky is overcast now, but I think it will clear up soon.
examples.zh: 现在天色阴沉，不过我想马上就会转晴的。

examples.en: It won’t be long before they clear the matter up.
examples.zh: 他们很快就能把事情弄个水落石出。

examples.en: She was born in a clerk family and she is also a bank clerk.
examples.zh: 她出生在一个职员家庭，她也是一个银行办事员。

examples.en: She is the cleverest girl in her class.
examples.zh: 她是班上最聪明的女孩。

examples.en: the click of a door latch
examples.zh: 开启门锁的咔哒声

examples.en: The door clicked shut.
examples.zh: 门咔哒一声关上了。

examples.en: Social workers must always consider the best interests of their clients.
examples.zh: 社会工作者必须时刻考虑其委托人的最佳利益。

examples.en: Keep away from the edge of the cliff!
examples.zh: 离悬崖边缘远点儿！

examples.en: This, along with considerable leisure time plus favorable climate, all contributes to Australians' relaxed attitude.
examples.zh: 这一点，以及大量闲暇时和有利的气候，都造就了澳大利亚人放松的态度。（黄浦）

examples.en: The pursuit of stability is not a bad thing. There are many times when such an attitude drives us to improve ourselves, challenge difficulties, and climb peaks.
examples.zh: 追求稳定并不是什么坏事，很多时候这样的态度在促使我们提升自我、挑战难度、攀登高峰。（普陀）

examples.en: We were very tired after our climb.
examples.zh: 攀登后我们非常疲惫。

examples.en: You'd better go to the clinic and have a thorough check.
examples.zh: 你最好去诊所做一个彻底检查。

examples.en: Big Ben is a famous clock in London.
examples.zh: 大本钟是伦敦一座著名的钟。

examples.en: Each clone has the same genetic information as the original.
examples.zh: 每个无性系都具有与母体相同的遗传信息。

examples.en: In recent years, some scientists and organizations have made public their intentions to clone human beings.
examples.zh: 近年来，一些科学家和组织公布了克隆人的计划。

examples.en: The highway to Nanjing is closed due to the heavy fog.
examples.zh: 因为大雾，通往南京的公路关闭了。

examples.en: We should pay close attention to the safety of students.
examples.zh: 我们应该密切关注学生的安全。

examples.en: He was sitting close to the stranger.
examples.zh: 他紧挨着那位陌生人坐着。

examples.en: three yards of cloth
examples.zh: 3码布

examples.en: It is the first time that he has commented on my clothes seriously.
examples.zh: 这是他第一次一本正经地评价我的衣着。（松江）

examples.en: an article of clothing
examples.zh: 一件衣服

items.explanation: 作不可数名词时，指“衣料”；与不定冠词连用时，指有特殊用途的布。

examples.en: This piece of cloth is not enough for a dress.
examples.zh: 这块布不够做连衣裙。

examples.en: a table cloth
examples.zh: 桌布

items.explanation: 指“衣服”，只用复数形式，不可与数词连用。

examples.en: a baby in long clothes
examples.zh: 襁褓中的婴儿

items.explanation: 为集合名词，不可数，意为“服装”，是包括鞋、帽、袜等衣着的总称。

examples.en: a piece of clothing
examples.zh: 一件衣服

examples.en: There are so many clouds today.
examples.zh: 今天云特别多。

examples.en: Steam has clouded the mirror.
examples.zh: 水蒸气使镜子变得模糊不清。

examples.en: It was cloudy yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天是阴天。

examples.en: He has just joined the local tennis club.
examples.zh: 他刚加入当地的网球俱乐部。

examples.en: get a clue to a mystery
examples.zh: 得到解谜的线索

examples.en: To the coach's relief, all the debate team members have worked together with one will to overcome various difficulties they came across, and all their efforts have finally been rewarded.
examples.zh: 令教练欣慰的是，辩论队全体队员齐心协力，克服了遇到的各种困难，最终所有的努力都得到了回报。（长宁）

examples.en: He coaches students for the examination.
examples.zh: 他辅导学生备考。

examples.en: How much coal was mined here?
examples.zh: 这里开采了多少煤？

examples.en: We lived on the eastern coast of England.
examples.zh: 我们生活在英格兰东海岸。

examples.en: Put your coat on, or you'll freeze.
examples.zh: 穿上外套，否则你会冻僵的。

examples.en: The paint coated the wall.
examples.zh: 墙壁上涂着漆。

examples.en: The cock is crowing.
examples.zh: 公鸡正在啼叫。

examples.en: She wanted to break the code.
examples.zh: 她想解开这密码。

senses.trans: 把……编成密码（或电码、代号等）

examples.en: They coded each sample and sent them to the lab for analysis.
examples.zh: 他们给每个样本都编了号，并送去实验室分析。

examples.en: Don't drink too much coffee at night, or you won't be able to sleep.
examples.zh: 晚上别喝太多的咖啡，会睡不着觉的。（普陀）

examples.en: His hobby is to collect coins from different countries.
examples.zh: 他的业余爱好是收集不同国家的硬币。

examples.en: You can coin a new word to explain your idea.
examples.zh: 你可以造一个词来诠释自己的观点。

examples.en: It was no coincidence that the two disappeared on the same day.
examples.zh: 两个人在同一天失踪绝非巧合。

examples.en: Doctors suggest that we should drink water before we feel thirsty, and drink more boiled water instead of juice or Coke.
examples.zh: 医生建议不要口渴了才喝水，而且要多喝白开水，而不是果汁或可口可乐。

examples.en: He stared at her cold blue eyes.
examples.zh: 他凝视着她冰冷的蓝眼睛。

examples.en: A cold kept him in bed for three days.
examples.zh: 感冒使他卧床三天。

examples.en: Hundreds of buildings collapsed in the earthquake.
examples.zh: 成百上千幢大楼在地震中倒塌。

examples.en: He dragged the dog by the collar.
examples.zh: 他拉着狗的颈圈。

examples.en: Despite his busy schedule, he signed up for the course recommended by his colleague.
examples.zh: 尽管日程安排很紧，他还是报名参加了他同事推荐的那个课程。（金山）

examples.en: Huge amounts of information about pollution was collected by the scientist last year.
examples.zh: 去年这位科学家收集了大量关于污染的信息。

items.explanation: vi. 聚集；集合（指主动汇集在一起）；vt. 使聚集；集合；收集（指把分散的物或人集中在一起，也可用于抽象的事物）

examples.en: The clouds are gathering.
examples.zh: 云在聚集。

examples.en: People often gather dead leaves and burn them. That causes air pollution.
examples.zh: 人们常把枯叶集中在一起烧掉，那样做会污染空气。

items.explanation: v. 收集，采集（指有选择地搜集和逐渐地积累）；聚集（多指渐渐地集中或集聚）

examples.en: Georgia had devoted a lot of time to collecting information about the revolution, and as a result yesterday's lecture was a great success.
examples.zh: 乔治亚花了大量时间收集关于那场革命的信息，结果昨天的讲座十分成功。

examples.en: Soon a crowd of people collected in the square.
examples.zh: 不久，广场上就聚集了一群人。

examples.en: There are two collections a day from this letterbox.
examples.zh: 这个信箱每天收信两次。

examples.en: To his surprise, the result of his Spring College Entrance Examination is much better than what he expected.
examples.zh: 令他惊讶的是，他的春考成绩比他期望的要好得多。

senses.trans: （独立的或附属于大学的）学院

examples.en: French colony
examples.zh: 法国殖民地

examples.en: It is generally believed that one's preference for colour can reveal one's personality.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为，对颜色的偏爱能反映一个人的性格。（青浦）

examples.en: The soap was coloured a light blue.
examples.zh: 肥皂被做成了浅蓝色。

items.explanation: 色彩艳丽的（指不仅有颜色而且色彩丰富；有时引申为“丰富多彩的”）

examples.en: The students live a colourful life on campus.
examples.zh: 学生们在校园里过着丰富多彩的生活。

items.explanation: 彩色的（指有颜色的而不是黑白的）

examples.en: Mother bought the daughter some coloured pencils for drawing.
examples.zh: 妈妈为女儿买了些画画的彩色铅笔。

examples.en: The newspaper devoted a special column to discussing the problem of unemployment, which is one of the most serious problems the present government is faced with.
examples.zh: 报纸开辟了专栏讨论失业问题，这是现届政府面临的最为严峻的问题之一。

examples.en: Your hair needs a comb.
examples.zh: 你的头发要梳一梳。

examples.en: After that he combed his hair and took his breakfast.
examples.zh: 这样之后他梳理了头发，然后吃早餐。

examples.en: This drink, which is a combination of fruit and vegetable juices, tastes great.
examples.zh: 这款饮料由水果和蔬菜汁混合而成，味道很好。（黄浦）

examples.en: She combines the rich traditions of Chinese culture with the composition and performance techniques of Western classical music, giving new life and expressive power to music.
examples.zh: 她将中国深厚的传统文化与西方古典音乐的作曲与演奏技法融为一体，赋予音乐全新的生命和表现力。（嘉定）

c.name: combine A with B
trans: 把 A 和 B 结合起来

examples.en: Whatever difficulty you may meet with, all your dreams will come true, only if you keep on working hard.
examples.zh: 无论你遇到什么困难，只要坚持不懈地努力，你所有的梦想都会实现。

examples.en: Come on over, we've got lots of the old gang here.
examples.zh: 过来吧，好多老朋友都在这儿。

examples.en: Have you got the issue that came out recently?
examples.zh: 你有最近出的那一期杂志吗？

examples.en: Let me know how the voting comes out.
examples.zh: 告诉我投票结果如何。

examples.en: The robbers knocked him unconscious, and when he came to himself he was lying alone in the dark.
examples.zh: 劫犯们把他打昏，当他醒来时发现自己孤身一人躺在黑暗中。

examples.en: After much talk they came to an agreement.
examples.zh: 经过多次商谈，他们达成了协议。

examples.en: When he came to himself, he found himself lying in bed.
examples.zh: 他苏醒过来后，发现自己躺在床上。

examples.en: Comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes and amusing stories.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员的工作是通过讲笑话和滑稽故事来逗人发笑。

examples.en: Do you prefer comedy or tragedy?
examples.zh: 你喜欢喜剧还是悲剧？

examples.en: I am always grateful to those who comfort me when I am in low spirits.
examples.zh: 我总是对那些在我失意时安慰我的人心存感激。

examples.en: Your letters have been a great comfort to me.
examples.zh: 你的来信给了我很大的安慰。

examples.en: During holidays and festivals, my family go camping in the suburbs so that we can enjoy a casual and comfortable life.
examples.zh: 每逢节假日，我们一家就会去郊外野营，享受悠闲惬意的生活。

examples.en: a comic actor
examples.zh: 喜剧演员

examples.en: Joe loved to read "Superman" comics.
examples.zh: 乔喜欢看《超人》漫画书。

examples.en: A good command of English will help one to get a good job.
examples.zh: 英语掌握得好有助于找到好工作。

examples.en: We can't speak English fluently unless we command a large vocabulary.
examples.zh: 我们只有掌握了大量的词汇才能流利地说英语。

examples.en: The commander deployed his men along the railway.
examples.zh: 指挥官把兵力部署在铁路沿线。

examples.en: Is it necessary for you to care about the comments which other people make on you?
examples.zh: 你有没有必要在乎他人对你的评论？

examples.en: Please comment on our plan as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快对我们的计划作出评论。

examples.en: The teacher refused to comment on the examination results.
examples.zh: 教师拒绝对考试结果发表评论。

examples.en: international commerce
examples.zh: 国际贸易

examples.en: a commercial venture
examples.zh: 商业投资

examples.en: In the commercial, an announcer interviews a teacher.
examples.zh: 在这则广告中，播音员采访了一位老师。

examples.en: During the past three years, he has committed himself to studying the relationship between the spread speed of information and the rhythm of people's life.
examples.zh: 在过去三年中，他一直致力于研究信息的传播速度和人们生活节奏的关系。

examples.en: The hospital has a commitment to provide the best possible medical care.
examples.zh: 这家医院承诺要提供最好的医疗服务。

examples.en: The committee's decision is to substitute Mary for Kitty to take part in the singing competition.
examples.zh: 组委会的决定是由玛丽代替凯蒂去参加歌唱比赛。

examples.en: We drew a conclusion from the survey that those who had a lot in common wouldn't necessarily make a good couple.
examples.zh: 我们从调查中得出结论，那些有许多共同之处的人并不一定能成为好夫妻。

examples.en: Birdsong may have more in common with human speech than we realize.
examples.zh: 鸟类唱歌和人类说话之间的共同之处，很可能比我们所认识到的还要多。

examples.en: He has communicated his wishes to me.
examples.zh: 他已经把他的愿望告诉了我。

examples.en: When it comes to office conflicts, experts suggest one should reflect more on themselves, always put themselves in others' shoes, and communicate with workmates in time.
examples.zh: 当谈到办公室冲突的时候，专家建议更多反思自己，更多换位思考，并及时与同事沟通。

examples.en: Due to the rapid development of communication network, the number of smartphone users in China has increased at an astonishing rate in recent years, which has significantly changed the way in which many people read.
examples.zh: 由于通信网络的快速发展，中国智能手机用户数量近年来以惊人的速度增长，这极大地改变了许多人的阅读方式。

examples.en: the Communist Party of China
examples.zh: 中国共产党

examples.en: The coffee shop in the community is scheduled to open at the end of the year, which is really the icing on the cake.
examples.zh: 小区里的咖啡店定于年底开张，这真是锦上添花的美事。（青浦）

examples.en: The dog has been the old lady's only companion for 5 years.
examples.zh: 这条狗成为老太太唯一的同伴已有 5 年了。

examples.en: This well-known company continues to improve its production technology and the newly released dairy product has not only high nutritional value but good taste, which is suitable for both the young and the old.
examples.zh: 这家知名企业不断改进生产技术，新近上市的这款奶制品不仅营养价值高，而且口感好，老少咸宜。

examples.en: If you are going out for a walk, I'll come along and keep you company.
examples.zh: 你要是去散步，我来陪你做个伴吧。

examples.en: Let's make a comparative study of the two languages.
examples.zh: 让我们将这两种语言做一下比较研究。

examples.en: Compared with other students, the girl has better listening and speaking abilities in English.
examples.zh: 同其他学生相比，那个女孩有更强的英语听说能力。

examples.en: There is no comparison between frozen and fresh food.
examples.zh: 冷冻食品和新鲜食品不能相提并论。

examples.en: By comparison, trips by sea offer a great variety of conveniences and comforts.
examples.zh: 相比之下，坐船旅行提供各种便利和舒适。

examples.en: I don't approve of children competing in China's Got Talent, which will make them dream of becoming famous overnight.
examples.zh: 我不赞成儿童参加《中国达人秀》，因为这会使他们梦想一夜成名。

examples.en: The selection process is based on rigorous tests of competence and experience.
examples.zh: 选拔过程是基于对能力和经验的严格测试。

examples.en: With the sharp rise in the number of the university students, the competition for employment is becoming fiercer and fiercer.
examples.zh: 随着大学生成人数的激增，就业竞争越来越激烈。

items.explanation: 指户内或户外、脑力或体力的游戏和比赛，通常有一定的规则，凡参加者必须遵守。

examples.en: We will win the game.
examples.zh: 我们将赢得比赛。

examples.en: a football game
examples.zh: 足球赛

examples.en: the Olympic Games
examples.zh: 奥运会（复数形式指运动比赛大会）

items.explanation: 用于个人竞技及力量型的比赛。指球类比赛时可以与 game 通用；重要的、公开的比赛用 match。

examples.en: a football match
examples.zh: 足球赛

items.explanation: 指知识、体力或技能方面的比赛，有时要进行一系列较量才能定胜负。

examples.en: He entered for a skiing competition.
examples.zh: 他报名参加了滑雪比赛。

items.explanation: （速度上的）比赛

examples.en: Who will win the 200-metre race?
examples.zh: 谁会赢 200 米赛跑？

examples.en: When we step into society one day, we should learn to get accustomed to the fiercely competitive social life.
examples.zh: 当我们踏入社会时，要学会适应竞争激烈的社会生活。

examples.en: She has come to understand that it is no use complaining about the past failure and that she should face the reality.
examples.zh: 她已经明白了，抱怨过去的失败是没有用的，要面对现实。

examples.en: People always complain that the big companies are unfriendly and unhelpful.
examples.zh: 人们总是抱怨大公司不友善，不愿提供帮助。

examples.en: A person must realize his strong and weak points before he can reasonably set up the goal for life and struggle for it without regrets or complaints.
examples.zh: 一个人必须清楚地意识到自己的长处和短处之后，才能合理地制定人生目标，无怨无悔地为之奋斗。

examples.en: Not until he completed the task did he find it was midnight.
examples.zh: 直到完成了任务，他才发现时间已经到了午夜。

examples.en: The doctor advised me to take a complete rest.
examples.zh: 医生让我彻底休息。

items.explanation: vt. 完成（侧重指结束了某事全过程的最后一步；后接名词或动名词）

examples.en: I have finished answering all my e-mails.
examples.zh: 我已回复完所有的电子邮件。

items.explanation: vt. 完成，使完满（侧重指结果的圆满和完美。在表示结束某项工作、任务时，与 finish 同义，可通用，但当 finish 作“吃完，读完”解，后接动名词时，不可通用）

examples.en: In his opinion, the happiness of parents will be quite completed if their children have more or less succeeded.
examples.zh: 在他看来，孩子或多或少成功了，家长也就心满意足，别无他求。

items.explanation: v. 结束，（使）终止（侧重整个过程发展到了终结。后接介词 in，表示“以……告终”）

examples.en: Gambling often ends up in theft and robbery, and even in crimes of violence.
examples.zh: 赌博往往使赌徒最终走向偷窃或抢劫，甚至犯下暴力罪行。

examples.en: The project is taking a long time but is now nearing completion.
examples.zh: 这个项目耗时很长，但现在就快结束了。

examples.en: a complex situation
examples.zh: 复杂的情况

examples.en: The complex opens to the public tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这幢综合大楼将于明天对公众开放。

items.explanation: 复杂的，错综的（指物体的整体结构或事物发展过程中包含着错综复杂的不同成分或关系）

examples.en: This is a complex sentence.
examples.zh: 这是一个复合句。

items.explanation: 复杂的；难解的（常指各种事物或事物的各个方面纠缠在一起，难以理解或解释；一般不用于具体事物）

examples.en: The detective tried to find a clue to the complicated case.
examples.zh: 侦探试图为那件错综复杂的案子找出线索。

examples.en: This case is too complicated to explain in such a short time.
examples.zh: 这个案例太复杂，一时半会解释不清楚。（长宁）

examples.en: The specialist was paid a compliment on his ability to cope with changes all the time.
examples.zh: 这位专家应对变化的能力令人赞不绝口。

examples.en: The management plan has four main components.
examples.zh: 管理计划有四个主要部分。

examples.en: The medical team will be composed of three physicians, a surgeon and two nurses.
examples.zh: 医疗队将由 3 位内科医生、1 位外科大夫和 2 位护士组成。

examples.en: Mozart began to compose when he was six years old.
examples.zh: 莫扎特6岁开始作曲。

examples.en: Muscle is composed of two different types of protein.
examples.zh: 肌肉是由两种不同类型的蛋白质构成的。

examples.en: Lewis emerges as a composer of distinction and sensitivity.
examples.zh: 刘易斯作为一位悟性很高的优秀作曲家崭露头角。

examples.en: Many spelling mistakes can be avoided if you check your composition carefully.
examples.zh: 如果你仔细检查作文的话，许多拼写错误是可以避免的。

examples.en: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。

examples.en: Many insects have compound eyes.
examples.zh: 许多昆虫有复眼。

examples.en: The question is beyond my comprehension.
examples.zh: 这问题超出了我的理解力。

examples.en: Child welfare services are well established and comprehensive.
examples.zh: 儿童福利机构发展成熟，体系完善。

examples.en: Education comprises two-thirds of all local council spending.
examples.zh: 教育占地方市政会全部开支的三分之二。

examples.en: compulsory education
examples.zh: 义务教育

senses.trans: （花样滑冰、体操比赛等中的）规定动作

examples.en: Don't worry, I'll compute the answer soon.
examples.zh: 别急，我马上就要算出答案了。

examples.en: I can operate the computer, but when it comes to the repair of it, I know nothing about it.
examples.zh: 我会操作电脑，但谈到修理电脑，我一无所知。

examples.en: He tried to conceal the truth by telling a lie.
examples.zh: 他企图用谎言来掩盖真相。

items.explanation: 比 hide 更正式，常指“有意而巧妙地隐藏或隐瞒”。

examples.en: She concealed the note in her dress.
examples.zh: 她把字条藏在衣服里。

items.explanation: 为常用词，指“故意或无意地躲藏或隐蔽而不被发现”。

examples.en: The view is hidden by the billboard.
examples.zh: 广告板把视线挡住了。

examples.en: If you concentrate on your studies, you are sure to pass the examination.
examples.zh: 只要你专心学习，一定能通过考试。

examples.en: He is a boy with little power of concentration.
examples.zh: 他是个注意力不容易集中的男孩。

examples.en: the concept of beauty
examples.zh: 美的概念

examples.en: This newly released movie is meant to arouse the public's concern about the frontier policemen, who risk their life to defend the national dignity of the country at any cost.
examples.zh: 最近上映的这部电影旨在唤起公众对于边防警察的关注，他们冒着生命危险，不惜一切代价捍卫国家的尊严。

examples.en: With various payment methods emerging, what many people are more and more concerned about is whether their e-wallets are safe enough, compared with cash or credit card.
examples.zh: 随着各种支付方式的出现，许多人越来越担心的是，和现金或信用卡相比，他们的电子钱包是否足够安全。

examples.en: Tickets for tonight's concert have already been sold out.
examples.zh: 今晚的音乐会门票已全部售罄。

examples.en: The jury concluded from the evidence that she was guilty.
examples.zh: 陪审团根据证据得出结论，认定她有罪。

examples.en: After a heated discussion, we reached a conclusion that when meeting a new word, we should guess its meaning first.
examples.zh: 在热烈的讨论后，我们得出了结论，遇到新词应该先猜词义。

examples.en: a concrete mixer
examples.zh: 混凝土搅拌机

examples.en: He concreted over his nice garden.
examples.zh: 他把他美丽的花园全浇成混凝土。

examples.en: They think he is the murderer, but they have no concrete evidence.
examples.zh: 他们认为他就是那个杀人犯，但是没有具体证据。

examples.en: It's difficult for them to reach to an agreement with the boss on improving their working conditions.
examples.zh: 他们很难与老板在改善工作条件上达成一致。

examples.en: She will join us on condition that we divide all the profits equally.
examples.zh: 她愿意加入，条件是我们大家要平分利润。

c.name: on this/that/no/what condition
trans: 在这种/那种/没有/什么情况下

examples.en: The experiments were conducted by the scientists from China.
examples.zh: 这项实验由来自中国的科学家进行指导。

examples.en: conduct oneself with judgement
examples.zh: 表现得有判断力

examples.en: His conduct at school was disgraceful.
examples.zh: 他在学校的表现简直丢人。

examples.en: He showed his ticket to the conductor and got on.
examples.zh: 他向检票员出示了车票，然后上了车。

examples.en: The excuse Eric made up for his absence from the conference didn't make any sense at all.
examples.zh: 艾里克为缺席会议所编造的借口一点儿也说不通。

examples.en: It is commendable that a teacher has the courage to confess to having made mistakes to his students.
examples.zh: 一个老师有勇气向学生承认自己犯了错误是难能可贵的。

examples.en: If you have confidence in yourself, your dream is sure to come true.
examples.zh: 只要对自己有信心，你的理想会实现的。

examples.en: I feel quite confident that I will pass the exam this time.
examples.zh: 我觉得很有信心，我会通过这次考试。

examples.en: Please confirm the news by calling me.
examples.zh: 请打电话给我来确认这个消息。

examples.en: conflict of interest
examples.zh: 利益冲突

examples.en: The two messages conflict and I don't know which to believe.
examples.zh: 这两条信息相冲突，我不知道该相信哪条。

examples.en: Confucius' thoughts have been developed into a system of philosophy known as Confucianism.
examples.zh: 孔子的思想形成了一套被称为“儒教”的哲学体系。

examples.en: Confucius is considered the greatest of the ancient Chinese sages.
examples.zh: 孔子被认为是中国古代最伟大的圣人。

examples.en: Be careful not to confuse quantity with quality.
examples.zh: 注意不要混淆数量与质量。

examples.en: The old man's mind was getting confused.
examples.zh: 这老人的脑子开始糊涂了。

examples.en: Cities have brought better life for people, but they have also caused population explosion, traffic congestion, environmental pollution, resource depletion and friction between cultures.
examples.zh: 城市为人们带来了美好生活，但也带来了人口膨胀、交通拥挤、环境污染、资源紧缺和文化摩擦等问题。

examples.en: He warmly congratulated me on the good exam result.
examples.zh: 他热情祝贺我考试取得优异的成绩。

examples.en: I congratulated him on his recent promotion/his being promoted recently.
examples.zh: 我祝贺他最近升职了。

examples.en: Congratulations on winning the prize!
examples.zh: 祝贺你获奖！

examples.en: a medical congress
examples.zh: 医学大会

examples.en: Somehow she connected the story with what she experienced in her childhood.
examples.zh: 不知怎的，她把这个故事和她童年时所经历的事联系起来了。

examples.en: The Chinese people will never be conquered.
examples.zh: 中国人民是不可战胜的。

items.explanation: 指“征服”，强调控制人、物或感情。

examples.en: Some countries may be defeated but never conquered.
examples.zh: 有些国家能被击败，却无法被征服。

items.explanation: 指“克服，克制”，尤指感情。

examples.en: He couldn't overcome his dislike for that man.
examples.zh: 他无法不讨厌那个男人。

examples.en: His conscience was plaguing him.
examples.zh: 他受着良心责备。

examples.en: Are you conscious of any change in this neighborhood?
examples.zh: 你是否察觉到这个街坊有什么变化？

examples.en: No matter how many excuses he made up, he had to pay the price for the consequences caused by his errors.
examples.zh: 无论他编造了多少借口，他都得为自己失误而造成的后果买单。

examples.en: The benefits of conservation are both financial and aesthetic.
examples.zh: 保护自然环境能带来经济方面和美化环境方面的好处。

examples.en: We must conserve our natural resources for future generations.
examples.zh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护自然资源。

examples.en: It is generally considered that the simplest way to keep fit is to eat more vegetables and less meat.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为，保持健康最简单的办法是多吃蔬菜少吃肉。

examples.en: Shares and bonds can bring one quite a considerable additional income.
examples.zh: 股票和债券都能给个人带来不菲的额外收入。

examples.en: When we get along with others, we should learn to put ourselves in others' shoes and be considerate of the difficulties of others.
examples.zh: 当我们与人相处时，要学会换位思考并体谅他人的难处。（徐汇）

examples.en: The entire world consists of matter.
examples.zh: 整个世界都是由物质组成的。

c.name: consist of
trans: 由……组成（一般用主动语态）

examples.en: Each group shall consist of not less than ten members.
examples.zh: 每个小组至少得有10位成员组成。

examples.en: It's terribly important for parents to be consistent.
examples.zh: 父母要做到始终如一，这是极为重要的。

examples.en: In history, change is constant.
examples.zh: 在历史上，变化是不断的。

items.explanation: 持续的（没有变更或间歇地连续着），经常的；坚定不移的

examples.en: Constant practice will make you overcome the difficulty.
examples.zh: 不断练习能让你克服困难。

items.explanation: 接二连三的（指事物和动作断断续续地发生，或连续发生，但有间断）

examples.en: There is continual trouble on the frontier.
examples.zh: 边界麻烦不断。

items.explanation: 连续的（指连续而不中断）

examples.en: The continuous work has made me thoroughly exhausted.
examples.zh: 连续的工作让我精疲力竭。

examples.en: He swore an oath promising to uphold and protect the country's constitution and laws.
examples.zh: 他宣誓捍卫国家的宪法与法律。

examples.en: Every citizen has the duty to construct his or her country.
examples.zh: 每个公民都有建设祖国的责任。

examples.en: The railway is still under construction.
examples.zh: 这条铁路仍在建设中。

examples.en: In Western countries, it is quite common for a person to consult a psychologist when he has some psychological problems.
examples.zh: 在西方国家，有心理问题去咨询心理医生是很普遍的。

examples.en: He spurned the advice of management consultants.
examples.zh: 他断然拒绝了管理顾问们的建议。

examples.en: The plans were drawn up in consultation with the World Health Organization.
examples.zh: 这些方案是在与世界卫生组织磋商之后起草的。

examples.en: Since the project was launched, it has consumed a lot of time and fund, but whether all the tasks can be accomplished in time remains to be seen.
examples.zh: 这个项目启动以来，已经消耗了很多时间和资金，但所有的任务能否按时完成还有待观察。
