examples.en: The leaves consumed quietly in bonfires.
examples.zh: 树叶无声地在营火中烧尽。

examples.en: Nowadays, with Chinese consumers becoming richer and their consciousness of health stronger, fast food industry is finding it difficult to develop in China.
examples.zh: 如今，随着中国消费者越来越富裕，健康意识越来越强，快餐业在中国的发展也举步维艰。

examples.en: Consumption is being reduced by 25 per cent.
examples.zh: 消费下降了 25 个百分点。

examples.en: They make contact with each other on the phone every now and then.
examples.zh: 他们经常打电话保持联系。

examples.en: You can contact the school office for more information.
examples.zh: 您可联系校办公室了解更多信息。（静安）

examples.en: Vegetables and fruits contain a variety of vitamins, which do much good to our health.
examples.zh: 蔬菜和水果富含多种维生素，对健康十分有益。

items.explanation: 着重强调“内含，相当于”。

examples.en: This kind of iron contains about 4% of carbon.
examples.zh: 这种铁含碳量为 4%。

items.explanation: 意为“把……列入，包括”。

examples.en: The book includes ten short stories.
examples.zh: 这本书有 10 篇短篇故事。

examples.en: Keep what's left in a covered container in the fridge.
examples.zh: 把剩下的食物装入带盖的容器，放进冰箱。

examples.en: contemporary literature
examples.zh: 当代文学

senses.trans: 发生（或存在）于同时代的

examples.en: The more practical the content of your website is and the more convenient the website is for use, the more likely you are to succeed.
examples.zh: 你的网站内容越实用，使用越方便，就越可能成功。

examples.en: Nothing will ever content the boy.
examples.zh: 什么也不会使这个男孩心满意足。

examples.en: They are happy so long as their children are content.
examples.zh: 只要孩子满意，他们就会很开心。

examples.en: She began to live in peace and content.
examples.zh: 她开始平静而知足地生活了。

examples.en: Little did I dream of being able to win the first prize in this chemistry contest.
examples.zh: 我做梦也想不到会在这次化学竞赛中获一等奖。

examples.en: contest every inch of land
examples.zh: 寸土必争

examples.en: guess the meaning of a word from its context
examples.zh: 从文章的上下文推测某词的意思

examples.en: the New Continent
examples.zh: 新大陆

examples.en: the Continent
examples.zh: 欧洲大陆

examples.en: Now that you are not interested in our topic, I don't think there is any need to continue our discussion.
examples.zh: 既然你对我们的话题不感兴趣，我认为我们没有必要继续讨论了。

examples.en: The state of affairs must not be allowed to continue.
examples.zh: 不能让这种状况延续下去。

examples.en: The final price of the product shall be subject to the contract.
examples.zh: 产品的最终价格以合同为准。

examples.en: The metal contracts as it cools down.
examples.zh: 当金属冷却了，它会收缩。

examples.en: We are faced with two apparently contradictory statements.
examples.zh: 我们面对两种明显矛盾的说法。

examples.en: Contrary to what the teacher had expected, the monitor worked out the problem.
examples.zh: 与老师预料的相反，班长答出了问题。

examples.en: Hot and cold are contraries.
examples.zh: 热和冷是对立面。

examples.en: He is by no means a traditional man. On the contrary, he always departs from common practice.
examples.zh: 他绝不是一个传统的人。相反，他常常背离惯常做法。

examples.en: The white walls make a sharp contrast with the black carpet.
examples.zh: 白色的墙壁与黑色的地毯形成了鲜明的对比。

examples.en: In this book the writer contrasts good with evil.
examples.zh: 在这本书中，作家对比了善与恶。

examples.en: She almost failed in the exam, but her sister, by contrast, did very well.
examples.zh: 她考试差点不及格，而她的妹妹相比之下考得很好。

examples.en: The retired worker contributed all he had to the Hope Project.
examples.zh: 这位退休工人把他所有的一切都贡献给了希望工程。

examples.en: Being exposed to a great many books contributes to our growth.
examples.zh: 阅读大量书籍有助于我们的成长。

examples.en: Does smoking contribute to lung cancer?
examples.zh: 吸烟会导致肺癌吗？

examples.en: Natural disasters have obviously contributed to the economic crisis.
examples.zh: 自然灾害很显然是造成经济危机的原因之一。

examples.en: His new contribution to the advancement of physiology was well appreciated.
examples.zh: 他对生理学发展的新贡献获得了高度赞赏。

examples.en: I couldn't control myself.
examples.zh: 我控制不住自己。

examples.en: Security workers should have rapid response ability so that accidents can be avoided before they go out of control.
examples.zh: 安保人员需要具备快速应变能力，这样才能把事故苗头掐灭在萌芽状态。

examples.en: Frankly speaking, what you said at the meeting yesterday is still controversial.
examples.zh: 坦白说，你昨天在会上表达的观点仍是有争议的。（宝山）

examples.en: Please give me a phone call at your convenience.
examples.zh: 请你方便的时候给我打个电话。

examples.en: Shopping online is a useful and convenient way for us to buy things.
examples.zh: 对我们来说，网购是一个实用、便利的购物方式。

examples.en: She's very conventional in her views.
examples.zh: 她的观点很守旧。

examples.en: Conversation is one of the pleasures of life.
examples.zh: 交谈是人生一大乐趣。

examples.en: He conveyed his deepest sympathy to the old man.
examples.zh: 他向这位老人表示深切慰问。

examples.en: She is convinced of his innocence.
examples.zh: 她确信他是无辜的。

examples.en: The cook is in charge of the kitchen helper.
examples.zh: 这位厨师负责管理厨工。

examples.en: So poor at cooking is Maria that she often confuses salt with sugar.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚真不擅长做饭，经常把盐和糖搞混。

examples.en: An electrician repaired the cooker.
examples.zh: 一位电工修理了这件炊具。

examples.en: The kids snarfed up all the cookies.
examples.zh: 孩子们一顿狼吞虎咽，把曲奇饼全吃光了。

examples.en: She really is a tough cookie.
examples.zh: 她真是个铁娘子。

examples.en: He was very cool and calm about the accident.
examples.zh: 他对这场意外很冷静。

examples.en: Teachers should provide students with chances to cooperate so that they can learn how to communicate with others.
examples.zh: 老师应该给学生提供合作的机会，这样他们才能学会如何与人沟通。

examples.en: Make a habit of watching weather forecast every day, so that you can cope with the unpredictable and changeable weather in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 养成每天看天气预报的习惯，这样你就能够应付上海变幻莫测、变化多端的天气了。

examples.en: A child copies his example.
examples.zh: 孩子学他的样。

examples.en: When I travel abroad, I always save a copy of my passport in my mobile phone, in case I should lose it.
examples.zh: 我出国旅行时总是在手机里保存护照复印件，以防护照丢失。

examples.en: Concern for the environment is at the core of our policies.
examples.zh: 对环境的关注是我们政策的核心。

examples.en: Integrity is one of my core values.
examples.zh: 诚实是我的核心价值之一。

examples.en: fields of corn
examples.zh: 玉米田

examples.en: I drop the letter in the mailbox on the corner.
examples.zh: 我把信投在拐角处的邮箱里。

examples.en: Four policemen cornered the robber at last.
examples.zh: 四名警察终于将抢劫犯逼入死角。

c.name: around the corner
trans: 在拐角处（强调“拐弯就是”，形容非常近）

examples.en: The owner opened a corporate checking account at the bank.

examples.en: The airport is trying to cope with the flights held up by the heavy fog.
examples.zh: 机场正想方设法处理由于大雾而延误的航班。

examples.en: You can always count on him for good advice.
examples.zh: 你总能在他那儿得到好的建议。

examples.en: You can always count on him for good advice.
examples.zh: 你总能在他那儿得到好的建议。

examples.en: We estimate it will take three days to cover the distance.
examples.zh: 我们估计走完这段路程要花3天时间。

examples.en: What they are supposed to do is to cut down on government spending.
examples.zh: 他们该做的是削减政府开支。

examples.en: He does daily exercises to help control his weight.
examples.zh: 他为控制体重每天坚持锻炼。

examples.en: China Daily
examples.zh: 《中国日报》

examples.en: They ran the general store and the farm dairy.
examples.zh: 他们经营着杂货店和农场的乳品店。

examples.en: dairy product
examples.zh: 乳制品

examples.en: A new dam was being built at the mouth of the valley.
examples.zh: 那山谷口正在兴建新水坝。

examples.en: Several recent events have damaged the government's public image.
examples.zh: 最近几次事件破坏了政府的公众形象。

examples.en: The forest fires kill many plants and animals in an eco-system so they cause damage to a forest.
examples.zh: 森林火灾会烧死生态系统中的许多动物和植物，由此给森林带来毁灭性破坏。

items.explanation: n., v. 指对无生命东西的破坏，使它无用、无价值，一般是局部性的；也可指一种损失。

examples.en: The man hit the keys too hard and damaged the piano.
examples.zh: 那人敲击琴键太重了，损坏了钢琴。

items.explanation: v. (n. destruction) 作“毁坏”解，是指彻底损坏，常含有“不能或很难修复”的意思。

examples.en: Hijacked planes destroyed the World Trade Center.
examples.zh: 被劫持的飞机毁坏了世贸中心。

items.explanation: n., v. 一般指对某人身体或精神上的伤害，“损害”的对象可以是自己，也可以是别人或别的事物。

examples.en: Smoking does him harm.
examples.zh: 吸烟对他有害。

examples.en: Don't stay outside in the damp.
examples.zh: 不要停留在外面的潮湿空气里。

examples.en: to damp clothes before ironing them
examples.zh: 在熨烫之前将衣服打湿

examples.en: damp air
examples.zh: 潮湿的空气

examples.en: I enjoy the popular dance "hip-hop", but neither my father nor my mother likes it.
examples.zh: 我喜欢流行的“嘻哈”舞蹈，但我父亲和母亲都不喜欢。

examples.en: It was unusual for such old people to dance Swan Lake in China's Got Talent.
examples.zh: 在中国达人秀的舞台上跳“天鹅湖”舞，对于这个年纪的老年人来说是不寻常的。

examples.en: In face of danger, the more desperate you are, the less chance there is that you will survive.
examples.zh: 面临险境时，你越绝望，生存的可能性就越小。

examples.en: Quite a few species in the world are in danger of becoming extinct.
examples.zh: 世界上不少物种正濒临灭绝。

examples.en: The situation is highly dangerous.
examples.zh: 形势十分危急。

examples.en: He didn't dare to speak to her.
examples.zh: 他不敢和她说话。

examples.en: He dare not speak to her.
examples.zh: 他不敢和她说话。

examples.en: That was a dark, moonless night.
examples.zh: 那是一个黑暗的、无月光的夜晚。

examples.en: There is too much dark in this painting.
examples.zh: 这幅画颜色太暗。

examples.en: The baby is the family darling.
examples.zh: 这婴儿是全家的宝贝儿。

senses.trans: [用作表示亲爱的称呼]亲爱的

examples.en: He has lost his darling son.
examples.zh: 他失去了爱子。

examples.en: to make a dash for/at
examples.zh: 向……急进；冲向

examples.en: The wolf dashed through the woods.
examples.zh: 狼突然跑进树林中。

examples.en: The database could be used as a teaching resource in colleges.
examples.zh: 在大学里，数据库可以被用作一种教学资源。

examples.en: In rushed Henry, sweating all over and out of breath, only to be told that he had made a mistake about the date of the meeting.
examples.zh: 亨利冲了进来，浑身冒汗，气喘吁吁，结果却被告知他弄错了开会的日期。

examples.en: Don't forget to date your letters.
examples.zh: 别忘了给你的信注上日期。

examples.en: Our friendship dates from college days.
examples.zh: 我们的友谊始于大学时代。

examples.en: In recent years, many universities have established financial laboratories, where students collect and analyse data in order to deepen their understanding of the significance behind the data.
examples.zh: 近年来，许多高校相继建立金融实验室，学生们在这里收集和分析数据，从而加深对数据内在意义的理解。（虹口）

examples.en: Kathy was delighted to find that her daughter had cleaned the room by herself.
examples.zh: 凯茜很高兴地发现，她的女儿已经自己打扫了房间。

examples.en: I woke up at dawn.
examples.zh: 我在黎明时醒来。

examples.en: The truth finally dawned on him.
examples.zh: 他最终明白了真相。

examples.en: No matter how tired she is, she will spare some time every day to read with her daughter together.
examples.zh: 不管多累，她每天都会抽出一些时间与女儿一起阅读。

examples.en: It is better to read by daylight than by lamplight.
examples.zh: 在日光下看书比在灯光下好。

examples.en: in the daytime
examples.zh: 在白天

examples.en: daytime flights
examples.zh: 白天航班

examples.en: Police are trying to contact the family of the dead man.
examples.zh: 警方在设法与死者的家属联系。

items.explanation: 死的

examples.en: The hunter fired a shot, and the wolf fell dead.
examples.zh: 猎人开了一枪，狼倒下死了。

items.explanation: 致命的，极其危险的（指具有造成死亡或毁坏的可能性。还可表示“死气沉沉的”）

examples.en: The deadly look on his face was due to his long illness.
examples.zh: 久病使他的脸上没有生气。

examples.en: Monday is the deadline for handing in this essay.
examples.zh: 这篇文章最迟应在星期一交来。

examples.en: My suggestion was that its location and facilities should be taken into consideration before a hotel was booked, but he turned a deaf ear to it.
examples.zh: 我的建议是预订酒店前要把地段和设施考虑在内，但他对此置之不理。

examples.en: He dealt the boy a blow on the ear.
examples.zh: 他打了那个男孩一记耳光。

examples.en: It is high time to take strict measures to deal with the environment pollution.
examples.zh: 是采取严厉措施治理环境污染的时候了。

examples.en: We lost a lot of money on that deal.
examples.zh: 我们在那笔交易中亏了许多钱。

examples.en: He lost everything that was dear to him.
examples.zh: 他失去了所珍惜的一切。

examples.en: Steve Jobs' death made the fans of Apple from all over the world very sad.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯的去世使得全世界苹果迷很伤心。

examples.en: We're just debating what to do next.
examples.zh: 我们正在讨论下一步该做什么。

examples.en: There is a general debate nowadays about the prices of housing problems.
examples.zh: 目前，针对房价问题存在普遍的争论。

examples.en: He is a thousand dollars in debt.
examples.zh: 他负债 1000 美元。

examples.en: The custom has prevailed for decades.
examples.zh: 这风俗已盛行数十年。

examples.en: Sugar can decay the teeth.
examples.zh: 糖能蛀蚀牙齿。

examples.en: His teeth have begun to decay.
examples.zh: 他的牙齿已开始蛀了。

examples.en: The house is in decay.
examples.zh: 房子已破损不堪。

examples.en: He deceived her into thinking he could drive a car.
examples.zh: 他骗她，使她相信他会开车。

examples.en: Winter lasts from December to February.
examples.zh: 冬天从十二月持续到二月。

examples.en: Nearby is a village with a decent pub.
examples.zh: 附近的村子里有一家还不错的酒馆。

examples.en: She hesitated whether to take the operation or not, so she didn't decide to take it until her doctor assured her that this kind of operation had never failed.
examples.zh: 她一直犹豫是否要做手术，直到医生确切地告诉她到目前为止这类手术没有失败过，才下决心做手术。

examples.en: Everyone should be responsible for his decision, because life is a series of choices.
examples.zh: 每个人都要为自己的决定负责，因为人生就是一系列的选择。

examples.en: She stood on the deck and waved.
examples.zh: 她站在甲板上挥手告别。

examples.en: The committee declared that our school would be responsible for everything of the competition.
examples.zh: 组委会宣布说，将由我们学校负责此次竞赛的各项事宜。

examples.en: As one grows older, one's memory starts to decline.
examples.zh: 随着年龄的增长，人的记忆力开始减退。

examples.en: These policies are to some extent responsible for the region's economic decline.
examples.zh: 这些政策在一定程度上对该地区的经济衰退负有责任。（黄浦）

items.explanation: 谢绝（指婉转拒绝）

examples.en: The waitress declined the gifts offered to her by the customers.
examples.zh: 女招待谢绝了顾客给她的礼物。

items.explanation: 拒绝

examples.en: He refused my offer of job.
examples.zh: 他拒绝我提供的工作。

items.explanation: 拒绝（强调拒不接受、抵制、不采纳，后接名词或代词）

examples.en: They rejected all our suggestions.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝我们所有的建议。

items.explanation: 拒绝给予、发给，是较为正式的用词，仅在正式场合使用。

examples.en: The judge withheld his decision until he had heard all the evidence.
examples.zh: 法官直到听完所有的证据才给予裁决。

examples.en: My mother likes to decorate rooms with flowers.
examples.zh: 我妈妈喜欢用花装饰房间。

examples.en: decrease one's wages
examples.zh: 减少某人的工资

examples.en: There has been a decrease in our imports this year.
examples.zh: 我们今年的进口物品减少了。

examples.en: He dedicated himself body and soul to the education of young people.
examples.zh: 他全身心地投入到年轻人的教育中。

senses.trans: 为(建筑物等)举行落成典礼

examples.en: to be rewarded for one's good deeds
examples.zh: 因所做的事善事而得到奖励

examples.en: It is proved that what the parents say and do have a deep influence on their children.
examples.zh: 事实证明，父母的言行对孩子有很深的影响。

examples.en: The ship sank deep into the sea.
examples.zh: 船沉入了海底。

examples.en: Deer are easily startled.
examples.zh: 鹿很容易受惊。

examples.en: They were defeated in their attempt to reach the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 他们登顶的尝试失败了。

examples.en: He helped engineer the candidate's defeat of his opponent.
examples.zh: 他帮那个候选人出谋划策，战胜了对手。

examples.en: Attack is the best defence.
examples.zh: 进攻是最好的防御。

examples.en: In time of war, all the people thought it their duty to defend their country.
examples.zh: 战争时期，全体人民认为保卫国家是他们的责任。

examples.en: He made a long speech defending his ideas.
examples.zh: 他发表长篇演说为他的见解辩护。

examples.en: to define the position of the government
examples.zh: 阐述政府的立场

examples.en: It's definite that he will come.
examples.zh: 他肯定要来的。

examples.en: I can state quite definitely it will be terrible.
examples.zh: 我可以非常明确地说，情况会十分糟糕。

examples.en: There is no general agreement on a standard definition of intelligence.
examples.zh: “智力”一词目前还没有一个普遍认可的标准定义。

examples.en: It is three years since Stephan graduated from Oxford with a master's degree in English literature.
examples.zh: 史蒂芬 3 年前从牛津大学毕业，获得了英语文学硕士学位。

examples.en: The injured girl was sent to the nearby hospital without delay.
examples.zh: 受伤的女孩并无耽搁，被送进了附近的医院。

examples.en: Due to the bad weather, the open-air concert which the children are looking forward to has to be delayed for two weeks.
examples.zh: 天气不好，孩子们心心念念的露天音乐会只能推迟两周举行。（松江）

examples.en: Don't delay any more.
examples.zh: 不要再拖了。

examples.en: He is the delegate of the meeting.
examples.zh: 他是这次会议的代表。

examples.en: The author deleted the last paragraph.
examples.zh: 作者删除了最后一段。

examples.en: The government is taking deliberate action to lower price.
examples.zh: 政府正在采取降低物价的慎重措施。

examples.en: A baby's skin is delicate.
examples.zh: 婴儿的皮肤很娇嫩。

examples.en: The soup is delicious.
examples.zh: 汤的味道美极了。

examples.en: What delighted me most was that her present was just what I was thinking of buying myself.
examples.zh: 使我最高兴的是，她给我的礼物正好就是我想要买的。

examples.en: To my delight, he brought me the book.
examples.zh: 使我高兴的是，他把书带给我了。

examples.en: Will you take the goods with you or shall we deliver them to your house?
examples.zh: 你随身带走货物，还是我们把货物送到你家？

examples.en: Use recorded delivery for large cheques or money orders.
examples.zh: 对于大额的支票和汇款单要使用挂号邮寄。

examples.en: He demanded that I should meet all his requirements.
examples.zh: 他要求我满足他的一切需要。

examples.en: Our school is making every effort to meet the demands of students for activities after class.
examples.zh: 我们学校正不遗余力地满足学生对课外活动的需求。

items.explanation: v., n. 强烈请求（指不容否定的要求，不能和带不定式的复合宾语连用）

examples.en: I demand to know the truth.
examples.zh: 我一定要知道真相。

items.explanation: n., v. 要求，恳请（指有礼貌的郑重请求，语气客气）

examples.en: The host requested his guests to sit down.
examples.zh: 主人恳请客人坐下。

examples.en: We came at your request.
examples.zh: 我们应你的请求而来。

items.explanation: v. 要求，命令（正式用语，指按照规章、惯例、客观上必要的，含有权威的内涵，常用于被动语态）；需要（比 need 更为正式）

examples.en: The court requires the attendance of witnesses.
examples.zh: 法庭传唤证人到场。

examples.en: We required extra help.
examples.zh: 我们需要额外的帮助。

examples.en: So demanding is the job that few people are equal to it.
examples.zh: 这份工作要求太高，没有几个人能胜任。

examples.en: socialist democracy
examples.zh: 社会主义民主

examples.en: At the exhibition, the company's sales manager demonstrated the new type of electronic toys which children had been looking forward to.
examples.zh: 在展览会上，公司销售经理展示了孩子们翘首以盼的新型电子玩具。

examples.en: They are demonstrating against the war.
examples.zh: 他们正在举行反战示威游行。

examples.en: The road is dense with traffic.
examples.zh: 路上交通繁忙。

examples.en: I have got toothache, so I must go to the dentist's.
examples.zh: 我牙疼，必须去看牙医。

examples.en: There is no denying that prices are mainly determined by the supply and demand on the market.
examples.zh: 无可否认，价格主要取决于市场的供需关系。

examples.en: When does the next train depart?
examples.zh: 下一次列车什么时候开？

examples.en: the Sales Department
examples.zh: 销售部

examples.en: The departure of the train was delayed.
examples.zh: 火车开出的时间推迟了。

examples.en: Since you are no longer a child, you can't always depend on your parents.
examples.zh: 不要总依靠父母，因为你已经不是小孩子了。

examples.en: The local economy is overwhelmingly dependent on oil and gas extraction.
examples.zh: 当地经济过于依赖石油和天然气的开采。

examples.en: Deposit the sand here.
examples.zh: 把沙子放在这里。

examples.en: If you evaporate a little sea water on a porcelain dish, on cooling, crystals of common salt will deposit on the sides of the dish.
examples.zh: 如果你将少许海水放到瓷盘中蒸发，冷却后就会有普通食盐的结晶附在盘的四周。

examples.en: current deposit
examples.zh: 活期存款

examples.en: Wet weather always depresses her.
examples.zh: 雨天总使她心情抑郁。

examples.en: The well is 20 feet in depth.
examples.zh: 井深 20 英尺。

examples.en: Words cannot describe the beauty of the scene.
examples.zh: 此景之美非语言所能描述。

examples.en: The scenery was beautiful beyond description.
examples.zh: 这景色美得无法形容。

examples.en: Parts of the country are so dry as to be almost a desert.
examples.zh: 这个国家的一些地区由于气候过于干燥，都快成荒原了。

examples.en: We deserted the farm for the city.
examples.zh: 我们离开农场，迁往城市。

examples.en: The craftsman has made a far greater contribution to chopsticks making than others and nobody but he deserves this honour.
examples.zh: 这位工匠对筷子制作的贡献远超他人，这项荣誉非他莫属。（松江）

examples.en: A new car has been designed for the Auto Exhibition in Beijing.
examples.zh: 已为北京车展设计了一款新型的汽车。

examples.en: a design for a dress
examples.zh: 服装图样

examples.en: We all desire happiness and health.
examples.zh: 我们都渴望得到幸福和健康。

examples.en: She has a desire for climbing mountains.
examples.zh: 她想去爬山。

items.explanation: 渴望，向往（含有强烈的意图和固定的目标，后接名词、不定式和带不定式的复合宾语或从句）

examples.en: He never achieved the status he so desired.
examples.zh: 他从没得到自己渴求的地位。

items.explanation: 期待；预料（对实现可能性很有把握）

examples.en: We expected their ship to arrive safely.
examples.zh: 我们盼望他们的船安全到达。

items.explanation: 希望（一般指预期某种渴望能够实现，并对之充满信心或把握，后接宾语从句、不定式等，但不能用 hope sb. to do sth.）

examples.en: We hope to see you again in the near future.
examples.zh: 我希望在不远的将来能见到你。

items.explanation: 希望，祝愿（指拥有未实现或不可能实现的愿望，后接宾语从句用虚拟，或接间接宾语和直接宾语，也可接不定式或复合宾语）

examples.en: He wished me good luck in the coming exams.
examples.zh: 他祝我在接下来来的考试中有好运气。

examples.en: On the desk lies an English dictionary of the latest issue.
examples.zh: 桌上有本最新版的英语字典。

trans: （办公大楼、宾馆等中的）服务台

examples.en: To the despair of the workers, the company announced the closure of the factory.
examples.zh: 令工人们绝望的是，公司宣布关闭工厂。

examples.en: Whatever happens to him, he never despairs.
examples.zh: 不管发生什么事，他从不绝望。

examples.en: The more desperate a person is for fame and wealth, the less likely he will do things in a practical manner.
examples.zh: 一个人名利心越重，就越不可能脚踏实地做事。（杨浦）

examples.en: Despite his poor family, the boy is ambitious and dreams of getting the Nobel Prize one day.
examples.zh: 尽管家境贫寒，但那个男孩志存高远并梦想着有朝一日能获诺贝尔奖。

examples.en: I am partial to desserts that combine fresh fruit with fine pastry.
examples.zh: 我偏爱加有新鲜水果的精致油酥甜点。

examples.en: The package was sent to the wrong destination.
examples.zh: 包裹被寄错地点。

examples.en: In the war, a lot of ancient buildings in the city were destroyed by the enemy troops.
examples.zh: 战时城里许多古建筑被敌军破坏了。

examples.en: There is worldwide concern about the destruction of the rainforests.
examples.zh: 全世界都在关注热带雨林遭到破坏的问题。

examples.en: It happens that a distant relative of the reporter knows the intricate details of rural development inside out.
examples.zh: 巧的是，这位记者的一个远房亲戚对乡村发展的丝丝脉络了如指掌。（上海春考）

examples.en: The report detailed the human rights abuses committed during the war.
examples.zh: 这份报告详述了战争期间所发生的践踏人权的情况。

examples.en: This method is discussed in detail in Chapter 14.
examples.zh: 这个方法在第 14 章将做详细讨论。

examples.en: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.
examples.zh: 这些检查旨在尽早地发现疾病。

examples.en: Pansy didn't read many detective stories.
examples.zh: 潘西读过的侦探小说不多。

examples.en: The detective found that the young man took part in many bank robberies.
examples.zh: 这个侦探发现那个年轻人参与过多次银行抢劫。

examples.en: It has reinforced my determination to blend into my surroundings.
examples.zh: 这让我更加下定决心融入周围环境。

examples.en: The following is a checklist to help you determine when it's time to move on.
examples.zh: 下面是一张对照检查表，能帮助你决定什么时候该行动。

examples.en: She has determined on becoming a doctor.
examples.zh: 她决心当一名医生。

examples.en: There are no difficulties that cannot be overcome as long as both parties are determined to reach an agreement.
examples.zh: 只要双方都决心达成协议，没有什么困难是不能克服的。

examples.en: In the course of developing economy, we must pay attention to saving resources.
examples.zh: 在经济发展过程中，我们必须注意节省资源。

examples.en: As children develop, some of the most important things they learn have to do with their sense of self.
examples.zh: 在成长过程中，孩子们学到的一些最重要的东西与他们的自我意识有关。

examples.en: Research shows that keeping pets contributes to people's mental health and character development.
examples.zh: 研究表明，养宠物有助于人的心理健康和性格培养。

examples.en: a device for catching flies
examples.zh: 捕捉苍蝇的装置

items.explanation: 装置（指为某种特殊用途而设计、发明或改装的东西）

examples.en: a new device for sharpening pencils
examples.zh: 一种新的削铅笔的装置

items.explanation: 装备（一般指设备，为不可数名词）

examples.en: Our school has a modern library with up-to-date equipment.
examples.zh: 我们学校拥有一个配有最新设备的现代化图书馆。

items.explanation: 器具（一般指有特定用途的精密器具、仪器）

examples.en: musical instruments
examples.zh: 乐器

items.explanation: 工具（尤指手工艺匠使用的各类工具，也可用于引申含义）

examples.en: A language is a tool of communication.
examples.zh: 语言是一种交流工具。

items.explanation: 器具，机械，装置

examples.en: an electrical appliance
examples.zh: 电器

examples.en: He devoted his whole life to the independence of his country.
examples.zh: 他为国家的独立事业奉献终生。

examples.en: Mrs. Brown has devoted herself to helping homeless children since she retired.
examples.zh: 退休以来，布朗夫人致力于帮助无家可归的儿童。

examples.en: The disease, whose complex nature led to its mistakenly being diagnosed as a flu-like illness in the 1990s, is now recognised as a rare mental disorder.
examples.zh: 在 20 世纪 90 年代，这种疾病因其复杂性曾被误诊为流感类疾病，如今人们已经认识到它是一种罕见的精神障碍。（杨浦）

trans: 对（问题等的）原因（或性质）下结论

examples.en: We reproduced a same working schematic diagram.
examples.zh: 我们复制了一份同样的施工简图。

examples.en: Do you often dial home?
examples.zh: 你常给家里打电话吗？

examples.en: The clock dial is luminous.
examples.zh: 那只钟面是夜光的。

examples.en: Do you think it is necessary to take measures to preserve Shanghai dialect?
examples.zh: 你认为有必要采取措施保护上海方言吗？

examples.en: They had long dialogues.
examples.zh: 他们进行了长时间的对话。

examples.en: a diamond ring
examples.zh: 一枚钻石戒指

examples.en: The teacher asked her students to keep an English diary every day.
examples.zh: 老师要求她的学生每天写一篇英语日记。

examples.en: We have a dictation every English class.
examples.zh: 每次上英语课我们都进行听写测验。

examples.en: You'd better look it up in the dictionary.
examples.zh: 你最好查一下词典。

examples.en: Quite a few old customs are dying out.
examples.zh: 许多旧风俗正逐渐消失。

senses.trans: [后接同源名词]遭受（某种形式的死亡）

examples.en: die a glorious death
examples.zh: 光荣死去

examples.en: The gossip will soon die down now that the woman is dead.
examples.zh: 既然这名女子已经死了，这些闲言碎语也将很快消失。

d.name: die from
trans: 通常指因受伤、事故等外部原因造成的死亡

d.name: die of
trans: 通常指因病、饥寒、年老等内部原因造成的死亡，或因……而极度痛苦（只用进行时）

examples.en: Those species inadaptable to changing conditions may die out.
examples.zh: 那些不能适应环境变化的物种可能会灭绝。

examples.en: People who are aware of the importance of health are paying more and more attention to their diets.
examples.zh: 意识到健康重要性的人们越来越关注他们的饮食。

examples.en: I'm sorry to differ from you about that question.
examples.zh: 很遗憾，关于这个问题我的看法和你的不同。

examples.en: Don't be too demanding for the intensity and frequency of the exercise, because only through steady and long flowing stream of workout can it make a difference.
examples.zh: 切莫苛求运动强度和频率，因为细水长流方能见效。

examples.en: The school authority and parents have different opinions on whether students must wear school uniforms.
examples.zh: 学生是否必须穿校服，校方和家长各执一词。

examples.en: Too many data make it difficult for us to determine which one has caused the error.
examples.zh: 太多的数据使我们很难判断错误是由哪个数据引起的。

d.name: Nothing is difficult to the man who will try.
trans: 世上无难事，只要肯登攀。

examples.en: In the face of the sudden disaster, some people are at a loss while others dare to face difficulties and challenges.
examples.zh: 面对这场突发的灾害，有的人不知所措，而有的人敢于直面困难与挑战。

examples.en: It is difficult to dig the ground when it is frozen hard.
examples.zh: 地面冻结的时候很难挖。

examples.en: Sugar digests easily.
examples.zh: 糖容易消化。

examples.en: the important digests of a book
examples.zh: 书的重点摘要

examples.en: The number 2004 contains four digits.
examples.zh: 2004 这个数是四位数。

examples.en: In addition to launching smart electronic products, the company is deepening cooperation with customers to explore the pathway to digital transformation and sustainable development.
examples.zh: 除了推出智能电子产品外，这个公司与客户深化合作，探索数字化转型和可持续发展的道路。（青浦）

examples.en: A man’s dignity depends not upon his wealth or rank but upon his character.
examples.zh: 人高尚与否不取决于他的财富和地位，而取决于他的品格。

examples.en: The boy is more diligent than anybody else.
examples.zh: 这孩子比任何人都勤奋。

examples.en: the dim light of a candle
examples.zh: 微弱的烛光

examples.en: We measured the dimensions of the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们测量了厨房的面积。

examples.en: We shall dine at seven o’clock.
examples.zh: 我们 7 点吃晚饭。

examples.en: Fine dining is a restaurant experience that is typically more sophisticated, unique, and expensive than one would find in the average restaurant.
examples.zh: 与在普通餐馆里用餐相比较，精致餐饮通常是一种更复杂、更独特、更昂贵的用餐体验。

examples.en: Nick as well as his brothers was having dinner when I visited him.
examples.zh: 当我去拜访尼克的时候，他和他的兄弟正在吃饭。

examples.en: carbon dioxide
examples.zh: 二氧化碳

examples.en: He dipped his finger in the water.
examples.zh: 他把手指浸入水中。

examples.en: The moment my aunt gained her diploma after four years of hard work, she was filled with joy.
examples.zh: 我阿姨苦读四年之后获得了文凭，那一刻她欣喜万分。

examples.en: She is a skilled diplomat and an expert negotiator.
examples.zh: 她是一位老练的外交官，也是一位专业的谈判代表。

examples.en: Can you direct me to the post office?
examples.zh: 你能给我指一下去邮局的方向吗？

examples.en: He has a direct way of speaking.
examples.zh: 他说话直率。

examples.en: The writer must take his material direct from life.
examples.zh: 作家必须直接从生活中取材。

d.name: direct sth. to
trans: 在(信封、包裹等)上书写姓名地址

examples.en: When the policeman arrived, the crowds scattered in all directions.
examples.zh: 当警察到来时，人群向四面八方散去。

examples.en: Tim wants to be a great director like Zhang Yimou when he grows up.
examples.zh: 蒂姆希望他长大后，能像张艺谋一样成为一名大导演。

examples.en: You can use a directory service to search for people on the Internet.
examples.zh: 你可以利用互联网的目录服务搜索人名。

examples.en: The shoes are covered with dirt.
examples.zh: 鞋子上布满了灰尘。

examples.en: If you lie on the ground you will get your clothes dirty.
examples.zh: 如果你躺在地上，会弄脏衣服的。

examples.en: People should wake up to the fact that people with disabilities have got a vote as well.
examples.zh: 人们应该认识到残疾人士同样也享有投票权。

examples.en: He was disabled from birth, but he never felt frustrated, nor did he ever give in to any difficulty.
examples.zh: 他生来就有残疾，但从不沮丧，也从未屈服于困难。

examples.en: In many parts of the world, the phenomenon of valuing sons over daughters has put many women at a disadvantage in education and employment.
examples.zh: 在世界许多地方，重男轻女的现象令许多女性在教育、就业方面处于劣势。

examples.en: be seriously disadvantaged by the general rise of raw material prices
examples.zh: 由于原料价格的普遍上涨而遭受严重损失

examples.en: a disagreeable experience
examples.zh: 令人不愉快的经历

examples.en: Let’s hope that all our troubles will disappear soon.
examples.zh: 希望我们所有的烦恼都会很快消失。

examples.en: The book disappointed me.
examples.zh: 这本书令我失望。

examples.en: They were bitterly disappointed at the result of the game.
examples.zh: 他们对比赛结果极为失望。

examples.en: They eyed her with disapproval.
examples.zh: 他们用反对的眼光看着她。

examples.en: He disapproved (of) my plan.
examples.zh: 他不同意我的计划。

examples.en: These natural disasters have warned us that everyone should start to protect the environment immediately.
examples.zh: 这些自然灾害警示我们，每个人都应该立即开始保护环境。

examples.en: These students had very little discipline.
examples.zh: 这些学生缺乏纪律。

examples.en: Parents must discipline their children.
examples.zh: 父母必须管教子女。

examples.en: The shop has discounted children’s clothes.
examples.zh: 商店打折出售儿童服装。

examples.en: That store doesn’t discount at all.
examples.zh: 那家铺子出售商品一概不打折。

examples.en: Students get a discount of 20% on air fares.
examples.zh: 学生乘飞机可享受 8 折优惠。

examples.en: We discouraged him from going back, but he still walked away in the direction of the railway station.
examples.zh: 我们劝他不要回去，但他还是朝着火车站的方向走了。

examples.en: A good education will help you discover and develop your talents.
examples.zh: 良好的教育，将有助于你发现和发挥你的才华。

items.explanation: 发现（存在而未为人知之物）；发觉（新奇或意外之物）

examples.en: Harvey discovered the circulation of the blood.
examples.zh: 哈维发现了血液的循环。

items.explanation: 发明，创造出（原来不存在的东西）

examples.en: Who invented the telephone?
examples.zh: 谁发明了电话？

examples.en: The scientist was awarded for the discovery he had made in chemistry.
examples.zh: 这位科学家因为在化学方面的发现而受到奖励。

senses.trans: 被发现的事物(或有才能的人)

examples.en: There should be no user discrimination based on who they are or what technology they use.
examples.zh: 不应该差别对待不同的用户及其使用的技术。

examples.en: They are discussing a vital issue whether they should raise more funds for this project in advance.
examples.zh: 他们正在讨论一项重要议题，即他们是否该提前为该项目募集更多的资金。

examples.en: There was much discussion about the reasons for the failure.
examples.zh: 人们就失败的原因进行了大量的讨论。

examples.en: The business of a doctor is to prevent and cure disease.
examples.zh: 医生的职责是预防和治疗疾病。

items.explanation: 指易患和传染的疾病，也是医学研究的对象。

examples.en: Flu is a common disease.
examples.zh: 流行性感冒是一种常见病。

items.explanation: 疾病（指不健康；为 health 的反义词）

examples.en: His father suffered from illness for ten years.
examples.zh: 他父亲患病 10 年。

items.explanation: 患病（一般指不适。英国人常用 illness 指不适，而美国人则常用 sickness 指不适）

examples.en: Some people suffer from sea sickness when they travel by sea.
examples.zh: 有些人乘船旅行时会晕船。

examples.en: The dish tastes best when it is hot.
examples.zh: 这道菜趁热吃味道最好。（闵行）

examples.en: This dishwasher is the latest model.
examples.zh: 这种洗碗机是最新款产品。

examples.en: Laser discs can store prodigious amounts of information.
examples.zh: 激光磁盘能够贮存大量信息。

examples.en: We like him personally, but dislike his way of living.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢他这个人，但不喜欢他的生活方式。

examples.en: Everyone has his own likes and dislikes.
examples.zh: 每个人都有他自己喜爱和厌恶的东西。

examples.en: He dismissed the suggestion as ridiculous.
examples.zh: 他认为那个建议过于荒唐，不予考虑。

examples.en: When the drill was over, the company dismissed.
examples.zh: 操练结束后，连队解散。

examples.en: She disobeyed her mother and went to the party.
examples.zh: 她不听母亲的劝告，去参加了那次聚会。

examples.en: Everything was in disorder, but it seemed that nothing had been stolen.
examples.zh: 一切都搞乱了，但似乎没有东西被偷走。

examples.en: He was arrested for disorderly conduct.
examples.zh: 他因扰乱社会治安被逮捕。

examples.en: a book display
examples.zh: 书展

examples.en: He displayed great ability in the running of the business.
examples.zh: 在企业管理方面他显示出很强的能力。

examples.en: I’m dissatisfied with the food here.
examples.zh: 我对这里的食物不满意。

examples.en: Water dissolves salt.
examples.zh: 水溶解盐。

examples.en: It was through distance education that Mary learned how to make personal investment.
examples.zh: 正是通过远程教育，玛丽学会了如何进行个人投资。

examples.en: She tried to distance herself from her family.
examples.zh: 她尝试与家人保持距离。

examples.en: He was told to keep the lead car at a constant and safe distance.
examples.zh: 他被告知要与引导车保持恒定且安全的距离。

examples.en: An inviting smell reminds us of the distant memories.
examples.zh: 一股诱人的味道唤起了我们遥远的记忆。（奉贤）

items.explanation: 仅指“距离远”。

examples.en: Dali is distant from Kunming.
examples.zh: 大理与昆明距离甚远。

items.explanation: 在现代英语中通常作副词，形容词则为 faraway。

examples.en: I know a nice little Italian restaurant not far from here.
examples.zh: 我知道有家不错的意大利小餐馆离这儿不远。

items.explanation: 表示“距离远”时，带有“偏僻”的意思。

examples.en: Nowadays computers are used even in remote mountainous regions.
examples.zh: 现在连偏僻的山区也用上了电脑。

examples.en: three distinct types of people
examples.zh: 3 种不同类型的人

examples.en: I can distinguish them by their uniforms.
examples.zh: 我能根据他们穿的制服辨认他们。

examples.en: a distinguished career
examples.zh: 非凡的事业

examples.en: Try not to distract the other students.
examples.zh: 尽量不要让其他学生分心。

examples.en: Coverage of the war was used to distract attention from other matters.
examples.zh: 对战争的报道被用来分散对其他事情的注意力。

examples.en: He closed his eyes to put a stop to all distracting thoughts, sitting there quietly and peacefully.
examples.zh: 他闭上眼睛，摒除杂念，平心静气地坐着。

examples.en: It does not turn its back upon us in times of adversity or distress.
examples.zh: 在逆境或痛苦中，它都不会背弃我们。

examples.en: She witnessed some very distressing scenes.
examples.zh: 她目睹了一些令人非常痛苦的场面。

examples.en: Please distribute the examination papers round the class.
examples.zh: 请把考卷发给全班同学。

examples.en: The company has worldwide distribution channels.
examples.zh: 这家公司拥有遍布全世界的分销网络。

examples.en: He lives in a mountainous district.
examples.zh: 他住在山区。

examples.en: The old man distrusts banks so he keeps his money at home.
examples.zh: 老人不信任银行，所以把钱放在家里。

examples.en: The noise in the street disturbed my study.
examples.zh: 街上的噪声干扰我学习。

examples.en: Any disturbance to the body’s state of equilibrium can produce stress.
examples.zh: 对身体平衡状态的任何干扰都可能产生压力。

examples.en: The boy dived from the bridge into the river.
examples.zh: 那男孩从桥上跳入河中。

examples.en: My interests are very diverse.
examples.zh: 我的兴趣非常广泛。

examples.en: To shelter more people, some big old houses have been divided into apartments.
examples.zh: 为了给更多的人提供居所，一些面积大的老房子已被分割成公寓。

items.explanation: 分开，隔开（指把曾在一起的东西或人分开，或把混杂在一起的东西分开）

examples.en: separate the good ones from the bad ones
examples.zh: 把好的和坏的分开

items.explanation: 划分，分开（指按一定比例加以划分，使其成为若干部分。用于分别类加以整理时可与 separate 换用）

examples.en: Children, divide the cake up among you.
examples.zh: 孩子们，你们把这个蛋糕分了吃吧。

items.explanation: 使隔离，使孤立（指把某人或物与其他的人或物完全隔开而使之孤立）

examples.en: Several villages have been isolated by the floods.
examples.zh: 洪水使好几座村庄与外界隔绝了。

examples.en: Europe is divided into several economic zones.
examples.zh: 欧洲分成若干个经济区。

examples.en: The current division of labor between workers and management will alter.
examples.zh: 当前工人与管理部门的分工将会改变。

examples.en: The judge divorced the couple.
examples.zh: 法官判这对夫妇离婚。

examples.en: My parents divorced when I was very young.
examples.zh: 我很小的时候父母就离婚了。

examples.en: She got a divorce from him last year.
examples.zh: 她去年和他离了婚。

examples.en: a dizzy speed
examples.zh: 使人晕眩的速度

examples.en: Though he was not rich, he did his best to help the students in poor areas.
examples.zh: 虽然他不富裕，但还是竭尽全力去帮助贫困地区的学生。

items.explanation: 通用词，可以用以表示执行各种行动。

examples.en: He did nothing today.
examples.zh: 他今天无所事事。

items.explanation: 表示进行一种通常为长时间，或需要努力、注意和技巧的工作。

examples.en: The surgeon performed an operation.
examples.zh: 医生做完了一台手术。

examples.en: A lot of poor people were infected with the deadly disease, so the experienced doctor volunteered to operate on them free of charge.
examples.zh: 许多穷困的人都染上了这种致命疾病，所以那个经验丰富的医生主动为他们免费手术。

examples.en: She signed several documents about the sale of her house.
examples.zh: 她签署了几份涉及出售房屋的文件。

examples.en: Although they were unknown in history, their names were still documented.
examples.zh: 虽然他们在历史上默默无闻，但他们的姓名却有案可查。

trans: 用纪实材料构成(影片、小说等)

examples.en: The clever dog can open the gate of the garden by itself.
examples.zh: 这条聪明的狗自己能打开花园的门。

examples.en: The girl likes her doll very much.
examples.zh: 这个女孩很喜欢她的洋娃娃。

senses.trans: 元(美国、加拿大等国的货币单位)

examples.en: Let me change the dollar bill for coins.
examples.zh: 让我把这张美元纸钞换成硬币。

examples.en: It is said that dolphins are very clever.
examples.zh: 据说海豚是很聪明的。

examples.en: I think probably that the laser has not realised the potential that was expected of it in that domain.
examples.zh: 我想激光可能在那个领域并没有充分发挥其潜力。

examples.en: domestic animal
examples.zh: 家畜

examples.en: a dominant figure at a conference
examples.zh: 会上举足轻重的人物

examples.en: Fathers have little power to dominate children and young people.
examples.zh: 父辈们几乎没有能力支配孩子们和年轻人的生活。

examples.en: The basketball team began to dominate after a series of impressive victories.
examples.zh: 篮球队在连续取得几场令人印象深刻的胜利后，开始占据主导地位。

examples.en: They came up with a good idea to donate the articles that haven't been claimed so far at the Lost and Found Office to a charity organization.
examples.zh: 他们想出了一个好方法：把失物招领处那些至今无人认领的物品捐给慈善机构。

examples.en: He was as stubborn as a donkey.
examples.zh: 他非常固执。

examples.en: Our kitchen has a brown door.
examples.zh: 我家厨房有扇棕色的门。

examples.en: The roommates have agreed to clean their dormitory once every two days.
examples.zh: 室友们商定好每两天打扫一次宿舍。（松江）

examples.en: The letters "i" and "j" have dots over them.
examples.zh: 字母“i”和“j”的上面都有点。

examples.en: He saw a little green valley dotted with a few huts and trees in the sun.
examples.zh: 他看到一个绿色的小山谷，阳光下，几间小屋和几棵树点缀着这个山谷。

examples.en: We want a double room with two single beds.
examples.zh: 我们要一间有两张单人床的双人间。

examples.en: The organization has doubled its membership in the past five years.
examples.zh: 这个组织的成员数量在过去的 5 年中翻了一番。

examples.en: The number of managers must double to 100 within 3 years.
examples.zh: 经理的人数在 3 年内必须翻倍达到 100 人。

examples.en: I doubt the truth of the news.
examples.zh: 我怀疑那条新闻的真实性。

examples.en: There is no doubt that doing some physical exercise in fresh air will do good to one's health.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，在新鲜的空气里锻炼对健康有好处。

d.name: doubt that ...
trans: 怀疑（用于否定句或疑问句）

examples.en: The sun goes down in the west.
examples.zh: 太阳从西边落下。

examples.en: Last week I was down with a bad cold and asked for three days' leave.
examples.zh: 上周我因重感冒病倒了，请了 3 天假。

examples.en: She is down with a fever today and has to take the day off.
examples.zh: 她今天发烧病倒了，不得不请一天假。

examples.en: Nowadays, it is so convenient for patients to download their medical records to access information such as the test results that they will save a lot of time and labor.
examples.zh: 如今，病人能很便捷地下载他们的医疗记录以获取诸如检测结果之类的信息，大大节省了时间和人力。

examples.en: The download will take about three minutes.
examples.zh: 下载要花大约 3 分钟。

examples.en: Are the children downstairs?
examples.zh: 孩子们在楼下吗？

examples.en: downtown restaurants
examples.zh: 闹市区的餐馆

examples.en: go downtown shopping
examples.zh: 去商业区购物

examples.en: The city is providing free transportation to the stadium from downtown.
examples.zh: 本市现在提供从市中心到体育场的免费交通。

examples.en: The boy lay on the grass face downwards.
examples.zh: 男孩趴在草地上。

examples.en: Do you remember that we collected dozens and dozens of shells on the beach in our childhood?
examples.zh: 还记得小时候我们在海滩收集了许多贝壳吗？

examples.en: three dozen eggs
examples.zh: 3 打鸡蛋

examples.en: a draft for/of a speech
examples.zh: 讲话底稿

examples.en: draft a bill
examples.zh: 起草一份法案

examples.en: He dragged a heavy box across the doorway.
examples.zh: 他把一个重箱子从门口拖了过去。

examples.en: Time seemed to drag.
examples.zh: 时间似乎过得很慢。

examples.en: Dragon is a large, long animal in old stories.
examples.zh: 在古老的故事里，龙是一种身形庞大且极长的动物。

examples.en: Working day and night was a great drain on his health, so he fell ill soon.
examples.zh: 没日没夜地工作对他的健康消耗很大，因此他不久就病倒了。

examples.en: The work drained his strength.
examples.zh: 那工作耗尽了他的力气。

examples.en: They have just produced a new drama.
examples.zh: 他们刚刚出品了一出新戏。

examples.en: It's just as dramatic as a film, only it's real.
examples.zh: 这就像电影一样充满戏剧性，不过这是真实发生的。

examples.en: He drew a straight line with a pencil.
examples.zh: 他用铅笔画了一条直线。

examples.en: The play is drawing well.
examples.zh: 那出戏很卖座。

examples.en: The drawer is so tight that I can't open it.
examples.zh: 这抽屉太紧了，我打不开。

examples.en: She did a drawing of me.
examples.zh: 她给我画了张像。

examples.en: Whatever difficulty you might meet with, all your dreams will come true, as long as you keep on working hard.
examples.zh: 无论遇到什么困难，只要你坚持不懈地努力，所有的梦想都会实现。

examples.en: If a child says he dreams of winning a Nobel Prize, you should encourage him instead of laughing at him.
examples.zh: 如果一个孩子说他想获得诺贝尔奖，你应该鼓励他而不是嘲笑他。

examples.en: It seems that the evening dress was designed by a top French designer.
examples.zh: 这件晚礼服好像出自一位法国顶尖设计师之手。

examples.en: It is required by the school that students should be dressed in school uniform every day.
examples.zh: 学校规定学生每天都要穿校服。

examples.en: She dressed well on very little money.
examples.zh: 她花很少的钱却穿得体面。

items.explanation: 给……穿衣；穿衣（作及物动词，后接人作宾语；常用 be dressed in 表示“穿着……的衣裳”）

examples.en: Wait a minute. I'm dressing the baby.
examples.zh: 等一等，我在给孩子穿衣服。

examples.en: The girl was dressed all in white.
examples.zh: 这姑娘穿着一身白。

items.explanation: 正穿着（相当于 be wearing，因此不可用进行时态）

examples.en: The baby had hardly anything on.
examples.zh: 这小孩几乎什么都没穿。

items.explanation: 穿上（表示动作）

examples.en: He put on his overcoat and his hat, and walked out.
examples.zh: 他穿上大衣，戴上帽子，走了出去。

items.explanation: 穿，戴（表示衣服已穿在身上。作及物动词，后接表示衣物等的名词。作不及物动词，有“耐穿”“经得起穿”的意思）

examples.en: The other day she wore a blue dress.
examples.zh: 那天她穿着一件蓝色的连衣裙。

examples.en: That cloth wears long.
examples.zh: 那种布料很耐穿。

examples.en: The current was drifting us along.
examples.zh: 潮水使我们向前漂去。

examples.en: We drifted down the stream.
examples.zh: 我们顺着溪流而下。

examples.en: drifts of smoke
examples.zh: 飘绕的烟雾

examples.en: build up a habit by drill
examples.zh: 通过训练养成习惯

examples.en: The troops were drilling.
examples.zh: 军队正在操练。

items.explanation: 主要指课堂上或军营中系统的、严格的训练。

examples.en: The teacher is drilling the students in pronunciation.
examples.zh: 老师正在训练学生的发音。

items.explanation: 指为了达到熟练，反复地去做某事。

examples.en: If you want to learn English well, you must practise speaking it whenever you can.
examples.zh: 如果你想学好英语，你必须在任何有空的时候练习说英语。

items.explanation: 着重于训练，培养技能。

examples.en: He was trained for the law.
examples.zh: 他受过法律训练。

examples.en: Drinking too much fruit juice can be harmful to children's teeth.
examples.zh: 喝太多果汁对孩子的牙齿有害。

examples.en: Coca-Cola is a soft drink.
examples.zh: 可口可乐是一种软饮料。

examples.en: The rain was dripping from the trees.
examples.zh: 雨水从树上滴落。

examples.en: Drips of water fell down her neck.
examples.zh: 滴下的水顺着她脖子往下淌。

examples.en: Can you drive a car?
examples.zh: 你会开车吗？

examples.en: It's only five minutes' drive to the station.
examples.zh: 到车站只有 5 分钟的车程。

d.name: drive sb. to do sth.
trans: 逼迫某人做某事（尤指不好的事）

examples.en: New drivers have twice as many accidents as experienced drivers.
examples.zh: 新手司机的事故数量是老司机的两倍。

examples.en: To deal with the situation in which drivers fall asleep halfway in traffic jams during peak travel hours, drone wake-up call services have been introduced.
examples.zh: 针对出行高峰期交通堵塞中司机可能在途中打瞌睡的问题，现已推出无人机唤醒服务。（金山）

examples.en: Even a drop of water mustn't be wasted because it is so important to all the living things.
examples.zh: 即使是一滴水也不能浪费，因为水对所有生命都非常重要。

examples.en: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night.
examples.zh: 晚上气温能降到零度以下。

items.explanation: 跌下；倒下；降低（作不及物动词时，一般指无意识行为，可与 fall 换用；作及物动词时，表示物体从一定的高度被释放）

examples.en: She dropped some lemon juice into her tea.
examples.zh: 她在茶里滴了几滴柠檬汁。

items.explanation: 落下；跌倒；下降（一般表示无意识行为）

examples.en: I saw something fall/drop out of his pocket.
examples.zh: 我看到有东西从他口袋里掉出来。

items.explanation: 下降（指渐渐下沉或下降，直至淹没）

examples.en: The Titanic struck against a huge iceberg and sank.
examples.zh: 泰坦尼克号撞上一座大冰山后沉没。

examples.en: More than seven million people have been affected by drought.
examples.zh: 已有超过 700 万的民众受到旱灾的影响。

examples.en: Don't play by the river in case you fall in and drown!
examples.zh: 不要在河边玩耍，以免掉到河里淹死。

examples.en: Until doctors accidentally discovered this antiviral drug, did people truly believe in its existence.
examples.zh: 直到医生偶然发现了这种抗病毒药物，人们才真正相信它的存在。（徐汇）

examples.en: At the hospital he was drugged.
examples.zh: 在医院里，他被上了麻醉药。

examples.en: I will bring stuff from the drugstore for your hands.
examples.zh: 我到药房去给你的手弄点药来。

examples.en: He plays the drums.
examples.zh: 他击鼓。

examples.en: He dried his hands with a towel.
examples.zh: 他用毛巾擦干手。

examples.en: The clothes dried quickly outside.
examples.zh: 衣服在外面干得快。

examples.en: This coat will keep you dry in the rain.
examples.zh: 这件外套会让你在雨中不被淋湿。

examples.en: Duck is a kind of water bird.
examples.zh: 鸭是一种水禽。

examples.en: I'm due for a fifteen-day paid vacation every year.
examples.zh: 我应有每年 15 天的带薪假。

examples.en: Most of the problems were due to human error.
examples.zh: 多数问题都是人为错误造成的。

examples.en: Art is not as important as life, but the life without art is dull.
examples.zh: 艺术远远没有生命重要，但是没有艺术的生活是乏味的。

examples.en: Drug adverse reactions shall be duly reported to the local drug administration authorities.
examples.zh: 应及时向当地药品监督管理部门报告药品的不良反应。

examples.en: Many people object to building a nuclear power plant on the island for fear that the wastewater might be dumped into the sea and pollute the marine life.
examples.zh: 很多人反对在岛上修建核电站，担心废水可能会排入海洋，污染海洋生物。（青浦）

examples.en: They dumped their old car in the town dump.
examples.zh: 他们把旧汽车扔到城镇的垃圾堆里。

examples.en: Dumpling is his favourite food.
examples.zh: 汤圆是他最喜欢的食品。

examples.en: The storm was of short duration.
examples.zh: 暴风雨持续时间很短。

examples.en: During the summer vacation, he took part in all kinds of volunteer activities to raise money for the survivors of the earthquake, which benefited him a lot.
examples.zh: 暑假期间，他参加了各种志愿者活动，为地震中的幸存者筹集善款，这使他受益匪浅。

examples.en: Dusk sets in early in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天，黄昏来得早。

examples.en: There is a lot of dust on this table.
examples.zh: 桌子上有许多灰尘。

examples.en: She dusted the table.
examples.zh: 她擦掉桌上的灰尘。

examples.en: remove refuse from a dustbin
examples.zh: 把垃圾从垃圾箱里运走

examples.en: She had matted hair and torn dusty clothes.
examples.zh: 她蓬头乱发，衣衫褴褛，满是灰尘。

examples.en: It's a healthy citizen's duty to donate blood.
examples.zh: 献血是每一个健康公民的责任。

examples.en: He brushed the wall with red dye.
examples.zh: 他用红漆刷墙。

examples.en: She had dyed her black hair.
examples.zh: 她将她的黑头发染了色。

examples.en: This material does not dye well.
examples.zh: 这料子染不好。

examples.en: He was such a dynamic speaker that he held our attention every minute of the three-hour lecture.
examples.zh: 他是一个如此有活力的演讲者，使我们在三个小时的演讲中一直全神贯注。

examples.en: When was the Tang Dynasty established?
examples.zh: 唐朝是哪年建立的？

examples.en: There are few people who would believe that these books date back to the 15th century.
examples.zh: 很少有人相信这些书的历史可以追溯到15世纪。

examples.en: How does current globalization differ from that in the late nineteenth century?
examples.zh: 目前的全球化和19世纪晚期的全球化有何差异？

examples.en: It is hard for children under five to distinguish right from wrong.
examples.zh: 对于5岁以下的小孩来说，分辨是非是困难的。

examples.en: Lies also do harm to those who tell them.
examples.zh: 谎话对说谎者本身也有损害。

examples.en: You can do nothing but let nature take its course.
examples.zh: 你无能为力，只能顺其自然。

examples.en: What conclusion can we draw from their failure?
examples.zh: 他们的失败能使我们得出什么结论呢？

examples.en: What conclusion can we draw from their failure?
examples.zh: 他们的失败能使我们得出什么结论呢？

examples.en: What conclusion can we draw from their failure?
examples.zh: 他们的失败能使我们得出什么结论呢？

examples.en: What conclusion can we draw from their failure?
examples.zh: 他们的失败能使我们得出什么结论呢？

examples.en: He managed to draw readers' attention to his works.
examples.zh: 他成功地吸引读者注意他的作品。

examples.en: He managed to draw readers' attention to his works.
examples.zh: 他成功地吸引读者注意他的作品。

examples.en: It is the regrets over yesterday and the fear of tomorrow that drive men mad.
examples.zh: 真正令人发疯的是对昨日的悔恨及对明日的恐惧。

examples.en: Be sure to drop in on me when you can spare a moment.
examples.zh: 等你抽得出空时一定要顺便来看看我。

examples.en: Be sure to drop in on me when you can spare a moment.
examples.zh: 等你抽得出空时一定要顺便来看看我。

examples.en: Due to the significant progress made in Chinese education, China has become one of the most favored places for overseas students.
examples.zh: 由于中国教育取得的巨大进步，中国已成为最受海外学生欢迎的留学目的地之一。

examples.en: Each bird loves to hear itself sing.
examples.zh: 每只鸟都喜欢听自己唱歌。

examples.en: Each of us had a try.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都试了一下。

examples.en: We each have different needs and interests.
examples.zh: 我们每个人有不同的需要和兴趣。

e.name: Each age offers its own men of parts.

examples.en: When Mr. Wang had found a job, he was eager to find a house from which it was convenient to go to work.
examples.zh: 找到工作后，王先生急于要找到一间上班方便的房子。

examples.en: I can see an eagle's nest on the rocks.
examples.zh: 我能看到岩石上的鹰巢。

examples.en: Julia sang too terribly for me to believe my ears.
examples.zh: 朱莉娅唱得太糟糕了，我都不相信我的耳朵。

examples.en: The policeman asked Mary whether she always caught such an early train.
examples.zh: 警察问玛丽，她是否总是赶这样早的火车。

examples.en: The more quickly he walk, the earlier he will get there.
examples.zh: 他走得越快，就越早到那里。

e.name: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
trans: 早睡早起会使人健康、富有、聪明。

examples.en: His achievement earned him respect.
examples.zh: 他的成就为他赢得了尊重。

items.explanation: 指“赢得，博得”。

examples.en: His courage and presence of mind earned him the admiration of his classmates.
examples.zh: 他的勇敢和沉着博得了同班同学的赞扬。

items.explanation: 指获得有用和需要的东西。

examples.en: She gained experience while working for the newspaper.
examples.zh: 她在为报社工作时获得许多工作经验。

items.explanation: 指获胜而得到奖励。

examples.en: Who is going to win the election?
examples.zh: 谁将赢得选举的胜利？

examples.en: It is my earnest wish that you use this money to continue your study of music.
examples.zh: 你用这笔钱继续学习音乐是我的诚挚愿望。

examples.en: You must show your annual earnings in the tax form.
examples.zh: 你必须在税单上注明你的年收入。

examples.en: My brother studies in a university and he knows a lot about the earth.
examples.zh: 我的哥哥在大学学习，他知道很多关于地球的事情。

e.name: on earth
trans: (用于疑问词后加强语气)究竟

examples.en: After the strike of the earthquake the government and volunteers from all over the world did everything they could to relieve the suffering of the people in the disaster-stricken area and help them rebuild their homes.
examples.zh: 在地震侵袭之后，政府和来自世界各地的志愿者尽最大的努力减少受灾人民的痛苦，帮他们重建家园。

examples.en: It is impossible for anyone to achieve success with ease.
examples.zh: 任何人都不能轻而易举获得成功。(长宁)

senses.trans: 解除(或减轻)……的痛苦(或负担等)

examples.en: The medicine eased the pain.
examples.zh: 这种药缓解了疼痛。

examples.en: China faces the Pacific on the east.
examples.zh: 中国东临太平洋。

examples.en: Take the east road, it is the shortest way.
examples.zh: 走向东那条路，那是最近的路。

examples.en: Several countries in Eastern Europe are counting the cost of yesterday's earthquake.
examples.zh: 东欧的几个国家正在计算昨天的地震带来的损失。

examples.en: The river here tends eastward.
examples.zh: 这条河从这里向东流。

examples.en: Nobody thought it easy to finish so much work in two days' time.
examples.zh: 没有人认为在两天之内完成这么多工作是件容易的事。

e.name: it is easy for sb. to do
trans: 对(某人)来说做……是简单的

examples.en: It's selfish of Jim to eat the whole cake.
examples.zh: 吉姆真自私，一个人吃了整个蛋糕。

examples.en: For beginners, this might be a good e-book.
examples.zh: 对初学者来说，或许这是一本不错的电子书。

examples.en: Development has been guided by a concern for the ecology of the area.
examples.zh: 该地区的发展以注重生态为指导原则。

examples.en: Africa is experiencing the most severe economic impacts of climate change in comparison to other regions.
examples.zh: 与其他地区相比，非洲正经历着由气候变化带来的最严重的经济影响。

examples.en: She is an economical woman.
examples.zh: 她是个节约的女人。

examples.en: The plan of our country is based on a rising economy.
examples.zh: 我国的计划建立在不断发展的经济基础上。

examples.en: Pollution can have disastrous effects on the delicately balanced ecosystem.
examples.zh: 污染会对处于脆弱状态中的生态平衡产生破坏性影响。

examples.en: Don't put the glass on the edge of the table.
examples.zh: 别把玻璃杯放在桌子的边缘。

examples.en: Using genetic editing technology on humans is risky.
examples.zh: 在人类身上使用基因编辑技术是非常危险的。(杨浦)

examples.en: The new edition of encyclopaedia will appear in the bookstores next week.
examples.zh: 新版的百科全书下周就会在书店上架。

examples.en: The editor's decision is final and shall evermore remain so.
examples.zh: 主编的决定是最终的，而且应该永远不会改变。

examples.en: an editorial decision
examples.zh: 稿件取舍决定

examples.en: He recomposed the editorial till dawn.
examples.zh: 他改写社论一直改到天明。

examples.en: The writer was educated at a very good school.
examples.zh: 这位作家在一所很好的学校里受过教育。

examples.en: All the people present at the meeting showed respect for the young Nobel Peace Prize winner who fights for the women's rights of education.
examples.zh: 对这个为女性教育权利抗争的年轻的诺贝尔和平奖获得者，所有与会人员都表示尊敬。

examples.en: Now educators are experimenting with ways to apply this model to academic subjects.
examples.zh: 现在教育工作者们正在尝试用一些方法把这个模式应用于一些学术科目中。

examples.en: It is claimed that diet pills have a remarkable and immediate effect, and do no harm to health, but it is far from the truth.
examples.zh: 有人声称减肥丸效果显著，立竿见影，并且对身体健康无害，但事实远非如此。

examples.en: The new tax law will not take effect until next month.
examples.zh: 新税法要到下个月才开始生效。

examples.en: A study illustrates that when people are under pressure, watching an interesting movie or talking to a friend is an effective way to get rid of fear and sadness.
examples.zh: 一项研究表明，当人们有压力时，看场有趣的电影或向朋友倾诉是排遣恐惧和忧伤的有效方法。

examples.en: The engine is highly efficient.
examples.zh: 这台发动机效率很高。

examples.en: Domestic brands are sparing no effort to gain a larger market share.
examples.zh: 国产品牌正在不遗余力地争取更大的市场份额。(金山)

e.name: in an effort to do sth.
make an effort to do sth.

examples.en: She has an egg for breakfast every day, doesn't she?
examples.zh: 她每天早餐吃一个鸡蛋，不是吗？

examples.en: You think you are much smarter than I am, eh?
examples.zh: 你认为你比我聪明得多，嗯？

examples.en: Eight kilometres is roughly equivalent to five miles.
examples.zh: 8公里约等于5英里。

examples.en: He sent his son to join the army as soon as he reached eighteen.
examples.zh: 他儿子一满18岁，他就送他参军了。

examples.en: Emily was an eighth grader.
examples.zh: 埃米莉是个八年级的学生。

examples.en: He's already eighty but still going strong.
examples.zh: 他都80岁了，身子骨还那么硬朗。

senses.trans: [用于否定句或否定词组后加强语气]也

examples.en: I haven't read it and my brother hasn't either.
examples.zh: 我没有读过，我兄弟也没读过。

examples.en: on either side of the river
examples.zh: 在河的两边

examples.en: I'm afraid that either of them will not agree to this arrangement.
examples.zh: 我恐怕他们两人都不会同意这样的安排。

e.name: Learning is like rowing upstream, either to advance or to go back.
trans: 学习如逆水行舟，不进则退。

examples.en: Is the girl in blue your elder sister?
examples.zh: 穿蓝衣服的那个女孩是你的姐姐吗？

examples.en: Many functions of the cell phone are of no use to those elderly people, and to some extent, the more functions it has, the more likely it is to be out of order.
examples.zh: 手机的很多功能对上了年纪的人来说没什么用，而且在某种程度上，功能越多，越有可能出故障。

items.explanation: 较老的；上年纪的，年老的

examples.en: She was an elderly woman, perhaps sixty years old.
examples.zh: 她是一位上了年纪的妇女，也许已经60岁了。

items.explanation: 年龄较大的；年长的

examples.en: Her elder daughter is married.
examples.zh: 她的长女已结婚了。

examples.en: After three heated TV debates, he was elected President of America.
examples.zh: 三轮激烈的电视辩论之后，他当选为美国总统。

items.explanation: 选举；推选(某人)

examples.en: The government is made up of men and women elected by the people of the country.
examples.zh: 政府是由这个国家的人民选出的人员组成的。

items.explanation: 挑选；选择

examples.en: He selected one of his favorite books and read to his children.
examples.zh: 他挑了一本他最喜欢的书读给孩子们听。

examples.en: The media played an important part in the last election.
examples.zh: 大众传媒在上一轮选举中发挥了重要作用。

examples.en: If the tax were heavy enough, people would start driving electric cars.
examples.zh: 如果赋税多到一定程度，人们就会开始驾驶电动汽车。

items.explanation: 作“电的；导电的；电动的”解，指被修饰的物体可能带有发电的或电动的装置。

examples.en: an electric spark
examples.zh: 电火花

examples.en: an electric cooker
examples.zh: 电炊具

items.explanation: 作“与电有关的，电气科学的”解，指被修饰的人或物本身并不带电。

examples.en: The cooker isn't working because of an electrical fault.
examples.zh: 这个炊具不能用了，因为出了电气方面的故障。

examples.en: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
examples.zh: 飞机由于发生电力故障而临时降落。

examples.en: She said she would find an electrician for us.
examples.zh: 她说她要给我们找一个电工技师。

examples.en: When water moves from a high place to a lower place, it can make electricity.
examples.zh: 当水从高处往低处流动时，它可以发电。

examples.en: Electrons are negatively charged with electricity.
examples.zh: 电子带负电荷。

examples.en: To follow the fashion, some young people spend one month's salary in buying a newly-released electronic product.
examples.zh: 为了赶时髦，一些年轻人花一个月的工资去购买新发布的电子产品。

examples.en: an elegant piece of furniture
examples.zh: 一件精美的家具

examples.en: As we all know, the efforts of countries in the Far East have not only protected the local environment but also contributed to reducing global reliance on this dangerous element.
examples.zh: 众所周知，远东各国的努力不仅保护了当地环境，也为降低全球对这一危险元素的依赖做出了贡献。(长宁)

examples.en: I have an elementary knowledge of physics.
examples.zh: 我掌握基本的物理知识。

examples.en: I saw a baby elephant drinking.
examples.zh: 我看见一只小象在喝水。

examples.en: go up in an elevator to the fifth floor
examples.zh: 乘升降电梯到5楼

examples.en: In the next three or four days, eleven witnesses will be called to testify.
examples.zh: 接下来的三四天里，将传唤11名证人出庭作证。

examples.en: The country wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.
examples.zh: 这个国家打算取消电子器件等产品的关税。

examples.en: somebody else
examples.zh: 另外一个人，别人

examples.en: Nowhere else in Shanghai can you find a better restaurant than this to enjoy sea food.
examples.zh: 在上海，你再也找不到比这家更好的海鲜餐馆了。

examples.en: They were living rather well, in comparison with people elsewhere in the world.
examples.zh: 和世界上其他地方的人相比，他们生活得相当好。

examples.en: I didn’t know anything about his life abroad until he told me by means of email.
examples.zh: 直到他给我发了电子邮件，我才知道他在国外的生活情况。

examples.en: With the help of the new technology, you can email your friends by mobile phone.
examples.zh: 在新技术的帮助下，你可以用手机给你的朋友发邮件。

examples.en: He embarrassed me by mentioning the mistake again.
examples.zh: 他再次提起那个错误，令我难堪。

examples.en: Do people with social anxiety get embarrassed easily?
examples.zh: 社交焦虑症患者是否很容易感到尴尬？

examples.en: The sun emerged from behind a cloud.
examples.zh: 太阳从云朵后钻出。

examples.en: The government is taking emergency action to deal with a housing crisis.
examples.zh: 政府正采取紧急措施解决住房危机。

examples.en: Britain agreed to cut emissions of nitrogen oxide from power stations.
examples.zh: 英国同意减少发电站氮氧化合物的排放量。

examples.en: Fireflies emit light but not heat.
examples.zh: 萤火虫发光但不放出热。

trans: 散发(光热、电波、液体、气味等)

examples.en: Love, hatred, and grief are emotions.
examples.zh: 爱、恨、悲伤都是情感。

examples.en: His Majesty the Emperor
examples.zh: 皇帝陛下

examples.en: Special emphasis should be put on the importance of protecting the environment.
examples.zh: 应该特别强调环保的重要性。

examples.en: Great emphasis is put on group work and interactive projects in this course.
examples.zh: 在本课程中，非常强调小组活动和互动项目。

examples.en: Great emphasis is put on group work and interactive projects in this course.
examples.zh: 在本课程中，非常强调小组活动和互动项目。

examples.en: Great emphasis is put on group work and interactive projects in this course.
examples.zh: 在本课程中，非常强调小组活动和互动项目。

examples.en: I want to emphasise that this is not over yet.
examples.zh: 我要强调这件事情还没完。

examples.en: Roman Empire
examples.zh: 罗马帝国

examples.en: The firm employs about 100 men.
examples.zh: 这家公司大约雇用了100个人。

examples.en: The new employee was inexperienced, so that he had trouble in dealing with the customer's complaints.
examples.zh: 新来的员工经验不足，在解决顾客投诉时遇到了麻烦。(金山)

examples.en: Employees can contract out of their employer's occupational pension scheme.
examples.zh: 雇员可以退出雇主的职业养老金计划。

examples.en: Except for an old lady, the bus was empty.
examples.zh: 那辆公共汽车上除了一位老妇之外，一个人也没有。

examples.en: They emptied the bottle.
examples.zh: 他们把瓶子一倒而空。

examples.en: The scholarship enabled the student to finish his studies in the university.
examples.zh: 这份奖学金使这名学生能完成他的大学学业。

examples.en: enclose the porch with glass
examples.zh: 用玻璃把走廊围起来

examples.en: No sooner had I left the school that early evening than I encountered a classmate of mine in primary school whom I hadn’t seen for ages.
examples.zh: 那天傍晚我一走出校门就遇到了一个多年不见的小学同班同学。

examples.en: my first encounter with Tom
examples.zh: 我和汤姆的初次见面

examples.en: Every time students meet with difficulty in learning a language, the teacher will encourage them with the saying that practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 每当学生在学习语言遇到困难时，老师就会用“熟能生巧”这句话来鼓励他们。

examples.en: I caught sight of a friend at the end of the room.
examples.zh: 我在房间的尽头看到一位朋友。

examples.en: Any attempt for Taiwan to break away from our motherland will end up in failure.
examples.zh: 任何想要把台湾从祖国分离出去的企图必将以失败告终。

examples.en: Long distance runners need great endurance.
examples.zh: 长跑运动员需要有很强的耐力。

examples.en: I can’t endure loud music.
examples.zh: 我不能忍受喧闹的音乐。

examples.en: We can’t endure much longer in this desert without water.
examples.zh: 没有水，我们无法在沙漠中坚持很久。

examples.en: I don’t know why a successful person often has many enemies.
examples.zh: 我不知道为什么一个成功的人往往有许多敌人。

examples.en: She is an energetic girl.
examples.zh: 她是一个精力充沛的女孩。

examples.en: energise a person for work
examples.zh: 激励某人努力工作

examples.en: Living on campus enables students to devote more time and energy to their academic work.
examples.zh: 住校能使学生有更多的时间和精力投入到学业中。(松江)

discriminations.intro: 这四个词的含义都与“力”有关。

items.explanation: 在物理学中是个重要术语，即“能”，包括动能和势能；在不作技术术语用时，它转化为功的“力”，可以表示“精力，体力”，还可表示“能量”和“能源”。

examples.en: As they grow old, people also accumulate belongings for two other reasons, lack of physical and mental energy, and sentiment.
examples.zh: 当人到老年时，他们会为另外两个原因而积聚相关事物，其一为体力和脑力的不足，其二是感情因素。

items.explanation: 表示克服阻力或使物体运动所需要的力，或者说这种“力”是具有能力(power)的人或机械在工作时所显示的“力”(force)；一辆处于静止状态的完好的机车具有潜在的“力”(power)，当它拖着满载货物的列车飞跑时，它便显示了自己克服阻力所需要的“力”(force)。

examples.en: Water streamed in torrents over its sides with such force that it set up a huge wave in the canal.
examples.zh: 水从侧面溢出，其力量之大，致使运河翻起波澜。

items.explanation: 包括“能力”或“动力”。这种“力”可以是固有的，也可以是获得的；可以是潜在的，也可以是施展出来的；也可以是体力、脑力、精神的力量或机械力。在物理学中 power 指功率。当 power 的含义是“权力”或“职权”时，其同义词为 authority。

examples.en: Experience teaches me that whatever power a fellow-guest may have to instruct or to amuse when he is sitting in a chair, or standing on a hearth-rug, quickly leaves him when he takes one out for a walk.
examples.zh: 经验告诉我，无论哪个与我一同做客的人，当他坐在椅子里或站在炉前地毯上的时候，他可能具有教导或逗乐的精力；当他陪别人出去散步的时候，这种精力很快就不见了。

examples.en: That all great art has this power of suggesting a world beyond is undeniable.
examples.zh: 不可否认，一切伟大的艺术都具备使人有超尘脱俗的浮想的力量。

items.explanation: 用作技术术语时，意思是“强度”。

examples.en: However, size and strength are not the only important things of this bridge.
examples.zh: 然而桥的尺寸和强度并非其唯一重要的方面。

examples.en: They never learned skills to engage the attention of others.
examples.zh: 他们从未学过吸引他人注意的技巧。

examples.en: The two friends engaged in conversation.
examples.zh: 两位朋友进行了交谈。

examples.en: He is engaged in making preparations for the conference these days.
examples.zh: 他这几天正忙于筹备会议。

examples.en: There seems to be something wrong with the engine. It’s much better to call in a mechanic to check it thoroughly than to fix it yourself.
examples.zh: 引擎似乎出了些问题，请一个机械工来彻底检查一下，比你自己修理要好得多。

examples.en: My father has worked as an engineer in the factory for several years.
examples.zh: 我父亲在这家工厂当了好多年工程师。

examples.en: What is it that motivates Xiao Wang to major in electronic engineering?
examples.zh: 究竟是什么激发了小王学习电子工程的积极性？(上海高考)

examples.en: Jane left England and made Greece her home.
examples.zh: 简离开了英格兰，在希腊安了家。

examples.en: We learn English not to take exams but to develop a tool for communication.
examples.zh: 我们学习英语不是为了参加考试，而是为了掌握一种交际工具。

examples.en: Passing the English examination will enhance your chances of getting the job.
examples.zh: 通过英语考试将会增加你获得这个职位的机会。

examples.en: In recent years, the products made in China have been enjoying higher and higher reputation.
examples.zh: 近年来，中国产品在世界各地享有越来越高的声誉。

examples.en: The party we attended last night was an enjoyable one.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚参加的聚会是令人愉快的。

examples.en: I suggest that you should read some English classics to improve your reading comprehension and enlarge your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 我建议你读一些英语名著，来提高阅读能力和扩大词汇量。

derivatives.name: enlargement
trans: 扩大物(尤指放大的照片)

examples.en: an enormous plate of food
examples.zh: 一大盘食物

examples.en: Our class team is strong enough to beat any other class.
examples.zh: 我们班队很强，可以战胜任何班级。

examples.en: They decided to enrol(l) him as a member of the society.
examples.zh: 他们决定吸收他为社团的成员。

examples.en: He decided to enrol(l) in the history course at the local evening school.
examples.zh: 他决定在当地夜校注册学习历史课程。

examples.en: The shop owner ensured that all the goods in his shop were of good quality.
examples.zh: 店主保证他商店里的所有货物质量都很好。

examples.en: No sooner had I entered the hall than he assured me that the discussion would end by three o’clock so that I would be in time to catch the last flight to London.
examples.zh: 我一进大厅，他就向我保证，讨论将会在3点之前结束，这样我就可以赶上最后一般去伦敦的飞机。

examples.en: Are you going to enter for the singing contest?
examples.zh: 你打算报名参加歌唱比赛吗？

examples.en: The government is offering support to small and medium-sized enterprises to help them grow.
examples.zh: 政府正在为中小企业提供支持，帮助它们发展。

examples.en: A teacher should entertain as well as teach.
examples.zh: 教师不仅要教书，也要能激发学生的兴趣。

examples.en: Some have called him the greatest entertainer of the twentieth century.
examples.zh: 有人称他为20世纪最伟大的艺人。

examples.en: an entertaining story
examples.zh: 一个有趣的故事

examples.en: Solving puzzles is an entertainment for many people.
examples.zh: 解谜对许多人来说是一种乐趣。

examples.en: She radiates an infectious enthusiasm for everything she does.
examples.zh: 她做任何事情都充满一种极富感染力的热情。

examples.en: enthusiastic support
examples.zh: 热情的支持

examples.en: He enjoys our entire confidence.
examples.zh: 他获得了我们全体的信赖。

items.explanation: 强调完整无缺点、整体性，修饰具体的或抽象的事物。

examples.en: I’m in entire ignorance as to what they have done.
examples.zh: 他们做了什么我全然不知。

items.explanation: 有强烈的数量含义，常作“总和，总数”解。

examples.en: His total income this month is 8,000 yuan.
examples.zh: 这个月他的总收入是8000元。

items.explanation: 口语中比 entire 用得多，只修饰可数名词，修饰单数可数名词时，前面须加限定词；不能修饰抽象名词。

examples.en: I don’t like the whole story, but only the first part.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢整个故事，只喜欢第一部分。

examples.en: The result is entirely unpredictable.
examples.zh: 结果是完全无法预料的。

examples.en: The author decided to entitle his book "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" after his main character.
examples.zh: 作者决定根据主人公的名字把书名定为《汤姆·索亚历险记》。

examples.en: While filling in the college entrance examination application, if your idea doesn't agree with your parents', how would you like to solve it properly?
examples.zh: 在填写高考志愿时，如果你的意见和父母的意见相左时，你会怎样妥善处理？（宝山）

examples.en: At the President's entry everyone fell silent.
examples.zh: 总统进来了，大家都鸦雀无声。

examples.en: Can I use this envelope?
examples.zh: 我可以用这个信封吗？

examples.en: Please tell us what to do to protect our environment.
examples.zh: 请告诉我们应该做什么来保护我们的环境。

examples.en: I don't envy you your journey in this bad weather.
examples.zh: 我并不羡慕你在这种坏天气去旅行。

examples.en: Her new house was the envy of all her friends.
examples.zh: 她的新居成了她所有朋友的羡慕对象。

senses.trans: (电视连续剧或广播剧的)一集

examples.en: Don't miss next week's thrilling episode.
examples.zh: 别错过下周扣人心弦的那一集。

examples.en: It's believed that a good book is equal to a good friend.
examples.zh: 人们相信，好书如益友。

examples.en: Let x be the equal of y.
examples.zh: 设 x 等于 y。

examples.en: Nine percent interest less seven percent inflation equals two percent.
examples.zh: 9%的利息减去7%的通货膨胀等于2%。

examples.en: The rent was equal to half his monthly income.
examples.zh: 租金等于他月收入的一半。

senses.trans: [用单数，常用作 the ~] 赤道

examples.en: All the planets orbit the Sun in roughly the same plane, round its equator.
examples.zh: 所有的行星大致在同一平面上绕太阳赤道运转。

examples.en: They can't afford to equip their laboratories properly for lack of funds.
examples.zh: 他们因缺乏资金无力充分装备自己的实验室。

examples.en: Rooms vary in size and are all equipped with television and telephone.
examples.zh: 房间大小不同，均配有电视和电话。

examples.en: Members of staff should be instructed in the use of fire equipment.
examples.zh: 应该指导全体职员学会使用消防设备。

examples.en: He changed his pounds for the equivalent amount of dollars.
examples.zh: 他把英镑换成了等值的美元。

examples.en: Some American words have no British equivalents.
examples.zh: 美式英语的一些单词在英式英语中没有对应词。

examples.en: It was on Sunday that, er, he called on me.
examples.zh: 他来拜访我，呃，是在周日。

examples.en: In the era of emails, many people still take great delight in receiving a paper letter.
examples.zh: 在电子邮件时代，许多人依然会因为收到纸质信件而欣喜不已。

examples.en: He erased the chalk marks.
examples.zh: 他擦去粉笔记号。

senses.trans: 擦除器(如黑板擦、橡皮、刮字刀等)

examples.en: I need a pen and an eraser.
examples.zh: 我需要一支笔和一块橡皮。

examples.en: The accident was caused by human error.
examples.zh: 这次事故是由于人为过错造成的。

examples.en: An active volcano may erupt at any time.
examples.zh: 活火山会随时喷发。

examples.en: He went up by escalator to the second floor.
examples.zh: 他乘自动扶梯到 2 楼。

examples.en: The disease spread all over the place and not a baby could escape death.
examples.zh: 疾病传遍这个地方，没有一个婴儿幸免于难。

examples.en: I read adventure stories as an escape from reality.
examples.zh: 我阅读探险小说以逃避现实。

examples.en: The police are tracking down a criminal who escaped from prison last night.
examples.zh: 警方正在追捕一名昨晚从监狱脱逃的罪犯。

examples.en: Their ideas still influence us today, especially in the arts, science, literature and philosophy.
examples.zh: 今天他们的想法仍然影响着我们，尤其是在艺术、科学、文学和哲学方面。

items.explanation: 特别，尤其(通常用来对前面所述的事件进一步说明或补充)

examples.en: She likes the country, especially in spring.
examples.zh: 她喜欢乡村，尤其是在春天。

items.explanation: 特别地(表示与众不同、少见、专门或需特别对待的意思)

examples.en: I came here specially to see you.
examples.zh: 我是特地来这里看你的。

items.explanation: 特别地，尤其(主要用于众多事例中选出一个“个别”的)

examples.en: His good temper was particularly noticed.
examples.zh: 他的好脾气尤为明显。

examples.en: I particularly mentioned that point.
examples.zh: 我特别提到了那一点。

examples.en: She wrote an essay titled My Family.
examples.zh: 她写了一篇题为《我的家庭》的文章。

examples.en: It's essential that the damaged road be repaired immediately.
examples.zh: 受损马路有必要立即修复。

items.explanation: 指“必要的，迫切需要的”。

examples.en: It's necessary for us to study hard.
examples.zh: 我们必须努力学习。

items.explanation: 指“必需的，不可缺少的”。

examples.en: Food is essential for life.
examples.zh: 食物是生命所必需的。

e.name: It is essential for sb. to do

examples.en: He established his son in business.
examples.zh: 他使儿子立足于商界。

discriminations.intro: 这三个词的一般含义是“使某人或某物稳定、固定下来”。

items.explanation: 原来的含义是“使位置固定”，但现在常常表示“使确立，使存在”。

examples.en: It is a newly planted tree and it has not established yet.
examples.zh: 这是一棵新栽的树，还没有扎下根来。

items.explanation: 特别强调使某物在位置、状态或特征方面固定下来。

examples.en: Her eyes were fixed on her plate.
examples.zh: 她的双眼盯着盘子。

items.explanation: 指使某人或某物安定下来。

examples.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England and had planned to settle down in the country.
examples.zh: 他常想在英国过退休生活，并打算在这个国家定居下来。

examples.en: We lived on an estate.
examples.zh: 我们住在一处庄园上。

trans: 上有大片建筑物的土地
个人全部财产(尤指遗产)

examples.en: It is estimated that it will take the country three years to recover from the economic crisis.
examples.zh: 那个国家估计要花 3 年时间才能从经济危机中恢复过来。

examples.en: We got two or three estimates before having the roof repaired.
examples.zh: 我们修理屋顶之前已收到了两三份估价单。

examples.en: There are lots of things to buy — tea, sugar, bread, etc.
examples.zh: 要买的东西很多：茶叶、糖、面包等。

examples.en: Our main aim is to increase sales in Europe.
examples.zh: 我们的主要目标是增加在欧洲的销售量。

examples.en: These actions are in contravention of European law.
examples.zh: 这些行动违反了欧洲的法律。

examples.en: She is the only European in the class.
examples.zh: 她是班上唯一的欧洲人。

examples.en: How would you evaluate yourself?
examples.zh: 你会如何评价自己？

examples.en: People like to watch TV on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 人们喜欢在除夕那晚看电视。

examples.en: We hope we can cooperate even more closely in the future.
examples.zh: 希望我们今后能更加密切地合作。

examples.en: What an amazing performance the boy gave in China's Got Talent yesterday evening!
examples.zh: 这个男孩在昨晚《中国达人秀》上的表演多么惊人啊！

examples.en: A newly-released survey shows that the biggest attraction of the Internet is that it keeps net citizens informed of the world events.
examples.zh: 一项新披露的调查表明，网络最吸引人之处在于它能让网民及时了解世界大事。

examples.en: The eventual aim is reunification.
examples.zh: 最终目标是实现统一。

examples.en: The police eventually recovered the stolen paintings.
examples.zh: 警方最终追回了失窃的油画。

examples.en: Both my husband and I think it is the most amusing story we have ever heard.
examples.zh: 我丈夫和我都认为这是我们听到过的最有趣的故事。

examples.en: He inherited his father's fortune and has lived a comfortable life ever since.
examples.zh: 他继承了他父亲的财产，从此以后过着舒适的生活。

examples.en: I'm fed up with your everlasting complaints.
examples.zh: 我讨厌你那永无休止的牢骚。

examples.en: It's well known to all that every citizen's right to life and health is protected by the law.
examples.zh: 众所周知，每位公民的生命权和健康权都受法律的保护。

examples.en: Please speak louder, so that everybody in the hall can hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 请大声点说，让在大厅里的每个人都听清楚。

examples.en: These are my everyday shoes, not my best ones.
examples.zh: 这些是我平常穿的鞋，不是最好的鞋。

examples.en: Everyone in the class passed the maths exam.
examples.zh: 班里每个人都通过了数学考试。

examples.en: Kevin is so independent that he always tries to do everything by himself.
examples.zh: 凯文是如此独立，以至于他总是设法自己去做每一件事。

examples.en: Everywhere are scenes of prosperity.
examples.zh: 到处是繁荣的景象。

examples.en: Whoever objects to carrying out the plan must provide enough evidence.
examples.zh: 无论谁反对执行这个计划，都必须要给出充足的理由。

examples.en: It is evident that he has made great progress recently.
examples.zh: 很明显，最近他取得了很大进步。

examples.en: There is no evil in that child.
examples.zh: 那孩子纯洁无邪。

examples.en: evil thoughts
examples.zh: 邪念

examples.en: the evolution of the modern car
examples.zh: 现代汽车的发展

examples.en: With the power of advanced technique, we evolve and refine principle.
examples.zh: 我们用先进技术的力量制定和改进原则。

examples.en: The exact date of the event has escaped me.
examples.zh: 我记不起这起事件的确切日期了。

examples.en: I know exactly how you feel.
examples.zh: 我完全清楚你的感受。

examples.en: After we pass the exam, we will celebrate by having a party next week.
examples.zh: 通过考试后，下周我们将聚会庆祝。

examples.en: The officers at the airport examine every traveler's passport carefully.
examples.zh: 机场工作人员仔细检查每个旅行者的护照。

examples.en: Would you please give us another example?
examples.zh: 请给我们另外举个例子好吗？

examples.en: An excellent story is the key to making a successful film.
examples.zh: 优秀的故事是拍出成功电影的关键。

examples.en: The amusement park completed last month is open to the public every day except on Mondays.
examples.zh: 上个月竣工的游乐园每天向公众开放，逢星期一休息。

items.explanation: 用于同类事物的排除，不能置于句首，可接从句。

examples.en: He gets up early every day except Sunday.
examples.zh: 除了星期天，他每天起得很早。

examples.en: I know nothing about him except that he is from Britain.
examples.zh: 除了知道他从英国来，其他有关他的情况我一无所知。

items.explanation: 用于异类事物的排除，可置于句首。

examples.en: The garden was silent except for the leaves.
examples.zh: 除了叶子的沙沙声，这个花园寂静无声。

examples.en: Except for Sam, you can all go home.
examples.zh: 除了萨姆，你们都能回家。

items.explanation: 注意：在现代英语中 except 和 except for 有混用的趋势，尤其在含有 all、none、no 等词的句中。

examples.en: He answered all the questions except (for) the last one.
examples.zh: 除最后一个问题外，他回答了所有问题。

examples.en: At the age of five, he showed exceptional talent as a musician.
examples.zh: 他5岁时就表现出非凡的音乐才能。

examples.en: The Italian exchange student was thankful to the host for his care and help.
examples.zh: 意大利的交换学生感谢接待方对他的关心和帮助。

examples.en: They exchanged experience at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他们在会上交流经验。

examples.en: The court case has excited a lot of public interest.
examples.zh: 这案件引起了公众的广泛兴趣。

examples.en: I'm really excited at the prospect of working abroad.
examples.zh: 我对有望到国外工作感到十分兴奋。

examples.en: This piece of equipment is an exciting new development.
examples.zh: 这台设备是一项振奋人心的最新研制成果。

examples.en: My foreign friend couldn't help exclaiming that there are so many places worth visiting in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 我的外国友人不禁赞叹：上海值得看的地方很多啊！（上海秋考）

examples.en: The Customs excludes certain items for entry.
examples.zh: 海关不准某些物品进口。

examples.en: We went on an excursion to the city.
examples.zh: 我们到这个城市去旅行。

examples.en: Please excuse me for being late.
examples.zh: 对不起，我迟到了。

examples.en: There's no excuse for behavior like that.
examples.zh: 别为那样的行为找借口。

examples.en: The executive manager tossed out my application.
examples.zh: 执行经理拒绝了我的申请。

examples.en: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive.
examples.zh: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争力很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

examples.en: To keep fit, we should get rid of unhealthy eating habits and do more exercise.
examples.zh: 为了强身健体，我们应该摆脱不健康的饮食习惯，多做运动。

examples.en: exercises in English composition
examples.zh: 英语作文练习

examples.en: The doctor advised her to take more exercise.
examples.zh: 医生嘱咐她多运动。

examples.en: You should exercise more.
examples.zh: 你应该多多锻炼。

examples.en: A full day's teaching exhausts me.
examples.zh: 讲一整天课令我筋疲力尽。

examples.en: Does the chemical factory exhaust into the river?
examples.zh: 化工场的废液是排入河里了吗？

examples.en: Industrial exhaust must be well treated.
examples.zh: 工业废气必须妥善处理。

examples.en: Most of the state leaders viewed the exhibits and gave high praise of them.
examples.zh: 大多数国家领导人看了展品，并给予了高度赞扬。

examples.en: Quite a few products exhibited this year have integrated tradition with fashion through a deep exploration of Eastern cultures.
examples.zh: 今年参展的不少产品通过对东方文化的深度挖掘，将传统与时尚融合。（虹口）

examples.en: The Egyptian exhibition at the Shanghai Museum was so popular that it was almost impossible to get a ticket.
examples.zh: 上海博物馆的埃及展太火爆了，根本抢不到票。（奉贤）

examples.en: Risks exist in online shopping, so careful consideration before placing an order can help avoid unnecessary losses.
examples.zh: 网购存在风险，因此下单之前的深思熟虑有助于避免不必要的损失。

e.name: exist by
trans: 靠……生活(与行为、职业等抽象名词或动名词搭配)

e.name: exist on
trans: 靠……生活(与食物、收入、薪金等名词搭配)

examples.en: People's social existence determines their consciousness.
examples.zh: 人们的社会存在决定人们的意识。

e.name: come into existence
trans: 开始存在(不能用被动语态)
