examples.en: Up to now, historians have assumed that calendars came into being with the introduction of agriculture.
examples.zh: 至今，历史学家们认为日历是随着农业的出现而产生的。

examples.en: The customer starts walking to the exit nearest where he parked.
examples.zh: 顾客开始走向距离他的停车点最近的出口。

examples.en: The petals of many flowers expand in the sunshine.
examples.zh: 许多花的花瓣在阳光下开放。

examples.en: He expanded on his new theory.
examples.zh: 他详细阐述了自己的新理论。

examples.en: The company is forging ahead with its plans for expansion.
examples.zh: 公司的扩张计划正顺利进行。

examples.en: The traffic is expected to be improved greatly after the road has been widened.
examples.zh: 道路拓宽后，这里的交通有望得到极大的改善。

examples.en: Beyond all expectations, the eight-year-old boy answered all the questions fluently in the competition, and won thunderous applause from the audience.
examples.zh: 出乎预料，这个年纪仅8岁的小男孩在竞赛中对答如流，赢得了观众们如雷般的掌声。（奉贤）

examples.en: What are the expenses of moving house?
examples.zh: 搬场费是多少？

examples.en: This beautiful skirt is as expensive as that red scarf.
examples.zh: 这条漂亮的裙子和那条红色的围巾一样贵。

examples.en: It was my volunteer experience that helped me to be admitted by the university.
examples.zh: 我的志愿者经历帮助我被这所大学录取。

examples.en: What he has experienced in the past helps him a lot in his present career.
examples.zh: 过去的经历有助于他目前的事业。

items.explanation: 指累积的经验。

examples.en: The lady has much experience in teaching children English.
examples.zh: 那位女士在幼儿英语教育方面很有经验。

items.explanation: 指通过书本学习或经验获得的某方面的知识。

examples.en: His knowledge and experience increase with his days.
examples.zh: 他的知识和经验与日俱增。

items.explanation: 指通过研究而获得的学识，层次比 knowledge 更高。

examples.en: He is known as a man of great learning.
examples.zh: 他因为渊博的学识而出名。

items.explanation: 指技能，即熟练做某事的能力。

examples.en: The man showed his skill in repairing the motorbike.
examples.zh: 那人展示了他修理摩托车的技能。

examples.en: I should describe the experiment as unsuccessful.
examples.zh: 应该说这次实验是不成功的。

examples.en: They experimented with new reagents and succeeded.
examples.zh: 他们用新试剂做了试验，获得了成功。

examples.en: an expert in electronics
examples.zh: 电子学专家

examples.en: He is an expert driver.
examples.zh: 他是一位技术高超的驾驶员。

examples.en: Can you explain why you were late?
examples.zh: 你能解释一下为什么迟到吗？

e.name: explain sth. to sb.
trans: 向某人解释(或阐明)某事

examples.en: How do you know that this explanation is wrong?
examples.zh: 你怎么知道这个解释是错误的呢？

examples.en: The boiler exploded and a big fire ensued.
examples.zh: 锅炉爆炸了，随之而来的是一场大火。

examples.en: Their heroic exploits will go down in history.
examples.zh: 他们的英雄业绩将被载入史册。

examples.en: to exploit the oil under the sea
examples.zh: 开发海底石油

examples.en: Clever exploitation of the latest technology would be a sure formula for success.
examples.zh: 对最新技术的巧妙利用必将带来成功。

examples.en: We must explore all the possibilities for the solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 我们必须探讨解决这个问题的所有可能性。

examples.en: the production of nuclear explosives
examples.zh: 核炸药的生产

examples.en: The total amount of the export this year has increased two times, compared with that of the same time last year.
examples.zh: 与去年同期相比，今年的出口总量增长了2倍。

examples.en: This country exports fruit.
examples.zh: 这个国家出口水果。

examples.en: She often takes her son to concerts at weekends, exposing him to art.
examples.zh: 她经常在周末带儿子去音乐会，让他受到艺术的熏陶。

trans: 使处于……作用(或影响)之下

discriminations.intro: 这四个词都含“景象的出现”或“向……展示某物”的意思。

items.explanation: 指“把某物展出使人们看到”。

examples.en: Jewelry is displayed on a sales counter.
examples.zh: 珠宝陈列在销售柜台里。

items.explanation: 指“为出售、竞赛、展览等而陈列”。

examples.en: Unearthed cultural relics was exhibited here last month.
examples.zh: 上个月在这里展览了出土文物。

items.explanation: 指“陈列商品等”，也可指“使……暴露”。

examples.en: expose goods in a shop window
examples.zh: 陈列货物于商店橱窗内

examples.en: The crime of the corrupt officials must be exposed without any reserve.
examples.zh: 对贪官污吏的罪行一定要毫无保留地予以揭发。

items.explanation: 系常用词，指“故意或有意向某人展示某物”。

examples.en: Show us the garden.
examples.zh: 让我们看一下花园。

examples.en: Therefore, in its exposure to various risks, credit risk remains the main risk.
examples.zh: 因此，在面临的各种风险中，信贷风险仍然是主要风险。

examples.en: He had boarded an express for Rome.
examples.zh: 他已经登上了前往罗马的特快列车。

examples.en: He still has difficulty expressing thoughts in English.
examples.zh: 他仍难以用英语表达自己的想法。

e.name: express oneself
trans: 表达自己的思想(感情、意见)

examples.en: Children can communicate with adults through facial expressions and by making noises long before they are able to speak or understand a language.
examples.zh: 在孩子们能够说或理解一门语言之前，他们很早就能够靠面部表情和发出噪声与大人交流。

examples.en: This subway line is going to be extended to the suburban area.
examples.zh: 这条地铁线将延伸到郊区。

discriminations.intro: 这两个词在作“（时间、空间的）延长”解时，可以互用。

items.explanation: （时间、空间的）延长；（范围的）扩展，延长（含比喻意义）

examples.en: Man is extending his eyes with radar.
examples.zh: 人类借助雷达来扩大自己的视野。

examples.en: the extended meaning of a word
examples.zh: 词汇的引申意义

items.explanation: （时间、空间的）延长；使加长

examples.en: to extend/lengthen a road
examples.zh: 延长道路

examples.en: He will appeal to the state for an extension of unemployment benefits.
examples.zh: 他将呼吁国家延长领取失业救济金的时限。

examples.en: They began to lay in extensive stores of food supplies.
examples.zh: 他们开始储备大量食物。

examples.en: I agree with you to some extent.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，我同意你的观点。

examples.en: To some extent, the new measure will relieve the pressure of population growth.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，新措施将缓解人口增长带来的压力。

examples.en: an external wound
examples.zh: 外伤

examples.en: The reason why some animals became extinct was that they couldn't adapt to the new environment, so we must pay attention to keeping the balance of nature.
examples.zh: 有些动物灭绝的原因是它们无法适应新的环境，因此我们必须注意保持生态平衡。

examples.en: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
examples.zh: 目前，30% 的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

examples.en: Firemen were called to extinguish the fire.
examples.zh: 有人打电话叫消防员来灭火。

examples.en: There is an extinguisher at the end of the street.
examples.zh: 街道的尽头有个灭火器。

examples.en: What should we do with this extra income?
examples.zh: 我们应该如何处理这笔额外的收入呢？

examples.en: a man of extraordinary strength
examples.zh: 一位力气惊人的男子

examples.en: extreme opinions
examples.zh: 偏激的观点

examples.en: We are on a world of extremes of temperature.
examples.zh: 我们生活在一个冷热气温悬殊的世界上。

examples.en: Recent years has witnessed the quick development of the mountain village which was extremely poor.
examples.zh: 那个曾经一贫如洗的小山村近几年发展迅猛。

examples.en: Reading can open up my eyes to the outside world.
examples.zh: 读书能够开拓我的视野。

examples.en: He had thick bushy eyebrows.
examples.zh: 他的眉毛又浓又粗。

examples.en: Your eyesight rights itself very quickly.
examples.zh: 你的视力恢复得非常快。

examples.en: Why did you end your essay with a quotation from Shakespeare?
examples.zh: 你为什么引用莎士比亚的话来作为文章的结尾呢？

examples.en: His attempts on the world record all ended up in failure.
examples.zh: 他对世界纪录发起的冲击均以失败告终。

examples.en: Why did you end your essay with a quotation from Shakespeare?
examples.zh: 你为什么引用莎士比亚的话来作为文章的结尾呢？

examples.en: His attempts on the world record all ended up in failure.
examples.zh: 他对世界纪录发起的冲击均以失败告终。

examples.en: Are you going to enter for the singing contest?
examples.zh: 你打算报名参加歌唱比赛吗？

examples.en: We entertained our neighbours and friends with a BBQ in our backyard.
examples.zh: 我们在后院用烧烤招待邻居和朋友。

e.name: exchange A for B
trans: 把 A 交换成 B

examples.en: The tokens can be exchanged for goods in any of our shops.
examples.zh: 兑换币可以在我们的任何一家店兑换商品。

examples.en: Class, I’m going to tell you a fable.
examples.zh: 同学们，我要给你们讲一个寓言。

examples.en: The fabric has been treated to repel water.
examples.zh: 这种织物进行过防水处理。

examples.en: In the face of injustice, he didn’t hesitate to stand up and defend justice. / Faced with injustice, he didn’t hesitate to step up and defend what is right.
examples.zh: 面对不公，他毫不犹豫地挺身而出，捍卫正义。(杨浦)

examples.en: We must face up to our responsibilities instead of shifting them onto others.
examples.zh: 我们必须直面我们的责任，而不是把它们推卸给其他人。

examples.en: They won in the face of fierce competition from all over the country.
examples.zh: 面对来自全国各地的激烈竞争，他们还是赢了。

examples.en: Structured teaching facilitates learning.
examples.zh: 有条理的教学有利于学习。

examples.en: It remains to be seen whether his proposal of buying more sports facilities in the group discussion yesterday can be put into practice.
examples.zh: 昨天他在小组讨论中关于添置运动设备的提议能否付诸实践，还需拭目以待。

examples.en: The fact that Andrew narrowly escaped being killed in the fire reminded us again of the importance of fire prevention.
examples.zh: 安德鲁险些葬身火海的事再次提醒了我们防火的重要性。

examples.en: More and more people are considering environmental factors when shopping, including the sustainability of products.
examples.zh: 越来越多的人在购物时考虑环保因素，包括产品的可持续性。(金山)

examples.en: The people there did not allow them to set up a factory so as not to pollute the water in the river.
examples.zh: 为防止污染河水，当地居民不允许他们在那儿建厂。

examples.en: The colours gently fade each time you wash the shirt.
examples.zh: 衬衣每洗一次都会褪点色。

examples.en: He fails in courage.
examples.zh: 他不够勇敢。

examples.en: He tried everything but failed to help his friend out of trouble.
examples.zh: 他尽了一切努力，但还是没能帮助朋友摆脱困境。

examples.en: I think the reason for his failure to learn English well is that he lacks perseverance.
examples.zh: 我觉得他学不好英语的原因是缺乏毅力。

examples.en: a faint light
examples.zh: 暗淡的光线

examples.en: faint at the sight of blood
examples.zh: 见到血晕了过去

examples.en: She went off in a faint.
examples.zh: 她昏过去了。

examples.en: She tries to be fair to all her employees.
examples.zh: 她尽量对所有雇员公平。

examples.en: a book fair
examples.zh: 书展

examples.en: He told the facts fairly.
examples.zh: 他实事求是地叙述这些事实。

discriminations.intro: 这三个副词的强弱程度不同。

items.explanation: 多与褒义词连用，表示适度的意思。fairly 放在冠词之后。fairly 不可修饰动词。

examples.en: The film was fairly good.
examples.zh: 那部电影还好。(有“勉强可看”之意)

examples.en: He does his job fairly well.
examples.zh: 他工作做得不错。

examples.en: He is fairly clever.
examples.zh: 他很聪明。(不可说 He is fairly foolish.)

items.explanation: 在分量上比 fairly 稍强。它相当于汉语的“十分，完全”，用来加强语气。quite 不用来修饰比较级，但表示身体康复时可说 quite better，完全康复了。quite 可与 another、a few、a lot of 等连用。quite 放在冠词之前。quite 可以修饰动词；修饰名词时须放在不定冠词前；当名词前有形容词时，可放在不定冠词后，也可放在不定冠词前。

examples.en: The film was quite good.
examples.zh: 那部电影相当好。(有“胜过许多影片”之意)

examples.en: I don’t quite understand the rule.
examples.zh: 我对那条规则不太理解。

examples.en: That was quite an accident.
examples.zh: 那是一起不太寻常的事故。

items.explanation: 常含有过分或不适当的意思，主要用于贬义，如 rather poor/bad/stupid/ugly/foolish；可与 too 和比较级连用，而 fairly、quite 不行。rather 可放在不定冠词之前或之后，但必须放在定冠词 the 之后。rather 可以修饰动词；修饰名词时须放在不定冠词前；当名词前有形容词时，可放在不定冠词后，也可放在不定冠词前。

examples.en: The film was rather good.
examples.zh: 那部电影不错。(有“值得一看”之意)

examples.en: It’s rather a pity.
examples.zh: 这真是有点遗憾。

examples.en: That car is rather larger than he wants.
examples.zh: 那辆车比他所需要的大。(不适合他)

examples.en: I rather like the smell of the leaves.
examples.zh: 我相当喜欢这种树叶的气味。

examples.en: It is a rather cold day.
examples.zh: 今天相当冷。(= It is rather a cold day.)

examples.en: The imaginative child made up fairy tales.
examples.zh: 这个想象力丰富的孩子自己编童话故事。

examples.en: Nobody could really help you if you have lost faith in your own ability.
examples.zh: 如果你对自己的能力失去了信心，那么没有人能真正帮助你。

examples.en: He faked his father’s signature.
examples.zh: 他伪造父亲的签字。

examples.en: The teapot looked old but was a recent fake.
examples.zh: 这把茶壶貌似古董，却是一件新近制作的赝品。

examples.en: Fake news on social media travels very fast.
examples.zh: 社交媒体上的假新闻传播得很快。

examples.en: On International Mathematics Day, which falls on March 14th, the expert was invited to give a lecture on mathematical symbols to primary school students.
examples.zh: 在 3 月 14 日国际数学日，这位专家受邀来给小学生做一场关于数学符号的讲座。(上海秋考)

examples.en: A fall into the pit, a gain in your wit.
examples.zh: 吃一堑长一智。

examples.en: in the fall of 2017
examples.zh: 在 2017 年的秋天

examples.en: The book fell off the shelf.
examples.zh: 这本书从架子上掉了下来。

examples.en: Did she fall off the cliff by accident, or was she pushed off?
examples.zh: 她是意外地掉下悬崖，还是被推下去的呢？

examples.en: He made a false promise that he would take back the false money he gave me on purpose.
examples.zh: 他给我做了一个假承诺：将收回他故意给我的假钞。

examples.en: The photographer works so tirelessly and his skills are so good that people predict his fame is just around the corner.
examples.zh: 这位摄影师工作孜孜不倦，技术又精湛，人们预测他的成名指日可待。

examples.en: I am quite familiar with this piece of music, but I can’t tell who composed it.
examples.zh: 这首乐曲我非常熟悉，但我讲不出是谁谱的曲。

examples.en: I am familiar with the casual atmosphere in the company.
examples.zh: 我对公司中这种轻松随意的氛围感到熟悉。

examples.en: I will take a holiday with my family as I finish all the exams.
examples.zh: 当所有考试都考完，我会跟家人一起去度假。

examples.en: This town is famous for its beautiful buildings.
examples.zh: 这个城镇以它那漂亮的建筑而出名。

examples.en: electric fan
examples.zh: 电风扇

examples.en: He fanned himself with his hat.
examples.zh: 他用帽子给自己扇风。

examples.en: Most football fans are satisfied with the team’s performance.
examples.zh: 大多数足球迷对球队的表现感到满意。

examples.en: a lively fancy
examples.zh: 丰富的想象力

examples.en: Do you fancy having a walk in the garden after supper?
examples.zh: 晚饭后想去散散步吗？

examples.en: Your proposals are utterly fantastic; we couldn’t possibly afford them.
examples.zh: 你的那些建议太不切实了，我们实在无法接受。

examples.en: Sometimes reality and fantasy are hard to distinguish.
examples.zh: 有时候现实和幻想很难区分。

examples.en: When you learn grammar, it is far from enough only to understand what the teacher explains.
examples.zh: 学习语法时，仅仅听懂老师的讲解是远远不够的。

examples.en: What’s the first-class fare from Chicago to Los Angeles?
examples.zh: 从芝加哥到洛杉矶的头等舱费用是多少？

examples.en: We’ve decided to have a farewell party before we leave the school.
examples.zh: 我们决定在离开学校前举行一个告别会。

examples.en: He made his farewell to his family.
examples.zh: 他向他的家人告别。

examples.en: Uncle Tom keeps many sheep on his farm and leads a happy life.
examples.zh: 汤姆叔叔在农场养了许多羊，过着幸福的生活。

examples.en: We farm for a living.
examples.zh: 我们以务农为生。

examples.en: The farmer looked sadly at the flooded field and he became sadder and sadder.
examples.zh: 农民忧郁地望着被洪水淹没的田地，他变得越来越悲哀。

examples.en: Children are often fascinated by the toys in the shop windows.
examples.zh: 孩子常被橱窗里的玩具迷住。

examples.en: The exhibition tells the fascinating story of the steam age.
examples.zh: 展览讲述了蒸汽时代引人入胜的故事。

examples.en: Excessive pursuit of fashion actually involves giving up the freedom of choice.
examples.zh: 过分地追求时尚其实是放弃了自己的选择自由。

examples.en: Fashionable as booking a taxi online is, many related problems remain to be settled.
examples.zh: 在线预订出租车虽然很时尚，但许多相关问题尚待解决。

examples.en: There is no doubt that the rapid development of fast food industry is changing our eating habits.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，快餐业的迅速发展正在改变我们的饮食习惯。

examples.en: to run fast
examples.zh: 快跑

examples.en: The squire confessed his sins to a priest and then fasted in order to cleanse his soul.
examples.zh: 乡绅向神父忏悔了他的罪行，然后禁食以净化他的灵魂。

discriminations.intro: 这四个词都有“快的”意思。

items.explanation: 强调物体进行相对运动；可以作副词。

examples.en: Light travels faster than sound.
examples.zh: 光比声音快。

items.explanation: 形容事情发生得快，占用的时间少，也不涉及速度。

examples.en: Roy acted quickly and extinguished the fire before it could spread any further.
examples.zh: 罗伊动作迅速，在火势进一步蔓延之前将其扑灭。

items.explanation: 只表示运动着的物体或事物的本身状况，并不涉及单位时间内所越过的距离。

examples.en: rapid work
examples.zh: 动作快

examples.en: rapid progress
examples.zh: 进步快

items.explanation: 在修饰人或人的动作时，含有“急忙”的意思，在修饰物体的相对运动时，强调直线运动的速度，或沿着一定道路前进的速度。

examples.en: He is a speedy worker.
examples.zh: 他干活很利索。

examples.en: All passengers are required to fasten their seat-belts while the plane is taking off.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞时要求所有乘客都系好安全带。

examples.en: You will become fatter and fatter if you don’t go on a diet.
examples.zh: 如果你不节食，会变得越来越胖。

examples.en: I don’t eat much fat, for example, fatty meat.
examples.zh: 我脂肪吃得不多，比如肥肉。

examples.en: a fatal accident
examples.zh: 重大事故

examples.en: When they met again after ten years, they felt that fate brought them together.
examples.zh: 十年后又见面时，他们觉得是命运使他们碰到了一块儿。

examples.en: His father is very kind.
examples.zh: 他的父亲非常慈祥。

examples.en: Somehow, people seem to think it’s my fault for letting him in.
examples.zh: 不知怎么的，人们似乎认为让他进来是我的错。

items.explanation: 缺点，不足(指过失与责任)

examples.en: It’s my fault, for I forgot to tell him about it.
examples.zh: 这是我的不对，我忘了告诉他这件事。

items.explanation: 错误(通常指思想与行为上的错误，为可数名词)

examples.en: We made a mistake, and came to the wrong room.
examples.zh: 我们犯了个错，走错了房间。

items.explanation: 短处(通常用复数形式，一般指达不到所要求的标准)

examples.en: I hope you would not mind if I point out a few of your shortcomings.
examples.zh: 我希望你不介意我指出你的一些不足。

items.explanation: 错误，坏事(强调违反道德标准的错误、坏事或不公平行为)

examples.en: They have done me a great wrong.
examples.zh: 他们冤枉我。

examples.en: I want to quit my job, for my boss is always finding fault with me.
examples.zh: 我想辞职不干了，因为我的老板总是挑我的错。

examples.en: Are you in favour of the suggestion of putting off the meeting till next week?
examples.zh: 你赞成把会议延迟到下周的提议吗？

examples.en: They favour liberal free-market policies.
examples.zh: 他们支持开放的自由市场政策。

examples.en: What is your favourite flower?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢什么花？

examples.en: A special express service is available by fax.
examples.zh: 提供传真特快专递服务。

examples.en: I faxed a copy of the agreement to each of the investors.
examples.zh: 我给每个投资人都传真了一份合同。

examples.en: Parents ask their kids not to play by the river for fear that something terrible might happen.
examples.zh: 家长嘱咐孩子别在河边嬉戏，以免遭遇不测。

examples.en: The soldier feared neither hardship nor death.
examples.zh: 这位战士不怕苦，二不怕死。

examples.en: The new plan was feasible in theory, but we met with many unexpected problems in the course of carrying it out.
examples.zh: 这个计划理论上行得通，但在实施的过程中我们遇到了许多意想不到的问题。

examples.en: a feather quilt
examples.zh: 羽绒被

examples.en: Round-the-clock service features this store.
examples.zh: 24 小时服务是这家商店的特色。

examples.en: This fabric, woven with cotton thread, is rich in national features.
examples.zh: 这种布料用棉线编织而成，很有民族特色。(松江)

examples.en: These trees come into leaf in February.
examples.zh: 这些树二月里长叶子。

examples.en: a doctor's fee for a visit
examples.zh: 医生的出诊费

examples.en: What do you feed your cat on?
examples.zh: 你用什么喂你的猫？

examples.en: I'm simply fed up with his carelessness and forgetfulness.
examples.zh: 我简直受够了他的粗心和健忘。

examples.en: We want your feedback.
examples.zh: 我们想要你们的反馈意见。

examples.en: Generally speaking, the more familiar you are with a place, the more you will feel at ease.
examples.zh: 一般来说，你对一个地方越熟悉，就越会感到自在。

examples.en: It seems that the feel and texture of paper pages along with colorful illustrations beats the static dimensions of a screen.
examples.zh: 纸页的触感、纹理以及彩色插图似乎胜过了静态的屏幕。

examples.en: He has lost all feeling in his leg.
examples.zh: 他的腿失去了知觉。

examples.en: hurt one’s feelings
examples.zh: 伤害某人的感情

items.explanation: 感觉（具体指生理或心理感觉）

examples.en: She experienced a feeling of happiness when she had succeeded in her job.
examples.zh: 工作取得成功时，她感到十分幸福。

items.explanation: 指心境、情绪及特定时间和场合的心情，常用形容词如 cheerful、agreeable、bad、joyful 等修饰，表示特定的情绪。

examples.en: That evening he was in a happy mood.
examples.zh: 那天晚上他心情愉快。

items.explanation: 知觉，感觉（泛指人体感官，如听觉、味觉、嗅觉、触觉等，也可解释为意识或辨别力）

examples.en: People have five senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.
examples.zh: 人有 5 种官能：视觉、听觉、嗅觉、味觉和触觉。

examples.en: He has no sense of shame.
examples.zh: 他没有羞耻感。

examples.en: What a fellow!
examples.zh: 好家伙！

examples.en: It is a female deer.
examples.zh: 这是一头雌鹿。

examples.en: This litter produced two males and seven females.
examples.zh: 这一窝产下2只雄仔和7只雌仔。

examples.en: erect a bamboo fence
examples.zh: 筑竹篱

examples.en: I haven’t decided which ferry I shall take to Hong Kong.
examples.zh: 我还没有决定乘哪一班渡轮去香港。

examples.en: a fertile imagination
examples.zh: 丰富的想象力

examples.en: Fertiliser enriches the soil.
examples.zh: 肥料使土壤肥沃。

examples.en: When this song debuted at this year’s Art Festival, it caused a sensation for its upbeat melody and witty style, but it was a flash in the pan.
examples.zh: 当这首歌在今年艺术节首发时，因其旋律欢快、风格诙谐而引起轰动，但只是昙花一现。

items.explanation: 通常指国际性节日，前面不可使用冠词。

examples.en: Christmas Day
examples.zh: 圣诞节

examples.en: National Day
examples.zh: 国庆节

examples.en: New Year’s Day
examples.zh: 元旦

items.explanation: 节日；喜庆日；音乐节；戏剧节；喜庆；欢宴

examples.en: the Lantern Festival
examples.zh: 元宵节，灯节

examples.en: the Moon Festival (= the Mid-autumn Festival)
examples.zh: 中秋节

examples.en: the Spring Festival
examples.zh: (中国)春节

items.explanation: 一般指“休假”。

examples.en: Tom and I are going to have a holiday.
examples.zh: 我和汤姆准备去度假。

items.explanation: 作“请假”解，指被批准可离开自己的工作一段时间。

examples.en: He stays at home on sick leave.
examples.zh: 他请了病假待在家里。

items.explanation: 在英国指大学的寒暑假或法定不工作的日子，美国可指任何假日(期)。

examples.en: The students are planning how to spend their summer vacation.
examples.zh: 学生们正在计划着怎样过暑假。

examples.en: Will you fetch some water?
examples.zh: 你去拿点儿水来好吗？

examples.en: Signs of infection include fever, cough, shortness of breath and breathing difficulties.
examples.zh: 感染症状包括发烧、咳嗽、呼吸短促、呼吸困难等。

examples.en: Whoever makes the fewest mistakes will be the winner of the competition and be awarded a free trip to Switzerland.
examples.zh: 任何一个出错最少的人将成为比赛的赢家，免费去瑞士旅游。

examples.en: Eating cereals and fruit will give you plenty of fibre in your diet.
examples.zh: 吃谷类食物和水果能多摄取纤维质。

examples.en: Nothing can appeal to me more than reading this historical fiction.
examples.zh: 没有什么比这本历史小说更能吸引我的了。

examples.en: A summer engineering program is a great way to learn more about the field and expand your experiences.
examples.zh: 暑期工程项目是一个很好的途径，能让你了解更多该领域的知识并增长相关经验。

examples.en: a fierce dog
examples.zh: 一条凶猛的狗

examples.en: The incident brings the total of people killed to fifteen.
examples.zh: 这次事故使死亡总人数达到 15 人。

examples.en: He lifted the cup for the fifth time this year.
examples.zh: 他今年第五次举起了奖杯。

examples.en: Students in fifty schools are to act as guinea pigs for these new teaching methods.
examples.zh: 50 所学校的学生将作为这些新教学法的试验对象。

examples.en: If we want to keep healthy, we must fight pollution.
examples.zh: 如果我们要保持健康，就必须与污染作斗争。

examples.en: He is still fighting for his life in hospital.
examples.zh: 他仍在医院与死神搏斗。

examples.en: The World AIDS Day is set to make people try their best in the fight against AIDS.
examples.zh: “世界艾滋病日”的设立是为了让人们尽自己最大的努力与艾滋病作斗争。

items.explanation: 在表示“斗争”的意思时，含有体力与勇猛的因素。

examples.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
examples.zh: 消防队员与森林大火搏斗了几乎3个星期，这才把火势控制住。

items.explanation: 在表示“斗争”的意思时，含有奋力挣扎的因素。

examples.en: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
examples.zh: 一上岸，那个女孩就向着她所看到的灯光的方向，挣扎着往峭壁上爬去。

examples.en: Mary struggled to her feet and fought against the wind and rain bravely.
examples.zh: 玛丽挣扎着站起来，勇敢地和风雨搏斗。

examples.en: Children are afraid of the stone figures in the temple which look so frightening.
examples.zh: 孩子们害怕寺庙里那些看起来很可怕的石像。

examples.en: Have you figured out how much the journey to New Zealand will cost?
examples.zh: 你算出这次去新西兰旅游要花多少钱吗？

discriminations.intro: 这三个词的一般含义为“形状”或“外形”。

items.explanation: 表示隐约可见的“人影”或“物影”，以及几何“图形”、人体“外形”、引人注目的“人物或塑像”等。

examples.en: In the torchlight he caught sight of a figure whom he immediately recognized as Bill Wilkins, our local grocer.
examples.zh: 他在手电筒的光下看到一个人影，立刻认出这个人是本地杂货商比尔·威尔金斯。

items.explanation: 最普通、使用范围最广、含义最多，哲学上讲的“形态”，文艺上讲的“体裁”，雕刻艺术上讲的“形状”，以及普通的含义“方式”或“形式”等，它都可以表示。此外，form 也可以表示人或动物的“体形”“外形”。

examples.en: Strange forms stand in gardens, and outside buildings and shops.
examples.zh: 花园里、建筑物和商店外面竖立着奇形怪状的雕塑形体。

items.explanation: 表示“外形”或“形状”以及“(人物)体形”。其内涵是：外形之下具有实体。

examples.en: The bridge is so long that the shape of the Earth had to be taken into account by its designer.
examples.zh: 桥身如此长，以至于它的设计师不得不考虑地球的形状。

examples.en: Before long, biscuits of all shapes and sizes began arriving at the factory.
examples.zh: 不久，大大小小各种形状的饼干开始送到这家工厂。

discriminations.intro: 另外，这三个词的含义差异还可以从它们表示的人体外形的差异上来进行辨析。

items.explanation: 所指的“人体外形”在意义上很含糊，只是能够认出，但未必看得很仔细或看得清楚。

examples.en: What he saw seemed to have the form of a man.
examples.zh: 他所看到的似乎是一个男子的身影。

examples.en: entertainment in the form of opera
examples.zh: 以戏剧形式的娱乐(强调可以认出的形式或形状)

examples.en: in form
examples.zh: 在形式上，在外形上(用于抽象的、无实体的事物)

items.explanation: 在表示“人体外形”时通常因黑暗而看不清楚，即“人影”，而且只强调身体的轮廓。

examples.en: She has a very good figure.
examples.zh: 她的体形很优美。

examples.en: to cut a piece of paper in the figure of a triangle
examples.zh: 把纸剪成三角形(强调轮廓)

items.explanation: 包括躯体轮廓也包含有血有肉的身体。

examples.en: to form a mass of clay in the shape of a man
examples.zh: 把一堆黏土塑造成男人的形状（强调实体）

examples.en: in shape
examples.zh: 在外形上（用于具有实体的事物）

examples.en: I still haven't figured out the key to his success.
examples.zh: 我依旧未能想出他成功的关键。

examples.en: Here’s our file on the results of the business in the past five years.
examples.zh: 这是我们过去 5 年来经营成绩的案卷。

examples.en: Please file those letters.
examples.zh: 请把这些信件存档。

examples.en: Her heart was filled with gratitude when she saw what they had done for her.
examples.zh: 当她看到他们为她所做的一切时，心里充满了感激之情。

examples.en: The victim’s lungs fill quickly with fluid.
examples.zh: 受害者的肺里很快充满了积液。

examples.en: He emptied the bottle of water and then filled it with beer.
examples.zh: 他把瓶子里的水倒空，然后装上啤酒。

examples.en: Although I was then too young to understand the meaning of the film, I remember my family were moved to tears.
examples.zh: 虽然当时我年幼不理解这部电影的含义，但我记得我的家人都感动得落泪了。

examples.en: film a new movie
examples.zh: 拍摄一部新电影

examples.en: In some cases, you can hardly tell who is the final winner.
examples.zh: 在某些情况下，你很难分辨出谁是最后的赢家。

examples.en: Although being admitted to one’s dream university requires a lot of efforts, which might seem forbidding for some students, the desire for success will finally get them motivated enough.
examples.zh: 考上心仪大学需要花大力气，这可能会让一些学生望而生畏，然而，对成功的渴望将最终使他们拥有足够的动力。

examples.en: People who work in banks know about finance.
examples.zh: 在银行工作的人懂金融。

examples.en: The government will finance the building of the new road with the taxes it collects.
examples.zh: 政府将用它征得的税收为修建这条新公路提供资金。

examples.en: The younger the students are when they are exposed to financial issues, the more likely they are to become responsible adults who can manage their finances effectively.
examples.zh: 学生们接触到财务事宜的年龄越小，就越有可能成为能有效管理财务的有责任心的成年人。

examples.en: I find it absolutely necessary for high school students to help their parents do some housework in their spare time.
examples.zh: 我觉得中学生在课余时间帮助父母做一些家务是完全必要的。

items.explanation: 找到，发现

examples.en: After looking these words up in a dictionary, you will find the difference.
examples.zh: 在字典中查一下这些词后，你会发现区别所在。

items.explanation: 弄清楚

examples.en: Go and find out the exact time of departure of the plane.
examples.zh: 去弄清楚飞机确切的起飞时间。

examples.en: The finding of the study suggests that exercise can improve mental health.
examples.zh: 这项研究的发现表明，运动可以改善心理健康。

examples.en: That’s a fine thing to say!
examples.zh: 那样说太好了！

examples.en: to pay a fine of $20
examples.zh: 付罚金20美元

examples.en: Those who are found eating, smoking or lying across the seats on the subway in Beijing can be fined between 50 to 500 yuan.
examples.zh: 在北京的地铁上吃东西、抽烟或躺在座位上的人，可能会被处以50至500元的罚款。

examples.en: the ring finger
examples.zh: 无名指

examples.en: Jenny can ask her teacher for help if she can’t finish writing the report by herself.
examples.zh: 如果珍妮自己不能完成报告的话，她可以求助于她的老师。

examples.en: All the people shouted when the theatre was on fire.
examples.zh: 戏院失火时，所有的人都叫了起来。

examples.en: The officer ordered his men to fire at the enemy.
examples.zh: 军官命令士兵向敌人开枪。

examples.en: The firemen broke down the wall in order to gain quick access to the building on fire.
examples.zh: 为了快速进入着火的大楼，消防队员拆了那面墙。

f.name: There is no smoke without fire.

examples.en: Children look forward to watching the fireworks show.
examples.zh: 孩子们盼望看到这场烟火表演。

examples.en: You must always build on firm ground.
examples.zh: 你必须始终脚踏实地。

examples.en: The firm’s employees were expecting large bonuses.
examples.zh: 这家公司的雇员期待着发放大笔奖金。

examples.en: At first glance, the street is nothing special, but it has become a popular tourist attraction thanks to its frequent appearances in a well-received movie.
examples.zh: 这条街乍一看并不起眼，但由于在一部叫好的电影中频频出镜，现在已成了游客青睐的景点。

examples.en: Eating fish helps to improve one’s memory and it also provides energy.
examples.zh: 吃鱼有助于提高记忆力，还能提供能量。

examples.en: Let’s go fishing.
examples.zh: 我们钓鱼去吧。

examples.en: This country dumped wastewater into the sea regardless of the safety of people, which sparked strong protest from local fishermen and people in neighbouring countries.
examples.zh: 这个国家不顾人民的安危将废水排入大海，这一行为受到了当地渔民和邻国人民的强烈抗议。(金山)

examples.en: My son had a tantrum and banged his fist on the ground.
examples.zh: 我儿子大发脾气，一拳捶在了地上。

examples.en: The tailor altered the jacket to fit me.
examples.zh: 裁缝将夹克改得合我身。

examples.en: The lid fits badly.
examples.zh: 这个盖子盖不上。

examples.en: Compared with others, he was much fitter for the job.
examples.zh: 与其他人相比，他更适合这项工作。

examples.en: The fit is perfect, but I’m not sure about the color.
examples.zh: 衣服很合身，但颜色我吃不准。

items.explanation: 主要指大小尺寸上的适合。

examples.en: Do you have any ready-made clothes that will fit me?
examples.zh: 你们有适合我穿的现成的衣服吗？

items.explanation: 主要指色彩、款式上的相配。

examples.en: This sweater exactly fits me but the colour doesn’t suit me.
examples.zh: 这件毛衣对我来说大小正合身，但颜色不适合。

examples.en: Mom forgot buying cucumbers for her neighbors five days ago.
examples.zh: 妈妈忘了5天前刚给邻居买过黄瓜。

examples.en: I asked the boy to fix the bicycle.
examples.zh: 我请这个小伙子修自行车。

discriminations.intro: 这三个词都含“修理，修补”的意思。

items.explanation: 含义较广，侧重表示“整修，校正”，有时可与 repair 或 mend 换用。

examples.en: The woman couldn’t fix/repair the loose connector of the computer.
examples.zh: 这位女士不会修理松动的电脑连接器。

items.explanation: 系常用词，指修补破损的、简单的日常用具，不需要专门技术或器械的修理，即缝缝补补。

examples.en: mend a toy
examples.zh: 修理玩具

items.explanation: 指修理构造较复杂或损坏较严重的物体，多指需一定技术或较大规模的整修。

examples.en: to repair a car
examples.zh: 修汽车

examples.en: national flag
examples.zh: 国旗

examples.en: The dry sticks burst into flames.
examples.zh: 干柴呼地燃烧起来。

examples.en: flashes of lightning
examples.zh: 闪电

examples.en: A driver is not supposed to flash his lights at the coming vehicles.
examples.zh: 司机不该朝着迎面开来的车辆闪灯。

examples.en: The Earth is round, not flat.
examples.zh: 地球是圆的，不是平的。

examples.en: My uncle lives on the twentieth floor. The flat has a nice view of the Huangpu River.
examples.zh: 我的叔叔住在 20 楼。这套公寓能看到黄浦江的美景。

examples.en: This dish has very little flavour.
examples.zh: 这道菜没什么味道。

examples.en: A trickle of refugees began to flee the country.
examples.zh: 难民开始三五成群地逃离该国。

examples.en: the flesh of an apple
examples.zh: 苹果肉

examples.en: We can visit your company on Monday or Tuesday; our plans are fairly flexible.
examples.zh: 我们可以在星期一或星期二到你们公司来，我们的计划是相当灵活的。

examples.en: Owing to bad weather, the flight was delayed for a couple of hours.
examples.zh: 由于天气恶劣，航班延误了好几个小时。

examples.en: Wood floats on water.
examples.zh: 木头漂浮在水上。

examples.en: Thanks to the villagers’ timely help, the tourists managed to protect themselves from the floods.
examples.zh: 多亏村民们的及时援助，游客们成功地逃脱了洪水的围困。

examples.en: Remember to repair the pipe, or the kitchen will be flooded soon.
examples.zh: 记得修水管，否则厨房很快就会水漫金山。(静安)

examples.en: I have bought a new flat and it’s on the eighth floor of the building.
examples.zh: 我买了一套新房子，在这幢楼的第 8 层。

items.explanation: 表示“在几层楼”，用 floor。比较英美关于楼层的不同说法：一楼 the first floor〈美〉, the ground floor〈英〉；二楼 the second floor〈美〉, the first floor〈英〉。
表示“楼房有多少层”时，用 story 或 storey，其复数形式分别为 stories 和 storeys。story 为美国拼法。
表示“楼房有多少层”时，用 story 或 storey，其复数形式分别为 stories 和 storeys。storey 为英国拼法。

examples.en: There are three storeys including the ground floor.
examples.zh: 包括底层在内一共有三层。

examples.en: If the dough is sticky, add more flour.
examples.zh: 如果面团太黏，就再加点面粉。

examples.en: Rivers flow into the sea.
examples.zh: 江河流入海中。

examples.en: a flow of oil
examples.zh: 油流出来

examples.en: We have made an appointment to see the flower show in the botanical garden this weekend.
examples.zh: 我们相约周末去植物园看花展。(闵行)

examples.en: He caught flu.
examples.zh: 他得了流感。

examples.en: He is fluent in five languages.
examples.zh: 他能流利地说 5 种语言。

examples.en: The plane flew from Paris to Rome.
examples.zh: 这架飞机从巴黎飞往罗马。

examples.en: He flew a small plane to Cuba.
examples.zh: 他驾驶一架小型飞机飞往古巴。

examples.en: We spread white covers over the bowls to keep flies away.
examples.zh: 我们在碗上铺了白色覆盖物以防止苍蝇。

examples.en: What we need to focus on is not what children say, but what action they take to creatively solve problems.
examples.zh: 我们要关注的不是孩子们的言语，而是他们在创造性解决问题时采取的行动。(普陀)

examples.en: English is obviously the focus of the students’ attention.
examples.zh: 英语显然是学生们注意的焦点。

examples.en: The noise outside made it hard for me to focus (my attention) on my work.
examples.zh: 外面的噪音让我很难集中注意力工作。

examples.en: The fog was so thick that I could not see my way.
examples.zh: 雾真大，我路都看不见了。

examples.en: It’s quite foggy now.
examples.zh: 现在雾很大。

examples.en: She folded the letter so that it would fit into her bag.
examples.zh: 她把信折起来，以便可以装到袋子里。

examples.en: Folks differ in their tastes.
examples.zh: 人们的爱好各异。

examples.en: Many schools have introduced folk arts such as paper-cut into classrooms, and that not only cultivates students’ practical ability, but also improves their artistic appreciation.
examples.zh: 许多学校已将剪纸之类的民间艺术引入课堂，这不但培养了学生的动手能力，也提高了他们的艺术鉴赏力。(闵行)

examples.en: Follow the natural law and you will finally be rewarded.
examples.zh: 遵循自然规律，你最终会得到回报。

examples.en: You go first and I’ll follow.
examples.zh: 你先走，我会跟上的。

examples.en: It rained on the day we arrived, but the following day was sunny.
examples.zh: 我们到达的那天正下着雨，但次日天气晴朗。

examples.en: The retired kindergarten teacher has recently become fond of cooking.
examples.zh: 这位幼儿园退休教师最近迷上了烹饪。(闵行)

examples.en: Good-looking food doesn’t necessarily taste good.
examples.zh: 好看的食物未必好吃。

examples.en: April Fool’s Day
examples.zh: 愚人节

examples.en: He fooled me into giving him money.
examples.zh: 他欺骗我，要我给他钱。

examples.en: I was very foolish to believe him and lend him the money.
examples.zh: 我真蠢，竟相信了他，还借钱给他。

examples.en: We decided to go on foot.
examples.zh: 我们决定步行去。

examples.en: They play football at school.
examples.zh: 他们在学校踢足球。

examples.en: I only did it for you.
examples.zh: 我只是为了你才干的。

examples.en: Don’t expect too much of her, for she is no more than a fresh hand.
examples.zh: 别对她期望太高，她毕竟只是一个新手。

examples.en: One who is under the age of 18 is forbidden to drink anything alcoholic in that country.
examples.zh: 在那个国家，18 岁以下的人被禁止饮用含酒精的饮料。

examples.en: He had to use force to get the lid off the tin.
examples.zh: 他得用力把罐盖打开。

examples.en: Under no circumstances can parents force their kids to do what is beyond their capacity.
examples.zh: 任何情况下父母都不能强迫孩子去做超出他们能力范围的事情。

examples.en: It made a very forceful impression on me.
examples.zh: 它给我留下了深刻的印象。

examples.en: The recent statement of the president forecast a change in the situation.
examples.zh: 总统最近的一次讲话预示着形势将有所变化。

examples.en: What’s the weather forecast today?
examples.zh: 今天的天气预报怎么说？

examples.en: Mary felt my forehead.
examples.zh: 玛丽摸了摸我的额头。

examples.en: Most foreign students in our school are used to the changeable weather in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 在我们学校的大多数外国学生习惯了上海的易变天气。

examples.en: Those who can foresee difficulties on their way to success may keep calm when they really appear.
examples.zh: 在走向成功的路途中，能够预见困难的人在困难真正出现的时候，常常能保持冷静的态度。

examples.en: It was half a year before the local police found out who was to blame for the forest fire.
examples.zh: 半年后，当地警察才查出了那起森林火灾的肇事者。

examples.en: He wants to live forever.
examples.zh: 他希望长生不老。

examples.en: I will never forget the day when I came to the school for the first time.
examples.zh: 我永远都忘不了我第一次来到这所学校的那天。

examples.en: I forgot about it.
examples.zh: 关于这件事我不记得了。

examples.en: As time passed by, the smart teacher was very old and sometimes rather forgetful.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，那个聪明的老师变成年迈的老人，而且有时相当健忘。

examples.en: It's very kind of you to forgive him for his bad manners.
examples.zh: 你真好，宽恕了他的粗鲁行为。

examples.en: There is a fork in my one hand, and a knife in my other hand.
examples.zh: 我一手拿叉，另一手拿刀。

examples.en: The road forks here.
examples.zh: 路在这里分岔。

examples.en: If you fill in this form, you can take books out of the library.
examples.zh: 如果你填了这张表，就可以把书带出图书馆。

examples.en: Somehow he formed the habit of sleeping in the day and working at night.
examples.zh: 不知怎的，他养成了白天睡觉、晚上工作的习惯。

examples.en: We usually send notices to visitors in the form of an e-mail.
examples.zh: 我们通常以电子邮件的形式向游客发出通知。

examples.en: They decided to put their relationship on a more formal footing.
examples.zh: 他们决定正式交往。

examples.en: The leaflet is in PDF format.
examples.zh: 宣传折页是 PDF 格式的。

examples.en: You can edit the contents of the table and format the text in each cell.
examples.zh: 您可以编辑表格中的内容，设计每个单元的文本。

examples.en: Of swimming and football he much preferred the former.
examples.zh: 在游泳和足球中，他更喜欢前者。

examples.en: from that day forth
examples.zh: 自那日起

examples.en: She's fortunate in having a good boss.
examples.zh: 她很幸运，有个好老板。

examples.en: Fortunately for him, he was very soon offered another job.
examples.zh: 他运气好，很快就有人聘他做另一份工作。

examples.en: She had the good fortune to be free from illness.
examples.zh: 她运气好，没生病。

examples.en: The plant provides forty percent of the country's electricity.
examples.zh: 全国总电量的 40% 是这家发电厂提供的。

examples.en: He's hoping to forward his career by this move.
examples.zh: 他正希望通过这一举动来促进他的事业。

examples.en: The new drug is a major step forward in the treatment of the disease.
examples.zh: 新药使这一疾病的治疗迈出重要的一步。

examples.en: He had a forward plunge down the stairs.
examples.zh: 他一头栽下楼梯。

examples.en: That university was founded more than a century ago.
examples.zh: 那所大学建于一个多世纪以前。

examples.en: I am determined to build on this solid foundation.
examples.zh: 我决定在这个坚实的基础之上继续努力。

examples.en: He was the founder and guiding spirit of New York's Shakespeare Festival.
examples.zh: 他是纽约莎士比亚戏剧节的创始人及领导者。

examples.en: The children were told not to play in the fountain.
examples.zh: 孩子们被告诫不要在喷泉中玩耍。

examples.en: Four of us will win in the end, and this victory will definitely activate the public's love of life.
examples.zh: 我们当中 4 人终将赢得胜利，并且这胜利必将提振大众对生活的热爱。

examples.en: When I was fourteen, my family moved to another city.
examples.zh: 当我 14 岁的时候，我们全家搬到了另一个城市。

examples.en: Indonesia is the fourth most populous country in the world.
examples.zh: 印度尼西亚是世界上第四人口大国。

examples.en: He's a sly old fox.
examples.zh: 他是个狡猾的老狐狸。

examples.en: the frame of a house
examples.zh: 房屋的框架

examples.en: to frame a picture in wood
examples.zh: 给画装木框

examples.en: Our school does an exchange with a school in France.
examples.zh: 我们学校与法国的一所学校进行交流。

examples.en: a frank reply
examples.zh: 坦率的回答

examples.en: When you are in a bad mood, you will be free from worry if you think of something nice.
examples.zh: 当你心情不好的时候，想想美好的事就能摆脱烦恼。

examples.en: They freed the birds from the cages.
examples.zh: 他们把鸟儿从笼子里放出来了。

examples.en: Users can download the software for free on the Internet.
examples.zh: 用户可以在网上免费下载该软件。

examples.en: For some students, freedom is far more meaningful than having enough pocket money, isn't it?
examples.zh: 对一些学生而言，可以自由支配时间远比拥有足够的零花钱更有意义，不是吗？

examples.en: When water freezes it becomes ice.
examples.zh: 当水凝固时就变成冰。

examples.en: I won't feel very cold in freezing weather.
examples.zh: 在极寒的天气里，我没有感到很冷。

examples.en: Scientists have used genetic engineering to protect tomatoes against the effects of freezing.
examples.zh: 科学家利用遗传工程来保护番茄免受严寒天气的影响。

examples.en: I need to improve my French.
examples.zh: 我得提高我的法语水平。

examples.en: The French runner is coming up fast on the inside.
examples.zh: 法国的赛跑选手正从内圈迅速赶上来。

examples.en: Traffic accidents have decreased in frequency over recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来交通事故发生的频率已经下降。

examples.en: The engineer and his son held frequent consultations concerning technical problems.
examples.zh: 工程师和他的儿子经常就技术问题互相征求意见。

examples.en: Buses run frequently between the city and the airport.
examples.zh: 公共汽车频繁往返于市区与机场之间。

examples.en: She kept the windows open to let the fresh air in.
examples.zh: 她把窗户打开，让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: This research is mainly an applied research concerning freshmen adjustment.
examples.zh: 本研究主要是关于大学新生适应性方面的应用型研究。

examples.en: Trade frictions between the two countries had been caused by trade protectionists.
examples.zh: 两国之间的贸易摩擦是由贸易保护主义者引起的。

examples.en: The team is practicing for their big game on Friday.
examples.zh: 球队正在训练，备战星期五的重大比赛。

examples.en: We bought a new fridge.
examples.zh: 我们买了个新冰箱。

examples.en: Don't judge a person based on his appearance when making friends.
examples.zh: 交友时勿以貌取人。(宝山)

f.name: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

examples.en: When we were visiting the small town, the people there were very friendly to us.
examples.zh: 当我们参观小镇时，那里的人们对我们很友好。

examples.en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
examples.zh: 真正的友谊比金钱更宝贵。

examples.en: She was really frightened at the sight of a snake.
examples.zh: 看到蛇，她真是吓坏了。

f.name: frighten sb. out of doing sth.

examples.en: She told the children not to be frightened.
examples.zh: 她告诉孩子们不要害怕。

examples.en: We dissected a frog in biology class.
examples.zh: 我们在生物课上解剖了一只青蛙。

examples.en: Hardly had he graduated from the high school when he hurried to travel abroad.
examples.zh: 他高中一毕业就迫不及待地出国旅游了。

examples.en: The teacher called the boy to the front.
examples.zh: 老师把男孩叫到前面。

items.explanation: 在……前面（在范围之外的前面）
在……前部（在范围之内的前面）

examples.en: Soldiers guard the frontier against invasion.
examples.zh: 战士们守卫边境，防止外敌入侵。

examples.en: Frost formed on the windows.
examples.zh: 窗户上结了霜。

examples.en: I don't think I like frozen food because it's not fresh.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢冷冻食品，因为冷冻食品不新鲜。

examples.en: I need a few bananas to make fruit salad. Could you please buy some?
examples.zh: 我需要一些香蕉做水果沙拉。能否请你去买一些？

examples.en: Both difficulty and failure did not frustrate his passion.
examples.zh: 困难和失败都没有挫伤他的热情。

examples.en: She fried an egg for her breakfast.
examples.zh: 她煎了一个蛋当早餐。

examples.en: They ran out of fuel.
examples.zh: 他们的燃料用完了。

examples.en: Aircraft sometimes fuel while in the air.
examples.zh: 飞机有时在空中加油。

examples.en: Thanks to those who helped me, I managed to fulfill the task on time.
examples.zh: 多亏了那些帮助我的人，我才得以按时完成这项任务。

examples.en: Facing new challenges, he is always full of confidence.
examples.zh: 面对新的挑战，他始终充满信心。

examples.en: It is no fun to be sick when you're on vacation.
examples.zh: 度假时生病令人扫兴。

f.name: It is great fun doing sth.
It is great fun to do sth.
It is not any fun doing ...

examples.en: This is the newest mobile phone, and I am not quite familiar with some of the functions.
examples.zh: 这是最新款的手机，有些功能我不太熟悉。

examples.en: The machine doesn't function well.
examples.zh: 这台机器有毛病。

examples.en: For lack of construction fund, this commercial center wasn't accessible to the public until recently.
examples.zh: 因缺少建筑资金，公众直到最近才得以进入这个商业中心。

examples.en: The fundamental cause of his success is his hard work.
examples.zh: 他成功的根本原因是他工作努力。

examples.en: He had to bring forward an 11 o'clock meeting so that he could get to the funeral on time.
examples.zh: 他不得不把 11 点的会议提前，这样他就可以准时赶去参加葬礼了。

examples.en: The story was really funny — it tickled me.
examples.zh: 那个故事真有趣——笑死我了。

examples.en: Bears have thick fur.
examples.zh: 熊有厚厚的毛。

examples.en: She rents a furnished flat.
examples.zh: 她租了一套备有家具的公寓。

examples.en: This old French table is a very valuable piece of furniture.
examples.zh: 这张旧法式桌子是一件很珍贵的家具。

examples.en: Not only should the government make policies to prevent further pollution, but also every citizen should take full responsibility for protecting the environment.
examples.zh: 不但政府应该制定政策防止进一步污染，而且每个公民都该责无旁贷地保护环境。

examples.en: Her health may worsen even further if she doesn't have the operation.
examples.zh: 她如果不动手术，健康状况会进一步恶化。

examples.en: They hoped the new venture would further the cause of cultural cooperation in Europe.
examples.zh: 他们希望这个新项目将促进欧洲的文化合作事业。

items.explanation: 只表示“（距离上）较远”。

examples.en: On the farther end of the street there was a large shop.
examples.zh: 在街道的远端有一家大商店。

items.explanation: 指“进一步”。

examples.en: I don't want to cause any further trouble.
examples.zh: 我不想引起进一步的麻烦。

examples.en: The house is far from the shopping center, and furthermore, it is a bit too small.
examples.zh: 这座房子远离购物中心，此外，它还太小了点。

examples.en: It's up to you what kind of life you will lead in the future.
examples.zh: 将来过怎样的生活取决于你自己。

examples.en: Keep this book for future use.
examples.zh: 把这本书保存好以备今后使用。

items.explanation: 将来

examples.en: Who can tell me what will happen in the future?
examples.zh: 谁能告诉我将来会发生什么事？

items.explanation: 今后，从今以后

examples.en: In future I must work harder so as to make more progress.
examples.zh: 从今以后，我必须更努力地工作以取得更大的进步。

examples.en: They met and fell in love with each other during the Second World War.
examples.zh: 他们在第二次世界大战期间相遇并相爱。

examples.en: What day does Christmas fall on this year?
examples.zh: 今年的圣诞节是星期几？

examples.en: The full cost of the wedding fell on the bridegroom.
examples.zh: 婚礼的全部费用由新郎承担。

examples.en: We have made some progress, but it is far from enough.
examples.zh: 我们已经取得了一些进步，但还远远不够。

examples.en: He can always find an excuse for his being absent from the meetings.
examples.zh: 他总能为缺席会议找到借口。

examples.en: His examples fitted in well with his argument.
examples.zh: 他举的例子很契合他的论点。

examples.en: The noise outside made it hard for me to focus (my attention) on my work.
examples.zh: 外面的噪音让我很难集中注意力工作。

examples.en: We must all follow his example and serve the people heart and soul.
examples.zh: 我们都应以他为榜样，全心全意为人民服务。

examples.en: The book offers much food for thought and is worth reading over and over again.
examples.zh: 这本书能引发很多思考，值得一读再读。

examples.en: I hope you will forgive me for opening your letter by mistake.
examples.zh: 我误拆了你的信，希望你原谅。

examples.en: You had better encourage your children to form the habit of reading at an early age.
examples.zh: 你最好鼓励孩子们从小养成阅读习惯。

examples.en: The shop delivers goods to your door free of charge.
examples.zh: 这家店免费送货上门。

f.name: from the bottom of one's heart

examples.en: The mother thanks the man from the bottom of her heart for saving her son's life.
examples.zh: 这位母亲衷心感谢那个人救了她儿子的性命。

examples.en: make big gains in elections
examples.zh: 在选举中取得巨大进展

examples.en: Don't take too much sugary drinks, or it will be easy for you to gain weight.
examples.zh: 别喝太多含糖饮料，否则你会容易发胖。

examples.en: The sick girl is gaining.
examples.zh: 生病的女孩正在痊愈。

items.explanation: 有 obtain 的含义，但更强调目的物是需要努力奋斗才能得到，而且这种东西具有价值，特别是物质价值。

examples.en: I hope you will gain great success.
examples.zh: 我希望你们能获得更大的成就。

items.explanation: 是最普遍、使用范围最广的词。

examples.en: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
examples.zh: 我坐在公交车的最前排，为好好地观赏乡村的景色。

items.explanation: 包含着“努力”、“希望”或“决意”去获得某物的意思。

examples.en: The journalist immediately set out to obtain these important facts.
examples.zh: 那位新闻记者立即着手查清这些重要的事实真相。

examples.en: This national gallery has a large collection of artworks from home and abroad, where people walk around leisurely, exploring the traces of time and feeling the integration of history and culture.
examples.zh: 国家艺术馆收藏了大量的国内外艺术作品，人们漫步其间，探寻时光的足迹，感受历史与文化的交融。(浦东)

examples.en: They gambled on the result of a race.
examples.zh: 他们赌一场比赛的输赢。

examples.en: The operation may succeed, or it may not; it's a bit of a gamble.
examples.zh: 这次手术没把握，可能成功，也可能失败。

examples.en: He had gambled everything away.
examples.zh: 他把什么都赌掉了。

examples.en: Can you tell me the reason why you are so crazy about online games?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我你热衷于网络游戏的原因吗？

examples.en: The gang were planning a robbery.
examples.zh: 这伙歹徒正在计划抢劫。

examples.en: Communicating with your parents from time to time can narrow the generation gap between you.
examples.zh: 经常和父母交流可以缩小你们之间的代沟。

examples.en: send the car to garage
examples.zh: 送车去修理厂

examples.en: The street is full of garbage.
examples.zh: 街上扔满了垃圾。

examples.en: work in a garden
examples.zh: 在花园里工作

examples.en: Boil the chick peas, add garlic and lemon juice.
examples.zh: 把鹰嘴豆放在开水中煮，并加入大蒜和柠檬汁。

examples.en: The government has taken effective measures to check all the pipes thoroughly to ensure the normal supply of gas.
examples.zh: 政府已经采取了有效措施彻底检查所有的管道，以确保燃气的正常供应。

examples.en: The car is short of gasoline.
examples.zh: 这辆车缺油。

examples.en: We will meet at the gate.
examples.zh: 我们在大门口碰头。

examples.en: The teacher gathered the pupils round her.
examples.zh: 老师把小学生们聚集在她周围。

examples.en: Thousands of people gathered on both sides of the street welcoming the athletes who had won the Olympic gold medals.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人聚集在马路两旁，欢迎在奥运会上获得金牌的运动员。

examples.en: We were all gay at the thought of the coming holidays.
examples.zh: 一想到即将到来的假期，我们都很高兴。

examples.en: stand high and gaze far
examples.zh: 站得高看得远

examples.en: attract the gaze of people
examples.zh: 引人注目

examples.en: In addition, there has been a sharp rise in the acceptance of gender equality and alternative lifestyles.
examples.zh: 此外，对于性别平等和另类生活方式的接受度也有了明显提升。

examples.en: the special gene of this animal
examples.zh: 这种动物的特殊基因

examples.en: Give me a general idea of the work.
examples.zh: 请告诉我这项工作的大致情况。

examples.en: The proposal has generated a lot of interest.
examples.zh: 这项提议引起众多的关注。

examples.en: The proverb is passed on from generation to generation.
examples.zh: 这句谚语一代传一代。

examples.en: She is a warmhearted, generous old lady.
examples.zh: 她是一位热心、慷慨的老太太。

examples.en: He is a genius for mathematics.
examples.zh: 他是个数学天才。

examples.en: gentle heart
examples.zh: 仁慈的心肠

items.explanation: 温和的，温柔的 (侧重对人的体贴和安慰)

examples.en: She is gentle to her younger brother.
examples.zh: 她对她的小弟弟亲切体贴。

items.explanation: 柔和的 (可指惩罚或判决等不严厉，或烟酒、事物、气候等较适中)

examples.en: He was given a milder punishment than he deserved.
examples.zh: 他受到的惩罚比他应得的轻得多。

items.explanation: 温柔的 (指人天生柔和的，或指物体柔软的)

examples.en: Her long hair felt soft like silk.
examples.zh: 她的长发摸上去像丝一样柔软。

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, we'll arrive in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 女士们、先生们，我们即将到达上海。

examples.en: genuine leather
examples.zh: 真皮

examples.en: Geography is an important subject.
examples.zh: 地理是一门很重要的学科。

examples.en: We went on a geology field trip.
examples.zh: 我们开展了地质野外考察。

examples.en: Middle school students have to learn both algebra and geometry.
examples.zh: 中学生必须学代数与几何。

examples.en: We can't see germs by eyes.
examples.zh: 肉眼看不见细菌。

examples.en: My German isn't very good, but I got the drift of what she said.
examples.zh: 我的德语不太好，但我大致明白她说的意思。

examples.en: German interest rates will come down before long.
examples.zh: 德国的利率水平很快就会降下来。

examples.en: Switzerland lies between France, Germany, Austria and Italy.
examples.zh: 瑞士位于法国、德国、奥地利和意大利之间。

examples.en: make faces and gestures at the girl
examples.zh: 对那女孩做鬼脸打手势

examples.en: gesture at sb. for him to sit
examples.zh: 打手势示意某人坐下

examples.en: Only when you respect others, may you get help from others.
examples.zh: 只有尊重别人，你才可能获得别人的帮助。

examples.en: She got there at six.
examples.zh: 她6点钟到达那里。

examples.en: I keep having the same dream about trying to get across a deep river.
examples.zh: 我老做同样的梦，梦见我费力地想过一条很深的河。

examples.en: The bridge was under repair, so it took us a long time to get across the river.
examples.zh: 桥正在整修，所以我们花了很长时间才渡过河去。

examples.en: It's impossible to get along with him.
examples.zh: 根本无法跟他和睦相处。

examples.en: They got down to business after exchanging greetings.
examples.zh: 互相问候之后，他们开始做正事。

g.name: get off
trans: 下车(马、自行车、火车、飞机等)

examples.en: Excuse me, I have to get off at the next stop.
examples.zh: 劳驾，我必须在下一站下车。

examples.en: When did you get to school yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天你什么时候到学校？

examples.en: This is the only forum where East and West can get together.
examples.zh: 这是东西方可以聚首的唯一论坛。

examples.en: I got up and walked over to where he was.
examples.zh: 我起身走到他那边。

examples.en: Do you believe in ghost?
examples.zh: 你相信有鬼吗？

examples.en: the giant packet
examples.zh: 巨大的包裹

examples.en: Newton was an intellectual giant.
examples.zh: 牛顿的智慧令人仰止。

examples.en: We might as well send her a remote-controlled air purifier as a housewarming gift.
examples.zh: 我们不妨送她一个遥控空气净化器作为乔迁礼物。(静安)

examples.en: She is a gifted teacher who never talks down to her students.
examples.zh: 她天生就是当老师的料，从来不用居高临下的口气对学生说话。

examples.en: The orange-brown spots on the skin of giraffes makes it possible for them to hide themselves in the wild.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿皮肤上的橙棕色斑点使它们可以在野外隐藏自己。(虹口)

examples.en: It was unusual for such a little girl to solve this hard problem in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 这样一个小女孩在10分钟内就解决了这个棘手的问题，这太不寻常了。

examples.en: On behalf of the victims, he expected the society to give them more understanding and help.
examples.zh: 代表受害者，他期望社会给予他们更多的理解和帮助。

examples.en: Don't give away to the public when we will start.
examples.zh: 不要向公众泄露我们开始的日期。

examples.en: The Smiths gave away most of their furniture to their neighbours when they were moving.
examples.zh: 史密斯夫妇在搬家时把大部分家具送给了邻居。

examples.en: We've already made it clear that we will never give in to any pressure.
examples.zh: 我们已经明确表示，决不会屈服于任何压力。

examples.en: If plastic and rubber are burnt, they'll give off poisonous gases.
examples.zh: 要是焚烧塑料和橡胶，它们就会放出有毒的气体。

examples.en: There were people at the entrance giving out leaflets.
examples.zh: 有人在入口处散发传单。

examples.en: They gave out leaflets and soon the movement spread to other cities.
examples.zh: 他们四处分发传单，这项运动很快就波及其他城市。

examples.en: They decided to give up their plan.
examples.zh: 他们决定放弃计划。

examples.en: I'll be glad to help you.
examples.zh: 我愿意帮你忙。

examples.en: He glanced at the dictionary and decided to buy one without hesitation.
examples.zh: 他匆匆看了一下那本字典，立刻决定把它买下来。

trans: 扫视 (at, down, over, round, through)

examples.en: At first glance, these impressive images look like moments captured by a talented photographer.
examples.zh: 乍一看，这些令人印象深刻的照片就像是一位天才摄影师捕捉到的瞬间。

items.explanation: 作“瞥视”解，指匆忙、粗略地看一眼，后常接介词 at、down、through、over 等。

examples.en: He glanced at the envelope and recognized her handwriting.
examples.zh: 他瞥了一眼信封，认出了她的笔迹。

items.explanation: 作“怒视”解，指因急躁、不满、发怒而睁大眼睛，凶狠、威胁地注视，常与 at 连用。

examples.en: He glared at me like a bull at a red rag.
examples.zh: 他对我怒目而视，就像牛看到红布。

items.explanation: 作“凝视”解，指目不转睛地直视着某人或某物，原因是好奇、惊讶、赞叹，常与 at 连用。

examples.en: They all stared in surprise.
examples.zh: 他们都惊奇地盯着看。

examples.en: He glanced at the envelope and recognized his uncle's handwriting.
examples.zh: 他瞥了一眼那个信封，认出是他叔父的笔迹。

examples.en: The glasses are made of fine glass.
examples.zh: 眼镜是由优质玻璃制成的。

examples.en: She can't read without glasses.
examples.zh: 她不戴眼镜就不能看书。

examples.en: The aging population problem is so serious that it becomes a global headache for governments.
examples.zh: 人口的老龄化问题十分严峻，成了各国政府都头疼不已的全球问题。

examples.en: She has travelled all over the globe.
examples.zh: 她已周游世界。

examples.en: a glorious victory
examples.zh: 辉煌的胜利

examples.en: It took only a few years for skilled workers to restore this ever lonely and long forgotten ancient town in the south of the Yangtze River to its former glory, which was amazing.
examples.zh: 仅耗时短短数载，能工巧匠们就让这座曾经落寞不堪、早已被人淡忘的江南古镇重现了昔日的辉煌，令人叹为观止。

examples.en: a pair of gloves
examples.zh: 一副手套

examples.en: Let's stick them together with glue.
examples.zh: 咱们把它们胶在一起吧。

examples.en: Because they were not informed in advance, few people came to attend the lecture, and there were enough materials to go round.
examples.zh: 由于事先没有接到通知，来参加这个讲座的人很少，因此有足够的材料分发。

examples.en: Go down and see what they are doing downstairs.
examples.zh: 下去看看他们在楼下干什么。

examples.en: Probate cases can go on for two years or more.
examples.zh: 遗嘱认证案可能要持续两年或者更长时间。

examples.en: Unemployment is likely to go on rising this year.
examples.zh: 今年的失业人数可能会继续上升。

examples.en: You should go over what you learn before you take an exam.
examples.zh: 你应该在考试前把你所学的知识复习一遍。

examples.en: The main road was flooded so we had to go round by narrow country lanes.
examples.zh: 公路干线遭水淹，我们只得择乡间小径绕行。

examples.en: There are not enough desks to go round in the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室里书桌不够用。

examples.en: When he was a child, he went through all kinds of hardships.
examples.zh: 孩提时代，他经历了各种各样的艰难困苦。

examples.en: The first thing she did was go up to her trainer and thank for all her help during the training.
examples.zh: 她做的第一件事就是走到教练跟前，感谢她在训练期间给与的帮助。

examples.en: Only by setting clear goals in life and making every effort to work on it can you realize your dream of being a useful person.
examples.zh: 只有设定明确的人生目标并不遗余力地为之奋斗，才能实现你成为有用之材的梦想。

examples.en: There is a goat on the hill.
examples.zh: 山上有一只羊。

examples.en: My God!
examples.zh: 天啊！

examples.en: Venus is a goddess of beauty.
examples.zh: 维纳斯是美的女神。

examples.en: Do you believe that it is made of gold?
examples.zh: 你相信这是黄金做的吗？

examples.en: Her hair is golden.
examples.zh: 她的头发是金黄色的。

items.explanation: 指真正的质地，意思是“金制的，金的”。

examples.en: gold mine
examples.zh: 金矿

examples.en: gold bar
examples.zh: 金条

examples.en: gold chain
examples.zh: 金链条

examples.en: gold coin
examples.zh: 金币

examples.en: gold watch
examples.zh: 金表

items.explanation: 指金黄色的外表，意思是“金色的”。golden 的引申意义也很常用，含有“贵重的；重要的，幸运的”之意，只能作定语。

examples.en: a golden watch
examples.zh: 镀金表

examples.en: golden hair
examples.zh: 金发

examples.en: golden saying
examples.zh: 金玉良言

examples.en: a golden sky
examples.zh: 金黄色的天空

examples.en: golden hours
examples.zh: 幸福的时刻

examples.en: golden age
examples.zh: 黄金时代

examples.en: golden wedding
examples.zh: 金婚 (结婚 50 周年纪念)

examples.en: golden years
examples.zh: 金色的年华

examples.en: golden sunlight
examples.zh: 金色的阳光

examples.en: play golf
examples.zh: 打高尔夫球

examples.en: To everybody, especially the old, being in a good mood does good to health.
examples.zh: 对每一个人来说，尤其是老年人，心情好对健康有很大的好处。

examples.en: To everybody, especially the old, being in a good mood does good to health.
examples.zh: 对每一个人来说，尤其是老年人，心情好对健康有很大的好处。

g.name: be so good as to do

examples.en: He left without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 他不辞而别。

examples.en: He retains a faith in human goodness.
examples.zh: 他依然相信人是善良的。

examples.en: Goodness, why are you so late?
examples.zh: 哎呀，你怎么来得这么晚呢！

examples.en: We are not accustomed to seeing so many kinds of goods in the shop.
examples.zh: 商店里的商品琳琅满目，让我们眼花缭乱。

examples.en: A young goose is a gosling.
examples.zh: 幼鹅的英文叫“gosling”。

examples.en: I don't approve of gossip.
examples.zh: 我不赞成背后议论。

examples.en: Customers pay to log on and gossip with other users.
examples.zh: 顾客付费后登录系统和其他用户聊天。

examples.en: The price of coffee is governed by the quantity which has been produced.
examples.zh: 咖啡的价格由产量决定。

examples.en: Reducing the gap between rich and poor is one of the main challenges facing the government.
examples.zh: 缩小贫富差距是政府面临的主要挑战之一。(徐汇)

examples.en: grab sb. by the arm
examples.zh: 抓住某人的手臂

examples.en: a graceful dance
examples.zh: 优美的舞蹈

senses.trans: [在感叹句中表示惊讶] 啊呀

examples.en: Busy as she was, she was gracious enough to show us round.
examples.zh: 虽然很忙，但她还是热情地带我们参观。

examples.en: She is in the second grade.
examples.zh: 她上二年级。

examples.en: There has been a gradual increase in the number of people owning cars.
examples.zh: 拥有汽车的人数一直在逐渐上升。

examples.en: These changes were gradually assimilated into everyday life.
examples.zh: 这些改变逐渐渗入日常生活。

examples.en: After listening to the professor's inspiring lecture, more university graduates are willing to devote themselves to the cause of environmental protection.
examples.zh: 听完这位教授鼓舞人心的讲座，更多的大学毕业生愿意投身于环保事业。

examples.en: After graduating from senior high school, they managed to enter first-rate universities.
examples.zh: 高中毕业后，他们成功地进了一流大学。

examples.zh: 子弹打伤了士兵的左腿。
