examples.en: It is very late; hence you must go to bed.
examples.zh: 时间已经很晚了，因此你必须睡觉去。

examples.en: It is no use persuading her not to do online shopping any more.
examples.zh: 劝阻她不要再网购是没有任何作用的。

examples.en: The dried herb is obtainable from health shops.
examples.zh: 这种干药草能在保健品商店里买到。

examples.en: Directors and actors from all over the world have traveled so far to gather here, which makes the film festival receive widespread attention and report.
examples.zh: 世界各地的导演、演员不远万里齐聚一堂，令本次电影节受到了广泛的关注和报道。

examples.en: Though they are really great, they have never thought of themselves as heroes.
examples.zh: 虽然他们真的很伟大，但他们从来没有认为自己是英雄。

examples.en: I cannot believe she is the heroine of the movie.
examples.zh: 我难以相信她是这部电影的女主角。

senses.trans: [物主代词绝对形式] 她的(所有物)

examples.en: The book is hers.
examples.zh: 这本书是她的。

examples.en: She hurt herself while rescuing the child.
examples.zh: 她在救孩子时伤到了自己。

examples.en: He never hesitates to make the criticisms that he considers helpful to others.
examples.zh: 他从来都是毫不犹豫地提出那些他认为对别人有帮助的批评。

examples.en: Hey, Tom!
examples.zh: 喂，汤姆！

examples.en: Hi, Alice!
examples.zh: 你好，爱丽丝！

examples.en: He could not hide his embarrassment.
examples.zh: 他没法掩盖自己的窘态。

examples.en: Shanghai Tower is one of the highest buildings in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 上海中心大厦是上海最高建筑物之一。

examples.en: The eagle flies high.
examples.zh: 鹰飞得很高。

items.explanation: 和 tall 均作形容词。high 多指物(但不指人)的高；既可作形容词又可作副词，多指物的高度。

examples.en: High hills surround the valley.
examples.zh: 高山围绕着山谷。

examples.en: a high building
examples.zh: 一幢高楼

examples.en: fly high in the sky
examples.zh: 高高地在空中飞翔

items.explanation: 和 high 均作形容词。tall 多指比通常者高，可指人也可指物，形容其高且细长。

examples.en: a tall man
examples.zh: 高个子

examples.en: a tall pine
examples.zh: 高大的松树

items.explanation: 是副词，表示抽象概念的高度。

examples.en: highly praise
examples.zh: 高度表扬

senses.trans: 最突出(或重要)的部分(或事件)

examples.en: Give me a rough idea of how the doll is made. Just the highlights.
examples.zh: 请大致介绍一下这个娃娃的制作过程，讲讲主要的就行了。

examples.en: He is highly regarded, but his youth might count against him.
examples.zh: 人们对他的评价很高，但他年轻这一点也许会对他不利。

examples.en: a new high-rise
examples.zh: 一幢新的高层建筑

examples.en: highway traffic
examples.zh: 公路交通

examples.en: go on a hike
examples.zh: 去徒步旅行

examples.en: I got out of breath running up the hill from the station.
examples.zh: 我从车站跑上山顶，连气都喘不上来了。

examples.en: Do you know him?
examples.zh: 你认识他吗？

examples.en: He asked himself a question.
examples.zh: 他问了自己一个问题。

examples.en: When she said she was tired, it was a hint that she wanted us to go.
examples.zh: 当她说累了时，是暗示我们可以走了。

examples.en: Why don't you hint to the director that it's time you had a raise in pay?
examples.zh: 为什么不向经理暗示该是你加薪的时候了？

examples.en: Fishing tackle is available for hire.
examples.zh: 钓具可供出租。

examples.en: He hired a car for two days.
examples.zh: 他租了一辆小汽车使用两天。

examples.en: It was a passer-by who saved the man trying to kill himself without considering his own safety.
examples.zh: 一个过路人不顾自己的安危，救了那个轻生的男子。

senses.trans: [物主代词绝对形式]他的(所有物)

examples.en: China and Japan signed a historic peace and friendship treaty.
examples.zh: 中日签订了具有历史意义的和平友好条约。

examples.en: The designer has integrated sustainable concepts into the renovation of the historical building, ensuring that the building not only meets environmental standards but also retains its cultural and historical significance.
examples.zh: 设计师将可持续理念融入历史建筑的修缮，既确保了该建筑符合环保要求，又保留其文化与历史价值。(杨浦)

items.explanation: 历史上著名的，有历史性的 (= of history)

examples.en: a historic meeting between the two leaders
examples.zh: 两位领导人之间的一次具有历史意义的会见

items.explanation: 历史(上)的，有关历史的 (= about history)

examples.en: Mr. Thompson gave all the historical papers of his grandfather to the public library according to his grandfather's will.
examples.zh: 汤普森先生按照他祖父的遗嘱，将其所有关于历史学的论文都赠送给了公共图书馆。

examples.en: Not only did the visitors from home and abroad appreciate the beauty of the ancient city, but also have a rough idea of the local traditional culture and the long history.
examples.zh: 中外游客们不仅领略了古城的美景，也对当地的传统文化和悠久历史有了一个大致的了解。

examples.en: A serious flood hit the city and caused a lot of damage.
examples.zh: 这个城市遭遇严重的水灾，损失惨重。

senses.trans: 成功而轰动一时的人或事物

examples.en: The concert was quite a hit in Chicago.
examples.zh: 这场音乐会在芝加哥曾轰动一时。

senses.trans: 高技术(= high tech, high technology)

examples.en: It is all made by hitech.
examples.zh: 这一切都是用高科技制作的。

examples.en: Taking up one or two hobbies is very valuable to people's mental and physical health.
examples.zh: 有一两项业余爱好对人的身心健康是弥足珍贵的。

examples.en: On hearing that the adult ceremony would be held next week, I told it to my classmates at once.
examples.zh: 听说成人仪式在下周举行后，我立刻将消息告诉了同学们。

examples.en: He holds on to my arm with a tenacious grip.
examples.zh: 他紧紧抓住我的手臂不放。

examples.en: She bit her lip to hold back the tears.
examples.zh: 她咬着嘴唇强忍住眼泪。

examples.en: When he left the telephone to find a pencil, he asked me to hold on.
examples.zh: 他离开电话去找铅笔的时候，让我别挂掉。

examples.en: He held on to a branch until we came to his rescue.
examples.zh: 他抓住一根树枝，直到我们来救他。

examples.en: We can stay here for as long as our supplies hold out.
examples.zh: 我们的供应品能维持多久，我们就能在这里呆多久。

examples.en: The doctors held out no hope of her recovery.
examples.zh: 医生对她的康复不抱希望。

examples.en: They were held up by fog.
examples.zh: 他们被雾所阻。

examples.en: We had planned to finish the work before dark, but the heavy rain held us up.
examples.zh: 我们原计划在天黑以前干完这项工作，可是给大雨耽搁了。

examples.en: The repairmen have dug a hole in the road.
examples.zh: 修路工人在路上挖了一个洞。

examples.en: When we heard the news that we would have a holiday, we were all excited.
examples.zh: 听到要放假的消息，我们都很兴奋。

examples.en: He looked young, dark and sharp-featured, with hollow cheeks.
examples.zh: 他看起来很年轻，肤色黝黑，五官分明，双颊凹陷。

examples.en: Squirrels often use a hollow in a tree to store nuts.
examples.zh: 松鼠常用树洞储藏坚果。

examples.en: holy love
examples.zh: 圣洁的爱

examples.en: They visited the holy yesterday.
examples.zh: 他们昨天参观了这座圣殿。

examples.en: Frank works with others from home through computers.
examples.zh: 弗兰克在家里通过电脑与其他人联系工作。

examples.en: You look very tired, so why don't you go home and have a good sleep?
examples.zh: 你看上去很疲惫，为什么不回家好好睡一觉呢？

examples.en: He came to miss his homeland when he settled down abroad.
examples.zh: 当他在国外安定下来时，他开始想念祖国了。

examples.en: He is a little homesick.
examples.zh: 他有点想家。

examples.en: My hometown is located on a beautiful stretch of land.
examples.zh: 我的家乡位于一片美丽的土地上。

examples.en: The movie on the TV last night was such a great attraction that I forgot to do my homework and was criticized.
examples.zh: 昨晚电视里放的电影太吸引人了，以至于我都忘了做作业，挨了批评。

examples.en: an honest face
examples.zh: 诚实坦率的脸

examples.en: Your bees make good honey.
examples.zh: 你们的蜜蜂能酿出上好的蜜。

examples.en: They are on their honeymoon.
examples.zh: 他们在度蜜月。

examples.en: It's an honour that I have been invited to such an important meeting.
examples.zh: 应邀参加这样重要的会议，我感到非常荣幸。

examples.en: Would you honour us by visiting us?
examples.zh: 可否请您光临？

examples.en: A welcome party will be held in honor of the distinguished guests.
examples.zh: 将为贵宾们举办一个欢迎会。

examples.en: an honourable task
examples.zh: 光荣的任务

examples.en: He hung his coat on the hook behind the door.
examples.zh: 他把外套挂在门后的挂钩上。

examples.en: The tourist industry won't grow if the restaurant owners regard tourists as fish to be hooked rather than as guests to be welcomed.
examples.zh: 如果饭店老板们把游客当作将要上钩的鱼而不是受欢迎的客人，旅游事业就不能得到发展。

examples.en: I hopped down three steps.
examples.zh: 我单脚跳下了 3 级台阶。

trans: 单足(或齐足)跳跃(或跳行)

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to hop the pole.
examples.zh: 老师要学生跳过这支杆。

examples.en: The pursuer cleared the fence in one hop.
examples.zh: 追捕者一跃跳过了栅栏。

examples.en: Every designer hopes that his work can stand the test of time.
examples.zh: 每位设计师都希望自己的作品能经受住时间的考验。

examples.en: If we don't give up hope, we will surely succeed.
examples.zh: 如果我们不放弃希望，我们一定会成功的。

h.name: Where there is life, there is hope.

examples.en: There is a confusing phenomenon that many young parents would rather invest much money in early education than travel with kids to broaden their horizons.
examples.zh: 有一个非常令人费解的现象：很多年轻父母宁愿把很多钱投资在早教上，也不愿意带娃旅行开阔眼界。(浦东、青浦)

examples.en: blare the horn
examples.zh: 按喇叭

examples.en: There was a horrible accident here yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天在这里发生了一起可怕的事故。

examples.en: the horror of war
examples.zh: 战争的恐怖

examples.en: When the horse finished the race, its sides were wet all over with sweat.
examples.zh: 当马完成比赛时，浑身都被汗水打湿了。

examples.en: The doctors in that hospital always examine patients with great care.
examples.zh: 该医院的医生总是非常仔细地对患者进行检查。

examples.en: Mr Brown was our host at the party.
examples.zh: 布朗先生是我们晚会的主持人。

examples.en: The academic conference was hosted by our university.
examples.zh: 我们大学是这次学术会议的东道主。

examples.en: The terrorists held 20 hostages.
examples.zh: 恐怖分子扣押了 20 个人质。

examples.en: Our hostess served up a large bowl of steaming hot dumplings.
examples.zh: 女主人端上一大碗热气腾腾的饺子。

examples.en: Young people are very hot on pop music.
examples.zh: 年轻人热衷于流行音乐。

examples.en: We're looking for a hotel to live in.
examples.zh: 我们在找一家旅馆住下。

examples.en: You can only hope that they will take themselves off at a decent hour.
examples.zh: 你只能希望他们能在适当的时间动身。

examples.en: For a big house the price is fairly low, but you have to take the money you'll spend on repairs into consideration.
examples.zh: 对于一所大房子而言这个价格是相当便宜了，但你还得把维修费用考虑进去。

examples.en: With the 3D movies becoming more and more popular in recent years, it seems that 3D TV may go into every household in the near future.
examples.zh: 近年来，随着 3D 电影变得越来越流行，似乎 3D 电视也可能在不久的将来进入每个家庭。

examples.en: a busy housewife
examples.zh: 一位忙碌的家庭主妇

examples.en: She often does housework at home.
examples.zh: 她常在家做家务。

examples.en: Housing is a key driver of the economy.
examples.zh: 住房是拉动经济的主要因素。

examples.en: How on earth can a person accomplish such a great project?
examples.zh: 一个人究竟怎样才能完成这样一项伟大的工程呢？(徐汇)

h.name: how come
trans: 为什么[常位于句首，后面用陈述语序]

examples.en: He can answer the question however hard it is.
examples.zh: 不管问题有多难，他都能回答。

examples.en: There seems little hope of her recovery. However, the doctors are still doing all they can.
examples.zh: 她康复的希望似乎很小，然而医生们还在尽力而为。

examples.en: She had hugged him exuberantly and invited him to dinner the next day.
examples.zh: 她兴高采烈地拥抱了他，并邀请他第二天一起吃晚饭。

examples.en: This is really a huge amount of money, but it is much less than we need.
examples.zh: 这实在是一笔巨款，但还远远低于我们的需要。

examples.en: Her greatness lies in her deep understanding of human nature.
examples.zh: 她的厉害之处在于她对人性的深刻了解。

examples.en: Whatever is done has to be done by humans.
examples.zh: 一切事情都是要人去做的。

examples.en: We admire her dedication to the cause of humanity.
examples.zh: 我们敬佩她对人类事业的献身精神。

examples.en: in my humble opinion
examples.zh: 据本人愚见

examples.en: a man with humour
examples.zh: 一个幽默的人

examples.en: The riddles are usually short, wise, and sometimes humourous.
examples.zh: 这些谜语通常简短、富有智慧，有时也很幽默。

examples.en: It took hundreds of years to build the canal, which still serves as the major waterway running east-west although it is not as busy as it used to be.
examples.zh: 这条运河历经数百年才修建而成，如今虽无昔日繁忙之景，但仍然是横跨东西的重要水路。

examples.en: They died from cold and hunger.
examples.zh: 他们死于寒冷和饥荒。

examples.en: to be hungry for knowledge
examples.zh: 渴望求知

examples.en: Detectives have been hunting him for seven months.
examples.zh: 侦探 7 个月来一直在追捕他。

examples.en: I hunted for my book everywhere.
examples.zh: 我到处找我的书。

examples.en: Police have launched a nationwide hunt for the killer.
examples.zh: 警察已经在全国范围内追捕杀人凶手了。

examples.en: The fox ran away before the hunter shot it.
examples.zh: 那只狐狸在猎人向它射击前跑掉了。

examples.en: The hurricane last night had been a great surprise.
examples.zh: 昨晚的飓风来得太突然。

examples.en: Don't make a hurried decision, look round well first.
examples.zh: 别急于做决定，先仔细考虑一下。

examples.en: When I went to the cinema in a hurry, the film had been on for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 当我赶到电影院时，电影已经开始 10 分钟了。

examples.en: Hurry him up.
examples.zh: 叫他快点。

examples.en: He picked up his bag and hurried off along the platform.
examples.zh: 他拿起包，沿着站台匆忙地走了。

examples.en: My leg hurts.
examples.zh: 我腿痛。

examples.en: It hurts me when you talk that way.
examples.zh: 你那样说话真叫我痛心。

examples.en: wait for my husband
examples.zh: 等我的丈夫

examples.en: a hut on the hill
examples.zh: 山上的小屋

examples.en: hydrogen bomb
examples.zh: 氢弹

examples.en: She has a surprising gift for seeing into people's minds.
examples.zh: 她有惊人的天赋，能看出别人的心思。

examples.en: She has a surprising gift for seeing into people's minds.
examples.zh: 她有惊人的天赋，能看出别人的心思。

examples.en: Only through repeated practice can we have a good command of English.
examples.zh: 只有反复操练，我们才能精通英语。

examples.en: Could I have a look at the instructions myself?
examples.zh: 我可以自己看看说明书吗？

examples.en: He and his wife both have a passion for classical music.
examples.zh: 他和他的妻子都酷爱古典音乐。

examples.en: Fathers have an enormous effect on their children's personalities.
examples.zh: 父亲对孩子们的个性有巨大的影响。

examples.en: I have confidence in establishing a long-term business relationship with your company.
examples.zh: 我有信心能和贵公司建立长期的商业关系。

examples.en: I have confidence in establishing a long-term business relationship with your company.
examples.zh: 我有信心能和贵公司建立长期的商业关系。

examples.en: It is generally believed that news media have a profound influence on people's mind.
examples.zh: 普遍认为新闻媒介对人的思想有深远的影响。

h.name: have no choice but to do

examples.en: We had no choice but to complain to the manager about it.
examples.zh: 我们只好向经理投诉这件事。

examples.en: Students show their respect for teachers by listening attentively in class.
examples.zh: 学生在课堂上专心听讲，以此来表示对老师的尊敬。

examples.en: Students show their respect for teachers by listening attentively in class.
examples.zh: 学生在课堂上专心听讲，以此来表示对老师的尊敬。

examples.en: Having had a good rest, the explorers headed for another mountain.
examples.zh: 好好休息一番之后，探险者们向另一座山进发。

h.name: hold a firm belief in sth.

examples.en: He holds a firm belief in the goodness of human nature.
examples.zh: 他对人性的善良坚信不移。

examples.en: He held on to a branch until we came to his rescue.
examples.zh: 他抓住一根树枝，直到我们来救他。

examples.en: I really hope that my article will be published in a newspaper someday.
examples.zh: 我真希望自己的文章有朝一日能见报。

examples.en: She put some ice in her drink.
examples.zh: 她往饮料里加了点冰。

examples.en: Many people like to eat ice-cream.
examples.zh: 许多人喜欢吃冰淇淋。

examples.en: Most children have so little close contact with adults apart from their parents and teachers that they have little idea of what adult life is like.
examples.zh: 大多数孩子很少与父母和老师之外的成年人有密切的接触，他们对大人的生活鲜有概念。

examples.en: This dictionary is ideal — it's exactly what I need.
examples.zh: 这本词典很理想，正是我所需要的。

examples.en: to realize one's ideal
examples.zh: 实现理想

examples.en: Our opinions are identical.
examples.zh: 我们的观点完全一致。

examples.en: Do you have any identification cards?
examples.zh: 你们有身份证吗？

examples.en: The biggest task of the parents is not to solely expect their child of high scores, but rather to identify what interests their child most and where his or her strength lies.
examples.zh: 父母最大的任务是发现孩子的兴趣和特长所在，而非一味追求高分。

examples.en: The donor's identity is a close secret.
examples.zh: 捐赠人的身份是一个严加保守的秘密。

examples.en: From that story comes the idiom "Draw a snake and add feet to it".
examples.zh: “画蛇添足”这个成语就是从这个故事来的。

examples.en: I would appreciate it very much if you could help me when I am in trouble.
examples.zh: 在我有麻烦的时候，如果你能帮助我，我将不胜感激。

examples.en: If he did wrong, it was from ignorance.
examples.zh: 如果他做错了，那是出于无知。

examples.en: What surprised us was that the bookworm was ignorant of the news that we won the championship.
examples.zh: 令我们吃惊的是，那个书呆子对我们赢得冠军的消息一无所知。

examples.en: They appear to be ignorant of what is going on here.
examples.zh: 他们对这里正在发生的事似乎一点也不知道。

examples.en: Some charity organizations always focus on how to get the helped out of poverty and ignore the mental needs of them.
examples.zh: 一些慈善机构往往将眼光放在如何让受助对象脱贫上，而忽略了受助者的心理需求。

items.explanation: 不顾；忽视（指对显而易见的东西不注意或者故意不予理会，只接名词作宾语）

examples.en: His driving was suspended for ignoring a red light.
examples.zh: 他因闯红灯而被罚暂停驾驶。

items.explanation: 疏忽，忽略（指因不小心或没注意而造成疏忽，后接不定式或动名词）

examples.en: I neglected winding the clock.
examples.zh: 我忘了给钟上发条。

examples.en: This article tells us how to avoid getting ill while traveling.
examples.zh: 这篇文章告诉我们怎样在旅行期间防止生病。

examples.en: The child has been ill-treated in the orphan house.
examples.zh: 这孩子在孤儿院里一直受虐待。

discriminations.intro: 相同点：ill 和 sick 都可以作表语，意为“生病的”。

items.explanation: 作定语时，意为“坏的，邪恶的”。

examples.en: Mr. Smith has been ill/sick in hospital for a month.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生已经生病住院一个月了。

examples.en: ill effect
examples.zh: 坏影响

examples.en: ill name
examples.zh: 恶名

examples.en: ill temper
examples.zh: 坏脾气

examples.en: ill luck
examples.zh: 坏运气

items.explanation: 作定语时，意为“生病的”；有时还可解释为“恶心的”。

examples.en: William stayed at home all day to look after his sick mother.
examples.zh: 威廉整天在家照顾他生病的母亲。

examples.en: The terrible smell made me sick.
examples.zh: 这可怕的味道让我恶心。

examples.en: illegal possession of firearms
examples.zh: 非法持有枪支

examples.en: I'm recovering after a long illness.
examples.zh: 我久病之后正在逐渐康复。

examples.en: The speaker said he would endeavor to illustrate.
examples.zh: 演讲人说他将设法举例说明。

examples.en: The book has not only illustrations but also a CD. No wonder children like it so much.
examples.zh: 这本书不仅有插图，还配有光盘，难怪孩子们如此喜欢。

examples.en: I had formed an image of her before we met.
examples.zh: 在我们见面之前，我曾想象过她的模样。

examples.en: His sorrow was imaged in his face.
examples.zh: 他的悲哀反映在他的脸上。

examples.en: All the characters in this book are imaginary.
examples.zh: 这本书中的人物都是虚构的。

examples.en: Curiosity and imagination are often viewed as the key to success.
examples.zh: 好奇心和想象力常常被认为是成功的关键。

examples.en: Learning to be responsible is really not as easy as one has imagined.
examples.zh: 学会负责真没想象那么简单。

examples.en: The little boy imitated his father.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩学他父亲的样。

examples.en: This imitation of Mona Lisa is so well-drawn that it can be passed for the genuine one.
examples.zh: 这幅《蒙娜丽莎》仿制品画得很像，几乎能以假乱真。

examples.en: If you really want to solve this problem, you have to take an immediate action to deal with it before the situation gets worse.
examples.zh: 如果你真的想解决问题，你必须在情况变得更糟之前，立即采取行动处理它。

examples.en: It is unrealistic to expect them to be able to solve the problem immediately.
examples.zh: 指望他们能够立即解决问题是不现实的。

examples.en: European immigrants in Australia
examples.zh: 在澳洲的欧洲移民

examples.en: They plan to immigrate to Finland next year.
examples.zh: 他们计划明年移居芬兰。

examples.en: Can you feel the impact of big data on modern life?
examples.zh: 你能感受到大数据给现代生活带来的冲击吗？

examples.en: How will the war impact on such a poet?
examples.zh: 战争对这样一个诗人会有什么影响？

examples.en: He became more and more impatient.
examples.zh: 他变得越来越不耐烦了。

examples.en: imperial trade
examples.zh: 帝国交易

examples.en: impersonal remarks
examples.zh: 不针对某个人的评论

examples.en: A spade is an implement for digging.
examples.zh: 铁锹是挖土的工具。

examples.en: The committee's decisions will be implemented immediately.
examples.zh: 委员会的决定将立即执行。

examples.en: What's the implication of the statement?
examples.zh: 这一声明的含义是什么？

examples.en: His smile implied that he had agreed to my suggestion.
examples.zh: 他的微笑暗示他已经同意了我的建议。

examples.en: Machinery is one of our imports.
examples.zh: 机械是我们的进口货物之一。

examples.en: import wool from Australia
examples.zh: 从澳大利亚进口羊毛

examples.en: The plan sounds quite good, but what is more important is that we should put it into practice as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 这个计划听上去很不错，不过更重要的是我们应该尽快付诸实施。

examples.en: We must not impose our views on others.
examples.zh: 我们不能把自己的观点强加于人。

examples.en: He always wants to impose on those who help him.
examples.zh: 他总是想占帮助他的那些人的便宜。

examples.en: an imposing old lady
examples.zh: 仪态雍容的老妇人

examples.en: If you don't go on a diet, it is impossible for you to lose weight.
examples.zh: 如果你不节食，是不可能减肥的。

examples.en: His words are strongly impressed on my memory.
examples.zh: 他的话深深铭记于我心头。

examples.en: Her gentleness has given me a deep impression.
examples.zh: 她的和蔼可亲给我留下了很深的印象。

examples.en: If you want to improve your spoken English, you must take every opportunity to talk with others in English.
examples.zh: 如果你要提高英语口语，就必须抓住每个机会用英语与别人交谈。

examples.en: Everything in his body operates in a healthy way more efficiently when a person laughs.
examples.zh: 一个人大笑时，其体内的一切都会运作得更健康，更有效率。

examples.en: The island is inaccessible except by boat.
examples.zh: 只有乘船才能到那个岛。

examples.en: The government of our country has declared that we will never give up an inch of land and sea under any circumstances.
examples.zh: 我国政府宣布：在任何情况下都不会放弃任何一寸土地和海洋。

examples.en: She watched him inch his way up the stairs.
examples.zh: 她看着他一步一步登上楼梯。

i.name: An inch of time is an inch of gold.

examples.en: Were there any exciting incidents during your journey?
examples.zh: 你们在旅程中有什么令人激动的事吗？

examples.en: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech.
examples.zh: 他在讲话中加进了许多引人发笑的故事。

examples.en: I've got three days' holiday including New Year's Day.
examples.zh: 包括元旦在内，我有 3 天假。

examples.en: What is your income from your job?
examples.zh: 你的工作收入是多少？

examples.en: incomplete combustion
examples.zh: 不完全燃烧

examples.en: That the population on the earth is increasing rapidly is one of the serious problems that mankind faces.
examples.zh: 地球上人口飞速增长是人类面临的重大问题之一。

examples.en: His weight showed an increase of 3 pounds in a month.
examples.zh: 他的体重一个月增加了 3 磅。

examples.en: The city is developing at an incredible speed.
examples.zh: 城市正在以惊人的速度发展。

examples.en: Thank you very much indeed.
examples.zh: 实在太感谢你了。

examples.en: achieve independence
examples.zh: 获得独立

examples.en: Parents should understand that they can't do everything for their children and kids have to learn to be independent.
examples.zh: 父母应该明白，他们不能为孩子做一切事情。孩子必须学会独立。

examples.en: His trip to India made a strong impression on him.
examples.zh: 印度之行对他的触动很大。

examples.en: Indian food
examples.zh: 印度食品

examples.en: I can't speak Indian.
examples.zh: 我不会说印第安语。

examples.en: Indicate the correct answer with a tick.
examples.zh: 打勾标出正确的答案。

examples.en: Each individual girl in the class has her own personality.
examples.zh: 这个班的每一个女孩都有自己的个性。

examples.en: The rights of the individual are considered to be the most important in a free society.
examples.zh: 在自由的社会里，个人权利被认为是最重要的。

items.explanation: 个别的，单个的（指众多的人或事物中单独的、与其他不相同的，常与“集体的”或“普遍的”相对）

examples.en: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
examples.zh: 树上的每片叶子都是不同的。

items.explanation: 个人的，私人的（强调某个人所有、所用的，与“团体的”或“非个人的”相对）

examples.en: It is impolite to ask personal questions.
examples.zh: 探问他人隐私是不礼貌的。

items.explanation: 私人的，私有的（强调非共有的或非公开的）

examples.en: This is a private car, which he bought himself last year.
examples.zh: 这是一辆私人汽车，他去年自己买的。

examples.en: go indoors
examples.zh: 进屋

examples.en: It will be years before the new discovery is applied to industrial production.
examples.zh: 还要过若干年才能将这一新发现应用到工业生产中去。

examples.en: We have to make our every effort to industrialise our country.
examples.zh: 我们应该尽最大的努力，使我们的国家实现工业化。

examples.en: Many townships in the coastal area have begun to industrialise.
examples.zh: 沿海地区的许多乡镇已开始工业化。

examples.en: Nowadays, more and more people prefer to shop online, which contributes to the booming of the express delivery industry.
examples.zh: 如今，越来越多的人喜欢在网上购物，这就促进了快递业的蓬勃发展。

examples.en: Such a difficult operation may not succeed, it's an inevitable gamble.
examples.zh: 这样一个难度很大的手术可能会不成功，但这是一次非做不可的冒险。

examples.en: The report has inevitably been greeted with scepticism.
examples.zh: 那份报告不可避免地遭到质疑。

examples.en: an inexact answer
examples.zh: 不精确的答案

examples.en: An infant school is a school for children from about five to seven years of age.
examples.zh: 幼儿园是一个供 5 岁至 7 岁儿童上学的学校。

examples.en: Never did it occur to me that my computer would be infected with such a serious virus.
examples.zh: 我从未想到我的电脑会感染上如此严重的病毒。

examples.en: Dressings are changed every four hours to help prevent infection.
examples.zh: 每 4 小时更换一次敷料，以防感染。

examples.en: to infer an unknown fact from a known fact
examples.zh: 从已知的事实推断出未知的事实

examples.en: The students from poor and backward countryside needn't feel they themselves are inferior to the others.
examples.zh: 来自贫困落后农村的学生不必觉得自己低人一等。

examples.en: My teacher influenced my decision to study science.
examples.zh: 我的老师对我学理科的决定起了影响作用。

examples.en: Although some technical innovations have attracted little public attention, they have more far-reaching influence on real life in every regard.
examples.zh: 有些技术创新虽没怎么引起公众的注意，却对现实生活的方方面面有着更深远的影响。

examples.en: He is an influential figure in early 20th century.
examples.zh: 他是 20 世纪初有影响力的人物。

examples.en: If you listen to the radio every day, you will be informed of what is happening in different places of the world.
examples.zh: 如果每天听广播，你就能了解世界各地发生的事。

examples.en: We regret to inform you of the cancellation of the tour.
examples.zh: 我们遗憾地通知您，此次旅行取消了。

examples.en: The Premier made an informal visit to Vietnam.
examples.zh: 总理对越南作了一次非正式访问。

examples.en: He had no difficulty at all obtaining the information he needed online.
examples.zh: 他毫不费劲在网上找到了所需的资料。

examples.en: For some buildings a vertical section is more informative than a plan.
examples.zh: 有些建筑的立面图能比平面图提供更多的信息。

examples.en: ingredients for onion soup
examples.zh: 做洋葱汤的原料

examples.en: How many inhabitants are there in this neighbourhood?
examples.zh: 这个小区有多少居民？

examples.en: The eldest son will inherit the title.
examples.zh: 长子将继承爵位。

examples.en: The government has taken a series of measures to deal with environmental pollution recently, and these measures have achieved initial effects in some cities.
examples.zh: 政府近来采取了一系列措施治理环境污染，这些措施在部分城市已取得初步成效。

examples.en: The trip was initiated by the manager of the community centre.
examples.zh: 这次旅行由社区活动中心的经理发起。

examples.en: He is a man of great initiative.
examples.zh: 他是一个进取心很强的人。

examples.en: Think of a tiny micro-robot that a doctor in the future will inject into your blood.
examples.zh: 想想未来医生会把一个微型机器人注射到你的血液里。

examples.en: In the past two years, up to thirty thousand people have been injured in traffic accidents in that country.
examples.zh: 在过去的两年里，那个国家有多达 3 万人在交通事故中受伤。

examples.en: Four police officers sustained serious injuries in the explosion.
examples.zh: 4 名警官在爆炸中受重伤。

examples.en: Don't write your exercise in red ink.
examples.zh: 不要用红墨水写练习。

examples.en: a tidy inn
examples.zh: 一家整洁的客栈

examples.en: inner emotions
examples.zh: 内心感情

examples.en: The inner of a nut refers to its edible seed.
examples.zh: 坚果的核指的是它可食用的种子。

examples.en: No matter how hard he tried to defend himself, he couldn't persuade the people present to believe that he was innocent.
examples.zh: 不管他怎么努力辩解，也无法说服在场的人认同他是无辜的。(宝山)

examples.en: In the age of global competition, design innovation is vital.
examples.zh: 在全球竞争的时代，设计创新至关重要。

examples.en: give more output with less labour input
examples.zh: 投入较少劳动力而生产较多的成品

examples.en: They inputted 3,000 words.
examples.zh: 他们输入了 3000 个词。

examples.en: Generally speaking, it is better not to inquire about women's age and personal affairs in Western countries.
examples.zh: 在西方国家，一般来说最好不要打听女性的年龄和私事。

examples.en: an inquiry office
examples.zh: 问讯处

examples.en: different kinds of insects
examples.zh: 各种昆虫

examples.en: He inserted a piece of carbon paper between two sheets.
examples.zh: 他在两页纸中间夹一张复写纸。

examples.en: She was standing just inside the gate.
examples.zh: 她站在刚进大门的地方。

examples.en: He was a man with considerable insight.
examples.zh: 他是个富有洞察力的人。

examples.en: We insist on self-reliance.
examples.zh: 我们坚持自力更生。

items.explanation: 坚持(指不顾困难、始终如一、坚定不移地追寻并达到目标，含褒义，后面可接介词 in 或 with)

examples.en: Not discouraged by his failure, he persevered in/with his research.
examples.zh: 他不因失败而气馁，仍然坚持研究。

items.explanation: 坚持要，一定要(多用于坚持意见或主张，后面接介词 on 或 that 从句，从句要用虚拟语气)；坚持认为，强调说(后续介词 on 或 upon；后续 that 从句，用陈述语气)

examples.en: He insisted on my going with him.
examples.zh: 他一定要我和他一起去。

examples.en: He insisted that I (should) go with him.
examples.zh: 他一定要我和他一起去。

examples.en: She insisted that I was to blame for the accident.
examples.zh: 她坚持认为我该对这场事故负责。

examples.en: We insist on the importance of good behavior.
examples.zh: 我们强调品行端正的重要。

items.explanation: 坚持，固执(可指意志坚决，但多指固执己见，后接介词 in)

examples.en: Don't persist in thinking ill of people.
examples.zh: 不要老是把别人看得挺坏。

examples.en: The teacher insisted on all the homework being handed in on Monday.
examples.zh: 老师坚持所有作业都要在星期一交上来。

i.name: insist that ...
trans: 坚持认为……是……(从句用虚拟语气)

examples.en: The government sent someone to inspect our school.
examples.zh: 政府派人来视察我们学校。

examples.en: Would you mind pointing out your luggage for inspection?
examples.zh: 可否把你的行李指给我们检查？

examples.en: Our monitor's being praised and awarded greatly inspired all the students in our class.
examples.zh: 班长受到了表扬和奖励，大大鼓舞了我们班同学。

examples.en: install a heating system
examples.zh: 装暖气设备

examples.en: This is only one instance out of many.
examples.zh: 这不过是许多例子中的一个。

examples.en: It all happened in an instant.
examples.zh: 一切是刹那间发生的。

examples.en: instant coffee
examples.zh: 速溶咖啡

examples.en: Stay calm at all times instead of taking blind action.
examples.zh: 任何时候都要保持冷静，而非盲目行事。(浦东)

items.explanation: 代替；反而(通常放在句尾或句首做状语)

examples.en: The teacher didn't punish the boy. Instead, she praised him.
examples.zh: 老师没有惩罚那个孩子，反而表扬了他。

items.explanation: 而不是；代替(后面除可接名词、代词外，还可接动名词、形容词、副词及介词短语)

examples.en: I got Peter to deliver the letter instead of Fitch.
examples.zh: 我让彼得替菲奇去送这封信。

examples.en: We'll have tea in the garden instead of in the house.
examples.zh: 我们将改在花园里喝茶，而不是在屋里喝。

items.explanation: 代替(后面只能接名词或代词)

examples.en: Tom played for the team in place of me.
examples.zh: 汤姆代替我为球队打比赛。

i.name: instead of
trans: 而不(跟名词、代词、动名词)

examples.en: Birds learn to fly by instinct.
examples.zh: 鸟学飞出自本能。

examples.en: English Institute
examples.zh: 英语协会

examples.en: We're trying to establish linkages between these groups and financial institutions.
examples.zh: 我们正努力在这些团体和金融机构之间建立联系。

examples.en: She instructed me in the use of the smartphone.
examples.zh: 她教我使用智能手机。

examples.en: I will take the medicine according to the instructions.
examples.zh: 我会按说明来服药。

examples.en: Playing a musical instrument enables children to coordinate different parts of their body.
examples.zh: 弹奏乐器可以让孩子协调身体各个部位。

derivatives.name: instrumental
trans: 用乐器演奏的(指非声乐的)

examples.en: He insulted her by calling her a stupid fool.
examples.zh: 他辱骂她是个笨蛋。

examples.en: He shouted insults at the boys.
examples.zh: 他大声辱骂男孩们。

examples.en: insurance company
examples.zh: 保险公司

examples.en: He insured his house against fire.
examples.zh: 他给自己的房屋保了火险。

examples.en: What is amazing about the museum is that it integrates the changes in the countryside, the traces of time, and the memories of childhood into a fixed space.
examples.zh: 这个博物馆的神奇之处在于，它将乡村的变迁、时光的痕迹和童年的回忆融合在了一个固定的空间里。(上海秋考)

examples.en: We've always regarded him as a man of integrity and high professional competence.
examples.zh: 我们一直都认为他是个正直而且业务能力很强的人。

examples.en: a man of intellect
examples.zh: 有非凡才智的人

examples.en: His intelligence quotient is very high.
examples.zh: 他的智商很高。

examples.en: She was one of the most caring and intelligent people I've ever met.
examples.zh: 她是我见过的最体贴、最聪明的人之一。

examples.en: Why didn't you inform him where you intended to visit in your letter?
examples.zh: 你为什么不在信中告知他你打算参观哪些地方？

examples.en: I had intended to join you in the summer camp, but I had some urgent business to attend to.
examples.zh: 我本打算和你一起去参加夏令营的，但有些紧急事务要处理。

examples.en: an intense light
examples.zh: 一道强光

examples.en: He has no intention of changing his job.
examples.zh: 他没有换工作的打算。

examples.en: The significance of the activity lies in the fact that it has contributed to better interaction between teachers and students.
examples.zh: 这个活动的意义在于它促进了师生间更好的互动。

examples.en: American football doesn't interest me at all.
examples.zh: 美式足球一点也提不起我的兴趣。

examples.en: His two great interests in life are music and painting.
examples.zh: 他一生中的两大爱好是音乐和绘画。

items.explanation: 意为“兴趣”，常用作不可数名词，也可作可数名词，意为“各种兴趣”。

examples.en: She has no interest in swimming.
examples.zh: 她对游泳不感兴趣。

examples.en: Reading and taking a walk are her two interests.
examples.zh: 看书和散步是她的两种兴趣爱好。

items.explanation: 意为“玩得高兴，有趣”，只能作不可数名词。

examples.en: It is fun to fish.
examples.zh: 钓鱼很有趣。

items.explanation: 作名词用时，为可数名词，意为“玩笑”，作不及物动词，意为“开玩笑”。

examples.en: play a joke on sb.
examples.zh: 同某人开玩笑

examples.en: have a joke about sb.
examples.zh: 开某人的玩笑

examples.en: She is always joking.
examples.zh: 她总是开玩笑。

i.name: be interested in doing sth.
trans: 对做某事感兴趣(可能已发生，可能未发生)

i.name: be interested to do sth.
trans: 对做某事感兴趣(通常尚未发生)

examples.en: He met a lot of interesting people during his time as a student.
examples.zh: 他在学生时代接触过许多有趣的人。

examples.en: an intermediate stage
examples.zh: 中间阶段

examples.en: It took internal whistle-blowing and investigative journalism to uncover the rot.
examples.zh: 是内部检举和调查性报道揭露了这一腐败事实。

examples.en: The 2018 Shanghai International Import Expo shows innovative ideas, and meanwhile it promotes free trade.
examples.zh: 2018上海进口博览会展示了创新理念，同时也促进了自由贸易。(宝山)

examples.en: In our school, the teachers and students have free access to the Internet.
examples.zh: 在我们学校，教师和学生都可以免费上网。

examples.en: If I had learned French, I would be able to interpret for our French friend.
examples.zh: 假如我学过法语，现在就能给我们的法国朋友当翻译了。

examples.en: a clever interpreter
examples.zh: 聪明的翻译员

examples.en: A knock at the door interrupted our conversation.
examples.zh: 敲门声打断了我们的谈话。

examples.en: There was a long interval before he answered the telephone.
examples.zh: 隔了好久他才接电话。

examples.en: China has registered a protest over foreign intervention.
examples.zh: 中国对外国干涉正式提出了抗议。

examples.en: He said he was greatly honoured to have had an interview with the president of Intel Company.
examples.zh: 他说他万分荣幸采访了英特尔公司的董事长。

examples.en: He was being interviewed on live TV.
examples.zh: 他当时正在接受电视直播的采访。

examples.en: Come into the house.
examples.zh: 到屋里来。

examples.en: The principal introduced in detail our school's history.

examples.zh: 我们可以把墙打通开扇新门。

examples.en: They heard a knock at the front door.
examples.zh: 他们听到前门有人敲门。

examples.en: The aim in bowling is to knock down all the pins with one or two bowls.
examples.zh: 保龄球的目标是一球或两球击倒所有保龄球瓶。

examples.en: He knocked his opponent down with one blow in the competition.
examples.zh: 比赛中他一拳就打倒了对手。

examples.en: It is known to all that lack of sleep will contribute to memory decline.
examples.zh: 众所周知，睡眠不足会导致记忆力下降。

items.explanation: 作“听说过”解时，是指对某事/人有所知或耳闻，但不一定认识。

examples.en: I know about him but I don't know him.
examples.zh: 我听说过他，但不认识他。

items.explanation: 作“见到过，听到过”解时，只能用于过去时和完成时；指认识，是指熟悉、了解的，可作及物动词或不及物动词；亦可作“知道”解，是指某一事，这一事实。

examples.en: I have known him for 5 years.
examples.zh: 我认识他 5 年了。

examples.en: I know you're right.
examples.zh: 我知道你是对的。

items.explanation: 指认识曾经见过的人、事物或听过的声音，但不一定是熟悉的。意为“认出，认清，承认”，只作及物动词。

examples.en: I recognized Peter although I hadn't seen him for 10 years.
examples.zh: 虽然我有 10 年没见到彼得了，但我还是认出了他。

items.explanation: 作“理解，领会”解，是指彻底告知某事，同时也是意识到某事和其他事情的关系。

examples.en: We comprehended where our duties lay.
examples.zh: 我们领悟到我们的职责所在。

items.explanation: 作“理解；了解”解，不但指某事的意义，而且知其内涵。

examples.en: I comprehended all that he said, but I failed to understand why he was so upset.
examples.zh: 我理解他所说的一切，但我不能理解他为什么那么心烦意乱。

examples.en: It's essential for a student majoring in economics to have a good knowledge of finance/rich financial knowledge.
examples.zh: 具有丰富的金融知识，对于一个主修经济学的学生而言是绝对必要的。

items.explanation: 指通过书本学习或经验获得知识。

examples.en: He has grown in knowledge.
examples.zh: 他的知识有了长进。

items.explanation: 指通过研究而获得的学识。

examples.en: She is a man of learning.
examples.zh: 她是一个博学之士。

items.explanation: 指技能，即有熟练做某事的能力。

examples.en: She plays the piano with skill.
examples.zh: 她钢琴弹得熟练。

items.explanation: 指积累的经验。

examples.en: He is a man of experience.
examples.zh: 他是个经验丰富的人。

examples.en: She's a knowledgeable woman.
examples.zh: 她是个知识渊博的女人。

examples.en: Please keep me informed of the progress of the experiment.
examples.zh: 请随时告知我实验的进展情况。

examples.en: Please keep me informed of the progress of the experiment.
examples.zh: 请随时告知我实验的进展情况。

examples.en: I've asked several friends to keep an eye on a job vacancy.
examples.zh: 我已请了几个朋友帮忙留意空缺的职位。

examples.en: Do you still keep in contact with your best friend in elementary school?
examples.zh: 你仍然和你小学时最好的朋友保持联系吗？

examples.en: The climbers kept on in the hope of reaching the top with one last effort.
examples.zh: 登山队员们继续前进，希望最后一鼓作气到达峰顶。

examples.en: Senior citizens can benefit from having a pet to keep them company.
examples.zh: 有一只宠物相伴对老年人很有好处。

examples.en: TV helps people to kill time and drive off their loneliness.
examples.zh: 电视有助于人们打发时间，驱除孤独。

examples.en: We usually have Science in the science lab.
examples.zh: 我们通常在科学实验室里上科学课。

examples.en: An attractive label is very necessary.
examples.zh: 具有吸引力的标签非常必要。

examples.en: COVID-19, as it's been labeled, is understood to be a new strain of coronavirus that has not previously been identified in humans.
examples.zh: 被命名为 COVID-19 的这种新型冠状病毒此前未在人类身上发现过。

examples.en: They have succeeded by their own labour.
examples.zh: 他们通过自己的努力获得了成功。

examples.en: For lack of water, the villagers in that area dug many wells to solve the problem of drinking water.
examples.zh: 由于缺水，那个地区的村民们挖了许多井来解决饮水问题。

examples.en: He lacks courage.
examples.zh: 他缺乏勇气。

items.explanation: 为名词词组，作“缺乏”解。

examples.en: The plant died for lack of water. (= The plant died because it is short of water.)
examples.zh: 由于缺水，植物枯死了。

items.explanation: 为形容词词组，作“缺乏”解。

examples.en: With the help of a ladder, neighbours were able to rescue the children from the blaze.
examples.zh: 邻居们借助一把梯子把孩子们从大火中救了出来。

examples.en: Who is that beautiful young lady?
examples.zh: 那位年轻漂亮的女士是谁呀？

examples.en: The lake looks beautiful in the moonlight.
examples.zh: 在月光下，湖看起来很漂亮。

examples.en: I prefer lamb chops to pork chops.
examples.zh: 我喜欢小羊排胜过猪排。

examples.en: Was he blind in the right eye and lame in the left foot?
examples.zh: 他是不是右眼瞎左脚瘸？

examples.en: The lamp is powered by two small batteries.
examples.zh: 这盏灯由两节小电池供电。

examples.en: The moment he stepped on the foreign land, Li Hua realized that it was important to follow the local customs.
examples.zh: 从踏上陌生国土的那一刻起，李华就意识到入乡随俗至关重要。

examples.en: The plane will land in five minutes.
examples.zh: 飞机将在 5 分钟后降落。

items.explanation: 陆地 (相对于海洋、泽地而言)

examples.en: Travelling at sea is more comfortable than travelling over land.
examples.zh: 海上旅行比陆上旅行更舒适。

items.explanation: 地面

examples.en: They sat on the ground, eating fast food.
examples.zh: 他们坐在地上吃快餐。

items.explanation: 陆地 (相对于天空而言)

examples.en: The spaceship is expected to return to earth after three days' flight.
examples.zh: 宇宙飞船预计经过 3 天飞行后返回地面。

items.explanation: 土壤 (指植物生长的表层土)

examples.en: The flood carried away the rich soil.
examples.zh: 洪水冲走了沃土。

items.explanation: 泥浆

examples.en: Rain turned dust into mud.
examples.zh: 雨将尘土化为泥浆。

examples.en: He was in an argument with his landlord downstairs.
examples.zh: 他与楼下的房东发生了争执。

examples.en: A winding footpath goes through the forest, which has become the characteristic landscape of the area.
examples.zh: 一条蜿蜒的步道穿过森林，成为该地区的特色景观。

examples.en: the inside lane
examples.zh: 内车道

l.name: It is a long lane that has no turning.

examples.en: The Chinese language is one of the most difficult languages in the world, so people who are learning it soon feel themselves challenged.
examples.zh: 汉语是世界上最难的语言之一，学习这种语言的人很快就会发现自己遇到了挑战。

examples.en: The beauty of traditional lanterns lies in the integration of candlelight and paper-cutting.
examples.zh: 烛光和剪纸的交融构成了传统灯笼之美。

examples.en: She kept her hands folded in her lap.
examples.zh: 她双手合拢，放在腿上。

examples.en: The waves lapped around our feet.
examples.zh: 波浪轻轻地拍打着我们的脚。

examples.en: It is significantly more compact than any comparable laptop, with no loss in functionality.
examples.zh: 它比同类笔记本电脑小巧很多，但功能未减。

examples.en: With an area of 200,000 square metres, the new National Museum has become the largest museum in the world.
examples.zh: 新的国家博物馆占地面积 20 万平方米，已成为世界上最大的博物馆。

items.explanation: 指面积、数量、容量、范围的“大”，有“广大的，规模巨大的”之意。

examples.en: a large size shoe
examples.zh: 大码鞋子

examples.en: a large number of visitors
examples.zh: 大批来访者

items.explanation: 强调体积、重量、容积的“大”，有“重的，重而大的”之意。

examples.en: The box is too big to carry.
examples.zh: 这盒子大得拿不动。

examples.en: laser radiation
examples.zh: 激光辐射

examples.en: The children have been chatting about their travel plan since last week.
examples.zh: 自上周起，孩子们就一直在聊出游计划。

examples.en: The last of the tests was held today.
examples.zh: 今天举行了最后一场考试。

examples.en: The meeting will last three hours.
examples.zh: 会议将持续 3 个小时。

examples.en: The late twentieth century witnessed the rapid development of China's economy.
examples.zh: 20 世纪末中国经济迅速发展。

examples.en: The children sat up late watching TV yesterday evening.
examples.zh: 昨晚孩子们看电视看到很晚才睡。

l.name: It is never too late to mend.

examples.en: Have you been on a bus lately?
examples.zh: 你最近乘过公共汽车吗？

examples.en: The late edition of this paper appears at 3 p.m.; there is a later one at 5 p.m.
examples.zh: 这份报纸的晚版于下午 3 时出版，下午 5 时还有更晚的一版。

examples.en: The young man fell in love with a lovely girl and they got married two months later.
examples.zh: 这个年轻人爱上了一个可爱的姑娘，两个月后，他们结婚了。

examples.en: This is only a rough idea; I'll go into details later on.
examples.zh: 这只是粗略想法，以后我将详加说明。

examples.en: The word “boring” never applies to his latest cartoons.
examples.zh: “乏味”这个词和他最新的漫画沾不上边。(松江)

examples.en: Did he walk or swim? The latter seems unlikely.
examples.zh: 他是散步还是游泳？后者看来不太可能。

examples.en: The funny story told by Michael made the little girl laugh a lot.
examples.zh: 迈克尔讲了有趣的故事，使得这个小女孩笑了很久。

examples.en: I laughed myself silly.
examples.zh: 我笑得撑不住了。

examples.en: Lysenko gave a deep rumbling laugh at his own joke.
examples.zh: 李森科对自己讲的笑话报以朗声大笑。

items.explanation: 是可数名词，作“笑；笑声”解。

examples.en: She said with a short laugh.
examples.zh: 她笑了笑说。

items.explanation: 是不可数名词，作“笑；笑声”解，等于 laughing。

examples.en: She let out a shriek of laughter.
examples.zh: 她发出一阵尖声的大笑。

l.name: He who laughs last laughs best.
trans: 谁笑到最后，谁笑得最好。

examples.en: burst into laughter
examples.zh: 突然大笑起来

examples.en: Rockets are being successfully launched and continuously updated, symbolising the increasingly strong national strength and rapid technological advancement of our country.
examples.zh: 火箭成功发射并不断更新换代，这些都是我国国力日益强盛、科技实力日新月异的象征。(金山)

examples.en: I sent the clothes to the laundry.
examples.zh: 我把衣服送去了洗衣店。

examples.en: I can't find the lavatory.
examples.zh: 我找不到厕所。

examples.en: Despite the serious air pollution, policemen still stick to the posts in the rush hours and strictly carry out the law to ensure the smooth traffic.
examples.zh: 尽管空气污染严重，警察仍在高蜂时段坚守岗位，严格执法，确保交通畅通。

examples.en: My mother asked me to mow the lawn.
examples.zh: 妈妈让我去修剪草坪。

examples.en: George is boasting everywhere that he is on the way to becoming a lawyer.
examples.zh: 乔治到处吹嘘他快要成为一名律师了。

examples.en: Lay it on the table.
examples.zh: 把它放在桌上。

examples.en: a layer of clay
examples.zh: 黏土层

examples.en: He is a lazy boy.
examples.zh: 他是个懒家伙。

examples.en: A careless comment of his has led to some unnecessary misunderstanding.
examples.zh: 他漫不经心的一句评论引起了一些不必要的误会。

examples.en: He took Dickon by the hand to lead him into the house.
examples.zh: 他牵着迪康的手，把他领进屋。

examples.en: He always takes the lead in response to the government's call.
examples.zh: 他总是带头响应政府的号召。

examples.en: The stairs leading to the basement are very slippery.
examples.zh: 通往地下室的楼梯很滑。

examples.en: Will the government's policies lead to an economic recovery?
examples.zh: 政府的政策能使经济复苏吗？

examples.en: Accompanied by the leader, they visited the hospital.
examples.zh: 在领导的陪同下，他们参观了医院。

examples.en: She lacks leadership.
examples.zh: 她缺乏领导才能。

examples.en: sweep up the dead leaves
examples.zh: 扫落叶

examples.en: He leafed idly through a magazine while waiting.
examples.zh: 在等候时，他无聊地浏览杂志。

examples.en: advertising leaflets
examples.zh: 广告传单

examples.en: The three nations united in a league of friendship.
examples.zh: 这三个国家结成友好同盟。

examples.en: The ship was leaking badly.
examples.zh: 这艘船漏得厉害。

examples.en: Last year, a civil servant was imprisoned for leaking a document to the press.
examples.zh: 去年，一名公务员因向报界泄露了一份文件而被判入狱。

examples.en: The news of the radiation leak caused widespread public alarm.
examples.zh: 辐射泄露的消息引起了公众的普遍恐慌。

examples.en: She leaned against his shoulder.
examples.zh: 她靠在他的肩上。

examples.en: The pagoda seems to be on the lean.
examples.zh: 这座塔似乎有些倾斜。

examples.en: The dog leapt over the fence.
examples.zh: 狗跳过了围栏。

examples.en: The dog made a leap over the fence.
examples.zh: 狗跳过了围栏。

examples.en: Do not leap headlong into decisions.
examples.zh: 不要轻率地做决定。

examples.en: We are quite shocked to learn that several hundred plants disappear every year on the earth.
examples.zh: 得知地球上每年有几百种植物消失时，我们大家都非常震惊。

l.name: Learn young, learn fair.
trans: 学习趁年轻，要学就学好。

examples.en: He is a serious scholar, a genuinely learned man.
examples.zh: 他是一位严谨的学者，一个真正的学问家。

examples.en: There's no point in doing countless exercises blindly because the key to learning is to know what it is and why it is so.
examples.zh: 盲目刷题毫无意义，学习的关键是要知其然，知其所以然。(浦东)

examples.en: On education funding, Japan performs best but spends the least per student.
examples.zh: 在教育投资方面，日本花在每位学生身上的钱最少，但却做得最好。

examples.en: The least noise would startle the child.
examples.zh: 最小的响声也会使孩子受惊吓。

examples.en: a leather coat
examples.zh: 皮衣

examples.en: For the sake of safety, children should not be left alone at home.
examples.zh: 为了安全起见，小孩不应该被单独留在家里。

l.name: leave + 过去分词
trans: 让(表示继续处于某种状态)

l.name: leave + 现在分词
trans: 让(表示继续处于某种状态)

l.name: leave + 形容词
trans: 让(表示继续处于某种状态)

examples.en: Leave him alone, for he has already become blind drunk.
examples.zh: 不要管他了，他已经烂醉如泥了。

examples.en: He wants to ask for a leave.
examples.zh: 他想请假。

examples.en: He gave us a lecture on physics.
examples.zh: 他给我们做了一次有关物理学的演讲。

examples.en: I am going to lecture to my students today.
examples.zh: 今天我准备给学生们讲课。

items.explanation: 意为“演讲；讲课”，指有准备的专题讲座，尤指学术性演讲及学校教师讲课。

examples.en: a series of lectures on philosophy
examples.zh: 哲学系列讲座

items.explanation: 意为“说话；演讲”，可以是有准备的讲话，也可以指无准备的讲话。

examples.en: By your speech I can tell you're from America.
examples.zh: 根据你的讲话，我能断定你是美国人。

examples.en: As a lecturer, I have been engaged in English teaching for ten years.
examples.zh: 作为讲师，我从事英语教学工作已有 10 年了。

examples.en: Put up your left hand.
examples.zh: 举起左手。

examples.en: The school is on the left of the road.
examples.zh: 学校在马路的左边。

examples.en: My legs still hurt due to a long walk yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我走了很长一段路，现在两条腿还在疼。

examples.en: legal aid
examples.zh: 法律援助（免费提供律师服务）

examples.en: What do you do in your leisure time?
examples.zh: 你空闲时间做些什么？

examples.en: I scarcely have leisure for football this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午我没有空踢足球。

examples.en: A lemon is an acid fruit.
examples.zh: 柠檬是一种酸味水果。

examples.en: You should lend a hand to whoever is in trouble.
examples.zh: 无论谁有麻烦，你都应该伸出援助之手。

items.explanation: 意为“借出”，表示把某物借给别人。它可接双宾语，也可与介词 to 连用。

examples.en: She lent some money to me.
examples.zh: 她借给我一些钱。

items.explanation: 意为“借进”，表示把某物借入。它不能接双宾语，常和介词 from 连用。

examples.en: Can I borrow a bike from you?
examples.zh: 我能问你借辆自行车吗？

items.explanation: 意为“借进”，可以与表示一段时间的状语连用 (how long, for two weeks)。

examples.en: I've kept the book for two days.
examples.zh: 这本书我已经借了两天了。

examples.en: Mary's dress is not the right length; it is too short.
examples.zh: 玛丽的衣服长短不合适，太短了。

examples.en: As time went by, we saw less and less of each other.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们见面越来越少。

examples.en: The saying that there should be more understanding and less finger-pointing can apply to every aspect in our life, and its positive impact on society can't be underestimated.
examples.zh: “多一分理解，少一分指责”，这句话适用于生活的方方面面，它对社会的积极影响不可小觑。

examples.en: You have to learn a good lesson from your failure.
examples.zh: 你得学会从失败中吸取教训。

examples.en: Don't let such a thing happen again, or you will lose your job!
examples.zh: 不要让这样的事情再次发生，否则你会失去工作！

examples.en: The flat lets for 6,500 yuan a month.
examples.zh: 这套公寓每月租金 6500 元。

l.name: Let's cross the bridge when we come to it.

examples.en: When she saw him, she let out a cry of horror.
examples.zh: 她看见他时吓得大叫一声。

examples.en: Each time he moved his leg, he let out a moan.
examples.zh: 他每移动一次腿，都呻吟一声。

examples.en: What did your son say in the letter?
examples.zh: 你儿子在信里说什么了？

examples.en: Governments of different levels consider it their duty to care about the people's welfare.
examples.zh: 各级政府都把关心人民的福祉当作自己的责任。

examples.en: We need a level piece of ground to play football on.
examples.zh: 我们踢足球需要一块平地。

examples.en: The Cincinnati Reds have levelled the score in the National League play-off against the Pittsburgh Pirates.
examples.zh: 在国家联盟季后赛中，辛辛那提红人队扳平了与匹兹堡海盗队的比分。

examples.en: liberate the mind from prejudice
examples.zh: 解除心中偏见

examples.en: Many countries have national holidays that commemorate their liberation from colonial rule.
examples.zh: 许多国家都有纪念它们从殖民统治中解放出来的国家节日。

examples.en: The constitution guards the liberty of the people.
examples.zh: 宪法保障人民的自由。

examples.en: I found the book with the help of the librarian.
examples.zh: 在图书馆管理员的帮助下，我找到了那本书。

examples.en: It was not until he entered the university that he realized how important the library was to his study.
examples.zh: 直到进入大学，他才意识到图书馆对学习有多重要。

examples.en: a license to sell spirits
examples.zh: 出售酒类的许可证

senses.trans: 许可(从事某行业或活动)

examples.en: license sb. to practise as a doctor
examples.zh: 批准某人开业行医

examples.en: He lifted the lid of the box and looked inside.
examples.zh: 他掀起盖子朝盒子里面看。

examples.en: He was lying in the shade of the tree.
examples.zh: 他正躺在树荫下。

examples.en: I'm sorry I lied to you.
examples.zh: 我很抱歉向你撒了谎。

examples.en: Li Lei would rather be punished than tell lies.
examples.zh: 李雷宁愿受罚也不愿说谎。

items.explanation: 作“说谎”解时，它的过去式、过去分词和现在分词为 lied、lied、lying；作“躺，卧，位于”解时，它的过去式、过去分词和现在分词为 lay、lain、lying。
作“放置，铺设，产(卵)，提出，平息，布置”解时，它的过去式、过去分词和现在分词为 laid、laid、laying。

examples.en: My first wish is to stay healthy all my life.
examples.zh: 我的第一个愿望就是一辈子健康。

items.explanation: 泛指“生活”时，life 为不可数名词。

examples.en: city life
examples.zh: 城市生活

items.explanation: 表示某种方式的“生活”时，life 为可数名词，其复数形式为 lives。

examples.en: They lived idle lives in those years.
examples.zh: 那些年他们过着悠闲的生活。

examples.en: Their profligate lifestyle resulted in bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 他们挥霍的生活方式导致了破产。

examples.en: The lift is out of order again.
examples.zh: 这部电梯又出了故障。

examples.en: This box is too heavy for me to lift.
examples.zh: 这箱子太重，我搬不动。

examples.en: If you lift up the chair, I'll clean the carpet underneath it.
examples.zh: 你如果把椅子抬起来，我就把它下面的地毯清扫一下。

items.explanation: vt. 举起，使升高；提高；提出；饲养

examples.en: A team of horses ran over a dirt road, raising a cloud of dust.
examples.zh: 一群马跑过泥灰路，扬起一片尘土。

examples.en: We don't want this matter to be raised again at the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们不希望在会议上再次提出这件事情。

examples.en: His job was to raise chickens.
examples.zh: 他的工作是养鸡。

items.explanation: vi. 上升，升起；起立；上涨；增长

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
examples.zh: 太阳从东方升起。

examples.en: Early to bed and early to rise makes a person healthy and wise.
examples.zh: 早睡早起，健康聪明。

examples.en: Purchasing power has risen by 20% within the past ten years.
examples.zh: 在过去的 10 年间，购买力增长了 20%。

items.explanation: vt. 举起，抬起（强调用力向上举起重物。引申后可作“提高水平、地位”解）

examples.en: That box was too heavy for her to lift.
examples.zh: 那个箱子太重，她拿不起来。

examples.en: We must lift/raise the level of our scientific research.
examples.zh: 我们必须提高我们的科研水平。

examples.en: It was nice of him to give us a lift to the office this morning.
examples.zh: 他真好，今天早上让我们搭便车到办公室。

examples.en: I'm accustomed to listening to some light music before sleep.
examples.zh: 我习惯睡前听点轻音乐。

examples.en: The sun gives us light during the day.
examples.zh: 白天，太阳给我们光亮。

examples.en: Will you light the fire for me?
examples.zh: 你替我点上火好吗？

discriminations.intro: 这两个词都是 light 的过去式和过去分词形式。作谓语动词用时，lighted 较多用于指“点燃”的场合。lit 较多用于其他场合，如“照亮，使发亮”。作前置定语时，倘若本身不带其他修饰词，用 lighted，若本身带有修饰词，用 lit 更多见。

items.explanation: 较多用于指“点燃”的场合；作前置定语时，倘若本身不带其他修饰词，用 lighted。

examples.en: He lighted a cigarette.
examples.zh: 他点了一支烟。

examples.en: a lighted lamp
examples.zh: 一盏照明灯

items.explanation: 较多用于其他场合，如“照亮，使发亮”；若本身带有修饰词，用 lit 更多见。

examples.en: His face lit up with happiness.
examples.zh: 他脸上喜气洋洋。

examples.en: a brightly lit room
examples.zh: 一个明亮的房间

examples.en: with lightning speed
examples.zh: 以闪电般的速度

examples.en: Two farmers were struck by lightning.
examples.zh: 两位农民遭到了闪电袭击。

examples.en: In the Western countries like the United State, it is hard for a writer to make a living only by writing.
examples.zh: 在美国这样的西方国家，作家单靠写作来谋生是很难的。

examples.en: How do you like the film Avatar?
examples.zh: 你认为电影《阿凡达》怎么样？

examples.en: If you can find whatever learning method that suits you, your learning efficiency is likely to improve remarkably.
examples.zh: 如果能找到任何适合的学习方法，你的学习效率就可能明显提高。

examples.en: Most likely he has gone.
examples.zh: 很可能他已经走了。

discriminations.intro: 注意：1. 主语是人，不能用 possible、probable。 2. 在 It is ... that 的句型中这三个词都可用。 3. 在 It is ... for sb. to do sth. 的句型中只能用 possible。 4. probable 不能与动词不定式连用。

items.explanation: 或许的，很可能的（侧重根据表面迹象做判断）

examples.en: They are likely to come here by taxi.
examples.zh: 他们很有可能乘出租车来。

items.explanation: 可能的（强调客观的或理论上的可能性，常暗示实际希望不大）

examples.en: If it is possible, I'll help you.
examples.zh: 如有可能的话，我会帮你的。

items.explanation: 大概的，很可能的（语气较强，常指根据正反两方面的各种情况推断出可能性）

examples.en: It is possible that it will rain if the wind changes, but with such a cloudless sky it doesn't seem probable.
examples.zh: 如果风向改变，可能会下雨；但在这样一个万里无云的天气里，不太可能下雨。

examples.en: Risk-taking is a way of life for those who repeatedly challenge the limits.
examples.zh: 对于一再挑战极限的人来说，冒险是一种生活方式。

examples.en: We must limit the amount of money we spend.
examples.zh: 我们必须控制花费。

examples.en: We are doing our best with the limited resources available.
examples.zh: 我们利用可获得的有限资源，尽最大的努力。

examples.en: We have a washing line on which we hang clothes to dry.
examples.zh: 我们有一根挂晾衣服的晾衣绳。

examples.en: People lined the streets to see the famous man go past.
examples.zh: 人们站在街道两旁，看着那位著名人士走过。

examples.en: The costs were very much in line with what we had expected.
examples.zh: 费用和我们预计的非常吻合。

examples.en: The costs were very much in line with what we had expected.
examples.zh: 费用和我们预计的非常吻合。

examples.en: Do you know the link between smoking and lung cancer?
examples.zh: 吸烟和肺癌之间的关系，你知道吗？

examples.en: Some people link the world warming to the El Nino Phenomenon.
examples.zh: 有些人把全球气温上升跟厄尔尼诺现象联系在一起。

examples.en: I think it important to link up theory with practice.
examples.zh: 我认为理论联系实践很重要。

examples.en: She was frightened by the roars of a lion.
examples.zh: 她被狮子的吼叫声吓呆了。

examples.en: the upper lip
examples.zh: 上嘴唇

examples.en: Air is a fluid but not a liquid.
examples.zh: 空气是流体，不是液体。

examples.en: He made a list of the things he wanted.
examples.zh: 他开出他所需物品的清单。

examples.en: He listed a lot of advantages of living in the city.
examples.zh: 他列举了许多住在城市的好处。

senses.trans: 把……编造成(或列入)一览表(或目录)

examples.en: Believe it or not, it is advisable to listen to others and take their advice.
examples.zh: 不管你信不信，善于倾听并采纳别人的意见是明智的。

examples.en: I can't believe that he failed the literacy test.
examples.zh: 我无法相信他识字测试不及格。

examples.en: It is context and convention that determine whether a term will be interpreted literally or metaphorically.
examples.zh: 对一个词的理解是按本义还是比喻义，要根据上下文和习惯。

examples.en: He made little literary accomplishment.
examples.zh: 他在文学方面成就就不多。

examples.en: Mo Yan was awarded the 2012 Nobel Prize for Literature.
examples.zh: 莫言获得 2012 年诺贝尔文学奖。

examples.en: One litre equals to 1 000 millilitres.
examples.zh: 1 升等于 1000 毫升。

examples.en: Don't leave litter everywhere.
examples.zh: 不要把垃圾扔得到处都是。

examples.en: I do not think you should litter things about.
examples.zh: 我认为你不应该把东西到处乱扔。

examples.en: If you litter, you will spoil the natural beauty of the surroundings.
examples.zh: 如果你随手乱扔垃圾的话，就会破坏周围环境的自然美。

examples.en: Put all the refuse in the litterbin.
examples.zh: 把这些垃圾都放在垃圾箱里。

senses.trans: 不多的，少到几乎没有的

examples.en: Most children have so little close contact with adults except their parents and teachers that they have little idea of what adult life is like.
examples.zh: 大多数孩子很少与父母和老师之外的成年人有密切的接触，他们对大人的生活鲜有概念。

examples.en: Miss Wang has got a big room to live in.
examples.zh: 王小姐住在一间大房间里。

examples.en: Were it not for science, we could not live a comfortable life.
examples.zh: 若非科学，我们无法过上舒适的生活。

l.name: live by
trans: 靠……维持生活 (强调的是维持生活所使用的手段和方法)

l.name: live on
trans: 以……为生计 (常以表示食物、工资及人的名词作宾语)

examples.en: The cat was playing with a live mouse.
examples.zh: 那只猫在玩一只活老鼠。

examples.en: Colorful umbrellas add to a lively atmosphere in the summer streets.
examples.zh: 各色雨伞给夏日街头增添了活泼的气氛。

items.explanation: 意为“活的；有生命的”，常作定语，多用于物。

examples.en: a live fish
examples.zh: 一条活鱼

items.explanation: 作形容词，意为“活着的”，既可用于人，也可用于物，可作表语，也可作定语，相对 dead 而言。

examples.en: The boy has no living relatives.
examples.zh: 这男孩没有活着的亲人。

items.explanation: 意为“活着的”，一般作表语，有时可作后置定语。

examples.en: a bird alive
examples.zh: 一只活鸟

items.explanation: 意为“生动的；灵敏的”。

examples.en: The teacher made her lessons interesting and lively.
examples.zh: 这位老师的课上得既生动又有趣。

examples.en: Excessive dosage of this drug can result in injury to the liver.
examples.zh: 这种药使用过量会损害肝脏。

examples.en: Physiology is the study of how living things work.
examples.zh: 生理学是研究生物功能的学科。

examples.en: People in this country enjoy a high standard of living.
examples.zh: 这个国家的人民享有很高的生活水平。

examples.en: Advances were made to benefit the living.
examples.zh: 取得的进展可以造福活着的人。

examples.en: We loaded the truck with bananas.
examples.zh: 我们把香蕉装上卡车。

examples.en: The ship is loading for Qingdao.
examples.zh: 这艘船正在装货运往青岛。

examples.en: The truck was carrying a load of bananas.
examples.zh: 这辆卡车装着一车香蕉。

examples.en: to bake a loaf of bread
examples.zh: 烤一块面包

examples.en: a low interest loan
examples.zh: 一笔低息贷款

examples.en: He loaned me a book.
examples.zh: 他借给我一本书。

examples.en: The entertainment park to be completed next year can create 50,000 new jobs for the local area.
examples.zh: 这个明年将竣工的游乐园可为当地创造 5 万个新职位。

items.explanation: 指“当地的；地方上的”，尤指人生活的地方。

examples.en: local dialect
examples.zh: 当地方言

items.explanation: 指“本国的；本土的”，尤指人出生的地方。

examples.en: native language
examples.zh: 本国语，母语

examples.en: Although this restaurant is not ideally located, it is quite popular among diners because of its rich dishes and excellent service.
examples.zh: 这家饭店虽然地段不佳，但因菜肴丰富、服务优质而深受食客青睐。

examples.en: Shenzhen is located in the south of China.
examples.zh: 深圳位于华南。

examples.en: Have they decided on the location of the new building yet?
examples.zh: 这座新建物的选址他们定下来了吗？

examples.en: Lock the stable door after the horse has been stolen.
examples.zh: 贼去关门，为时已晚。

examples.en: Someone has locked up the house.
examples.zh: 有人把房子锁起来了。

examples.en: We're having new locks fitted on all the doors of the classrooms.
examples.zh: 我们正在给所有的教室门安装新锁。

examples.en: At the swimming pool I put my clothes in a locker.
examples.zh: 在游泳池我把衣服锁在小柜里。

examples.en: They are sawing a log into planks.
examples.zh: 他们把原木锯成一块块厚板。

examples.en: Do you know how to log into the system?
examples.zh: 你知道怎么登录进入这个系统吗？

examples.en: His thinking goes against all logic.
examples.zh: 他的思维完全不合逻辑。

examples.en: Nowadays more and more children are so dependent on computers that they can't think in a logical way.
examples.zh: 现在越来越多孩子太依赖电脑，无法用逻辑来思考问题。

examples.en: The International Stock Exchange started life as a coffee shop in London.
examples.zh: 国际证券交易所起初是伦敦的一家咖啡馆。

examples.en: He doesn't feel lonely when he is left alone.
examples.zh: 在只剩他一个人的时候，他并不感到孤独。

items.explanation: 表示“独自一人”，即可作形容词 (只作表语)，也可作副词。

examples.en: He went alone.
examples.zh: 他一个人去了。

items.explanation: 意为“孤独的；寂寞的”，可作定语或表语，指地点时，则表示“荒凉”。

examples.en: a lonely man
examples.zh: 一位孤独的人

examples.en: Looking at the children's longing eyes for knowledge, the volunteer teacher gave up his high paying job in the city without hesitation and chose to stay in this small mountain village.
examples.zh: 看着孩子们渴求知识的眼睛，这位支教老师义无反顾地放弃了城市里的高薪工作，选择了留在这个小山村。

examples.en: They long for victory, yet shrink from fight.
examples.zh: 他们渴望胜利，但面对斗争又退缩了。

examples.en: So excited was she that she failed to fall asleep the whole night when she learned she had been admitted to the university she had been dreaming of for a long time.
examples.zh: 得知自己被那所梦寐以求的大学录取时，她是如此激动以至于彻夜未眠。

examples.en: a long-term contract
examples.zh: 长期合同

examples.en: They all looked happily at the teacher when he told them the good news.
examples.zh: 当老师告诉他们这个好消息时，他们都开心地看着他。

examples.en: The famous actor kept his good looks even in old age.
examples.zh: 这位著名的演员即使年老仍保持着好看的容貌。

discriminations.intro: look 与 see, watch, notice 的区别：

items.explanation: 指行为的过程，强调有意识地去看，但不一定看到。它是不及物动词，后接宾语时要与介词 at 连用。

examples.en: Please look at the blackboard.
examples.zh: 请看黑板。

items.explanation: 指行为的结果，强调通过视觉器官看见物体。可以是有意识地看，也可以不是；看电影要用 see。

examples.en: She looked but saw no one around.
examples.zh: 她看了看周围，但没有看到任何人。

items.explanation: 指行为的过程，强调全神贯注地看，含有欣赏意味，常用于看比赛、戏、电视、表演等。

examples.en: They are watching TV now.
examples.zh: 他们现在正在看电视。

items.explanation: 指行为的结果，意为“注意到，觉察到”。

examples.en: Please notice the regulations overleaf.
examples.zh: 请注意本页反面的规章。

discriminations.intro: refer to 与 look up 的区别：

items.explanation: 作“查阅，参考”解，后接要查阅的书籍、笔记等。

examples.en: When he gives a lecture, he never refers to his notes.
examples.zh: 当他做讲座的时候，从来不看稿子。

items.explanation: 作“从某书中查出……”解，后接要查出的东西。

examples.en: Please look up the word in your dictionary.
examples.zh: 请在词典中查一下这个单词。

examples.en: She is too busy to look after her child.
examples.zh: 她太忙，没有时间照料孩子。

examples.en: My husband climbed down into the hole and began to look around.
examples.zh: 我的丈夫爬到洞下面开始四处张望。

examples.en: He looked around and caught a man putting his hand into the pocket of a passenger.
examples.zh: 他环顾四周，发现一名男子正把手伸进一名乘客的口袋。

examples.en: I can look back on things with a clear conscience.
examples.zh: 我可以问心无愧地回首过去。

examples.en: I like to look back on my high-school days, which were the happiest in my life.
examples.zh: 我喜欢回顾我的高中时代，那是我生命中最快乐的时光。

examples.en: I wish you wouldn't look down on this kind of work.
examples.zh: 我希望你不要看不起这种工作。

examples.en: Gone are the days when women were looked down upon.
examples.zh: 妇女受轻视的年代一去不复返了。

examples.en: The searchers fanned out to look for the missing man.
examples.zh: 搜寻人员四下散开寻找失踪者。

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you in the near future.
examples.zh: 我盼望着不久后收到你的信。

examples.en: They set up a working party to look into the issue.
examples.zh: 他们设立了一个特别工作组来调查这个问题。

examples.en: Once the police began to look into her past, all sorts of things came to light.
examples.zh: 一旦警方开始调查她的过去，一切才真相大白。

examples.en: Passers-by simply looked on as he was attacked.
examples.zh: 他遭人袭击，路人只在一边袖手旁观。

examples.en: Passers-by just looked on as a man was attacked.
examples.zh: 有一名男子遭袭击，路人只在一旁围观。

examples.en: What are the symptoms to look out for?
examples.zh: 有哪些症状需要注意？

examples.en: She swiveled round to look out of the window.
examples.zh: 她转过身去望窗外。

examples.en: Here's the essay for you to look over.
examples.zh: 这篇文章请你过目。

examples.en: Look through your old clothes and see if there's anything to give away.
examples.zh: 把你的旧衣服翻一翻，看看有没有可以送人的。

examples.en: I will look through these files and see if I can find a copy of the document.
examples.zh: 我会翻一下这些档案，看看能否找到该文件的复印件。

examples.en: I look to you to support me in this matter.
examples.zh: 在这件事上我要靠你支持。

examples.en: Children usually look to their parents for guidance and reassurance.
examples.zh: 儿童通常依靠他们的父母来获得指导和宽慰。

l.name: look up
trans: (在词典、参考书中等) 查检

examples.en: He looked up the number in the telephone directory.
examples.zh: 他在电话簿里查电话号码。

examples.en: I bought these chocolates loose, not in a box.
examples.zh: 我买的这些巧克力是散装的，不是盒装的。

examples.en: My belt is too tight; I must loosen it.
examples.zh: 我的腰带太紧，我必须松一松。

examples.en: a lorry driver
examples.zh: 卡车司机

examples.en: Despite the fact that he had been there many times, he still lost his way.
examples.zh: 尽管他已经去过那里很多次了，他还是迷路了。

examples.en: They always lose because they have no team spirit.
examples.zh: 他们总是输，因为他们没有团队精神。

examples.en: Did you report the loss of your car to the police?
examples.zh: 你丢车的事报警了吗？

examples.en: I was at a loss for what to do next.
examples.zh: 下一步该怎么做，我完全没谱。

examples.en: The man looked surprised and somewhat at a loss.
examples.zh: 那人看起来非常吃惊，也有点手足无措。

examples.en: He was at a loss for words to express his disappointment.
examples.zh: 他不知道用什么话表示他失望的心情。

examples.en: Lots of students went to the school hall to enjoy the wonderful paintings by Mr. Hu.
examples.zh: 很多学生来到学校礼堂欣赏胡先生的精彩画作。

examples.en: I feel a lot better today.
examples.zh: 我今天感到好多了。

examples.en: The teacher's voice is very loud; we can all hear it.
examples.zh: 老师的声音很大，我们都听得见。

examples.en: Pay compliments to those you love and care for before it is too late.
examples.zh: 趁一切还来得及，去赞美你爱着、关心着的人吧。

examples.en: The boy fell in love with the girl.
examples.zh: 这小伙子爱上了这个姑娘。

antonyms.name: unloved
trans: 无人喜欢 (去疼爱) 的

examples.en: The children are looking happily at these lovely dogs.
examples.zh: 孩子们高兴地看着这些可爱的狗。

examples.en: cast loving glances
examples.zh: 传送秋波

trans: [常用来构成复合词] 热爱……的

examples.en: In spite of the good reward and low risk, the market reaction toward the financial product recently launched by the bank was still muted.
examples.zh: 尽管回报丰厚且风险不大，市场对银行最近推出的金融产品仍反应冷淡。

examples.en: Examinations also lower the standards of teaching.
examples.zh: 考试也使教学水平降低。

examples.en: They are still among the most loyal customers.
examples.zh: 他们仍属最忠诚的客户。

examples.en: He showed his loyalty to the king.
examples.zh: 他向国王表明了他的忠诚。

examples.en: I had the luck to get a ticket.
examples.zh: 我侥幸弄到了一张票。

examples.en: She was lucky enough to be chosen for the team.
examples.zh: 她很幸运被选中加入此队。

examples.en: Nowadays, many airports use electronic equipment to check the forbidden items in the luggage passengers carry.
examples.zh: 如今，很多机场使用电子设备来检查旅客携带的行李中的违禁物品。

examples.en: The traditional Chinese lunar calendar divides the year into 24 solar terms.
examples.zh: 传统的中国农历将一年分为二十四节气。

examples.en: Nobody at the lunch table believed the truth of his story.

examples.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，我们将讨论如何顺利执行合同。

examples.en: We had better learn by heart as many sentence patterns as possible.
examples.zh: 我们最好能尽可能多背些句型。

examples.en: The ability to learn a lesson from one's failure is highly regarded in our school.
examples.zh: 在我们学校，从错误中吸取教训的能力是很被看重的。

examples.zh: 在我们学校，从错误中吸取教训的能力是很被看重的。

examples.en: There isn't enough room for us in the car, let alone two dogs and a cat.
examples.zh: 车子里连我们的地方都不够，更不必说两条狗和一只猫了。

examples.en: The greatest charm of traveling lies in the fact that it can provide people with new experiences.
examples.zh: 旅行的最大魅力在于它能为人们提供新的阅历。

examples.zh: 令我失望的是，电影没有我预想的那么好。

examples.zh: 批评者说他的改革导致了生活水平下降。

examples.en: I like to look back on my high-school days, which were the happiest in my life.
examples.zh: 我喜欢回顾我的高中时代，那是我生命中最快乐的时光。

examples.en: Gone are the days when women were looked down upon.
examples.zh: 妇女受轻视的年代一去不复返了。

examples.en: She has admirable leadership skills and is looked up to by her peers.
examples.zh: 她具有令人羡慕的领导才能，受到同龄人的敬佩。

examples.en: The biggest aim of study is to make students have the ability to conquer difficulties and keep learning instead of changing them into machines that only can handle tests.
examples.zh: 学习的最大目标是使学生拥有克服困难和持续学习的能力，而不是将他们变成只会应付考试的机器。

items.explanation: 指人工制造的“机器，机械”，常需用能源（如油）来工作，有时具有抽象意义，可不加冠词。

examples.en: a drilling machine
examples.zh: 钻床

items.explanation: 作“器具，器械，仪器”解，常指精密的器具或仪器。

examples.en: medical instruments
examples.zh: 医疗器械

items.explanation: 指“工具，器具”或“工作母机”，如铲子、锤子等，它们常比 machine 指的工具结构更简单或体积更小些。

examples.en: tool box
examples.zh: 工具箱

examples.en: On the customs declaration, the sender labeled the freight as agricultural machinery.
examples.zh: 在报关单上，寄货人将货物列为农用机械。

examples.en: The noise will drive me mad.
examples.zh: 这噪音会使我发疯的。

examples.en: Good morning, madam.
examples.zh: 夫人，早上好。

examples.en: I like reading this magazine.
examples.zh: 我喜欢读这本杂志。

examples.en: That music is really magic!
examples.zh: 那音乐真是美极了！

examples.en: The magician is going to perform magic at the party.
examples.zh: 这位魔术师将在晚会上表演魔术。

examples.en: I used to believe my mother had magical powers.
examples.zh: 我以前一直相信我母亲有魔力。

examples.en: The magnificent scene of the waterfall is a perfect delight to the eye.
examples.zh: 瀑布的宏伟景观真是好看极了。

examples.zh: 他刚解雇了他的女仆。

examples.en: This mail service is called Rural Free Delivery.
examples.zh: 这种邮政服务称为“农村免费邮递服务”。

examples.en: They asked her to mail him a letter.
examples.zh: 他们要她给他寄封信。

examples.en: A report must be mailed the next day.
examples.zh: 有份报告必须在第二天寄出。

examples.en: The main idea of the paragraph usually appears in the first sentence of the paragraph.
examples.zh: 段落的主要意思通常出现在段落的第一句上。

examples.en: It is more than 3,000 kilometers from Hawaii to the mainland of the United States.
examples.zh: 从夏威夷到美国本土有 3000 多公里。

examples.en: The two countries have maintained close relationship for a long time, including cultural exchange and all kinds of visits.
examples.zh: 两国长期以来一直保持密切的联系，包括文化交流及各种形式的访问。

examples.en: It's time for us to solve the major problem.
examples.zh: 是解决主要问题的时候了。

examples.en: She hopes to major in computer science when she enters that university.
examples.zh: 她希望进那所大学后主修计算机科学。

examples.en: Mathematics is my major.
examples.zh: 我的专业是数学。

examples.en: John majored in accounting and business administration in Harvard.
examples.zh: 约翰在哈佛大学主修的是会计和工商管理。

examples.en: The majority of foreign nationals working here have work permits.
examples.zh: 大多数在这里工作的外国人都有工作许可证。

examples.en: The Internet enables us to make more friends throughout the world.
examples.zh: 因特网使我们能在全世界广交朋友。

examples.en: When the bell rang, all the students make for the classroom.
examples.zh: 铃响了，学生们都涌向教室。

examples.zh: 小偷开着偷来的汽车溜掉了。

examples.en: It was difficult to make out the manager's handwriting.
examples.zh: 经理的字迹很难辨认。

examples.zh: 透过雾霭，我只能看见一个模糊的人影。

examples.zh: 我只是来弄清楚是否一切都在正轨上。

examples.en: Early biographers didn't hesitate to make up an admirable story or two about their hero.
examples.zh: 早期的传记作家常不惜弄虚作假，编造出一两个与英雄人物有关的美妙故事来。

examples.en: We need $50 to make up the sum required.
examples.zh: 我们还需要 50 美元以凑足所需要的数目。

examples.en: He leans over backwards to make up for what he has lost.
examples.zh: 他尽力弥补他的损失。

examples.en: Hard work can often make up for a lack of intelligence.
examples.zh: 勤能补拙。

examples.en: A school master is a male teacher.
examples.zh: 校长是位男老师。

examples.zh: 确认嫌疑人是一名白人男子。

examples.zh: 我喜欢和我的朋友一起去购物中心闲逛。

examples.en: Economic globalization is an inevitable trend of the development of economy, which is independent of man's will.
examples.zh: 经济全球化是经济发展的必然趋势，它是不以人类的意志为转移的。(崇明)

examples.zh: 士兵在这个检查站守了一星期。

examples.zh: 既然他答应帮助你，我肯定他一定会设法做到的。

examples.zh: 经理不在时谁负责？

examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢这产品，请随时向经理投诉。

examples.zh: 上个月一颗新的人造卫星被发射升空了。

examples.en: The film star waved to the crowd with an artificial smile.
examples.zh: 那个电影明星带着做作的微笑向人群挥手。

items.explanation: 人造的；合成的（指所造的东西不是单纯的某一物质的）

examples.en: Now many synthetic products have replaced the natural ones.
examples.zh: 现在有许多人工合成的产品替代了纯天然的产品。

examples.zh: 人们需要以自己的方式和时间来处理问题。

examples.zh: 我们期望尽可能的学生参与到“个人职业生涯规划”的主题活动中。

examples.en: There are not many chairs left in the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室里剩下的椅子不多。

items.explanation: 许多的（修饰复数或单数可数名词，与单数名词连用时，表示所包含的人员或物品的数目是众多的）

examples.en: There is a numerous library in our school.
examples.zh: 我们学校有一个藏书量很大的图书馆。

examples.zh: 自 2007 年以来，街景地图服务赢得了数百万用户。

examples.zh: 参赛者必须能够在 3.5 小时内完成半程马拉松比赛。(奉贤)

examples.zh: 他生于 2005 年 3 月 28 日。

examples.zh: 士兵们行进在街道上。

examples.en: It will make a full day's march.
examples.zh: 这要一整天的路程。

examples.zh: 有人在页边潦草地做了点注释。

examples.en: a marine plant

examples.zh: 如果你每天都复习一下，就可以获得好成绩。

examples.zh: 请在有问题的地方做个记号。

examples.zh: 自这款最新智能手机上市以来，就再没有其他手机对我更有吸引力了。

examples.zh: 不要匆忙结婚。

examples.zh: 他们相爱了，并想要结婚。

examples.zh: 人们认为这些是现代科学的奇迹。

examples.zh: 人人对他的勇气都惊叹不已。

examples.en: a marvellous film
examples.zh: 一部绝妙的电影

examples.en: We all wore masks at the party and no one knew who we were.
examples.zh: 在晚会上我们都戴着假面具，谁也认不出我们。

examples.en: There are masses of people in the hall.
examples.zh: 大厅里有很多人。

examples.en: The floods caused a massive loss of life.
examples.zh: 洪水造成许多人丧生。

examples.zh: 我觉得英语是一门很难掌握的语言。

examples.en: You are masters of our country.
examples.zh: 你们是国家的主人。

examples.zh: 她极有绘画天赋，不知接下来会有何等佳作面世。(杨浦)

examples.zh: 我觉得你的窗帘与墙纸不匹配。

examples.en: The colours match well.
examples.zh: 颜色配得很好。

examples.en: The shirt and blouse are a perfect match.
examples.zh: 这裙子和衬衫搭配得十分好。

examples.zh: 老师问我数学作业是否已经完成了。

examples.zh: 这是一件无关紧要的事。

examples.zh: 人生最重要的不是我们置身何处，而是我们将前往何方。

examples.zh: 他看上去强壮健康，其实患抑郁症多年了。

examples.zh: 中年人

examples.zh: 我们的计划还没有考虑成熟。

examples.zh: 你最多可向图书馆借 10 本书。

examples.zh: 他将要在 5 月毕业。

examples.zh: 遇到突发危险时，人会茫然不知所措，这是很正常的。

examples.zh: 天阴下来了，今天下午也许有雨。

examples.zh: 他肯定会当选为新市长。

examples.zh: 你真周到，帮我预先订好了票。

examples.zh: 在一些国家，用餐后不付小费是很失礼的事。

examples.zh: 18 岁意味着你要对自己的言行负责了。

examples.en: the mean age
examples.zh: 平均年龄

examples.en: He says his life has lost its meaning since his wife died.
examples.zh: 他说妻子死后他的生命就失去了价值。

examples.en: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are important means of maintaining good health.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼和均衡饮食是保持健康的重要方式。

items.explanation: 方法（指使用一定的工具或材料，采取一定的步骤做一件事情的方法）

examples.en: Do you have any means of identification?
examples.zh: 你有什么鉴定的方法吗？

items.explanation: 方式；方法（着重于“一件事情如何做的方式”）

examples.en: Do it in this way.
examples.zh: 用这种方法做。

items.explanation: 办法，方法（指做一件事情的具体技术）

examples.en: Do you know any new method of learning a language?
examples.zh: 你知道学习语言的新方法吗？

items.explanation: 措施，步骤

examples.en: The government has taken measures to make the air in Shanghai cleaner.
examples.zh: 政府已采取措施进一步净化上海的空气。

examples.en: You must get there by all means before dark.
examples.zh: 你们无论如何要在天黑以前到达那里。

examples.en: They tried to save the failing economy by means of tax increases.
examples.zh: 他们试图用增加税收的办法来挽救日益衰落的经济。

examples.en: Please find a taxi, and in the meantime I'll pack some food.
examples.zh: 请你叫辆出租车，趁这工夫我打包些食物。

examples.en: There is nearly half an hour left. Meanwhile let's play tennis.
examples.zh: 还剩下差不多半小时。在这段时间里，我们打网球吧。

examples.en: Mother measured me to see what size of dress I should have.
examples.zh: 母亲给我量尺寸，好知道我该穿什么码的衣服。

examples.en: Can he measure accurately?
examples.zh: 他能计量准确吗？

examples.en: a measure made by a surveyor
examples.zh: 勘测员所做的测量

examples.zh: 医生说：“朱先生，你最好不要吃太多的肉。你已经超重了。”

examples.en: a car mechanic
examples.zh: 汽车修理工

examples.zh: 火车因为机械故障停了下来。

examples.en: win a medal
examples.zh: 得奖章

examples.zh: 有些药品广告以虚假事实误导消费者，应该予以禁止。

examples.zh: 这种新药对病人是否有副作用还不知道。

examples.zh: 商业电视是一种广告媒介。

examples.en: He is of medium height.
examples.zh: 他中等身材。

examples.en: I met my teacher in the street today.
examples.zh: 我今天在街上遇见了我的老师。

examples.en: Studying abroad can help students learn foreign languages and know about foreign cultures, but students should take the difficulties that they may meet with into consideration.
examples.zh: 出国留学有助于学生学习外语和了解外国文化，但学生应该考虑可能遇到的困难。

examples.en: The sports meet was postponed because of rain.
examples.zh: 运动会因雨延期。

examples.en: The 8th School Sports Meeting was put off because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 因下大雨，第 8 届校运动会被推迟了。

examples.en: Would you like some melon?
examples.zh: 你要吃点瓜吗？

examples.en: Iron will melt when it is made very hot.
examples.zh: 当铁烧得很热时就会熔化。

examples.zh: 在团队精神的鼓舞下，研究小组的每个成员都为新项目作出了自己的贡献。

examples.zh: 这家俱乐部的会员总数为 300 人。

examples.zh: 我在备忘录上记下了要再买一些咖啡。

examples.zh: 这部电影因为两位主角的精湛演技而令人难忘。

examples.zh: 请写一份会议简报。

examples.zh: 纪念馆展出了许多图片和实物。

examples.en: erect a memorial to a martyr
examples.zh: 为烈士立纪念碑

examples.zh: 他记住了那一系列日期，但却忽略了与其有关的主要事实。

examples.zh: 当我看到这些图片时，所有美好的回忆都涌入我的脑海。

examples.zh: 你能补一下我衬衫上的洞吗？

examples.zh: 越来越多的年轻人遭受着精神问题的困扰，这是由日益增加的生活压力造成的。

examples.zh: 其实他从不想冒犯你，可他提到的事的确引起了不愉快的误解。

examples.zh: 今天的菜单上有什么菜？

examples.zh: 水果商

examples.zh: 对某人起了怜悯之心

examples.zh: 一个小孩子是不能做成人工作的。

examples.en: The news merely fortified their determination.
examples.zh: 这个消息只是坚定了他们的决心。

examples.zh: 丰收以后，到处可以看到一片欢乐景象。

examples.zh: 如果不好好准备，周五的演讲可能会变得一塌糊涂。

examples.en: Don't mess my room!
examples.zh: 别把我房间弄乱！
