examples.zh: 警察的及时到来阻止了一次严重事故。

examples.en: The nation's economy is growing rapidly.
examples.zh: 这个国家的经济在快速增长。

examples.en: The building is part of our national heritage.
examples.zh: 这个建筑是我们民族遗产的一部分。

examples.en: What's your nationality, Chinese or Japanese?
examples.zh: 你的国籍是什么，中国籍还是日本籍？

examples.en: At the end of every year some people go back to their native homes.
examples.zh: 每年年终，有些人回到故乡。

examples.en: Are you a native, or just a visitor?
examples.zh: 你是本地人还是游客？

examples.en: Earthquake is one of the natural disasters on the earth.
examples.zh: 地震是地球上的自然灾害之一。

n.name: It is natural for sb. to do sth.
trans: 对某人来说做……是很自然的

n.name: It is natural that sb. should do
trans: 对某人来说……是很自然的事

examples.en: He was a printer by trade and naturalist by avocation.
examples.zh: 他从事印刷业，同时是个博物学爱好者。

examples.en: Man is engaged in a constant struggle with nature.
examples.zh: 人类总是与大自然进行着不断的抗争。

examples.en: The teacher kept the student in because he was naughty.
examples.zh: 那个学生因为顽皮，放学后被老师留在学校里。

examples.en: a naval officer
examples.zh: 海军军官

examples.en: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow.
examples.zh: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

examples.en: Don't sit near the air-conditioner.
examples.zh: 别坐在空调旁边。

examples.en: His school is very near.
examples.zh: 他学校就在附近。

examples.en: The time for my departure from Japan was drawing nearer every day.
examples.zh: 我离开日本的日子一天天近了。

examples.en: The Bakers live nearby.
examples.zh: 贝克一家就住在附近。

examples.en: She came from a nearby village.
examples.zh: 她来自附近的一个村庄。

items.explanation: 指距离的接近，没有比较级和最高级。nearby 作定语，可前置，也可后置。

examples.en: a nearby town (= a town nearby)
examples.zh: 附近一个城镇

items.explanation: 可表示距离、时间和关系的接近，有比较级和最高级。

examples.en: Our school is quite near.
examples.zh: 我们学校很近。

examples.en: Don't go nearer to the fire.
examples.zh: 不要离火太近。

examples.en: The job's nearly finished.
examples.zh: 这项工作差不多完成了。

examples.en: She always kept her room neat.
examples.zh: 她总是把房间收拾得很整洁。

examples.en: Cars are a necessary part of life.
examples.zh: 汽车是生活中一个必不可少的部分。

n.name: It is necessary for sb. to do sth.

examples.en: Be careful with your neck.
examples.zh: 保护好你的脖子。

examples.en: You needn't talk so loud.
examples.zh: 你不必这么大声讲话。

examples.en: Don't hesitate to make contact with me if you need more information.
examples.zh: 如果你需要更多的信息，请随时和我联系。

examples.en: There is a great need for qualified doctors and teachers in our city.
examples.zh: 我们城里需要大量有资质的医生和教师。

n.name: There is no need to do sth.

examples.en: knitting needle
examples.zh: (针织机上用的)织针

examples.en: a negative sentence
examples.zh: 否定句

examples.en: No matter how busy you are, you should not neglect your health.
examples.zh: 不管你怎么忙，都不应该忽视健康。

examples.en: neglect of duty
examples.zh: 疏于职守

examples.en: He negotiated with her on it.
examples.zh: 为这件事他同她谈判。

examples.en: They recently failed to negotiate a mutually acceptable new contract.
examples.zh: 他们最近未能谈成一个双方都满意的新合同。

examples.en: This old woman is my neighbour.
examples.zh: 这个老奶奶是我的邻居。

examples.en: We have learned to help our parents at home and people in our neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 我们学会了在家里帮助父母，在小区帮助居民。

examples.en: Neither book is satisfactory.
examples.zh: 两本书都不令人满意。

examples.en: Peter's parents are good at physics, but neither of them is good at English.
examples.zh: 彼得的父母擅长物理，但他们的英语都不行。

examples.en: — I can't swim. — Neither can I.
examples.zh: — 我不会游泳。— 我也不会。

examples.en: Let me introduce my nephew to you.
examples.zh: 我来介绍一下我的侄子。

examples.en: She's suffering from nerves.
examples.zh: 她患有神经过敏。

examples.en: He feels nervous when he faces so many people.
examples.zh: 面对那么多人，他感到紧张。

examples.en: How long do baby birds stay in the nest?
examples.zh: 雏鸟在鸟窝里待多久？

examples.en: The fishermen are mending their nets.
examples.zh: 渔民们正在补渔网。

examples.en: A firewall provides an essential security blanket for your computer network.
examples.zh: 防火墙为计算机网络提供了基本安全保障。

examples.en: a neutral position
examples.zh: 中立立场

examples.en: Never before has he been so eager to receive his parents' understanding and support as he is now.
examples.zh: 他从没像现在这样渴望得到父母的理解和支持。

examples.en: It would nevertheless affect our international position profoundly.
examples.zh: 它依旧会深刻影响我国在国际上的地位。

examples.en: He was tired; nevertheless, he kept working.
examples.zh: 尽管他累了，但还在继续工作。

examples.en: The girl is so clever that she can memorize all these new words quickly.
examples.zh: 这个女孩很聪明，她很快就能记住所有这些新单词。

examples.en: The newcomer is not used to the heavy traffic in big cities.
examples.zh: 新来者对大都市拥挤的交通不习惯。

examples.en: The whole nation was in deep grief at the news that the king had passed away.
examples.zh: 国王去世的消息使整个国家陷入深深的悲痛。

examples.en: You can get that paper at your local newsagent's shop.
examples.zh: 你可以在当地的书报亭买到那份报纸。

examples.en: What a wonderful newspaper 21st Century is!
examples.zh: 《21 世纪报》是一份多么好的报纸啊！

examples.en: Reflection after a failure will increase your chances of achieving success next time.
examples.zh: 失败后反思会增加你下次获得成功的机会。

examples.en: What a nice day!
examples.zh: 多好的一天啊！

examples.en: Everyone on the team was tagged with a nickname.
examples.zh: 队里的每个成员都有一个绰号。

examples.en: He was nicknamed "the Great Bear" due to his size and way of walking.
examples.zh: 他因为体型和走路姿势而被起了个叫“大熊”的绰号。

examples.en: This is my niece, Joyce.
examples.zh: 这是我的侄女乔伊斯。

examples.en: How pleasant it is to appreciate the night view of Shanghai while drinking coffee.
examples.zh: 边喝咖啡边欣赏上海夜景，多惬意呀！(长宁)

examples.en: The movie won nine Academy Awards, including Best Picture.
examples.zh: 这部电影荣获 9 项奥斯卡金像奖，包括最佳影片奖。

examples.en: He was a kid really, not more than eighteen or nineteen.
examples.zh: 他实际上还是个孩子，最多不过十八九岁。

examples.en: The center of the earthquake is ninety miles from our city.
examples.zh: 这次地震的震中在距我市 90 英里的地方。

examples.en: Beethoven's Ninth Symphony is a glorious piece of music.
examples.zh: 贝多芬的《第九交响曲》是壮丽的音乐篇章。

examples.en: Despite the unpredictable future, he is accustomed to trying his best to do everything well in order to leave no regrets in life.
examples.zh: 尽管前途未卜，为了不让人生留有遗憾，他习惯尽力做好每一件事。

examples.en: a noble man
examples.zh: 贵族

examples.en: Only you can do such a thing, I'm sure, and nobody else has such an ability.
examples.zh: 我敢肯定，只有你能做这样的事情，别人没有这样的能力。

examples.en: She nodded me a welcome.
examples.zh: 她对我点头表示欢迎。

examples.en: David said nothing, but simply nodded, as if understanding perfectly.
examples.zh: 戴维什么都没说，只是点点头，好像完全理解了。

examples.en: He welcomed her with a nod.
examples.zh: 他向她点头表示欢迎。

examples.en: Please be quiet. We are not allowed to make much noise in the reading room.
examples.zh: 请安静。在阅览室里不允许喧哗。

items.explanation: 喧闹声，噪声，噪音(指令人不快的吵闹声)

examples.en: Noise is also a kind of pollution.
examples.zh: 噪音也是一种污染。

items.explanation: 声音(泛指各种声音)，声响

examples.en: the sound of birds singing
examples.zh: 鸟儿歌唱的声音

items.explanation: 嗓音(指人所发出的话语声和歌声)

examples.en: I've lost my voice.
examples.zh: 我嗓子哑了。

examples.en: It's too noisy here.
examples.zh: 这里太吵了。

examples.en: None of us enjoy getting up early.
examples.zh: 我们中间没人喜欢早起。

examples.en: The degree of involvement of the ghostwriter in nonfiction writing projects ranges from minor to significant.
examples.zh: 代笔作家在非虚构写作项目中的参与度从低到高程度不等。(黄浦)

examples.en: What he said was nonsense.
examples.zh: 他说的话都是废话。

examples.en: a nonstop flight
examples.zh: 直达航班

examples.en: Would you like some noodles?
examples.zh: 想来点面条吗？

examples.en: He came at noon.
examples.zh: 他中午来的。

examples.en: He has neither talent nor the desire to learn.
examples.zh: 他既没天分，也不想学习。

examples.en: Ups and downs are quite normal in life.
examples.zh: 起起伏伏在人生中很常见。

n.name: It is normal for sb. to do

examples.en: He comes from the north.
examples.zh: 他从北方来。

examples.en: The wind's in the northeast.
examples.zh: 正在刮东北风。

examples.en: Prices at three-star hotels fell furthest in several northern cities.
examples.zh: 三星级酒店的住宿价格在几个北方城市降得最多。

examples.en: We are travelling northwest.
examples.zh: 我们向西北行。

examples.en: He was born in the northwest.
examples.zh: 他出生于西北部。

examples.en: He has a big nose.
examples.zh: 他有个大鼻子。

examples.en: Not until he failed several times did he realize the importance of learning continuously.
examples.zh: 直到失败了好几次，他才明白不断学习的重要性。

examples.en: Please take the note to the teacher.
examples.zh: 请把这个便条送交老师。

examples.en: The letter failed to note what became of him lately.
examples.zh: 信中没有说明他近来的情况。

examples.en: He took my name and address, scribbling it down in his notebook.
examples.zh: 他要了我的姓名和地址，匆匆写在他的笔记本上。

examples.en: He wants nothing more than time.
examples.zh: 他最需要的是时间。

n.name: Nothing in the world is difficult if you put your heart into it.
trans: 世上无难事，只怕有心人。

examples.en: All passengers flying to Spain are requested to continue to wait until further notice.
examples.zh: 所有飞往西班牙的乘客被要求继续等候，何时出发另行通知。(浦东)

examples.en: And you didn't notice anything unusual?
examples.zh: 你没觉察到什么异常的事？

examples.en: I have mended the hole now. I don't think it notices.
examples.zh: 现在我已经把洞补好，我觉得它不是很明显。

items.explanation: 有“看”或“看到”的意思，是个通用词，使用范围最广。see 的使用范围虽然最广，但作“看”解时，不能用于祈使句。

examples.en: He looked round but saw nobody.
examples.zh: 他转过头去看了一下，但没有看见什么。

items.explanation: 作“看到”或“注意到”解，强调的是“留心观察”。

examples.en: The search proved difficult, for the puma was often observed at one place in the morning and at another place twenty miles away in the evening.
examples.zh: 搜寻工作被证实是很困难的，因为人们看到的这只美洲狮常常是早上的一个地方，而晚上又在 20 英里之外的另一个地方。

items.explanation: 作“注意到，发现”解，是表示在某种偶然的情况下，看到某种情况或事情。

examples.en: I happened to be walking in my garden when I noticed a huge number of snails taking a stroll on some of my prize plants.
examples.zh: 我碰巧在花园里散步，突然看到许多蜗牛在我的—些心爱的植物上悠闲地爬着。

items.explanation: 作“注意”解，是强调在做某事中，同时注意到某事。

examples.en: After consulting my railway timetable, I noted with satisfaction that there was an express train to Westhaven.
examples.zh: 我翻阅了铁路时刻表，见有一班去韦斯赫温的快车，甚为满意。

items.explanation: 作“注意到，觉察”解，有时包含“评论”的意思。

examples.en: This outstanding originality of the newly-made film has been remarked by some critics.
examples.zh: 这部新拍的影片有着鲜明的独到之处，受到了某些评论家的关注。

items.explanation: 表示“观看”或“监视”的意思，强调看到的人或物应处于运动状态。

examples.en: One day there were fewer people in the shop than usual when the woman came in, so it was easier for the detective to watch her.
examples.zh: 一天，当那个女人进来时，该店里的人比平常少一些，所以侦探比较容易监视她。

examples.en: A lot of reports have been written on this subject, and it seems impossible to take no notice of it.
examples.zh: 关于这一话题已写了大量报道，看来已不可能对此置若罔闻了。

examples.en: an abstract noun
examples.zh: 抽象名词

examples.en: It's a novel experience.
examples.zh: 那是一段新奇的经历。

examples.en: I thought the novel was going to be really boring.
examples.zh: 我觉得这部小说真的很无聊。(上海高考)

examples.en: I'd put her in the top rank of modern novelists.
examples.zh: 我认为她应属于一流的现代小说家。

examples.en: Retail sales fell in November by 10%.
examples.zh: 11 月零售额下降 10%。

examples.en: Now Shanghai Museum is accessible to everyone for free.
examples.zh: 现在人人都可以免费参观上海博物馆。

senses.trans: 现今，现在(常用于将现在的风俗习惯等与过去相比时)

examples.en: Nowadays vlogs are much more useful than traditional diaries and especially welcomed by young people.
examples.zh: 如今，视频日志比传统の日记更实用，尤其受到年轻人的欢迎。

examples.en: On his way to the museum he lost the key to his office and nowhere could it be found.
examples.zh: 在去博物馆的路上，他把办公室的钥匙弄丢了，哪儿也找不到。

examples.en: a nuclear particle
examples.zh: 核微粒

examples.en: You can ring his home number.
examples.zh: 你可以拨他家里的电话号码。

examples.en: number the seats
examples.zh: 给座位编号

items.explanation: 若干；许多(用于可数名词，谓语动词一般用复数)

examples.en: There are a large number of people there.
examples.zh: 那里有很多人。

items.explanation: ……的数目(谓语动词用单数)

examples.en: The number of the League members in this school is large.
examples.zh: 这所学校的团员人数很多。

examples.en: Those birds have become numerous lately.
examples.zh: 近来那种鸟变得越来越多了。

examples.en: She wishes to be a nurse.
examples.zh: 她想当名护士。

examples.en: She rushed home to nurse her daughter back to health.
examples.zh: 她赶回家去照顾女儿，盼她早日康复。

examples.en: We have started a campaign for better nursery and school services.
examples.zh: 我们已发起一场运动，要求改善幼儿园和中小学教育服务。

examples.en: Nursing was ill-paid and grindingly hard work.
examples.zh: 护理工作薪水微薄，艰苦难耐。

examples.en: Have some chocolate with nuts.
examples.zh: 吃些果仁巧克力吧。

examples.en: Contrary to the common view, milk's role as a sleep aid is related not to the nutrients it contains but to the psychological hint the bedtime habit of drinking milk produces.
examples.zh: 与普遍的观点相反，牛奶作为助眠剂的作用与其所含营养成分无关，而是与喝牛奶这一睡前习惯所产生的心理暗示有关。

examples.en: When my mother cooks, she considers not only just nutrient value, but variety as well.
examples.zh: 我妈妈做饭时不仅考虑营养价值，还考虑品种多样。

examples.en: This is a piece of advice on diet and nutrition.
examples.zh: 这是一条有关饮食和营养的建议。

examples.en: We've decided to negotiate with the employer about a pay rise.
examples.zh: 我们决定与老板谈判增加工资。

examples.en: George was seriously injured in the car crash, from which he learned a lesson that it is essential to obey the traffic rules.
examples.zh: 乔治在这次撞车事故中受了重伤，从中他得到了一个教训：遵守交通规则是十分必要的。

examples.en: They made it clear that they all objected to putting the meeting off.
examples.zh: 他们明确表示都反对会议延期。

examples.en: Cullen objected that his small staff would be unable to handle the added work.
examples.zh: 卡伦提出反对，说他的人手较少，无法完成额外工作。

examples.en: What is your object in doing that?
examples.zh: 你做那件事的目的是什么？

examples.en: The couple objected to their daughter's engagement to a poor man.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇反对他们女儿和一个穷小子订婚。

o.name: object + that 从句
trans: 提出……作为反对的理由，反对说

examples.en: to take an objective view of a situation
examples.zh: 对形势持客观的看法

examples.en: His objective was to be finished by October.
examples.zh: 他的目标是在 10 月前完成。

examples.en: They were obliged to sell their house to pay the debts.
examples.zh: 他们不得不卖掉房子来还债。

o.name: be obliged to sb. for sth.
I would be obliged if ...
trans: 如果……的话，我将不胜感激

examples.en: Falling profits obliged them to close the factory.
examples.zh: 日益减少的利润迫使他们不得不关掉工厂。

examples.en: Keep him under observation.
examples.zh: 留意他的情况。

examples.en: Everybody should strictly observe traffic rules and regulations.
examples.zh: 每个人都应该严格地遵守交通规则。

examples.en: Rent and labor costs remain to be the biggest obstacles faced by convenience stores.
examples.zh: 房租和人力成本依旧是便利店发展面临的最大障碍。(普陀)

examples.en: Knowledge can be obtained through study.
examples.zh: 知识可以通过学习获得。

examples.en: It is strange that she should have failed to see such an obvious mistake.
examples.zh: 真奇怪，她竟然未能看出如此明显的错误。

examples.en: Diet and exercise are obviously important.
examples.zh: 显然，饮食和运动是重要的。

examples.en: Her graduation ceremony was a great occasion for the whole family.
examples.zh: 她的毕业典礼是全家人非常重要的时刻。

examples.en: The painting was given to us as a present on the occasion of our silver wedding.
examples.zh: 这幅画是我们银婚纪念时刻别人给的礼物。

examples.en: They have complained of discrimination and occasional rough treatment.
examples.zh: 他们抗议遭受歧视，而且偶尔还会遭到粗暴的对待。

examples.en: He is a merchant by occupation.
examples.zh: 他的职业是经商。

examples.en: occupy a lot of space
examples.zh: 占很大空间

examples.en: Lifelong learning refers to a self-initiated form of ability enhancement, which focuses on personal growth and tends to occur outside the classroom.
examples.zh: 终身学习指的是一种自我驱动的能力提升方式，它关注个人的成长且往往发生在课堂之外。(青浦)

examples.en: the Pacific Ocean
examples.zh: 太平洋

examples.en: I woke up at four o'clock this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我 4 点钟就醒了。

examples.en: Payment is due on 1 October.
examples.zh: 付款期限为 10 月 1 日。

examples.en: It's odd that he hasn't telephoned me.
examples.zh: 真奇怪，他没给我打电话。

examples.en: They had two children of their own.
examples.zh: 他们有两个自己的孩子。

examples.en: cut off the gas
examples.zh: 关上煤气

examples.en: Keep off the grass.
examples.zh: 勿践踏草坪。

examples.en: Driving without a licence is an offence.
examples.zh: 无证驾驶是违法行为。

examples.en: I'm sorry for offending you.
examples.zh: 抱歉，冒犯你了。

o.name: be offended at sth.
trans: 因某事而生气，因某事而被触怒

o.name: offend against
trans: 违反法律(或风俗、礼貌等)

examples.en: He offered to drive us to the station, but we'd rather go there on foot.
examples.zh: 他表示要开车送我们去车站，可是我们宁愿步行去。

examples.en: Today's special offer gives you a choice of three destinations.
examples.zh: 今天推出的特价线路有 3 个目的地可供选择。

examples.en: Maria had hardly arrived at the office when she learned the news that she was promoted to sales manager.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚一到办公室就得知了她升职到销售经理的消息。

examples.en: An officer is receiving her.
examples.zh: 一位官员正在接待她。

examples.en: The mass media demanded that all the official documents concerning the sale of this land be made public.
examples.zh: 大众媒体要求公布有关出售这块土地的全部正式文件。

examples.en: A senior UN official hopes to visit China this month.
examples.zh: 一位联合国高级官员希望于本月访问中国。

examples.en: Kitty is such an honest student that she is often praised by her teachers.
examples.zh: 凯蒂是一个诚实的学生，她经常受到老师的表扬。

examples.en: Oh, my God!
examples.zh: 哦，我的上帝！

examples.en: Oil is liquid.
examples.zh: 石油是液体。

examples.zh: 警察叫小偷把口袋都翻出来。

examples.en: read a romantic poem
examples.zh: 读一首浪漫诗

examples.en: He was determined to reinvent himself as a poet and writer.
examples.zh: 他下决心把自己重塑成一个诗人兼作家。

examples.en: I myself enjoy cinema, poetry, eating out and long walks.
examples.zh: 我本人喜欢电影、诗歌、外出吃饭和远途散步。

examples.en: It's rude to point your fingers at people.
examples.zh: 用手指着别人是不礼貌的。

examples.en: I can't see any point in trying to persuade him, for he just won't listen.
examples.zh: 我看不出劝他有什么用，他不会听的。(上海高考)

examples.en: He pointed at the flowchart to illustrate his point.
examples.zh: 他指着流程图来说明他的论点。

examples.en: The witch put some poison in the soup.
examples.zh: 女巫在汤里放了毒。

examples.en: He tried to poison the cat.
examples.zh: 他想毒死那只猫。

examples.en: She has tried to poison already.
examples.zh: 她已经试着下了毒。

examples.en: This gas is highly poisonous.
examples.zh: 这种气体有剧毒。

examples.en: Warmth melts some of the polar ice.
examples.zh: 温暖的天气融化了一些极地的冰雪。

examples.en: The North Pole and the South Pole are opposite each other.
examples.zh: 北极与南极是相对的两极。

examples.en: The police remind the public to be careful not to fall for scams because nowadays, there are many types of influencer marketing.
examples.zh: 如今网红营销名目繁多，警方提醒公众谨防上当受骗。(金山)

examples.en: The old man was thankful to the policeman who found the lost car for him.
examples.zh: 这位老人感激警察找到了他丢失的汽车。

examples.en: The manager was pleased with the new policy, believing it was an effective way to promote the products.
examples.zh: 经理对新政策很满意，认为它是一种宣传产品的有效方法。

examples.en: polish the shoes
examples.zh: 擦鞋

examples.en: I've never seen such a polite clerk.
examples.zh: 我从未见过这样有礼貌的店员。

examples.en: political rights
examples.zh: 政治权利

examples.en: He is widely regarded as Hungary's most skillful politician.
examples.zh: 他是公认的匈牙利最有手腕的政治家。

examples.en: Politics was one of his university subjects.
examples.zh: 政治学是他大学的课程之一。

examples.en: The environment will be seriously polluted if people don't take any action.
examples.zh: 如果人们不采取任何行动，环境将受到严重污染。

examples.en: All the students in Shanghai should help fight pollution to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 上海所有的学生都应该为了保护环境与污染作斗争。

examples.en: a fish pond
examples.zh: 鱼塘

examples.en: a swimming pool
examples.zh: 游泳池

examples.en: My family used to be poor.
examples.zh: 我家过去很穷。

examples.en: Pop songs are popular with most young people.
examples.zh: 流行歌曲深受年轻人的喜爱。

examples.en: I like cheerful, uplifting middle-of-the-road pop.
examples.zh: 我喜欢曲调欢快而且令人振奋的大众流行音乐。

examples.en: I like to eat popcorn when I am watching TV play at home.
examples.zh: 当我在家看电视剧时，喜欢吃爆米花。

examples.en: Our English teacher has a good sense of humor and that is why his lessons are so popular with the students.
examples.zh: 我们的英语老师富有幽默感，这就是为什么他的课广受学生欢迎。

examples.en: We are sure the toys will be popular among children and good for their intelligence.
examples.zh: 我们相信，这些玩具会受到儿童的喜爱并对其智力大有益处。

examples.en: That city has a population of over ten million.
examples.zh: 那个城市的人口超过了一千万。

senses.trans: (城市、国家等的) (全体) 人民 (或居民)

examples.en: How much pork do you need to make dumplings for the family and the guests?
examples.zh: 为家人和客人包饺子，你需要多少猪肉？

examples.en: Shanghai is the biggest port of China.
examples.zh: 上海是中国第一大港。

examples.en: I always carry a portable computer with me.
examples.zh: 我总是随身携带一台手提电脑。

examples.en: I struggled with my bags, desperately looking for a porter.
examples.zh: 我提着行李艰难地走着，迫切地寻找搬运工。

examples.en: a portion of the property
examples.zh: 财产的一部分

examples.en: a portrait of the queen
examples.zh: 女王肖像

examples.en: Drugs pose a major threat to our society.
examples.zh: 毒品成为对社会的一大威胁。

examples.en: He adopted a relaxed pose for the camera.
examples.zh: 他摆了个放松的姿势拍照。

examples.en: The company has made it clear that only those who have a good command of computer skills can apply for this position.
examples.zh: 公司明确表示，只有精通计算机技能的人才能申请这个职位。

examples.en: a positive attitude
examples.zh: 积极的态度

examples.en: possess the property
examples.zh: 拥有财产

examples.en: The possession of a passport is essential for travelling abroad.
examples.zh: 出国旅行必须持有护照。

examples.en: After reading the reports about this professor and astronaut, it dawned on me that as long as one dares to dream and works diligently to fulfill that dream, life holds infinite possibilities.
examples.zh: 读了关于这位教授宇航员的报道，我逐渐意识到，只要敢于有梦，勤于圆梦，人生就有无限可能。(浦东)

examples.en: Is it possible to prevent a financial crisis from happening again in the future?
examples.zh: 有可能防止金融危机再次发生吗？

p.name: It is possible for sb. to do ...

examples.en: You have to get eight wooden posts, and drive them into the ground.
examples.zh: 你得找来8根木桩，并把它们敲入地里。

examples.en: She has posted photographs on bulletin boards.
examples.zh: 她已把照片贴在了公告牌上。

examples.en: Has the post come yet?
examples.zh: 邮件来了吗？

examples.en: If I write a letter, would you post it for me?
examples.zh: 如果我写封信，你能替我寄出去吗？

examples.en: apply for a post
examples.zh: 申请一个职位

examples.en: All letters must be stamped with the correct postage.
examples.zh: 任何信件都应该按所需邮资贴邮票。

examples.en: Postal money orders are available in amounts up to $700.
examples.zh: 邮政汇票的金额最高可达 700 美元。

examples.en: He sent me a postcard from the United Nations.
examples.zh: 他从联合国给我寄来一张明信片。

examples.en: If you put the postcode on the envelope, it'll get there quicker.
examples.zh: 在信封上写上邮政编码可以投递得快一些。

examples.en: Only when he saw the posters which were put up everywhere in the neighbourhood with his own eyes did he truly believe that the Chinese Poetry Competition was very popular.
examples.zh: 只有当他亲眼看见那些贴满小区的海报时，才真正相信《中国诗词大会》是多么受欢迎。

examples.en: His ambition is to be a postman.
examples.zh: 他的志向是想成为一名邮递员。

examples.en: The meeting is postponed to June.
examples.zh: 会议被延期至6月。

examples.en: Most of the flower pots were moved into the house by Mrs. Green last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚大多数的花盆都由格林太太搬进了房子里。

examples.en: They bought some fresh potatoes at the supermarket yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天他们在超市买了一些新鲜的土豆。

examples.en: That hole in the road is a potential danger.
examples.zh: 路上的那个坑是个潜在的危险。

examples.en: The meeting has the potential to be a watershed event.
examples.zh: 这次会议有可能成为转折性事件。

examples.en: The pen costs 5 pounds.
examples.zh: 这支钢笔要 5 英镑。

examples.en: Pour some wine into my glass.
examples.zh: 倒一些酒到我的杯子里。

examples.en: Tourists pour into London in summer.
examples.zh: 夏季，游客纷纷涌入伦敦。

examples.en: poverty in vitamins
examples.zh: 维生素的缺乏

examples.en: reduce sth. to powder
examples.zh: 把某物弄成粉末

examples.en: They have built three nuclear power stations this year.
examples.zh: 今年他们建造了 3 座核电站。

examples.en: The “flywheel” battery, it is said, could power an electric car for 600 miles on a single charge.
examples.zh: 据说“飞轮”电池充电一次就能驱动电动汽车行驶 600 英里。

examples.en: The situation has changed for the better since the current government came into power.
examples.zh: 自从现届政府上台以来，局面有所好转。

examples.en: Sam has broad shoulders and powerful arms.
examples.zh: 山姆有宽阔的肩膀和强有力的手臂。

examples.en: He was sympathetic, but powerless to help.
examples.zh: 他表示同情，但爱莫能助。

examples.en: Teachers spare no efforts to promote the quality-oriented education, cultivating student’ spirit of innovation and practical ability.
examples.zh: 教师们不遗余力地推进素质教育，旨在培养学生的创新精神和实践能力。

examples.en: You need more practice before you can play for our team.
examples.zh: 在你能为我们队打球前，你需要更多的练习。

examples.en: The child usually practises (playing) the piano for an hour a day.
examples.zh: 这孩子每天通常练习弹琴一小时。

examples.en: To be a good musician, you have to practise a lot.
examples.zh: 要成为优秀的音乐家，必须勤于练习。

trans: 从事职业(尤指律师或医生)

examples.en: I was praised for my progress last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我因进步而受到表扬。

examples.en: His good behavior deserves praise.
examples.zh: 他的好品行值得表扬。

examples.en: He prayed to God for the sick lady.
examples.zh: 他为那名生病的妇人向上帝祈祷。

examples.en: Life is precious, so don't be anxious about everyday affairs.
examples.zh: 人生可贵，不要为日常琐事而忧心忡忡。

examples.en: The satellite enables us to calculate their precise location anywhere in the world.
examples.zh: 卫星使我们能够计算出它们在世界上任何地方的精确位置。

examples.en: The syllabus prescribes precisely which books should be read.
examples.zh: 教学大纲明确规定了哪些是必读的书。

examples.en: People cannot predict how things will pan out.
examples.zh: 人们无法预料事情会有什么样的结果。

examples.en: Some teenagers are so keen on online games that they sometimes prefer not to have meals, and what’s more, they usually have a bad relationship with their parents.
examples.zh: 有些青少年热衷于网络游戏，有时候竟然连饭都可以不吃，而且他们和家长的关系往往也比较糟糕。

examples.en: I can't say that I have any particular preference.
examples.zh: 我说不出自己有什么特别偏好。

examples.en: be pregnant with a child
examples.zh: 怀了孩子

examples.en: He has a prejudice against modern poetry.
examples.zh: 他对现代诗抱有偏见。

examples.en: I don't want to prejudice people against us.
examples.zh: 我不想使人们对我们产生偏见。

examples.en: The premier and his entourage arrived in Paris last night.
examples.zh: 总理一行于昨晚抵达巴黎。

examples.en: He failed in the examination, not because it was difficult but because he didn't make adequate preparations for it.
examples.zh: 他考试没有通过，不是因为太难，而是因为他没有做好充分准备。

examples.en: Working on a part-time basis can prepare them for a future career.
examples.zh: 做兼职能让他们为将来的职业做好准备。

examples.en: Her Majesty later honoured the Headmaster with her presence at lunch.
examples.zh: 随后女王陛下出席了午餐，令校长感到荣幸。

examples.en: He gave his mother a present.
examples.zh: 他给了妈妈一份礼物。

examples.en: They presented flowers to their teacher.
examples.zh: 他们献花给老师。

examples.en: There is no way at present of predicting which individuals will develop the disease.
examples.zh: 目前还没有办法预测谁会得这种病。

examples.en: What is your present job?
examples.zh: 你现在的工作是什么？

examples.en: We are deadly short of hands at present.
examples.zh: 目前我们极缺人手。

examples.en: The ideas in the show's presentation were good, but failed in execution.
examples.zh: 那场展览陈述的想法很好，但是没能实现。

examples.en: She is presently writing a book.
examples.zh: 她现在正在写一本书。

examples.en: We need to preserve the forest.
examples.zh: 我们要保护森林。

examples.en: The President will give a speech on the morning of National Day.
examples.zh: 在国庆节的上午，总统将发表讲话。

examples.en: Please press this button.
examples.zh: 请按这个按钮。

examples.en: Press reports revealed that ozone levels in the upper atmosphere fell during the past month.
examples.zh: 新闻报道透露，上层大气的臭氧浓度在上个月有所下降。

examples.en: Do not put much pressure on the handle, it may break.
examples.zh: 不要在手柄上太用力了，它会坏的。

examples.en: She chose economics as her major under pressure from her parents.
examples.zh: 她是迫于父母的压力才选择经济学作为专业的。

examples.en: She pretended not to have met him before.
examples.zh: 她假装以前从未见过他。

examples.en: What a pretty dress your sister is wearing today!
examples.zh: 你妹妹今天穿的裙子好漂亮啊！

examples.en: It was a pretty serious accident.
examples.zh: 这是一起相当严重的事故。

examples.en: Effective measures must be taken to prevent the spread of the virus.
examples.zh: 必须采取有效措施以防止病毒扩散。

examples.en: Our teachers ask us to preview the new text before we have the class.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们上课前先把新课预习好。

examples.en: Please send the recording for my preview.
examples.zh: 请将那份录音送来给我预审。

examples.en: The man was known to the police because of previous convictions.
examples.zh: 因为有犯罪前科，警察们都认识这个人。

examples.en: In the Jurassic and Cretaceous, they were prey as well as predator and often had to make a speedy exit as a result.
examples.zh: 在侏罗纪和白垩纪，它们既是猎物也是捕食者，因此经常不得不迅速逃离。(闵行)

examples.en: Cats prey upon mice.
examples.zh: 猫捕食鼠。

examples.en: The supermarket is very popular, because it provides customers with reasonable prices, a relaxing atmosphere and a wide range of products.
examples.zh: 那家超市很受欢迎，因为它提供给顾客合理的价格、令人轻松的氛围和范围广泛的产品。

items.explanation: 价值(指某物之值，有一定价钱的分量)

examples.en: books of real worth
examples.zh: 真正有价值的书

examples.en: a car worth $20,000
examples.zh: 一辆价值 2 万美元的小汽车

items.explanation: 价格，价钱

examples.en: What is the price of this diamond ring?
examples.zh: 这只钻戒的价格是多少？

items.explanation: 价值

examples.en: What is the value of your house?
examples.zh: 你的房子值多少钱？

examples.en: Chinese people took pride in China’s winning 51 gold medals at Beijing Olympics.
examples.zh: 中国在北京奥运会上获得 51 枚金牌，这使全国人民感到自豪。

examples.en: Keeping healthy is of primary importance.
examples.zh: 保持身体健康是硬道理。

examples.en: Primitive people usually lived in caves.
examples.zh: 原始人通常住在山洞里。

examples.en: the prince of Wales
examples.zh: 威尔士王储

examples.en: She was like a princess in a fairy tale.
examples.zh: 她就像童话里的公主。

examples.en: the principal rivers of a country
examples.zh: 一个国家的主要河流

examples.en: The principal appeals to the teachers to encourage students to play a full part in class.
examples.zh: 校长呼吁老师让学生在课上充分发挥作用。

examples.en: Whoever wants to be successful should first understand the principle that success comes from hard effort and perseverance.
examples.zh: 无论谁想要成功必先明白这个道理：成功来自艰苦的付出和坚持不懈。

examples.en: The mark of a man's shoe is printed on the floor.
examples.zh: 地上留有一个男子的鞋印。

examples.en: put the article into print
examples.zh: 将这篇文章付印

examples.en: This information must not be disclosed without prior written consent.
examples.zh: 未事先征得书面许可，此消息不得泄露。

examples.en: Only when the environmental problem is regarded as the top priority will it be likely to be solved.
examples.zh: 只有当环境问题被看作第一要务时它才有可能得到解决。

examples.en: put sb. into prison
examples.zh: 把某人关进监狱

examples.en: He is a prisoner.
examples.zh: 他是个囚犯。

examples.en: Some young people are now rich enough to buy private cars.
examples.zh: 现在有一些年轻人有能力买私家车。

examples.en: In private, I gave them my candid opinion.
examples.zh: 私下里，我对他们直言相告。

examples.en: She is the first Chinese woman scientist to be awarded the Nobel Prize.
examples.zh: 她是中国第一个被授予诺贝尔奖的女科学家。

examples.en: A storm is probable today.
examples.zh: 今天可能会有暴风雨。

examples.en: Probably the restaurant is still open at this hour. Let’s go and have a bite.
examples.zh: 这家餐馆大概此刻还开着，让我们去吃一点东西吧。

examples.en: It is a difficult problem for middle school students whether they can resist the temptation of online games.
examples.zh: 能否抵御网络游戏的诱惑，是摆在中学生面前的一道难题。

examples.en: the procedure of the meeting
examples.zh: 会议议程

examples.en: The train proceeded at the same speed as before.
examples.zh: 列车以原来的速度继续前进。

examples.en: One has to process a photographic film to print pictures from it.
examples.zh: 必须先处理照相底片，然后才能冲印出相片。

examples.en: Learning is a process of trying and failing and trying and succeeding.
examples.zh: 学习是一个尝试、失败、再尝试，然后成功的过程。

examples.en: Hard work often produces good results.
examples.zh: 努力工作经常会有好结果。

examples.en: This shop sells native produce.
examples.zh: 这家商店出售土特产。

senses.trans: [总称](尤指新鲜水果、蔬菜等)农产品

p.name: A plant may produce new flowers; man is young but once.
trans: 花有重开日，人无再少年。

examples.en: This plan was the product of many hours of careful thought.
examples.zh: 这个计划是经过长时间仔细思考的产物。

examples.en: Because of the slump in domestic demand, production has stopped.
examples.zh: 由于国内需求大幅下降，生产已经停止。

examples.en: Land, labor and capital are all productive of wealth.
examples.zh: 土地、劳动和资本都能创造财富。

examples.en: He is a lawyer by profession.
examples.zh: 他是职业律师。

examples.en: His professional career spanned 16 years.
examples.zh: 他的职业生涯持续了 16 年。

examples.en: He is a model professional and an example to the younger lads.
examples.zh: 他是个模范的专业人士，是年轻人的榜样。

examples.en: The professor said that deep sleep allowed suppressed anxieties to surface.
examples.zh: 教授说深度睡眠可以使压抑的焦虑情绪得以释放。

examples.en: We could see the profile of a distant hill on a clear day.
examples.zh: 天气晴朗的时候，我们可看到远山的轮廓。

examples.en: I have read it to my profit.
examples.zh: 我读了之后大有收获。

examples.en: You can profit by making mistakes.
examples.zh: 你可以从错误中得到教益。

examples.en: Drug manufacturing is the most profitable business in America.
examples.zh: 制药业是美国利润最丰厚的产业。

examples.en: We are all faithful listeners to the programme.
examples.zh: 我们都是这档节目的忠实听众。

senses.trans: 为……安排节目(或制订计划)

examples.en: The lights were programmed to turn on at sunset.
examples.zh: 灯被设定在日落时自动打开。

trans: 使按预订步骤(或计划)工作

examples.en: Every student has unlimited potential to overcome difficulties in study and keep making progress.
examples.zh: 每个学生都具有无限的潜能去克服学习中的困难，不断进取。

examples.en: He continues to progress in his studies.
examples.zh: 他在学业上继续进步。

examples.en: This is a yardstick for measuring whether a person is really progressive.
examples.zh: 这是衡量一个人是否真正进步的标准。

examples.en: Smoking is prohibited.
examples.zh: 禁止吸烟。

examples.en: Hope Project becomes a big event of national concern.
examples.zh: “希望工程”成了一件全国关心的大事。

examples.en: They were projecting a new power plant.
examples.zh: 他们正在设计一个新发电厂。

examples.en: I will lend you the book as long as you promise to get it back to me in two weeks.
examples.zh: 只要你保证两周后还给我，我就把这本书借给你。

examples.en: Not only did he make a promise, but also he kept it.
examples.zh: 他不仅做出了许诺，而且履行了诺言。

examples.en: Once he makes a promise, he will never go back on it.
examples.zh: 他一旦答应，就不会食言。

examples.en: Please feel assured that we will keep our promise.
examples.zh: 请放心，我们一定遵守诺言。

examples.en: These organizations have made outstanding contributions to promoting friendship and cooperation between the two countries.
examples.zh: 这些组织为促进两国友谊与合作做出了杰出的贡献。

examples.en: He pronounced the word correctly.
examples.zh: 那个单词他发音准确。

examples.en: I thought a phonetic spelling might aid in pronunciation.
examples.zh: 我想语音拼写可能有助于发音。

examples.en: Have you any proof that you were the winner?
examples.zh: 你有什么证据说是你赢了？

examples.en: The room is proof against sound.
examples.zh: 这个房间是隔音的。

examples.en: Two out of five people lack a proper job.

examples.en: He owns a great deal of property.

examples.en: There have been many changes in our school in recent years.
examples.zh: 近几年，我们学校已经有了许多变化。

examples.en: Recently, reducing excessive academic work and off-campus tutoring for primary and middle school students has been a major issue of public concern.
examples.zh: 近来，减少中小学生过重的学业负担和课外辅导是公众主要关注的问题。

examples.en: The reception at noon has been put off till next Wednesday.
examples.zh: 中午的欢迎会已推迟到下周三。

examples.en: The personnel manager has been casting about for somebody who can act as receptionist.
examples.zh: 人事部经理一直在到处物色前台接待员的人选。

examples.en: The recipe for their drink is a closely guarded trade secret.
examples.zh: 他们的饮料配方是严格保守的商业秘密。

examples.en: He gave a beautiful recitation of some poems by Blake.
examples.zh: 他声情并茂地朗诵了几首布莱克的诗。

examples.en: recite a poem
examples.zh: 背诵一首诗

examples.en: The facilities have improved beyond all recognition.
examples.zh: 这些设备经过大幅改良，都让人认不出来了。

examples.en: There is no denying that China's advanced technology of high-speed railway has been recognised by almost all the countries in the world.
examples.zh: 不可否认的是，中国高铁的先进技术已受到世界上几乎所有国家的认可。

examples.en: The health advisor recommends taking herbs to promote recovery.
examples.zh: 健康顾问推荐服用草药来促进康复。(闵行)

examples.en: Let me play your favourite record.
examples.zh: 让我播放你最喜欢的唱片。

examples.en: The singer has recorded some popular songs.
examples.zh: 这个歌手已录制了一些流行歌曲。

examples.en: My voice records quite well.
examples.zh: 我的声音录下来很好听。

examples.en: The quality of the recording is quite exceptional.
examples.zh: 录音质量相当出色。

examples.en: With the help of the police, they recovered the lost money.
examples.zh: 在警察的帮助下，他们找回了丢失的钱。

examples.en: After several months' treatment, he at last recovered from the disease.
examples.zh: 经过几个月的治疗，他终于康复了。

examples.en: The foreign exchange market hasn’t recovered from the economic depression.
examples.zh: 外汇市场还未从经济萧条中恢复过来。

examples.en: I often recreate myself with gardening.
examples.zh: 我常以园艺为消遣。

examples.en: His only form of recreation is playing football.
examples.zh: 他唯一的娱乐就是踢足球。

examples.en: to recycle waste paper
examples.zh: 回收废纸

examples.en: Her eyes were red with crying.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛哭红了。

examples.en: There's too much red in the painting.
examples.zh: 这幅画中用的红色太多。

examples.en: They've reduced the prices in the shop, so it's a good time to buy.
examples.zh: 商店已经降低了商品的价格，看来现在是买东西的好时候。

examples.en: He referred to his teacher when he talked about his teaching experience.
examples.zh: 他谈到他的教学经验时提及了他的老师。

examples.en: For more detailed information please refer to the instructions.
examples.zh: 请参阅使用说明，以获取更多详细信息。

examples.en: DINK families refer to families that have double income and no kids.
examples.zh: 丁克家庭是指有双份收入、没有孩子的家庭。

examples.en: reference book
examples.zh: 参考书

examples.en: There is no doubt that the choice of school reflects the parents' hope for their children.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，选择学校常常能反映出父母对子女的希望。

examples.en: to reform criminals
examples.zh: 改造罪犯

examples.en: The reform and opening policy has brought us a rich and colourful life.
examples.zh: 改革开放的政策给我们带来了丰富多彩的生活。

examples.en: A cool drink refreshed me after my long walk.
examples.zh: 走了很长的一段路之后，一杯冷饮使我恢复了精神。

examples.en: a new refrigerator
examples.zh: 一台崭新的冰箱

examples.en: a political refugee
examples.zh: 政治难民

examples.en: Dissatisfied customers can return the product for a full refund.
examples.zh: 顾客如不满意可以退货并获全额退款。

examples.en: her refusal of my help
examples.zh: 她拒绝我的帮助

examples.en: She refused to help me.
examples.zh: 她不肯帮助我。

examples.en: He regards the painting as the most valuable property of his.
examples.zh: 他把这张画视为他最珍贵的财产。

examples.en: Please give my regards to your family.
examples.zh: 请代我向你的家人问好。

examples.en: He is regarded as the best comedian on the English stage.
examples.zh: 他被认为是英国戏剧舞台上最出色的喜剧演员。

examples.en: I wrote a letter regarding my daughter's school examinations.
examples.zh: 我写了一封关于我女儿学校考试的信。

examples.en: Regardless of my protest, he carried on.
examples.zh: 他不顾我的反对，仍一意孤行。

examples.en: forest regions
examples.zh: 森林地带

examples.en: It is said that the reason why new users of microblog must use real names when they are registering is to protect web users' interests and improve credibility of the Internet.
examples.zh: 新的微博用户注册时必须使用实名，据说原因是为了保护网民的利益和提高网络的可信度。

examples.en: I never regret doing what I have done.
examples.zh: 我做过的事从不后悔。

examples.en: He told me with regret that he could not come to the party.
examples.zh: 他很抱歉地对我说了，他不能来参加这个聚会了。

examples.en: We should so act that we shall have nothing to regret.
examples.zh: 我们应该这样行动，从而使我们将来不会后悔。

examples.en: We regretted having sold the house.
examples.zh: 我们后悔出售了这房子。

examples.en: There are two most famous and popular programs that have regular performances in Shanghai Circus World.
examples.zh: 有两个最著名、最受欢迎的节目定期在上海马戏城演出。

examples.en: Now we have a reservoir regulating the river flow.
examples.zh: 现在我们有一个水库来调节河水的流量。

examples.en: safety regulation
examples.zh: 安全条例

senses.trans: 拒绝(相信、考虑、接受、录取等)

examples.en: He rejected their invitation point-blank.
examples.zh: 他直截了当地拒绝了他们的邀请。

examples.en: I related my adventure to my family.
examples.zh: 我向家人讲述了我的奇遇。

examples.en: She is a girl who notices nothing except what relates to herself.
examples.zh: 她是一个只注意与她自己有关的事的女孩。

examples.en: Health is closely related to physical exercise.
examples.zh: 健康与体育锻炼密切相关。

examples.en: Political news is often closely related to economic and social issues.
examples.zh: 政治新闻往往与经济和社会问题息息相关。

examples.en: the relation between mother and child
examples.zh: 母子关系

examples.en: The teacher has a very good relationship with her students.
examples.zh: 这位老师和学生们关系很好。

examples.en: Today we visited our relatives.
examples.zh: 今天我们拜访了亲戚。

examples.en: the facts relative to this question
examples.zh: 与这个问题有关的事实

examples.en: Relatively speaking, it is a fine day. (= It is relatively a fine day.)
examples.zh: 相对而言，今天是个好天。

examples.en: Einstein's theory of relativity won him universal esteem.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦的相对论赢得了全世界对他的崇敬。

examples.en: Why don't you go to the cinema to relax yourself?
examples.zh: 为什么不去看场电影放松一下自己？

examples.en: Mountain climbing and fishing are John's favourite relaxations.
examples.zh: 登山和钓鱼是约翰最喜欢的消遣。

examples.en: The game was relayed by satellite to audiences all over the world.
examples.zh: 这场比赛通过卫星向全世界的观众进行了转播。

examples.en: There was a relay race on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 星期二有一场接力赛。

examples.en: Although this classic film was first released in 1998, it still caused a huge response among fans when it was re-released this month.
examples.zh: 虽然这部经典老片在 1998 年首映，但当它本月重新上映时，依然在影迷中引起了极大的反响。(奉贤)

examples.en: I don't think his remarks are relevant to our discussion.
examples.zh: 我认为他的话不切合我们的议题。

examples.en: It's not reliable to judge a man only by his looks.
examples.zh: 单凭貌相来判断一个人是不可靠的。

examples.en: To our relief, nobody happened to be in the workshop when the explosion occurred.
examples.zh: 令人宽慰的是，爆炸发生时碰巧车间里没有人。

examples.en: Will the medicine relieve the patient of his bad headache?
examples.zh: 这药会缓解病人的剧烈头痛吗？

r.name: relieve sb. of ...
trans: 解除（某人的负担、任务、责任等）

examples.en: the great religions of the world
examples.zh: 世界几大宗教

examples.en: a religious question
examples.zh: 宗教问题

examples.en: One solution would be to duplicate the list in XML, but we're reluctant to do so because the list changes frequently.
examples.zh: 一个解决方案是以 XML 格式复制该列表，但我们不太愿意这样做，因为该列表经常更改。

examples.en: rely on one's own efforts
examples.zh: 依靠自己的努力

examples.en: The conflict between people's demand for high quality education and the insufficient educational resources remains to be solved.
examples.zh: 人们对高质量教育的需求和不够充足的教育资源之间的矛盾有待解决。

items.explanation: 留下；继续；仍然是（强调别人离开后或东西撤走后仍然留下或存在；后接不定式构成复合谓语，意为“留待，尚待”）

examples.en: His story remains to be proved.
examples.zh: 他的故事有待证实。

items.explanation: 暂住，逗留；继续是；保持（持续的状态）

examples.en: I stayed awake the whole night.
examples.zh: 我整夜没睡着。

examples.en: He remarked that it was getting late.
examples.zh: 他说天色渐晚了。

examples.en: All the people present were moved at his remark.
examples.zh: 听了他的话，在场的人都被感动了。

examples.en: Your work has been remarkable this week.
examples.zh: 这星期你的工作很出色。

examples.en: The famous singer died, but her sweet voice will be remembered for ever.
examples.zh: 这位著名歌手去世了，但她甜美的声音将永远被铭记。

items.explanation: 系常用词，指“过去的事情仍在记忆中，不必费劲就能想起”。

examples.en: He'll remember this day.
examples.zh: 他会记住这一天。

items.explanation: 较 remember 正式，指“对自己或他人的过去进行有意的回忆”。

examples.en: Let me recall what he said.
examples.zh: 让我回想一下他说过什么。

items.explanation: 指“由于受到提醒或启发而想起往事”。

examples.en: Your story reminds me of another.
examples.zh: 你的故事使我想起另一个故事。

examples.en: The photo reminds me of the days when we were having a holiday at the seaside.
examples.zh: 这张照片使我想起了我们在海边度假的日子。

examples.en: This is an important reminder for all of us.
examples.zh: 这是对我们所有人的一个重要的提醒。

examples.en: In busy farming seasons, the small remote village seems deserted.
examples.zh: 农忙季节，这个偏远的小村子显得空荡荡的。(奉贤)

examples.en: remove one's hat/coat
examples.zh: 脱掉帽子/外衣

examples.en: to renew one's library ticket
examples.zh: 更换图书卡

examples.en: He pays a weekly rent of 100 dollars.
examples.zh: 他每星期付 100 美元的房租。

examples.en: My father rents an office in the city.
examples.zh: 我父亲在城里租了间办公室。

examples.en: The students can not only operate the machines safely but also repair them.
examples.zh: 学生们不仅能安全地操作这些机器，而且还能修理这些机器。

examples.en: I'm afraid this old radio is beyond repair.
examples.zh: 恐怕这台旧收音机修不好了。

examples.en: Though I repeated the phone number many times, the foreigner still couldn't write it down.
examples.zh: 虽然我把电话号码重复了好多次，但这个外国人还是不能把它写下来。

examples.en: George replaced Edward as captain.
examples.zh: 乔治接替爱德华出任队长。

examples.en: She smiled, but didn't reply.
examples.zh: 她笑而不答。

examples.en: Why have you never made any reply to what I asked?
examples.zh: 为什么你从不回答我问的问题？

examples.en: The newspaper reported that there had been a fire in the village.
examples.zh: 报纸报道说这个村庄失过一次火。

examples.en: The newspaper report was on the front page.
examples.zh: 这篇新闻报道在头版。

examples.en: The reporter described the accident in detail.
examples.zh: 记者详尽地描述了那起意外事件。

examples.en: Mr. Wang was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
examples.zh: 王先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

examples.en: Are your opinions representative of those of the other students?
examples.zh: 你们的意见代表其他学生的吗？

examples.en: the People's Republic of China
examples.zh: 中华人民共和国

examples.en: a man of good reputation
examples.zh: 信誉很好的人

examples.en: Gentlemen are requested not to smoke.
examples.zh: 先生们请勿吸烟。

examples.en: She made a request for some water.
examples.zh: 她请求给点水。

examples.en: A dozen interviewees, including beginners and professionals, said they were enthusiastic about rock climbing because it required them to solve problems creatively.
examples.zh: 包括新手和资深玩家在内的多位受访者表示，他们热衷攀岩是因为这项运动需要他们富有创造性地解决问题。(黄浦)

examples.en: to meet/satisfy/fill one's requirements
examples.zh: 满足某人的要求

examples.en: News came that all the people suffering from the flood were rescued.
examples.zh: 消息传来，水灾地区所有的受灾者都得救了。

examples.en: The rescue attempt was impeded by bad weather.
examples.zh: 营救工作受到恶劣天气的阻碍。

examples.en: Our efforts are rewarded so long as the results of this research can be applied to the development of new technologies.
examples.zh: 只要这项研究的结果能够应用于新技术的开发，我们的努力就得到了回报。(徐汇)

examples.en: The historical background to the play has been very carefully and thoroughly researched.
examples.zh: 这个剧本的历史背景已经过精心缜密的研究。

examples.en: They resemble each other in personality, and they've been friends for years.
examples.zh: 他俩性格相似，已是多年的朋友了。

examples.en: I have reserved a room for you at the hotel.
examples.zh: 我已在旅馆为你预订了一个房间。

examples.en: change one's residence
examples.zh: 更换住处

examples.en: Only by boat can the nearby residents have easy access to this island.
examples.zh: 只有通过乘船，周边的居民才能容易地到达这个岛上。

examples.en: Whether you will resign next month or not, it's essential to do well in the work at hand, as it reflects your character.
examples.zh: 无论你下个月是否离职，都必须在当前工作表现出色，因为这体现了你的品格。(长宁)

examples.en: I could no longer resist the urge to watch the basketball match last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我没能抑制住冲动，看了篮球比赛。

examples.en: When she had attempted to cut his nails he resisted.
examples.zh: 她试图给他剪指甲，他不让。

examples.en: Generally speaking, there was no resistance to the idea.
examples.zh: 一般说来，没有人会反对这个观点。

examples.en: Don't be afraid of getting caught in the rain, as it's time to see whether your new overcoat is resistant to the rain.
examples.zh: 别担心淋雨，正是试试你的新外套是否防雨的好时机。（普陀）

examples.en: She's always making good resolutions.
examples.zh: 她决心总是下得很好。

examples.en: I resolved to visit my grandmother at least once a year.
examples.zh: 我决定每年至少去看望祖母一次。

examples.en: So far, the countryside resort has not been equipped with wireless network, which brings much inconvenience to tourists.
examples.zh: 这个乡间度假村至今还没有配备无线网络，这给游客带来诸多不便。（青浦）

examples.en: While developing economy, we must pay attention to saving resources and preventing pollution.
examples.zh: 在发展经济的同时，我们必须注意节约资源和防止污染。

examples.en: The new job is better paid, but in some respect less interesting.
examples.zh: 这份新工作报酬更多，但在某些方面没那么有趣。

examples.en: I respect him for his diligence.
examples.zh: 我敬佩他的勤奋。

items.explanation: (指品行高尚且有社会地位的人)可敬的；值得尊敬的；(指衣服、外表、行为等)文雅的；体面的

examples.en: They are poor, but respectable.
examples.zh: 他们虽然穷但受人尊敬。

items.explanation: 表示尊敬的；恭敬的 (指对别人的尊敬)

examples.en: Be more respectful to your seniors.
examples.zh: 更加尊重长者。

items.explanation: 可敬的，有威望的 (常修饰年长者或权威性意见等)

examples.en: He is a highly respected scientist in the world.
examples.zh: 他是世界上具有很高威望的科学家。

examples.en: They are each recognized specialists in their respective fields.
examples.zh: 他们在各自的领域都被视为专家。

examples.en: The first, second and third prizes went to James, Lytton and Tom respectively.
examples.zh: 头等奖、二等奖、三等奖分别为詹姆斯、利顿和汤姆所得。

examples.en: My American friend responded to my letter with a phone call.
examples.zh: 我美国的朋友收到我的信，给我回了一个电话。

examples.en: She has received a response from that college to her application.
examples.zh: 她已经收到那所大学对她申请的答复。

examples.en: It was because of a strong sense of responsibility and much working experience that the teacher who worked in the countryside cultivated a great number of excellent students.
examples.zh: 正是因为有强烈的责任感和丰富的实践经验，这位乡村老师才培养出了一批批优秀的学生。

examples.en: Who do you think should be responsible for the serious accident?
examples.zh: 你认为谁该为这起严重的事故负责？

examples.en: Parents are supposed to be responsible for their children’s education.
examples.zh: 父母理应对其子女的教育负有责任。

examples.en: to take a rest
examples.zh: 休息一下

examples.en: I rested for an hour before I went out.
examples.zh: 我在出去前休息了一个小时。

examples.en: Take what you want and throw the rest away.
examples.zh: 把你想要的拿去，剩下的丢掉。

examples.en: The customers are pleased with the service of the restaurant.
examples.zh: 顾客对这家餐厅的服务感到满意。

examples.en: The patient was restless from pain.
examples.zh: 病人因疼痛而坐卧不宁。

examples.en: His skill of restoring ancient paintings has reached such a level that he has restored the one covered with dust for a long time to its former glamour.
examples.zh: 他的古画修复水平如此之高，使得那幅尘封已久的画作重现光彩。（杨浦）

examples.en: Women in China are no longer restricted to domestic labour now.
examples.zh: 现在，中国妇女不再被束缚于家务劳动了。

examples.en: I am optimistic about the result of the game.
examples.zh: 我对这场比赛的结果抱乐观态度。（宝山）

examples.en: The accident resulted in three people being killed.
examples.zh: 这次事故造成 3 人死亡。

examples.en: He performed perfectly in the interview and as a result, he was given the job.
examples.zh: 他在面试中表现完美，因此得到了那份工作。

examples.en: Grain shortage resulted from continuous rapid increase of population.
examples.zh: 人口不断迅速增长造成了粮食短缺。

examples.en: The collision of the two ships resulted in a serious oil spill.
examples.zh: 两艘船相撞导致了严重的石油外泄。

examples.en: Please send a detailed résumé to our company.
examples.zh: 请给我们公司寄一份详细的履历。

examples.en: to retire from the world
examples.zh: 遁世

examples.en: He has returned to his old habits.
examples.zh: 他重拾旧习。

examples.en: When will you return the book I lent you?
examples.zh: 你什么时候把我借给你的书还给我？

examples.en: We look forward to your return from abroad.
examples.zh: 我们盼着你回国。

examples.en: His wish to reunite with his parents came true.
examples.zh: 他与父母亲团聚的愿望实现了。

examples.en: It is said that the secret of hers was not revealed till her death.
examples.zh: 据说直到她去世，她的那个秘密才被透露出来。

examples.en: She said she would take her revenge on Tom.
examples.zh: 她说她要向汤姆报仇。

examples.en: He repeatedly assured his mother that he would revenge his dead brother.
examples.zh: 他多次向妈妈保证他将为死去的哥哥报仇。

examples.en: I'll revenge on you one day.
examples.zh: 总有一天我会找你报仇的。

examples.en: the reverse side of a fabric
examples.zh: 织物的反面

examples.en: The truth is just the reverse.
examples.zh: 真实情况恰好相反。

examples.en: Have you reviewed what we covered in class yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天我们课堂上讲的东西你们复习了吗？

examples.en: The college published a drama review.
examples.zh: 学院出版了一份戏剧评论刊物。

examples.en: He often revises his lessons at home.
examples.zh: 他经常在家复习功课。

discriminations.intro: review 和 revise 都有“复习”的意思，revise 主要用于美式英语。

examples.en: It is necessary for us to review/revise the old lessons now and then.
examples.zh: 我们必须常常复习旧课。

examples.en: It is necessary for us to review/revise the old lessons now and then.
examples.zh: 我们必须常常复习旧课。

examples.en: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
examples.zh: 实际上写作过程中最重要的阶段是修改。

examples.en: The revolution broke out.
examples.zh: 革命爆发了。

examples.en: He suffered for his revolutionary principles.
examples.zh: 他为了自己的革命原则而遭受苦难。

examples.zh: 汤姆因表现勇敢而获得了一枚奖章，这一点也不奇怪。

examples.en: They rewarded him with a gift of money.
examples.zh: 他们用钱报答他。

examples.en: She tried to rewrite the story in easy English.
examples.zh: 她试着用简单的英文改写那则故事。

examples.en: I can't find a rhyme to “teacup”.
examples.zh: 我找不到一个与 “teacup” 同韵的词。

examples.en: the exciting rhythms of drum music

examples.en: The southerners prefer rice and the northerners prefer food made from flour.
examples.zh: 南方人比较喜欢吃米饭，北方人爱吃面食。

examples.en: This kind of plant grows well in the soil rich in minerals.
examples.zh: 这种植物在矿物质多的土壤里长势良好。

examples.zh: 要改掉一个人的习惯是不容易的。

examples.en: You are supposed to get rid of carelessness, for it often leads to irretrievable errors.
examples.zh: 你们一定要克服粗枝大叶，因为粗枝大叶常常引起无可挽回的错误。

examples.en: Scientists claimed yesterday to have solved the riddle of the birth of the universe.
examples.zh: 科学家们昨天声称已经解开了宇宙形成之谜。

examples.zh: 他坐小汽车去转了一圈。

examples.en: She was riding a bicycle.
examples.zh: 她在骑一辆自行车。

examples.en: As its rider tried to free it, the horse kicked out.
examples.zh: 骑手想松开那匹马时，它乱踢乱蹬。

examples.en: a ridiculous suggestion
examples.zh: 可笑的建议

examples.en: My decision proved to be right.
examples.zh: 事实证明我的决定是对的。

examples.en: No matter how happiness changes in definition, people will never give up their rights to pursue happiness.
examples.zh: 无论幸福的定义如何变化，人们永远不会放弃追求幸福的权利。（杨浦）

examples.en: Rigid traditions melted away.
examples.zh: 死板的传统渐渐解体。

examples.en: a wedding ring
examples.zh: 结婚戒指

examples.en: I rang (up) Peter to see if he could come to dinner.
examples.zh: 我给彼得打电话问他是否能来吃饭。

examples.en: I was so absorbed in reading that I didn't hear my cell phone ringing.
examples.zh: 我在全神贯注地看书，没有听到手机在响。

examples.en: This apple isn't ripe yet — we can't eat it.
examples.zh: 这个苹果还没有熟，我们不能吃。

examples.en: a rise in prices
examples.zh: 物价上涨

examples.en: Nowadays, the cost of living keeps rising while people's income remains unchanged.
examples.zh: 近来，生活费用持续上涨，人们的收入却没什么变化。

examples.en: Some government officials ran the risk of committing crimes for their personal interests.
examples.zh: 某些政府官员为了个人利益不惜冒险犯罪。

examples.en: to risk failure
examples.zh: 冒失败之险

examples.en: What we see is an old ritual.
examples.zh: 我们看到的是一种古老的仪式。

examples.en: These factories are trying their best not to pollute the river any longer.
examples.zh: 这些工厂正在尽力不再污染河流。

examples.en: It is not obvious when the road is to be opened to traffic.
examples.zh: 这条马路何时通车还不清楚。

r.name: Confidence in yourself is the first step on the road to success.
trans: 自信是走向成功的第一步。

examples.en: The waves are roaring.
examples.zh: 波涛在呼啸。

examples.en: roar approval of a resolution
examples.zh: 大声表示赞成决议

examples.zh: 怒狮的吼声

examples.en: By the time the Peking duck was roasted, the smell had made all the foreign diners' mouths water.
examples.zh: 北京烤鸭烤好时，香味让所有外国食客都垂涎三尺。（长宁）

examples.en: You have robbed me of my happiness.
examples.zh: 你剥夺了我的幸福。

examples.en: Her younger brother was cut by a robber last week.
examples.zh: 她弟弟上周被劫匪砍伤。

examples.en: Two bank robberies were reported in this area last month.
examples.zh: 上个月这一地区报道了两起银行抢劫案。

examples.en: Compared to its lifelike appearance, the robot's function of guarding the house is a bigger sell.
examples.zh: 相比其栩栩如生的外表，机器人看家护院的功能是一个更大的卖点。（金山）

examples.en: throw rocks at sb.
examples.zh: 向某人掷石块

examples.en: He is a drummer in a rock band.
examples.zh: 他是一个摇滚乐团的鼓手。

examples.en: When I came back inside, light and air bursting in with me, Grandma, her hair up, would rock a little and smile.
examples.zh: 当我回到屋内时，光线和空气一起冲进来，梳起头发的奶奶会微笑着晃动一下身子。

examples.en: This space rocket carries two satellites.
examples.zh: 这枚太空火箭搭载了2颗卫星。

examples.en: So important a role does the mobile phone play in people's daily life that no one dares to travel without it.
examples.zh: 手机在人们日常生活中起着如此重要的作用，没有人敢不带手机去旅行。

examples.en: The ball rolled into the hole.
examples.zh: 球滚进了洞里。

examples.en: She rolled her sleeves up and began to prepare for the party.
examples.zh: 她卷起袖子，开始为派对做准备。

examples.en: The desk calculator uses a roll of paper.
examples.zh: 这台台式计算器使用卷纸。

examples.en: a very romantic love story
examples.zh: 一个浪漫色彩极浓的爱情故事

examples.en: He's an old-fashioned romantic.
examples.zh: 他是一个老派的浪漫主义者。

examples.en: Rising through the roof is the Tower of the Sun, inside which stands a 160-foot-tall Tree of Life.
examples.zh: 穿过屋顶矗立着“太阳之塔”，在里面有一棵160英尺高的“生命之树”。

examples.en: His room is twice the size of mine. In other words, my room is only half as big as his.
examples.zh: 他的房间是我的房间的2倍大，换句话说，我的房间只有他的房间的一半大。

examples.en: Money is the root of all evil.
examples.zh: 金钱是万恶之源。

examples.en: Root the cuttings in a heated propagator.
examples.zh: 把插条放在加热的培育箱里生根。

examples.en: Some cuttings root easily.
examples.zh: 有些插枝易于生根。

examples.en: They tied the ship to the quay with ropes.
examples.zh: 他们用绳子把船拴在码头上。

examples.en: I have to prune the roses.
examples.zh: 我得给玫瑰修剪枝条。

examples.en: The woodwork of the house was rotting away.
examples.zh: 这座房子的木结构正在腐烂。

examples.en: These bananas will go rotten in a week.
examples.zh: 这些香蕉一星期之内会烂。

examples.en: He has a rough tongue.
examples.zh: 他语言粗鲁。

examples.en: A ball is round.
examples.zh: 球是圆的。

examples.zh: 一场10回合的拳击赛

examples.zh: 地球围绕太阳转。

examples.en: Unlike regular buses, this type of smart bus can automatically plan its route, avoid pedestrians and vehicles, and take passengers to their destination.
examples.zh: 和普通巴士不同，这款智能巴士可以自动规划路线，避让行人和车辆，将乘客送达目的地。（虹口）

examples.en: The flight is routed to Chicago via New York.
examples.zh: 这个航班经纽约飞往芝加哥。

items.explanation: 路（泛指任何的道路，也可指一处到另一处的路线）

examples.en: It's a long way from my home to school.
examples.zh: 从我家到学校路很远。

items.explanation: 路（尤指公路，也指“路线，航线”）

examples.en: They discovered a new route to the camp.
examples.zh: 他们发现一条新的通往营地的路线。

examples.zh: 开始日常的例行公事

examples.en: a routine medical examination
examples.zh: 常规的体检

examples.en: A row of children are standing in front of a row of chairs.
examples.zh: 一排小孩站在一排椅子前。

examples.en: We rowed down the river.
examples.zh: 我们划船顺流而下。

examples.en: the royal palace
examples.zh: 王宫

examples.en: She rubbed her shoes with a cloth to make them shine.
examples.zh: 她用一块布把鞋擦得锃亮。

examples.en: Rubber bullets were used to break up the demonstration.
examples.zh: 橡皮子弹被用来驱散示威人群。

examples.en: There is a pile of rubbish in the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 在街道的拐角处有一堆垃圾。

examples.en: He was punished because he was rude to his teacher.
examples.zh: 他被处罚了，因为他对老师不礼貌。

examples.en: The next Rugby World Cup will take place in three years' time.
examples.zh: 下一届橄榄球世界杯赛将于3年后举行。

examples.en: I was ruined by that law case.
examples.zh: 我被那场官司搞得倾家荡产。

examples.en: the ruin of his hopes
examples.zh: 他的希望的破灭

examples.en: You should obey the traffic rules.
examples.zh: 你应该遵守交通规则。

examples.en: The king rules that country.
examples.zh: 国王统治着那个国家。

examples.en: This is a ruler graduated in both inches and centimetres.
examples.zh: 这是一把刻有英寸和厘米的尺子。

examples.en: He runs fastest in our class.
examples.zh: 他是我们班跑得最快的。

examples.en: His father ran a prosperous paint business.
examples.zh: 他的父亲经营着一家生意红火的涂料公司。

examples.en: It runs across Britain from Anglesey in northwest Wales to Dover in southeast England.
examples.zh: 它穿越英国，从威尔士西北部的安格尔西到英格兰东南部的多佛。

examples.en: I ran across the article in yesterday’s newspaper.
examples.zh: 我在昨天的报纸上偶然发现了这篇文章。

examples.en: If you run after two hares, you will catch neither.
examples.zh: 同时追两兔，全都抓不住。

examples.en: How brave the unarmed young man was when he prevented the criminal from running away from the scene at the risk of his own life!
examples.zh: 这个手无寸铁的年轻人冒着生命危险阻止了歹徒逃离现场，他是多么勇敢啊！

examples.en: If you run into any problems, don't hesitate to ask me for help.
examples.zh: 如果你遇到任何问题，请随时向我求助。

examples.en: Rarely do we run out of conversation.
examples.zh: 我们有谈不完的话。（上海高考）

examples.en: the world's fastest runner
examples.zh: 世界上最快的赛跑运动员

examples.en: Specialists propose that sales campaigns should be launched in rural areas.
examples.zh: 专家建议推销活动要面向农村地区。

examples.en: Someone inside the building rushed out.
examples.zh: 大楼里有个人冲了出来。

examples.en: The driver was rushed to casualty after the car accident.
examples.zh: 车祸后，司机被迅速送到急救室抢救。

examples.en: I don't like the rush of modern life.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢快节奏的现代生活。

examples.en: His apartment was the most famous literary salon in Russia.
examples.zh: 他的公寓是俄罗斯最著名的文学沙龙。

examples.en: Can you make yourself understood in Russian?
examples.zh: 你能用俄语表达你的意思吗？

examples.en: Six of the 38 people were Russian citizens.
examples.zh: 38个人中有6个是俄罗斯公民。

examples.en: Those dresses range in price from twenty to fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 那些裙子的价格从20美元到50美元不等。

examples.en: He reached out for the book on the top shelf, but couldn’t reach it.
examples.zh: 他伸手去拿书架顶层的书，但是够不到。

examples.en: All applicants will have equal opportunities regardless of age, gender or nationality.
examples.zh: 所有申请者，无论年龄、性别或国籍都具有同等机会。

examples.en: I reminded him of the appointment, but he didn’t make any response.
examples.zh: 我提醒他约会的事情，但他没有任何反应。

examples.en: They replaced the narrow streets with wide boulevards.
examples.zh: 他们将狭窄的街道都改建成了宽阔的林荫大道。

examples.en: She responded to the news by bursting into tears.
examples.zh: 她听到那个消息后突然就哭了起来。

examples.en: I reward my children with ice cream for their decent behavior.
examples.zh: 孩子们举止得体，我奖励他们冰淇淋。

examples.en: He is not willing to run the risk of losing his money.
examples.zh: 他不愿意冒赔钱的风险。

examples.en: He is not willing to run the risk of losing his money.
examples.zh: 他不愿意冒赔钱的风险。

examples.en: You cannot park here during the rush hour.
examples.zh: 交通高峰时你不能把车停在这儿。

examples.en: a sack of candies
examples.zh: 一袋糖果

examples.en: A church is a sacred building.
examples.zh: 教堂是神圣的建筑物。

examples.en: Parents make a lot of sacrifice so that their children can live better in the future.
examples.zh: 父母做出很多牺牲，为的是他们的子女将来能生活得好一些。

examples.en: You shouldn't sacrifice the environment to promote economic growth.
examples.zh: 你不应该为了促进经济增长而牺牲环境。

examples.en: We are very sad and angry to hear that the bad milk powder caused the deaths of over 30 babies.
examples.zh: 得知劣质奶粉引起 30 多个婴儿死亡，我们非常难过，非常生气。

examples.en: Don't sadden your friends and gladden your enemies.
examples.zh: 勿使亲者痛仇者快。

examples.en: I decided not to buy frozen dumplings though the government said they were safe.
examples.zh: 虽然政府说冷冻饺子是安全的，但我还是决定不买。

examples.en: The files are now in a safe to which only he has the key.
examples.zh: 文件目前放在一个只有他才能打开的保险柜里。

examples.en: All pilots are responsible for their passengers' safety.
examples.zh: 所有飞行员都对乘客的安全负责。

examples.en: When does the ship sail?
examples.zh: 这艘船何时起航？

examples.en: I don't recollect how to sail a boat.
examples.zh: 我想不起怎样驾船了。

examples.en: in full sail
examples.zh: 张满帆

examples.en: The sailor went through all the motions smartly.
examples.zh: 这个水手机灵地走了走过场。

examples.en: for safety's sake
examples.zh: 为了安全起见

examples.en: An increasing number of people tend to use the ATM for the sake of convenience.
examples.zh: 为方便起见，越来越多的人倾向于使用自动取款机。

examples.en: He had a steak and a green salad.
examples.zh: 他要了一块牛排和一份生菜沙拉。

examples.en: He was engaged at a salary of $1,000 a month.
examples.zh: 他以月薪 1000 美元受聘。

examples.en: In addition to enriching students' school life, the school charity sale has also improved their ability to organize an activity and developed their team spirit.
examples.zh: 校园义卖活动不仅丰富了校园生活，还提高了学生们的组织活动能力，培养了他们的团队合作精神。

examples.en: This ten-dollar hat is now on sale for five.
examples.zh: 10 美元一顶的帽子现在减价卖 5 美元。

examples.en: Daly was a fast-talking Irish-American who had started out as a salesman.
examples.zh: 达利是个花言巧语的爱尔兰裔美国人，最初是做推销员的。

examples.en: Salt occurs naturally in sea water.
examples.zh: 盐天然存在于海水中。

examples.en: They gave her salty water to make her vomit.
examples.zh: 他们给她喝盐水，好让她吐出来。

examples.en: If parents share the same idea on the issue of educating their children, the family will be more harmonious.
examples.zh: 如果父母在教育孩子的问题上意见一致，家庭就会更加和睦。（闵行）

examples.en: give a sample of one's courage
examples.zh: 用实例表明自己的勇气

examples.en: children playing on the sand(s)
examples.zh: 在沙滩上玩耍的儿童

examples.en: To make a ham sandwich you put a slice of ham between two slices of bread.
examples.zh: 把一片火腿夹在两片面包之间就做成了火腿三明治。

examples.en: The moon is the earth's satellite.
examples.zh: 月球是地球的卫星。

examples.en: Taking up a job that is worth doing can bring people mental satisfaction.
examples.zh: 从事值得做的工作会给人以精神上的满足感。

examples.en: It's satisfactory to know that he came back safely.
examples.zh: 令人满意的是得知他安全地回来了。

items.explanation: 感到满意的

examples.en: He came out with a satisfied smile on his face.
examples.zh: 他出来时露出满意的微笑。

items.explanation: 令人满足的，令人满意的

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its delicious food and satisfying service.
examples.zh: 这家饭店因美味的食物和周到的服务而著名。

items.explanation: [通常作表语] 令人满意的

examples.en: The result of the test is satisfactory.
examples.zh: 考试结果令人满意。

examples.en: It's hard for a teacher to satisfy all his students in the class.
examples.zh: 教师很难使班上所有的学生都满意。

examples.en: We're going boating on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们打算星期六去划船。

examples.en: The sauce tastes too sweet.
examples.zh: 这种酱汁味道太甜。

examples.en: Refilling his cup, she slopped some tea into the saucer.
examples.zh: 给他续茶的时候，她不小心溅了一些在茶碟上。

examples.en: He dropped his sausage on the pavement and someone's dog ate it, mustard and all.
examples.zh: 他把香肠丢在人行道上，不知是谁家的狗将香肠连带芥末都吃个了精光。

examples.en: Although the doctors did everything they could to save the sick boy, they failed at last.
examples.zh: 虽然医生们尽力拯救这个生病的男孩，但最终还是失败了。

s.name: A stitch in time saves nine.

examples.en: She went to the bank and drew out all her savings.
examples.zh: 她去银行取出所有存款。

examples.en: It is said that Chinese started to use paper money earlier than Westerners.
examples.zh: 据说，中国人比西方人更早使用纸币。

examples.en: What time does your watch say?
examples.zh: 你的表几点了？

items.explanation: speak 和 talk 通常用作不及物动词，都有“说话”的意思。在会议上正式发言用 speak，其名词为 speech。speak 在用作及物动词时，其宾语一般是语言或词语之类的话语。

examples.en: I know of the man, but I've never spoken to him.
examples.zh: 我知道这个人，不过从来没有和他说话。

examples.en: He spoke at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在会上发言了。

examples.en: He speaks English very well.
examples.zh: 他的英语说得很好。

items.explanation: 表示“随便漫谈”，其名词亦为 talk。“我想和你聊一聊。”应译成：I want to have a talk with you。“我有话要和你说。”可译成：I want to speak to you. 或 I have a word with you。

examples.en: Human beings can talk, but animals can't.
examples.zh: 人会说话，而动物却不会。

examples.en: They have been talking since two o'clock.
examples.zh: 从两点钟到现在，他们一直在谈话。

items.explanation: 作“讲；描述；讲述；告诉”解，是及物动词，后常跟表示“故事；经历”的词。可以跟直接引语或间接引语作为宾语，它没有相应的名词。

examples.en: He is telling an interesting story.
examples.zh: 他在讲一个有趣的故事。

items.explanation: 表示“说”，可以跟直接引语或间接引语作为宾语，它没有相应的名词。

examples.en: He said nothing.
examples.zh: 他什么话都没说。

examples.en: "There's no smoke without fire", as the saying goes.
examples.zh: 常言道：“无风不起浪。”

examples.en: place the meat on the scale
examples.zh: 把肉放在磅秤上过秤

examples.en: The boxer scaled 90 kilos.
examples.zh: 那名拳击手的体重为 90 公斤。

examples.en: The force of the wind is measured on a standard scale of 0-12.
examples.zh: 风力是按 0-12 级标准等级测量的。

examples.en: He scanned the newspaper while having his breakfast.
examples.zh: 他在吃早餐时把报纸粗略地翻阅了一下。

examples.en: That bird has become scarce in this country.
examples.zh: 那种鸟在这个国家已变得很稀有了。

examples.en: You could scarcely find a better person for this job than Miss Cane.
examples.zh: 想要找比凯恩小姐更适合的人来做这项工作怕是很难了。

examples.en: That noise scared me.
examples.zh: 那声音把我吓坏了。

examples.en: A scarf can keep me warm in winter.
examples.zh: 围巾在冬天可以让我觉得暖和。

examples.zh: 我待在宾馆里，透过窗口看到的是美丽的景色。

examples.en: No scenery is more beautiful than what I am enjoying here.
examples.zh: 没有什么能比得上我在这里看到的景色。

items.explanation: 指一个景色或场景，包括人或动作；指舞台某个场面或部分布景；也指实际生活等中的场面。

examples.en: This is a scene of children playing in the garden.
examples.zh: 这是孩子们在公园里玩耍的情景。

items.explanation: 指一个地区的整个自然景色；也指舞台的全部布景或整个场面。

examples.en: The natural scenery of China is beautiful.
examples.zh: 中国的自然景色美不胜收。

examples.zh: 日落是一幅多美的景象。

examples.zh: 右转，我看到了一家快餐店。

examples.zh: 从酒店顶楼的房间看出去风景很美。

examples.zh: 你可能认为艺术只意味着绘画或雕塑。

examples.zh: 信写好后把它装进空白信封里封好。

examples.zh: 爸爸坐在书桌旁看报。

examples.zh: 有几秒钟大家都沉默无语。

examples.zh: 在中学，孩子获得更深一些的知识。

examples.zh: 两国间有秘密协定。

examples.zh: 老夫妇俩过着平静安定的生活。

examples.zh: 这些安全措施仍将继续实施至下月初。

examples.zh: 看到母亲正在康复，他感觉轻松了许多。

examples.zh: 我想要到机场给你送行。

examples.zh: 从一开始我就看穿了你的小计谋。

examples.zh: 他说谎不高明，任何人都能识破。

examples.zh: 请注意，没有身份证明的人是不能进来的。

examples.zh: 你来负责处理下次委员会会议的安排工作，好吗？

examples.zh: 请确保包装可以适合长途海运。

examples.en: The farmers are scattering seeds.
examples.zh: 农夫们在播种。

examples.en: They mowed the wide lawns and seeded them.
examples.zh: 他们割了大片草地的草，然后在上面播种。

examples.en: We sought an answer to the question, but couldn't find one.
examples.zh: 我们在寻求这个问题的答案，可是没能找到。

examples.zh: 最让我担心的是，这孩子除了在线游戏之外，似乎对周围的一切都视而不见。(松江)

examples.en: We must seize every opportunity to improve ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们必须抓住每一个提升自己的机会。

examples.en: Seldom does he realize the importance of communicating with others.
examples.zh: 他很少意识到与别人交流的重要性。

examples.en: I was selected for the team.
examples.zh: 我被选入这个队。

examples.en: He's too selfish to think of lending me his car.
examples.zh: 他很自私，不想把汽车借给我。

examples.zh: 那位作家写的这本书去年销售情况不好。

examples.zh: 她给我寄来一件礼物。

examples.en: He sent to warn me.
examples.zh: 他捎信来提醒我注意。

examples.en: Honours were automatically awarded to senior officials just because they were senior.
examples.zh: 荣誉顺理成章地授予资深官员，就因为他们资格老。

examples.en: He is my senior by three years.
examples.zh: 他比我大3岁。

examples.en: Her sense of duty is worthy of being praised.
examples.zh: 她的责任心值得称道。

examples.en: He sensed that his proposals were unwelcome.
examples.zh: 他觉得他的建议不受欢迎。

examples.en: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning.
examples.zh: 你可以通过合理计划来提高盈利的机会。

examples.en: He's a sensitive lad and some of the criticism has stung him.
examples.zh: 他是个敏感的小伙子，有些批评刺痛了他。

examples.en: Please make a whole sentence when answering the question.
examples.zh: 回答问题时请说完整的句子。

examples.en: They have gone to separate places.
examples.zh: 他们去了不同的地方。

examples.en: Britain is separated from the other European countries by the English Channel.
examples.zh: 英吉利海峡把英国和其他欧洲国家分开。

examples.en: The economy continued to exhibit signs of decline in September.
examples.zh: 9月，经济继续呈现出衰退的迹象。

examples.en: Students will benefit a lot by studying abroad, but they are likely to be faced with a series of challenges that they have never met with before.
examples.zh: 出国学习会使学生受益匪浅，但是他们有可能会面临一系列前所未有的挑战。

examples.en: Not until she knew about the relevant information in the newspaper did she realize how serious the problem of food waste was.
examples.zh: 她在报纸上了解到相关信息，这才意识到粮食浪费的问题有多严重。

examples.en: The servant bowed the guests out as they left.
examples.zh: 客人们离去时，仆人躬身送他们出门。

examples.en: Science serves the people.
examples.zh: 科学为人民服务。

examples.en: Many college students volunteered to serve as interpreters for the international conference.
examples.zh: 许多大学生志愿充当国际会议的口译员。

examples.zh: 社会活动是理论联系实际的桥梁。

examples.zh: 这家超市的特色是 24 小时服务。

examples.zh: 学习方法包括听讲座、导师辅导、个案研究与实操课程。

examples.en: He set his hand on my shoulder.
examples.zh: 他把手搁在我肩上。

examples.en: The sun has set.
examples.zh: 日已西沉。

discriminations.intro: 这两个词组均有“开始做某事”的意思，但用法有所不同。

examples.en: I set out to cook as soon as I got home.
examples.zh: 我一到家就开始做饭。

examples.en: When will you set about building the house?
examples.zh: 你什么时候开始建造房屋？

examples.en: We set about our task as soon as we got there.
examples.zh: 我们一到那儿就开始执行我们的任务。

examples.en: After the earthquake, the people set about rebuilding their homes.
examples.zh: 地震过后，人们开始重建家园。

examples.en: After the earthquake, people set about rebuilding their homes.
examples.zh: 地震过后，人们开始重建家园。

examples.en: He didn't realize that he should have set aside more time to accompany the family instead of being busy with his work until he was divorced from his wife.
examples.zh: 直到妻子与他离了婚，他才意识到应该多抽一些时间陪伴家人，而不是一心忙工作。（金山）

examples.zh: 他们同意搁置分歧，为同一目标而努力。

examples.en: I try to set aside a few minutes each day to do some exercise.
examples.zh: 我每天尽量腾出一些时间锻炼一下身体。

examples.zh: 安全起见，你最好出发前查一下地图，避开拥堵的路线。（青浦）

examples.en: The foreign minister set off on another diplomatic trip.
examples.zh: 外交部长开始了又一次外交之旅。

examples.en: Informed on the phone that the flight had been cancelled, she set out for the train station immediately.
examples.zh: 接到电话说航班已取消，她立刻出发去了火车站。（普陀）

examples.en: The journalist immediately set out to collect relevant information.
examples.zh: 记者立即着手搜集相关信息。

examples.en: The police set up roadblocks to check passing vehicles.
examples.zh: 警察设置了路障以检查过往车辆。

examples.en: The charity has set up a fund for the victims of the earthquake.
examples.zh: 这个慈善组织已经为地震的受灾者设立了一项基金。

examples.zh: 这故事的背景是古罗马。

examples.zh: 退休以后他回到家乡，在他出生的村子里安顿下来。

examples.zh: 我们已经定了由谁来付饭钱。

examples.en: I was a guide, a pathfinder, an original settler.
examples.zh: 我成了领路人、开拓者、原始移民。

examples.zh: 二加五等于七。

examples.zh: 我17岁时离开了家。

examples.zh: 他已从第7名跃升到第2名。

examples.zh: 那艘船可以载客70人。

examples.zh: 珍妮非常希望她的父母能允许她独自一人去日本旅游，但令她失望的是，他们不同意，还给出了多条理由。

examples.en: Don't be severe on him; he is only a boy.
examples.zh: 不要对他这么严厉，他还只是个孩子。

examples.zh: 他们坐在阴凉处。

examples.zh: 新出来的香型洗发水

examples.zh: 我下班后坚持练习瑜伽，因为这有助于我保持良好的身材。

examples.zh: 他用黏土捏了一只罐子。

examples.zh: 与会者来自各行各业，但他们一致认同教育的重要性。

examples.zh: 我们给了这 5 个孩子每人均等的一份。

examples.zh: 急转弯

examples.zh: 你们可以选择架子上的任何一个玩具，但每个人只能拿一个。

examples.zh: 我收集贝壳和海边有趣的小玩意儿。

examples.zh: 为人民提供安全的住所和食品是政府的职责。

examples.zh: 避开麻烦

examples.zh: 她把椅子向床移近。

examples.zh: 他父亲是一家炼钢厂的轮班工人。

examples.zh: 灯光照亮了小屋子。

examples.zh: 后天你去美国是乘飞机还是坐船？

examples.zh: 食物正被运往遭受旱灾的非洲南部。

examples.zh: 你认识那个穿白衬衣的人吗？

examples.zh: 许多窗户在爆炸中被震碎了。

examples.zh: 她去世的消息令我震惊。

examples.zh: 你不介意我把鞋子脱了，是吧？

examples.zh: 随着技术进步，人人都能拍一段视频上传到平台。（嘉定）

examples.zh: 商店里的商品琳琅满目，让我们无所适从。

examples.zh: 玛丽比她妈妈矮多了。

examples.zh: 女运动员穿着短上衣和紧身短裤。

examples.zh: 财务情况已经糟糕得不能再糟了；总之一句话，我们破产了。

examples.zh: 由于缺乏受过专业训练的教师，一些学校很难加入汉语教学的竞争。

examples.zh: 这条短裤是真丝做的，夏天穿起来很舒服。

examples.en: shoulder by shoulder
examples.zh: 肩并肩

examples.zh: 她大声喊叫求助。

examples.zh: 突如其来的一声呼喊转移了警察的注意力，犯人趁机逃跑了。

examples.zh: 她努力镇定下来，不把激动的情绪流露出来。

examples.zh: 许多人去看了花展。

examples.zh: 请带外宾们参观一下工厂。

examples.zh: 娜奥米当时正在炫耀她的订婚戒指。

examples.zh: 来参加开业典礼的人比我们预料的要多。
