examples.zh: 老师建议所有的学生都该学会怎么使用词典来查词。

examples.en: He agreed with health experts' suggestion that items such as towels and toothbrushes should be replaced regularly.
examples.zh: 他同意健康专家的建议：毛巾、牙刷等物品要定期更换。

examples.en: He resigned as he didn't think the post suited him.
examples.zh: 他辞职了，因为他认为这个岗位不适合他。

examples.en: a diving suit
examples.zh: 潜水服

examples.en: This wine is not suitable to my taste.
examples.zh: 这酒不合我的胃口。

examples.en: I bought a suitcase for next week's trip.
examples.zh: 我为下星期的旅行买了一只手提箱。

examples.en: He set aside a sum of money from his living expenses each month in case of emergency.
examples.zh: 他每月从生活费中留出一笔钱，以防患于未然。(崇明)

examples.en: The seven categories can be briefly summarised as follows.
examples.zh: 可以简单地归纳为如下 7 大类。

examples.en: What follows is a brief summary of the process.
examples.zh: 接下来是对此流程的一个简短概括。

examples.en: David didn't know where he was going to spend his holiday this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天大卫不知道要去哪里度假。

examples.en: I want to sit in the sun.
examples.zh: 我想在太阳下面坐一坐。

examples.en: She liked to sunbathe in the seclusion of her own garden.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在自己僻静的花园里晒日光浴。

examples.en: When I was cycling in Lushan Mountain with my primary school classmates last Sunday, we once saw that the top of the mountain was close at hand, but it was out of reach in fact.
examples.zh: 上星期日，我和小学同学结伴在庐山骑行，我们一度看到山巅近在咫尺，然而它实则遥不可及。

examples.en: I saw her sitting at a window table, bathed in sunlight.
examples.zh: 我看见她坐在靠窗的桌旁，沐浴在阳光中。

examples.en: It's bound to be sunny again tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天肯定又是阳光灿烂。

examples.en: We got up at sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们在日出时起床。

examples.en: We worked from sunup to sunset.
examples.zh: 我们从日出工作到日落。

examples.en: a super meal
examples.zh: 极好的饭菜

examples.en: After six months' training, the whole team is in superb form.
examples.zh: 经过 6 个月的训练，全队状态极佳。

examples.en: a superior cloth
examples.zh: 上好的布料

examples.en: The supermarket has a wide range of goods, which can meet the need of different customers.
examples.zh: 这家超市商品种类繁多，能满足不同的消费需求。(闵行)

examples.en: The role of the independent director is to supervise and restrict administrative authorities of the company.
examples.zh: 独立董事的职责是对公司的行政部门进行监督和约束。

examples.en: Each student has a supervisor to advise on the writing of the dissertation.
examples.zh: 每个学生都有导师指导他们写论文。

examples.en: Neither Betty nor Peter has potatoes for supper.
examples.zh: 无论是贝蒂还是彼得晚餐都没有吃土豆。

examples.en: When supply exceeds demand, problems come.
examples.zh: 当供大于求时，问题就来了。

examples.en: Our food supplies the energy for movement.
examples.zh: 食物为运动提供能量。

examples.en: They supply us with latest equipment regularly.
examples.zh: 他们定期向我们提供最新的设备。

examples.en: He did a part-time job so that he could support his family.
examples.zh: 他做了一份兼职工作，因此可以养家。

examples.en: We need your support.
examples.zh: 我们需要你的支持。

examples.en: Let's suppose that the news is true.
examples.zh: 让我们假定那个消息是真的。

examples.en: Not until the mother made sure that her son had got home safe and sound did she feel relieved.
examples.zh: 直到那位母亲确认她的儿子已安然无恙地到家，她才松了一口气。

items.explanation: 相同点：be sure of/about (= be certain of/about) 确信；be sure + 从句 (= be certain + 从句) 肯定；be sure to do sth. (= be certain to do sth.) 确信做某事；for sure (= for certain) 确定，肯定；make sure (= make certain) 确信

examples.en: We are quite sure/certain about their success.
examples.zh: 我们对他们的成功相当有信心。

examples.en: I am sure/certain that he meant no harm to you.
examples.zh: 我肯定他并不想伤害你。

examples.en: She is certain/sure to win the first place in the 100-meter race.
examples.zh: 她肯定能获得 100 米跑的第一名。

examples.en: I don't know for certain/sure who will win the election.
examples.zh: 这次选举谁将获胜，我不太确定。

examples.en: Would you mind going back to make sure/certain that the door is locked?
examples.zh: 你回去确定一下门是否关上了，好吗？

items.explanation: 不同点：作定语时，sure 意为“可靠的”。

examples.en: He is a sure friend.
examples.zh: 他是个值得信赖的朋友。

items.explanation: 不同点：主语是 it 时，只能用 certain；作定语时，certain 意为“某某”。

examples.en: It is certain that his conclusion is right.
examples.zh: 他的结论肯定是对的。

examples.en: A certain guide will lead you to the place.
examples.zh: 有个导游将领你到这个地方。

items.explanation: 指别人（说话者或他人）“相信”，而不是作为句子主语的人或事“相信”。如改写成 that 从句，主句的主语和从句的主语不同。

examples.en: He is sure to succeed. (= I am sure that he will succeed.)
examples.zh: 他一定会成功。

items.explanation: 指句子的主语“相信”，主语必定是人。如改写成 that 从句，主句和从句的主语为同一人。

examples.en: He is sure of winning. (= He is sure that he will win.)
examples.zh: 他确信他（自己）一定会赢。

examples.en: As we have been practising regularly, we are sure of winning the game this time.
examples.zh: 因为我们定期训练，所以这次比赛有把握赢。

examples.en: Rich information on the Internet attracts people of all ages to surf it.
examples.zh: 丰富的网络资讯吸引老老少少上网冲浪。

examples.en: Surf booms upon a desolate shore.
examples.zh: 激浪轰隆隆地拍打着荒凉的海岸。

examples.en: About three-fourths of the earth's surface is covered by water.
examples.zh: 大约 3/4 的地球表面被水覆盖。

examples.en: a heart surgeon
examples.zh: 心脏外科医生

examples.en: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.
examples.zh: 手术后她的膝盖活动不便，走路时被迫跛行。

examples.en: Smith is a very common English surname.
examples.zh: 史密斯是一个很普通的英国姓氏。

examples.en: It wouldn't surprise me if they lost.
examples.zh: 他们要是失败了也不足为奇。

senses.trans: 意想不到的事物（如消息、礼物等）

examples.en: I have a surprise for you.
examples.zh: 我要让你大吃一惊。

examples.en: Troops have surrounded the town.
examples.zh: 部队已将该城包围。

examples.en: a hotel set in peaceful surroundings
examples.zh: 建在安静环境里的酒店

examples.en: Standing in the watchtower, we admired the surrounding scenes.
examples.zh: 我们站在碉楼上，欣赏四周的景色。

examples.en: The explorers climbed a mound to survey the land around them.
examples.zh: 探险者爬上一个土堆以测量他们四周的土地。

examples.en: It's for a class survey.
examples.zh: 这是为了一次课堂调查。

examples.en: He survived the shipwreck.
examples.zh: 在这次船只沉没事件中他幸免于死。

examples.en: If a child depends on his parents for everything, his parents are responsible for it, because even animals know that they should teach their children how to survive.
examples.zh: 孩子什么事都依赖父母，父母也是有责任的，连动物都知道应该教下一代如何生存。

examples.en: I suspect that some of the officials have taken bribes.
examples.zh: 我怀疑有些官员受了贿。

examples.en: suspend a lamp from the ceiling
examples.zh: 把灯挂在天花板上

examples.en: Because he wasn't very confident about his suspicion, he used a three-step process to search for the truth.
examples.zh: 因为他对自己的怀疑不太自信，所以用了三步走的方法来寻找真相。(杨浦)

examples.en: The article said that the real estate market should be carefully managed to sustain the healthy development of the country's economy.
examples.zh: 这篇文章说，房地产市场应认真加以管理，以维持国家经济的健康发展。

examples.en: The government should do more to promote sustainable agricultural development.
examples.zh: 政府应该做更多工作来推动可持续的农业发展。

examples.en: One swallow does not make a summer.
examples.zh: 一燕不成夏。

examples.en: He swallowed the medicine with water.
examples.zh: 他用水把药吞下去。

examples.en: Will you swear that you were not there?
examples.zh: 你愿意起誓说你当时不在场吗？

examples.en: A good sweat will cure a cold.
examples.zh: 出一身大汗可以治好感冒。

examples.en: He is sweating heavily.
examples.zh: 他大汗淋漓。

examples.en: a pretty sweater
examples.zh: 一件漂亮的毛线衫

examples.en: sweep the floor
examples.zh: 扫地

examples.en: These sweets are delicious.
examples.zh: 这些糖果很好吃。

examples.en: Her voice was as soft and sweet as a young girl's.
examples.zh: 她的声音和小女孩的一样温柔悦耳。

examples.en: go swimming
examples.zh: 去游泳

examples.en: When can we go for a swim?
examples.zh: 我们什么时候可以去游泳？

examples.en: Swimming is a good form of exercise.
examples.zh: 游泳是很好的锻炼方式。

examples.en: The chandelier swung in the wind.
examples.zh: 枝形吊灯随风晃动。

examples.en: play on/have a swing
examples.zh: 荡秋千

examples.en: Turn off the switch.
examples.zh: 关掉开关。

examples.en: She switched the light on.
examples.zh: 她开了灯。

examples.en: Please switch off the lights when you leave.
examples.zh: 出门时请随手关灯。

examples.en: You switch the radio off by pressing this button.
examples.zh: 你按这个按钮就能把收音机关上。

examples.en: Many people switch on the television simply to stave off boredom over the Christmas break.
examples.zh: 很多人打开电视仅仅是为了打发圣诞节期间的无聊时光而已。

examples.en: First you should switch on the machine.
examples.zh: 首先你得把机器打开。

examples.en: White is the symbol of purity.
examples.zh: 白色是纯洁的象征。

examples.en: A torch symbolises the brightness.
examples.zh: 火炬象征光明。

examples.en: The documentary aroused public sympathy for victims of the disaster.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片唤起了公众对灾民的同情心。

examples.en: the Ninth Symphony
examples.zh: 《第九交响曲》

examples.en: Avoid close contact with anyone with cold or flu-like symptoms.
examples.zh: 避免跟有感冒或流感症状的人密切接触。

examples.en: This synthetic dress material does not crush.
examples.zh: 这种合成纤维衣料不会皱。

examples.en: For the banking system, however, there are still signs of dislocation.
examples.zh: 不管怎样，对于银行业体系来说，仍然存在混乱的迹象。

examples.en: When the water pipes leak, we usually send for a plumber.
examples.zh: 水管漏水时，我们通常派人去请水管工。

s.name: separate A from B
trans: 把 A 和 B 分开

examples.en: A large river separates the north of the city from the south.
examples.zh: 一条大河把这个城市的南北分开。

examples.en: In the absence of solid evidence the prisoner was set free.
examples.zh: 因缺乏确凿证据，犯人被释放了。

examples.en: This company set an example to many other companies in management.
examples.zh: 这家公司在管理上为其他许多公司树立了榜样。

examples.en: He finally settled down in a seaside town after many years of moving around.
examples.zh: 多年颠沛流离之后，他终于在一个海边小镇安定下来了。

examples.en: A plane crashed shortly after taking off, killing all 163 on board.
examples.zh: 一架飞机在起飞后不久坠毁，机上163人全部丧生。

examples.en: A plane crashed shortly after taking off, killing all 163 on board.
examples.zh: 一架飞机在起飞后不久坠毁，机上163人全部丧生。

examples.en: He objected to slowing down the pace of reform.
examples.zh: 他反对减缓改革的步伐。

examples.en: While people speak highly of the Internet, its drawbacks shouldn’t be neglected.
examples.zh: 当人们高度评价网络时，不应忽视它的不足。

examples.en: Convenience stores have been springing up in every corner of the city in the past two decades.
examples.zh: 近20年，便利店在城市的各处不断涌现。

examples.en: It was a real effort to stay awake through the film.
examples.zh: 真要强打着精神才能看完整部电影。

examples.en: According to the latest survey, many British suffer from heart diseases.
examples.zh: 据最近调查显示，许多英国人患心脏病。

examples.en: They supply us with latest equipment regularly.
examples.zh: 他们定期向我们提供最新的设备。

examples.en: Sometimes I surf the Internet and download e-books to read.
examples.zh: 有时我上网，然后下载电子图书阅读。

examples.en: Hardly had he sat down when he found that the table hadn't been tidied up.
examples.zh: 他刚一坐下，就发现桌子还没收拾好。

examples.en: a sleeping tablet
examples.zh: 安眠药片

examples.en: Never will the plan to tackle climate change succeed no matter how complete and thorough it's developed unless coal consumption is strictly controlled.
examples.zh: 除非严格控制煤炭消耗量，否则，应对气候变化的方案无论制订得多周详，都无法获得成功。

examples.en: a price tag
examples.zh: 价格标签

examples.en: Dogs wag their tails when they are pleased.
examples.zh: 狗一高兴就摇尾巴。

examples.en: a well-tailored suit
examples.zh: 工艺考究的衣服

examples.en: go to the tailor to be measured for a suit
examples.zh: 到裁缝店定做西装

examples.en: It takes perseverance to do anything well.
examples.zh: 要做好一件事，就需要坚持不懈的精神。

examples.en: All member states are to take immediate action to address the crisis.
examples.zh: 所有成员国都需立刻采取行动以应对危机。

examples.en: They took advantage of the customers' curiosity and sold out the goods in stock.
examples.zh: 他们利用顾客的好奇心，把库存商品销售一空。

examples.en: The monastery has taken in 26 refugees.
examples.zh: 修道院已经收留了 26 位难民。

examples.en: The students find it easy to take in what their teacher has taught.
examples.zh: 学生们发现老师所教的东西很容易领会。

examples.en: He was taken in by the salesman when he bought that secondhand car.
examples.zh: 他购买那辆二手汽车时，被销售员骗了。

examples.en: You can watch aircraft take off or land at close quarters.
examples.zh: 你可以近距离观察飞机的起降。

examples.en: No other organization was able or willing to take on the job.
examples.zh: 没有任何别的组织有能力或愿意承担此项工作。

examples.en: Her hair took on a healthy shine after she used the new shampoo.
examples.zh: 用了这种洗发水之后，她的头发开始呈现出健康的光泽。

examples.en: Prime candidate to take over his job is Margaret Ramsay.
examples.zh: 接替他工作的首要人选是玛格丽特·拉姆齐。

examples.en: He has made it clear that he won't take over the company.
examples.zh: 他已经明确表示不愿接管这家公司。

examples.en: Environmental-friendly bags have taken the place of plastic bags in many supermarkets.
examples.zh: 在许多超市，环保袋已经取代了塑料袋。

t.name: take up
trans: 占去（地方、时间、注意力等）

examples.en: He did not particularly want to take up a competitive sport.
examples.zh: 他并不是特别想从事竞技体育运动。

examples.en: Angela used to be a model and has decided to take it up again.
examples.zh: 安琪拉以前当过模特，现已决定重操旧业了。

examples.en: These machines consume more power and take up more space.
examples.zh: 这些机器消耗更多的能量，并且占用更多的空间。

examples.en: tales of adventure
examples.zh: 冒险故事

examples.en: My sister has a talent for music.
examples.zh: 我妹妹有音乐天赋。

examples.en: His sister is engaged to a talented young man.
examples.zh: 他姐姐与一位非常有才气的青年订婚了。

examples.en: Not until that moment had he ever talked about his new book with that chief editor.
examples.zh: 在此之前，他从未和那位主编讨论过自己的新书。(徐汇)

examples.en: I met Mr. Jones in the street and had a long talk with him about his operation.
examples.zh: 我在街上遇到琼斯先生，并就他的手术跟他谈了很长时间。

examples.en: He didn't want company, talkative or otherwise.
examples.zh: 他不想跟人搭伴，不管这个伴儿是否健谈。

examples.en: She is five feet tall.
examples.zh: 她身高 5 英尺。

examples.en: a tame monkey
examples.zh: 经过驯养的猴子

examples.en: tame a tiger
examples.zh: 驯虎

examples.en: keep tropical fish in a glass tank
examples.zh: 在玻璃缸中养热带鱼

examples.en: He tapped on the door.
examples.zh: 他轻轻敲门。

examples.en: give a little tap at the door
examples.zh: 在门上轻叩一下

senses.trans: (煤气、自来水管道上的)龙头，阀门

examples.en: The tap was leaking the whole night, and there is water all over the bathroom floor.
examples.zh: 水龙头通宵漏水，浴室地板上到处都是水。

examples.en: It's too noisy. I cannot hear the tape clearly.
examples.zh: 太吵了。我听不清楚磁带。

examples.en: The hunter's target was a wild animal.
examples.zh: 这个猎人的目标是一只野兽。

examples.en: The two sides had decided not to target each other with the strategic nuclear weapons under their respective control.
examples.zh: 双方决定，不把各自控制下的战略核武器瞄准对方。

examples.en: Only by cooperating with each other can the whole team accomplish the task on time.
examples.zh: 整个团队只有互相配合才能按时完成这项任务。

examples.en: Can I taste your drink?
examples.zh: 我可以尝一尝你的饮料吗？

examples.en: She can't endure the taste of garlic.
examples.zh: 她受不了大蒜的味道。

examples.en: These two shopkeepers are in prison for tax evasion.
examples.zh: 这两个店主因逃税而坐牢。

examples.en: Imports are heavily taxed.
examples.zh: 进口货物征税很高。

examples.en: I don't often go to school by taxi.
examples.zh: 我不是经常坐出租车去学校的。

examples.en: Tea is the most popular drink in the world besides water.
examples.zh: 除了水外，茶是世界上最流行的饮料。

examples.en: To make lessons lively, our teacher taught us English in a special way.
examples.zh: 为了使课上气氛活跃，老师用一种特殊的方式教我们英语。

examples.en: Although teachers of different subjects vary in teaching styles, they all pay close attention to the students' development.
examples.zh: 尽管不同学科教师的教学风格不尽相同，他们都密切关注学生的发展。(静安)

examples.en: All the team members are in favour of his proposal.
examples.zh: 所有队员都赞成他的提议。

examples.en: It's hard to team these colours up.
examples.zh: 把这些颜色配起来是困难的。

examples.en: I'd also like to get a china teapot.
examples.zh: 我还想买一只瓷茶壶。

examples.en: She delivered such a heartfelt speech that we were almost moved to tears.
examples.zh: 她做了一场真诚的演讲，让我们感动得几乎落泪。

examples.en: The wind makes my eyes tear.
examples.zh: 风吹得我眼睛淌泪。

examples.en: He tore his trousers.
examples.zh: 他撕破了裤子。

examples.en: a technical job
examples.zh: 技术性的工作

examples.en: The technician is busy repairing the machine.
examples.zh: 技师正忙于修理那台机器。

examples.en: learn technique by practice
examples.zh: 通过实践获得技术

examples.en: It is likely that they will visit Shanghai Science & Technology Museum today and spend a whole day there.
examples.zh: 他们今天可能会去上海科技馆参观并在那儿待一天。

items.explanation: 技术（指某方面特定的技巧和方法）

examples.en: Both technique and responsibility are important to doctors.
examples.zh: 技术与责任对医生而言同样重要。

items.explanation: 技术（指应用技术，是工业技术的总称）

examples.en: science and technology
examples.zh: 科学技术

senses.trans: 青少年时期(指 13 至 19 岁)

examples.en: She began writing poetry in her teens.
examples.zh: 她从十几岁开始写诗。

examples.en: Although it is typical of teenagers to talk back to parents, they respect their parents in their hearts.
examples.zh: 虽然青少年爱和父母顶嘴，但是他们内心是尊重父母的。(浦东)

examples.en: send a telegram
examples.zh: 发电报

examples.en: send a message by telegraph (或 on the telegraph)
examples.zh: 用电报发送信息

examples.en: Tom telegraphed an urgent message to Wavell.
examples.zh: 汤姆给韦维尔发了封紧急电报。

examples.en: Telephone me tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天给我打电话。

examples.en: Mr. Smith telephoned up about half an hour ago.
examples.zh: 大约半小时前史密斯先生来过电话。

examples.en: We told him the news by telephone.
examples.zh: 我们打电话告诉他这个消息。

examples.en: How about appreciating the moon with the newly-bought telescope?
examples.zh: 不如我们带上新买的望远镜去赏月吧！(松江)

examples.en: The National Sports Meet will be televised live.
examples.zh: 全国运动会将通过电视进行现场直播。

examples.en: The Smiths were watching TV when the telephone rang.
examples.zh: 史密斯一家正在看电视，这时电话响了。

examples.en: Only the mother can easily tell one of the twins from the other.
examples.zh: 只有母亲能很容易地分辨出两个双胞胎孩子。

examples.en: It's too early to tell.
examples.zh: 现在确定还为时过早。

t.name: tell sb./sth. from sb./sth.
trans: 辨别，区分(常与 can、could、be able to 连用)

examples.en: lose one's temper
examples.zh: 发脾气

examples.en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
examples.zh: 尼罗河流域一年四季气候温和。

examples.en: The food and medicine must be kept at a low temperature.
examples.zh: 食品和药物必须在低温下保存。

examples.en: Do you know where this temple is?
examples.zh: 你知道这座寺庙在哪里吗？

examples.zh: 临时的工作

examples.zh: 他受到金钱引诱。

examples.en: Ten persons were invited but only five turned up.
examples.zh: 邀请了 10 人，只有 5 人出席。

examples.en: The students tended their teacher patiently when he was in hospital.
examples.zh: 老师住院期间，学生们耐心地照料他。

examples.en: About 50% of the Shanghainese tend to buy air-conditioners made by joint ventures.
examples.zh: 大约 50% 的上海人倾向于购买合资企业造的空调。

examples.en: The tendency of events is towards war.
examples.zh: 大势趋向战争。

examples.en: Steam the carrots until they are just beginning to be tender.
examples.zh: 将胡萝卜蒸至刚好变软。

examples.zh: 草地网球

examples.en: The increasingly tense doctor-patient relationship remains to be solved.
examples.zh: 日益紧张的医患关系有待解决。

examples.en: the perfect tense
examples.zh: 完成时

examples.en: Exercise is a good safety valve for the tension that builds up at work.
examples.zh: 锻炼身体是排解工作压力的好办法。

examples.en: put up a tent
examples.zh: 支起一顶帐篷

examples.en: Today is her tenth birthday.
examples.zh: 今天是她的 10 岁生日。

examples.en: There are three terms in a school year.
examples.zh: 一学年有三个学期。

examples.en: The company has fallen behind in terms of market share.
examples.zh: 从市场占有率方面来说，该公司已经落后了。

examples.en: Free shuttle bus service is available between terminals.
examples.zh: 航站楼之间有免费的穿梭巴士服务。

examples.en: It is terrible to tell a lie.
examples.zh: 说谎是很糟糕的一件事。

examples.en: Even clever people are not terribly clever when put on the spot.
examples.zh: 即便是聪明人在面对难题时也未必就能表现得特别聪明。

examples.en: She drove at a terrific speed.
examples.zh: 她以极快的速度开车。

examples.en: This meeting is to be held on neutral territory.
examples.zh: 这次会议将在中立国举行。

examples.en: The terror ended when armed police swooped on the car.
examples.zh: 武警突袭了这辆车，从而制止了这起恐怖活动。

examples.zh: 智力测验

examples.en: have one's eyesight tested
examples.zh: 检查视力

items.explanation: 指正式的测验。

examples.en: a test in mathematics
examples.zh: 数学测验

items.explanation: 指随堂考查，非正式的测验。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a quiz at the end of the lesson.
examples.zh: 老师在一堂课快要结束的时候让我们做了个小测验。

items.explanation: 指正规的考试。

examples.en: college entrance examinations
examples.zh: 大学入学考试

examples.en: Reciting English texts is a useful way to improve English.
examples.zh: 背英语课文是提高英语水平的好方法。

examples.en: a maths textbook
examples.zh: 数学课本

examples.en: According to the shop assistant, the storage capacity of the new type of camera is a few times greater than that of the old type.
examples.zh: 听店员说，新款摄像机的存储空间是老款的好几倍。(嘉定)

examples.en: Thank you for offering us such a good meal.
examples.zh: 谢谢您为我们提供了这么可口的一餐。

examples.en: They accepted their certificates with words of thanks.
examples.zh: 他们一边道谢，一边接过证书。

examples.en: Thanks to the satellite, we can receive live sports programs.
examples.zh: 多亏了卫星，我们才可以接收到现场直播的体育节目。

examples.en: Do you know that boy?
examples.zh: 你认识那个男孩吗？

examples.en: The new exam system gives students more freedom to choose subjects and universities.
examples.zh: 新的考试制度给了学生更多选择科目和大学的自由。

examples.en: During our visit to London we often went to the theatre.
examples.zh: 我们在伦敦逗留期间常去看戏。

examples.en: He was put in prison for theft.
examples.zh: 他因为偷窃被关进监狱。

examples.en: People should pay attention to their manners in public.
examples.zh: 人们在公共场所应注意自己的言谈举止。

senses.trans: [物主代词] 他们的(所有物)

examples.en: The ship is theirs.
examples.zh: 这艘船是他们的。

examples.en: No wonder these flowers are dying. You should have watered them earlier.
examples.zh: 难怪这些花要死了。你真应该早点浇水。

senses.trans: (谈话、讨论、文章等的)题目，主题

examples.en: The theme for tonight's talk is education.
examples.zh: 今晚谈话的主题是教育。

examples.en: Young people should be encouraged to solve the problems that they are faced with by themselves.
examples.zh: 应当鼓励年轻人自己解决他们面临的问题。

examples.en: Go into the cave, then they won't see you.
examples.zh: 躲进洞里去，他们就看不到你了。

examples.en: In theory, three things could happen.
examples.zh: 理论上，可能发生了 3 种情况。

examples.en: Physical therapy alternates with chemical one.
examples.zh: 理疗和化疗交替进行。

senses.trans: (作引导词，与be等动词连用，表“有”“存在”之意)

examples.en: There are more and more complaints about food safety.
examples.zh: 针对食品安全的投诉越来越多。

t.name: There is no royal road to learning.

examples.en: He became a citizen, thereby gaining the right to vote.
examples.zh: 他成了公民，因此有了选举权。

examples.en: I was ill, and therefore could not come.
examples.zh: 我病了，所以不能来。

examples.en: These clothes need washing.
examples.zh: 这些衣服要洗了。

examples.en: They are my students.
examples.zh: 他们是我的学生。

examples.en: a thick book
examples.zh: 一本厚书

examples.en: catch a thief
examples.zh: 抓住一个贼

examples.en: That boy is the thinnest one in his class.
examples.zh: 那个男孩是全班最瘦的。

examples.en: He spent too much time on some unimportant things, which led to the failure of the whole plan.
examples.zh: 他在一些不重要的事情上花费时间太多，这导致了整个计划的失败。

examples.en: I thought you would go to Beijing with me by high-speed rail.
examples.zh: 我以为你会和我一起乘高铁去北京。

t.name: think about
trans: 考虑，思考(尤指计划、观念等)

t.name: think much of sb./sth.
trans: [常用于否定句] 对某人 / 某事评价很高

examples.en: We all think of you as a member of the family.
examples.zh: 我们都把你当成家里人。

examples.en: His quick thinking saved her life.
examples.zh: 他敏捷的思维救了她一命。

examples.en: As far as I can remember, this is the third time we've met.
examples.zh: 我记得这是我们第三次会面了。

examples.en: I often feel thirsty when it's very hot.
examples.zh: 天热时我常感到口渴。

examples.en: Thirteen is often considered an unlucky number.
examples.zh: 13 常被认为是不吉利的数字。

examples.en: Only thirty students graduated in Chinese last year.
examples.zh: 去年只有 30 名学生获得汉语学士学位。

examples.en: Who is to blame for this accident?
examples.zh: 谁来为这次事故承担责任？

examples.en: This is for you.
examples.zh: 这是给你的。

examples.en: You should always try to be thorough in whatever you do.
examples.zh: 无论你做什么，都应该尽量仔细周到。

examples.en: Those who work hard will succeed in the end.
examples.zh: 那些努力工作的人最终会取得成功。

examples.en: Though he is a child, he is very brave.
examples.zh: 虽然他是个孩子，可是他很勇敢。

examples.en: Please write and let me have your thoughts on the matter.
examples.zh: 请书面告知我你对此事的意见。

examples.en: Nancy, who had been thoughtful for some time, suddenly spoke.
examples.zh: 南希沉思了一会儿，突然开口说话了。

examples.en: Thousands of pieces of data are stored in a computer's memory.
examples.zh: 在计算机的存储器中存有成千万条数据。

examples.en: to lose the thread of one's argument
examples.zh: 论点有失条理

examples.en: I threaded my way through the crowd.
examples.zh: 我从人群中穿过。

examples.en: Threats are being made on his life.
examples.zh: 有人正对他的生命进行威胁。

examples.en: Desert threatens the northern part of our country.
examples.zh: 沙漠威胁着我们国家的北方。

examples.en: At present, three of us have no choice but to complete this plan through the Internet.
examples.zh: 目前，我们有三个人只能通过网络来完成这项计划。

examples.en: clear one's throat
examples.zh: 清喉咙

examples.en: We walked through the market to the truck park.
examples.zh: 我们穿过市场到了卡车停车场。

examples.en: They wouldn't let us through.
examples.zh: 他们没让我们过去。

examples.en: He is famous throughout the world.
examples.zh: 他闻名于世界。

examples.en: Don't throw rubbish everywhere!
examples.zh: 别乱丢垃圾！

examples.en: a record throw with the hammer
examples.zh: 创纪录的一掷链球

examples.en: a thunder of applause
examples.zh: 雷鸣般的掌声

examples.en: It is thundering.
examples.zh: 正在打雷。

examples.en: Last night I was caught by a thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 昨天晚上我遇上了雷雨。

examples.en: Professor Sawyer was formally installed as president last Thursday.
examples.zh: 索耶教授上周四被正式任命为校长。

examples.en: He sold his farm and thus he had enough money for his journey.
examples.zh: 他卖掉了农场，这样他就有足够的钱去旅行了。

examples.en: Why don't you book tickets on the Internet?
examples.zh: 为什么不在网上订票？

examples.en: go with the tide
examples.zh: 顺应潮流

examples.en: He will be willing to tide us over.
examples.zh: 他愿意帮助我们渡过难关。

examples.en: Edward, you have grown up. You should learn to make your own room tidy.
examples.zh: 爱德华，你已经长大了。你应该学会自己整理房间。

examples.en: I want a tie that will match with this suit.
examples.zh: 我想要一条和这件西服相配的领带。

examples.en: Can you tie up this parcel for me?
examples.zh: 你能替我捆好这个包裹吗？

examples.en: There are tigers in the forest.
examples.zh: 森林里有老虎。

examples.en: Tie the knot as tight as you can.
examples.zh: 尽量把这个结打紧。

examples.en: You never know what you can do till you try.
examples.zh: 你永远不知道自己能做什么，直到尝试过后。

examples.en: If parents have no time to care for the child, the child is likely to have feelings of loneliness.
examples.zh: 父母没有时间关心孩子，可能会让孩子产生孤独感。

examples.en: We completed the work five days ahead of time.
examples.zh: 我们提前5天完成工作。

examples.en: We managed to fulfill the task ahead of time.
examples.zh: 我们做到了提前完成任务。

examples.en: We are under the eyes of both sides all the time.
examples.zh: 我们一直都在双方的密切监视下。

examples.en: The song had a great vogue at one time.
examples.zh: 这首歌曾风行一时。

examples.en: At one time scientists thought that there was nothing smaller than atoms.
examples.zh: 科学家曾一度认为没有比原子更小的东西了。

examples.en: We all make a fool of ourselves at times.
examples.zh: 有时，我们都会干出傻事。

examples.en: His daughters visited him from time to time when he was ill.
examples.zh: 他生病的时候，他的女儿们时常去探望他。

examples.en: They have a good time on their return journey.
examples.zh: 他们在归途中过得很愉快。

examples.en: They finished the task in no time.
examples.zh: 他们一下子就完成了任务。

examples.en: At this rate, we'll be able to pay off the loan in no time.
examples.zh: 照这种速度，我们很快就可以把贷款还清了。

examples.en: I arrived just in time for my flight to London.
examples.zh: 我及时赶上了飞往伦敦的航班。

examples.en: We shall be landing in Paris in sixteen minutes, exactly on time.
examples.zh: 我们将于16分钟后准时在巴黎降落。

examples.en: Once upon a time there lived a king who had three daughters.
examples.zh: 从前有个国王，他有3个女儿。

examples.en: a school timetable
examples.zh: 课程表

examples.en: a timid reply
examples.zh: 战战兢兢的答复

examples.en: open a tin of beans
examples.zh: 开一罐豆子

examples.en: a tiny baby
examples.zh: 小小的婴儿

examples.en: the tip of a finger
examples.zh: 手指尖

examples.en: The north pole is slightly tipped towards the sun.
examples.zh: 北极略微向太阳倾斜。

examples.en: have a slight tip to the south
examples.zh: 稍稍向南倾斜

examples.en: He paid the bill and tipped the waiter.
examples.zh: 他付了账，还给侍者小费。

examples.en: I gave the barber a tip.
examples.zh: 我给了理发师小费。

examples.en: He came on tiptoe.
examples.zh: 他踮着脚尖来了。

examples.en: I tiptoed past the sleeping child.
examples.zh: 我踮着脚从睡着的孩子旁边走过。

examples.en: He tired easily, though he was unable to sleep well at night.
examples.zh: 他很容易疲倦，可夜里却睡不好觉。

examples.en: Although they were tired out, they still continued to search for the survivors in the accident.
examples.zh: 虽然已精疲力竭，他们还是继续搜寻事故中的幸存者。

examples.en: If a tire blows out while one is driving at a high speed, it can be very dangerous.
examples.zh: 高速行驶时车胎爆炸是很危险的。

examples.en: It's normal to feel tired after such a long trip.
examples.zh: 这样长途旅行之后感到疲劳是正常的。

examples.en: Have you got a tissue?
examples.zh: 你有纸巾吗？

examples.en: A doctor has the title "Dr." in front of his name.
examples.zh: 医生的名字前有“Dr.”这个称呼。

examples.en: They climbed to the top.
examples.zh: 他们爬到了顶。

examples.en: exchange toasts
examples.zh: 相互敬酒

examples.en: They toasted her in champagne.
examples.zh: 他们以香槟向她敬酒。

examples.en: We ordered scrambled eggs and toast.
examples.zh: 我们要了炒蛋和吐司。

examples.en: Toast the bread lightly on both sides.
examples.zh: 稍稍烘烤面包两面。

examples.en: The government imposed a ban on tobacco advertising.
examples.zh: 政府下令禁止烟草广告。

examples.en: Today is my birthday.
examples.zh: 今天是我的生日。

examples.en: There is a hole in the toe of my sock.
examples.zh: 我的袜子尖有一个洞。

examples.en: Life is a journey on which opportunities and challenges exist together.
examples.zh: 生命就是一次旅程，在这次旅程中，机遇和挑战并存。

examples.en: How much longer would he stay on the toilet?
examples.zh: 他还要在马桶上坐多久呀？

examples.en: I can not tolerate your carelessness.
examples.zh: 我不能容忍你的粗心大意。

examples.en: She spread some tomato paste on the fried fish.
examples.zh: 她在炸好的鱼上涂了一层番茄酱。

examples.en: The sea was his tomb.
examples.zh: 他葬身于大海。

examples.en: Jane doesn't want to see the film La La Land with her friend tomorrow.
examples.zh: 简明天不想和她的朋友一起去看电影《爱乐之城》。

examples.en: three tons of coal
examples.zh: 3吨煤

examples.en: an angry tone of voice
examples.zh: 生气的口吻

examples.en: This time-honoured restaurant has created its own cooking style by adopting the cooking methods from various countries, where guests can taste foreign cultures at the tip of their tongue.
examples.zh: 这家老字号餐厅吸纳了各国的烹饪方法，创造了自己独特的烹饪风格，在这里，食客可以在舌尖上品尝到异国文化。（普陀）

examples.en: Why don't you relax yourself by reading a magazine tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚为什么不看本杂志放松一下呢？

examples.en: It's not safe for teenagers to give out too much information about themselves on the Internet.
examples.zh: 青少年在互联网上提供太多有关自己的信息，这是不安全的。

examples.en: Words are his tools.
examples.zh: 语言是他的工具。

examples.en: It is necessary for everyone to brush his teeth after each meal.
examples.zh: 对大家来说，每餐后刷牙是必要的。

examples.en: I have got toothache, so I must go to a dentist.
examples.zh: 我牙疼，必须去看牙医。

examples.en: We use toothbrushes with toothpaste to brush our teeth.
examples.zh: 我们用涂了牙膏的牙刷来刷牙。

examples.en: Which brand of toothpaste do you use?
examples.zh: 你用什么牌子的牙膏？

examples.en: After he won the match, he felt on top of the world.
examples.zh: 他在这场比赛中获胜后，感觉棒极了。

examples.en: Put it in the top drawer.
examples.zh: 把它放在最上面的抽屉里。

examples.en: A church tops the hill.
examples.zh: 山顶有一座教堂。

examples.en: Let's change the topic!
examples.zh: 我们换个话题吧！

examples.en: light a torch
examples.zh: 点燃火把

examples.en: The town was hit by a tornado.
examples.zh: 那个城镇遭到龙卷风袭击。

examples.en: be in total ignorance of it
examples.zh: 完全不知道这件事

examples.en: Our expenses reached a total of $20.
examples.zh: 我们的花费总计 20 美元。

examples.en: They haven't totaled the exact figures.
examples.zh: 他们还没有对确切数据进行总计。

examples.en: We touched many topics in our talk.
examples.zh: 我们的谈话涉及很多话题。

examples.en: Ever since he left Shanghai, we have kept in touch with each other by email.
examples.zh: 自从他离开上海以后，我们一直靠电子邮件来互相联系。

examples.en: tough soldiers
examples.zh: 能耐劳苦的军人

examples.en: Shall we take a tour to the Summer Palace, Mrs. White?
examples.zh: 怀特太太，我们去颐和园游览好吗？

examples.en: tour Mexico
examples.zh: 漫游墨西哥

examples.en: More and more countries in the world are now taking measures to attract more Chinese tourists.
examples.zh: 现在世界上越来越多的国家正采取措施来吸引更多的中国游客。

examples.en: The BBC will cover all the major games of the tournament.
examples.zh: 英国广播公司将报道这次锦标赛的所有重要比赛。

examples.en: She walked towards the door.
examples.zh: 她向门口走去。

examples.en: a paper towel
examples.zh: 纸巾

examples.en: The TV Tower has attracted tens of thousands of visitors since 2017.
examples.zh: 自 2017 年以来，电视塔已吸引了数万名游客。

examples.en: Such a peaceful life is he leading in that remote town that he doesn't even want to return to his hometown.
examples.zh: 他在那个偏远小镇过着如此宁静的生活，以至于他都不想返回家乡了。

examples.en: Joyce has a lot of toys.
examples.zh: 乔伊斯有很多玩具。

examples.en: They searched the building but did not find any trace of the criminal.
examples.zh: 他们搜查了这座楼房，可是没有发现罪犯的一点踪迹。

examples.en: They traced the criminal to a house in the city.
examples.zh: 他们追踪罪犯到了城里的一座房子里。

examples.en: The hunter followed the animal's tracks.
examples.zh: 猎人追踪动物的足迹。

examples.en: I followed him, tracking him in the snow until finally he got tired.
examples.zh: 我跟着他，在雪地里追踪他，直到他最终体力不支。

examples.en: When he was young, he wanted to be engaged in foreign trade.
examples.zh: 他年轻时想从事对外贸易工作。

examples.en: He usually trades at the No. 5 Department Store.
examples.zh: 他通常在第五百货商店进行交易。

examples.en: They traded land for goods and money.
examples.zh: 他们用土地换取了货物与金钱。

examples.en: A trade war is a fight that serves the interests of none, and will only lead to serious consequence and negative impact.
examples.zh: 贸易战是一场不符合任何一方利益的争斗，只会导致严重后果和负面影响。(杨浦)

examples.en: The company now has a trademark of its own.
examples.zh: 这家公司现在有了自己的商标。

examples.en: Credit is everything to a trader.
examples.zh: 信用对于商人来说至关重要。

examples.en: It is a tradition that the young look after the old in their family.
examples.zh: 在他们家，年轻人照顾年长者是一个传统。

examples.en: There are also people who come to take such courses as traditional Chinese medicine, painting, calligraphy and photography.
examples.zh: 还有一些人到学校里来是为了学习诸如中医、绘画、书法和摄影等课程。

examples.en: Roads in Shanghai always hold up more traffic than usual on rainy days.

examples.zh: 除非采取紧急措施，否则我们的计划将泡汤。

examples.en: I've just come back from a holiday in the US.
examples.zh: 我刚从美国度假回来。

examples.en: Whether the new policy will do us harm or good remains to be seen.
examples.zh: 新政策会给我们带来好处还是危害还得拭目以待。

examples.en: Today the word has virtually dropped out of usage.
examples.zh: 这个词今天差不多已不再使用了。

examples.en: Her job is to show the customers how to use the computer.
examples.zh: 她的工作是教客户如何使用电脑。

senses.trans: 惯常（现仅用过去式used /juːst/，后接不定式，表示过去的事实或状态）

examples.en: He doesn't swim so often as he used to.
examples.zh: 他不像过去那样常游泳了。

examples.en: You'll save electricity by turning off lights not in use.
examples.zh: 你把不用的灯关掉就能省电。

examples.en: used clothes
examples.zh: 旧衣服

examples.en: I am used to reading English newspaper every day.
examples.zh: 我习惯于每天读英语报。

examples.en: It's useful to know several foreign languages when you are travelling abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外旅行，懂几门外语很有用。

examples.en: The contents of the box were rendered useless by damp.
examples.zh: 箱内的东西由于受潮变得毫无价值了。

examples.en: Tea is considered to be the usual drink of British people.
examples.zh: 茶被认为是英国人的日常饮料。

examples.en: Everything went on as usual as though nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 一切照常进行，好像什么事也没有发生。

examples.en: I usually go to work by bike.
examples.zh: 我通常骑自行车上班。

examples.en: We'll have to slow down for the road ahead is under construction.
examples.zh: 我们得开慢一点，前面的路正在施工。

u.name: under no circumstances
trans: 无论在什么条件下都不

examples.en: We must under no circumstances give up halfway.
examples.zh: 我们绝不能半途而废。

examples.en: Use your head, and you'll find a way.
examples.zh: 动动脑筋，你就会找出办法来的。

examples.en: By the end of last year, he had used up all his savings.
examples.zh: 到去年底，他已经用完了全部存款。

examples.en: This will help to fill a vacancy in our knowledge.
examples.zh: 这有助于弥补我们知识上的空白。

examples.en: The top post in the delegation was still vacant.
examples.zh: 代表团中的最高职位仍旧空着。

examples.en: Students have access to the library during the vacation too.
examples.zh: 在假期学生也能使用图书馆。

examples.en: a vague answer
examples.zh: 含糊其辞的回答

examples.en: This train ticket is valid for three days.
examples.zh: 这张火车票3日内有效。

examples.en: a remote valley
examples.zh: 偏远的山谷

examples.en: What matters to volunteers is not how much they can do for others but that they can gain valuable experience and happiness from helping other people.
examples.zh: 对志愿者来说，重要的不是能为别人做多少，而是能获得宝贵的经验和帮助他人的快乐。

examples.en: His advice is of great value to us.
examples.zh: 他的建议对我们很有价值。

examples.en: I value your advice.
examples.zh: 我尊重你的意见。

examples.en: a furniture van
examples.zh: 搬家具的货车

examples.en: water vapour
examples.zh: 水蒸气

examples.en: There are wide variations caused by different academic programme structures.
examples.zh: 不同的教学项目结构造成了巨大的差异。

examples.en: This new department store offers a large variety of goods for sale.
examples.zh: 这家新百货商店备有品种繁多的商品。

examples.en: Everyone arrived late at the party for various reasons.
examples.zh: 由于种种原因，大家赴会都迟到了。

examples.en: to vary one's style of writing
examples.zh: 改变字体

examples.en: People vary very much in their ideas.
examples.zh: 人们的想法差异很大。

examples.en: break a vase
examples.zh: 打碎一只花瓶

examples.en: vast sums of money
examples.zh: 巨款

examples.en: I prefer vegetables to meat because they are good for my health.
examples.zh: 比起肉我更喜欢吃蔬菜，因为它们对身体健康有好处。

examples.en: The old lady is a vegetarian and never touches meat.
examples.zh: 这位老太太是素食者，从不碰肉食。

examples.en: I work at a vegetarian restaurant.
examples.zh: 我在一间素食餐馆工作。

examples.en: The lake was almost solid with silt and vegetation.
examples.zh: 湖里几乎快被淤泥和植物填满了。

examples.en: a space vehicle
examples.zh: 宇宙飞船

examples.en: fail in one's ventures
examples.zh: 投机失败

examples.en: He ventured his life to rescue the drowning child.
examples.zh: 他冒着生命危险抢救快要淹死的孩子。

examples.en: The venue for the World Cup remains undecided.
examples.zh: 世界杯的举办地点尚未确定。

examples.en: The word is compounded of a preposition and a verb.
examples.zh: 这个词是由一个介词和一个动词复合而成的。

examples.en: comparison of the original text with the English version
examples.zh: 原文和英文译本的比较

examples.en: Tony's words made his mother feel very excited.
examples.zh: 托尼的话让他的母亲感到非常兴奋。

examples.en: It is the very book that I've been looking for a long time.
examples.zh: 这正是我找了很久的书。

examples.en: a cotton vest
examples.zh: 一件棉背心

examples.en: We gossip about them and vice versa.
examples.zh: 我们议论他们，他们也议论我们。

examples.en: He is the victim of his own foolishness.
examples.zh: 他因自己的愚昧而自食其果。

examples.en: They celebrated their victory cheerily.
examples.zh: 他们兴高采烈地庆祝胜利。

examples.en: Thousands of people viewed the 30-minute video only two hours after it was posted on the web.
examples.zh: 这段 30 分钟的视频在网上发布仅 2 个小时，就有数千人观看过。

examples.en: We were playing video games with her.
examples.zh: 我们当时在和她一起打视频游戏。

examples.en: Two technicians were preparing a videotape recording of last week's programme.
examples.zh: 两名技术人员正在准备上周节目的录像带。

examples.en: Clouds came down and the hill tops passed from our view.
examples.zh: 云层下来了，我们看不见山顶了。

examples.en: The subject may be viewed in various ways.
examples.zh: 这问题可从各方面考虑。

examples.en: a person with vigour and vitality
examples.zh: 一个充满活力的人

examples.en: Water pollution is one of the most serious problems in that village.
examples.zh: 在那个村里，水污染是最严重的问题之一。

examples.en: You mustn't do violence to him.
examples.zh: 你不能对他使用暴力。

examples.en: There will be a violent storm.
examples.zh: 将有一场大风暴。

examples.en: play the violin
examples.zh: 拉小提琴

examples.en: The performance of the violinist displayed great art.
examples.zh: 小提琴手的表演展现了高超的艺术技巧。

examples.en: Over the years, he's picked off his competitors so that he now has a virtual monopoly.
examples.zh: 多年来，他战胜了一个个竞争对手，现已成为实际的垄断者。

examples.en: a man of high virtue
examples.zh: 道德高尚的人

examples.en: This kind of virus wasn't known until a German doctor discovered it by chance.
examples.zh: 这种病毒在被德国医生偶然发现之前，一直不为人知。

examples.en: I was eventually granted an exit visa.
examples.zh: 我终于获得了出境签证。

examples.en: visible improvements
examples.zh: 明显的改善

examples.en: He has very little vision in the left eye.
examples.zh: 他左眼的视力很弱。

examples.en: We started our visit to the United States on February 13.
examples.zh: 2月13日，我们开始了对美国的访问。

examples.en: Visiting the museum will take you back to the 1930s.
examples.zh: 参观这家博物馆能带你回到20世纪30年代。(黄浦)

examples.en: Every day, we examine the visitors' passports carefully before they check in.
examples.zh: 每天旅客入住前，我们都要仔细检查他们的护照。

examples.en: His designs have a strong visual appeal.
examples.zh: 他的设计有很强的视觉感染力。

senses.trans: 视觉资料(指说明性的图片、影片等)

examples.en: Remember you want your visuals to reinforce your message, not detract from what you are saying.
examples.zh: 要记住，使用视觉材料是为了使表达的意思更加清楚明白，而不是分散别人对所讲内容的注意力。

examples.en: The leader's vital and cheerful manner filled his men with courage.
examples.zh: 这位领袖富有朝气和乐观的精神状态使他的部属勇气倍增。

examples.en: It remains unknown whether vitamin pills can replace food to provide enough energy for us.
examples.zh: 维生素片能否替代食物为我们提供足够能量仍然未知。(静安)

examples.en: It is still vivid in my memory.
examples.zh: 这事我还记得清清楚楚。

examples.en: Language practice needs to be based on enough vocabulary.
examples.zh: 语言运用需要足够的词汇量为基础。

examples.en: have a real vocation for looking after the sick
examples.zh: 有照顾病人的真实本领

examples.en: She speaks in a soft voice.
examples.zh: 她说话声很柔和。

examples.en: Some scientists have voiced concern that the disease could be passed on to humans.
examples.zh: 有些科学家表示担忧，认为这种病可能传染给人类。

v.name: shout at the top of one's voice

examples.en: The spectators disapproved of the match being cancelled with one voice.
examples.zh: 观众异口同声地反对取消比赛。

examples.en: It was not plausible that a solo volcano could bring about such chaos.
examples.zh: 单独的火山能导致这种混乱程度的破坏，这似乎不合理。(普陀)

examples.en: We play volleyball after class.
examples.zh: 放学后我们打排球。

examples.en: a library of over 10,000 volumes
examples.zh: 藏书超过 10000 册的图书馆

examples.en: Not only can volunteer activities enable teenagers to learn how to help the disabled, but they can also raise teenagers' awareness to cooperate with strangers.
examples.zh: 志愿者活动不仅能使青少年学到如何帮助残疾人，还可以提高他们与陌生人合作的意识。

examples.en: He volunteered to get some information.
examples.zh: 他自告奋勇去获取一些信息。

examples.en: She wants to be a volunteer.
examples.zh: 她想成为一名志愿者。

examples.en: an open vote
examples.zh: 记名投票

examples.en: He voted for the Democrats.
examples.zh: 他投了民主党的票。

examples.en: It was voted that residents will have to pay a trash collection fee.
examples.zh: 经投票决定，居民们必须支付一笔垃圾收集费。

examples.en: make a voyage
examples.zh: 作一次航行

examples.en: Teachers qualified to teach in England are not accepted in Scotland and vice versa.
examples.zh: 在英格兰有教书资格的老师在苏格兰得不到认可，反之亦然。

examples.en: Wages are paid on Fridays.
examples.zh: 每星期五发工资。

examples.en: He has no waist.
examples.zh: 他胖得都没有腰身了。

examples.en: As we all know, it's not polite to keep others waiting for a long time.
examples.zh: 我们都知道，让别人久等是不礼貌的。

w.name: Time and tide wait for no man.

examples.en: Mary's brothers work as waiters in a five-star hotel.
examples.zh: 玛丽的兄弟在一家五星级酒店当服务员。

examples.en: We asked the waitress for another glass of wine.
examples.zh: 我们请那位女侍者再来一杯酒。

examples.en: The border town, enveloped in morning mist, tuneful bird calls and distant dog barks, is gradually waking up from a sound sleep.
examples.zh: 这个被晨雾、悦耳的鸟鸣声和远处的狗吠声笼罩的边陲小镇，慢慢地从酣睡中苏醒了。（长宁）

examples.en: It's time to wake him.
examples.zh: 该把他叫醒了。

examples.en: It looks as if he had just waken up.
examples.zh: 好像他刚睡醒似的。

examples.en: I was knocking on your door to waken you.
examples.zh: 我敲你的门是为了把你唤醒。

examples.en: We walk to school each day.
examples.zh: 我们每天走路去上学。

examples.en: It is a long walk to the town.
examples.zh: 到城里要走很长的路。

examples.en: The wall was painted blue.
examples.zh: 墙壁被漆成蓝色。

w.name: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true man.

examples.en: I lost a wallet.
examples.zh: 我丢了一只钱包。

examples.en: She likes waltz very much.
examples.zh: 她很喜欢华尔兹舞曲。

examples.en: The children wandered in the woods.
examples.zh: 孩子们在森林里漫步。

examples.en: Did you want to tell me something?
examples.zh: 你想告诉我什么吗？

examples.en: Timidity reveals a want of power, and audacity a lack of skill.
examples.zh: 胆怯表明缺乏能力，鲁莽表明缺乏技巧。

examples.en: The war made millions of people homeless.
examples.zh: 战争使成千万的人无家可归。

examples.en: the surgical ward
examples.zh: 外科病房

examples.en: She was a warm and loving mother.
examples.zh: 她是一位热情慈爱的母亲。

examples.en: Please warm the milk.
examples.zh: 请把牛奶热一热。

examples.en: The milk is warming (up) on the stove.
examples.zh: 牛奶正在炉子上温热。

examples.en: They had no difficulty finding the warm-hearted person.
examples.zh: 他们毫不费力地就找到了那位好心人。

examples.en: There's a feeling of warmth and trust here.
examples.zh: 这里有一种温暖和信任的感觉。

examples.en: I warned him of the danger, but he said he didn't care.
examples.zh: 我警告过他有危险，但他说他无所谓。

examples.en: "Don't do anything yet," he warned. "Too risky."
examples.zh: “暂时不要采取行动，”他警告说，“太危险。”

examples.en: I feel it my duty to warn you against smoking.
examples.zh: 我觉得有义务警告您不要吸烟。

examples.en: Doctors issued a warning against eating any fish caught in the river.
examples.zh: 医生警告不要吃那条河里捕的鱼。

examples.en: The warship was torpedoed and sank at once.
examples.zh: 军舰被鱼雷击中，立即沉没。

examples.en: He often helps his wife wash the dishes.
examples.zh: 他常帮助妻子洗洗餐具。

examples.en: It's a good habit to wash up before a meal.
examples.zh: 饭前洗手洗脸是好习惯。

examples.en: She gave the car a good washing.
examples.zh: 她把车好好地洗刷了一遍。

examples.en: Will you please tell me where the washroom is?
examples.zh: 麻烦你告诉我卫生间在哪里？

examples.en: Please take a short shower and don't waste water.
examples.zh: 请快速冲个澡，不要浪费水。

examples.en: It'd be a pity if all this work went to waste.
examples.zh: 如果所有这一切工作都白干了，那多可惜。

examples.en: Waste of food is wicked.
examples.zh: 浪费粮食是不道德的。

examples.en: Internet bars mustn't let people under 18 in or let anybody watch bad things.
examples.zh: 网吧不能让18岁以下的人进入或让任何人看有害的东西。

examples.en: be on the watch
examples.zh: 看守着，提防着

examples.en: The watchman opened the gate for her.
examples.zh: 守夜人给她打开了大门。

examples.en: We should tell our children not to waste water.
examples.zh: 我们应当告诉孩子们不要浪费水。

examples.en: Water your garden in the early morning.
examples.zh: 清晨给你的花园浇浇水。

examples.en: Watermelons are very cheap here.
examples.zh: 这里的西瓜很便宜。

examples.en: a waterproof coat
examples.zh: 雨衣

examples.en: She gave a wave as she left the house.
examples.zh: 她离开家时挥了挥手。

examples.en: He waved desperately to his companion.
examples.zh: 他拼命向他的伙伴挥手。

examples.en: We waved our farewells.
examples.zh: 我们挥手告别。

examples.en: Everyone should keep in mind that we should treat people the way we want to be treated.
examples.zh: 每个人应当牢记：己所不欲，勿施于人。（奉贤）

examples.en: In a way, I'm glad you made that mistake, for it will serve as a warning to you.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上说，你犯那个错误我倒感到高兴，因为它可以起到警示你的作用。

examples.en: He is in no way superior to me in speed or strength.
examples.zh: 在速度和力量方面他决不比我强。

examples.en: Preparations for a big celebration are well under way.
examples.zh: 盛大庆祝活动的准备工作正在顺利进行中。

examples.en: We may well have our dreams, but they can't be realized unless we work hard on them.
examples.zh: 梦想还是要有的，但不努力就不可能实现。（浦东）

examples.en: She spoke in a weak voice.
examples.zh: 她用微弱的声音说话。

examples.en: The team has been weakened by injury.
examples.zh: 这个队因伤实力减弱。

examples.en: Good health is true wealth.
examples.zh: 健康是真正的财富。

examples.en: a wealthy family
examples.zh: 有钱人家

examples.en: a nuclear weapon
examples.zh: 核武器

examples.en: They can see the words on the blackboard clearly, so they don't have to wear glasses.
examples.zh: 他们可以清楚地看到黑板上的字，所以不需要戴眼镜。

examples.en: Good leather will wear for years.
examples.zh: 好的皮革会很经用。

examples.en: Despite the bad weather, the sports meet we are looking forward to will be held as planned.
examples.zh: 尽管天气不好，我们盼望的运动会仍将按原定计划举行。

examples.en: Is that what the weatherman says?
examples.zh: 这是那位天气预报员说的吗？

examples.en: to weave a mat
examples.zh: 织席子

examples.en: a spider's web
examples.zh: 蜘蛛网

examples.en: The article is worth reading, for it provides not only much information about the course but also a lot of practical websites.
examples.zh: 这篇文章值得一读，它不仅提供了很多该课程的相关信息，而且还有大量的实用网址。

examples.en: Many people prefer to get married on National Day, so you'll have to reserve the restaurant at least half a year before your daughter's wedding.
examples.zh: 很多人喜欢在国庆节结婚，因此你至少得在你女儿婚礼之前半年预定饭店。

examples.en: You shouldn't have had your children doing whatever they wanted in the restaurant last Wednesday, which must have disturbed the other customers.
examples.zh: 上周三你不该听任孩子们在餐厅里为所欲为的，那肯定打扰到了其他顾客。

examples.en: Clear the soil of weeds and fork in plenty of compost.
examples.zh: 清除土中的杂草，然后叉入大量堆肥。

examples.en: I've been weeding the flower beds.
examples.zh: 我一直在除花坛里的杂草。

examples.en: I haven't finished reading the book that you lent me last week.
examples.zh: 我还没看完你上周借给我的那本书。

examples.en: The store is open only on weekdays.
examples.zh: 这家商店只在工作日开。

examples.en: I don't work at the weekend.
examples.zh: 我周末不工作。

examples.en: In addition to my weekly wage, I got a lot of tips.
examples.zh: 除了每周的薪水外，我还能得到不少小费。

examples.en: They will swap places next week and will repeat the switch weekly.
examples.zh: 下周他们将交换座位，并且以后每周换一次。

examples.en: This weekly is printed every Friday.
examples.zh: 这份周报每星期五出版发行。

examples.en: She wept when she heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 当她听到这个坏消息时哭了。

examples.en: He weighed himself on the scales.
examples.zh: 他在磅秤上称体重。

examples.en: How much do you weigh?
examples.zh: 你有多重？

examples.en: That man is twice my weight.
examples.zh: 那个人的体重是我的2倍。

examples.en: He's a weird guy.
examples.zh: 他是个古怪的家伙。

examples.en: My aunt welcomed me.
examples.zh: 我的姑姑迎接了我。

examples.en: I called on my former classmate, only to receive a cold welcome.
examples.zh: 我去看望以前的同学，却受到冷遇。

examples.en: You're welcome to try, but you won't succeed.
examples.zh: 你尽管尝试，但你是不会成功的。

w.name: be welcome to do sth./to sth.

examples.en: seek welfare for the people
examples.zh: 为人民谋幸福

examples.en: His arguments are well grounded in facts.
examples.zh: 他的话是以事实为依据的。

examples.en: I'm very well.
examples.zh: 我身体很好。

examples.en: An encyclopedia is a well of knowledge.
examples.zh: 百科全书是知识的源泉。

examples.en: That writer is well-known.
examples.zh: 那位作家很有名。

examples.en: The wind is from the west.
examples.zh: 风从西方吹来。

examples.en: The West Lake is famous for its beautiful scenery.
examples.zh: 西湖以风景优美著称。

examples.en: Which kind of food do you prefer, Chinese or Western?
examples.zh: 你喜欢吃中餐，还是喜欢吃西餐？

examples.en: It is wet in the south, while the north is dry.
examples.zh: 南方雨水充沛，北方则比较干燥。

examples.en: The baby has wetted the bed again.
examples.zh: 这个婴儿又尿床了。

examples.en: hunting whales
examples.zh: 捕鲸

examples.en: Everyone should do what he thinks right.
examples.zh: 每个人都应该做自己认为是正确的事。

examples.en: She looks pretty whatever she wears.
examples.zh: 她不管穿什么都很好看。

examples.en: Whatever book you may read, read it carefully.
examples.zh: 不管你读什么书，都要仔细。

examples.en: a field of wheat
examples.zh: 一块麦田

examples.en: The two rear wheels spin freely, while the front wheel is driven by an electric motor.
examples.zh: 两只后轮自由转动，而前轮由电机驱动。

examples.en: He wheeled around to face her.
examples.zh: 他突然转过身来面对她。

examples.en: Only when you lose something will you find how precious it is, so you should learn to cherish what you have.
examples.zh: 只有当你失去东西时，才会觉得它是多么的宝贵，所以要学会珍惜所拥有的。

examples.en: Come whenever you like.
examples.zh: 你想什么时候来就什么时候来。

examples.en: Leaving situations that fail to bring you joy can leave you with sufficient time to explore where your heart is truly leading you.
examples.zh: 离开无法带给你快乐的境地，可以让你有足够的时间去探索心之所向。(宝山)

examples.en: Wherever you go, I go too.
examples.zh: 无论你到哪里，我都去。

examples.en: Whether you will go on an excursion or participate in a sports event, you had better take health insurance into consideration.
examples.zh: 无论是短途旅行还是参加体育比赛，你最好把健康保险考虑在内。

examples.en: He spent too much time on some unimportant things, which led to the failure of the whole project.
examples.zh: 他在一些无关紧要的事上花费太多时间，导致了整个项目的失败。

examples.en: Whichever side wins, I shall be satisfied.
examples.zh: 不论哪一边胜，我都高兴。

examples.en: While I admit that the problems are difficult, I don’t agree that they cannot be solved.
examples.zh: 我承认这些问题有些棘手，但我认为它们不是不能解决。

examples.en: We're going away for a while.
examples.zh: 我们要出门一阵。

items.explanation: 可表示主句和从句动作同时发生或先后发生。从句可表示一个时间点或一段时间。

examples.en: I will lend you the book when I have finished it.
examples.zh: 我看完这本书后，会把它借给你。

items.explanation: 表示主句和从句动作同时发生。从句表示一段时间。

examples.en: Mr. Baker phoned you while you were out.
examples.zh: 你不在的时候，贝克先生打电话给你了。

items.explanation: 表示主句和从句动作同时发生。从句可表示一个时间点或一段时间。

examples.en: He sang songs as he was taking a bath.
examples.zh: 他一边洗澡，一边唱歌。

items.explanation: 有时 when, while, as 意思相近，可以互换。

examples.en: Tom was reading a book while/when/as Mary was writing a letter.
examples.zh: 汤姆在看书，玛丽在写信。

examples.en: punish sb. with a whip
examples.zh: 鞭笞某人

examples.en: He whipped the horse to make it run faster.
examples.zh: 他策马加速前进。

examples.en: The teacher knew that the students were whispering.
examples.zh: 老师知道学生们在窃窃私语地议论。

examples.en: to speak in a whisper/in whispers
examples.zh: 低声说话

examples.en: He whispered the message to David.
examples.zh: 他悄声把这个消息告诉了戴维。

examples.en: The teacher blew a whistle to start the race.
examples.zh: 老师吹响哨子开始了赛跑。

examples.en: He whistled to his dog.
examples.zh: 他吹口哨唤狗。

examples.en: My grandfather went white at the age of thirty.
examples.zh: 我祖父的头发 30 岁时就变白了。

examples.en: Who do you think will win the first prize?
examples.zh: 你觉得谁会赢得第一名呢？

examples.en: Whoever has never experienced several failures can hardly feel the happiness of success.
examples.zh: 任何一个不经历几次失败的人几乎体会不到成功的喜悦。

examples.en: Although Steve Jobs has left us, his creative ideas will always have great influence on the whole world.
examples.zh: 尽管史蒂夫·乔布斯离开了我们，他的创意对整个世界始终有很大的影响。

examples.en: The research has far-reaching implications for medicine as a whole.
examples.zh: 这项研究对整个医学界都有着深远的影响。

examples.en: On the whole, I'm satisfied with the progress she has made this term.
examples.zh: 我对她这学期所取得的进步大体上是满意的。

examples.en: Did you know whom Bill was waiting for?
examples.zh: 你知道比尔在等谁吗？

examples.en: Not well managed, the museum, whose exhibits are dusty and hall deserted, requires immediate improvement.
examples.zh: 博物馆疏于管理，展品积灰，门庭冷落，亟需改善。(上海高考)

examples.en: The reason why the TV series is popular with young parents is that it's easy for them to identify with characters in it.
examples.zh: 这部电视连续剧受年轻父母欢迎的原因是，他们很容易与剧中的人物产生共鸣。

examples.en: My brother has wide interests.
examples.zh: 我的兄弟兴趣广泛。

examples.en: With the development of China, Chinese has become an international language and is widely used all over the world.
examples.zh: 随着中国的发展，汉语已成为一种国际语言，在世界各地被广泛使用。

examples.en: a widespread disease
examples.zh: 一种流行病

examples.en: Measure the full width of the window.
examples.zh: 测量一下窗户的全宽。

examples.en: She is a good wife and mother.
examples.zh: 她是个贤妻良母。

examples.en: Wi-Fi connections, or hotspots, can be found in airports, hotels, coffee shops and many other places.
examples.zh: 在机场、旅馆、咖啡店和其他许多地方都可以找到无线网络连接或者热点。

examples.en: Hearing the news that the astronauts returned to the earth safe and sound, people were wild with joy.
examples.zh: 听到两位宇航员安然无恙返回地球的消息，人们欣喜若狂。

examples.en: The garden's turned into a wilderness.
examples.zh: 这园子现已变为杂草丛生的荒地。

examples.en: a wildlife zoo
examples.zh: 野生动物园

examples.en: When we gain something, we will lose something else, and we should be conscious of it.
examples.zh: 有所得就有所失，我们要意识到这一点。

examples.en: He has such a strong will that he is sure to make every effort and try to finish the task in advance.
examples.zh: 他有着如此坚强的意志，定会不遗余力，力争提前完成任务。

examples.en: He's quite willing to pay the price I ask.
examples.zh: 他非常愿意按照我的要价付钱。

examples.en: He listened to reason and willingly accepted his comrades' opinions and criticisms.
examples.zh: 他听从劝告，欣然接受了同志们的意见和批评。

examples.en: Nobody knows which player will win the game until the last moment.
examples.zh: 不到最后一刻，没人知道哪位运动员会赢得这场比赛。

examples.en: Wind is a motive power.
examples.zh: 风是一种动力。

examples.en: The insight into how whales hear might explain whether sonar testing by military ships is causing the animals to wind up on beaches.
examples.zh: 了解了鲸鱼如何听到声音，也许就能解释军舰的声纳测试是否会导致动物搁浅在海滩上。(崇明)

examples.en: Please open the window.
examples.zh: 请把窗户打开。

examples.en: It's very windy and dusty here in winter.
examples.zh: 这里冬天风沙很大。

examples.en: You won't be able to make the best wine unless you choose the perfect grapes only.
examples.zh: 只有挑选极好的葡萄，才能酿造出最好的酒。

examples.en: Friendship is love without wing.
examples.zh: 友谊是无翼之爱。

examples.en: The winner will receive a prize to the value of £1,000.
examples.zh: 获胜者将得到价值 1000 英镑的奖品。

examples.en: In winter the weather is always cold.
examples.zh: 冬天天气总是很冷。

examples.en: wipe the dishes
examples.zh: 擦碟子

examples.en: Why was her wire busy?
examples.zh: 为什么她的电话占线？

examples.en: Wisdom is more precious than wealth.
examples.zh: 智慧比财富更珍贵。

w.name: Wisdom in the mind is better than money in the hand.
trans: 胸中有知识，胜于手中有金钱。

examples.en: wise advice
examples.zh: 明智的建议

examples.en: I wish I knew what had happened.
examples.zh: 我希望我知道发生了什么事。

examples.en: He has no wish to go.
examples.zh: 他不太想去。

examples.en: Mother says I may go if I wish.
examples.zh: 妈妈说我如果想去就可以去。

w.name: wish (that) ...
trans: 但愿(从句一般要用虚拟)

w.name: wish for
trans: 欲，愿(尤指不大可能获得或达到的，或有赖于好运或特殊环境才能获得的某种事物)

examples.en: to be past the wit of man
examples.zh: 非人的智力所能及

examples.en: He agreed that he was wrong with good grace.
examples.zh: 他大方地承认自己错了。

examples.en: I advise you to withdraw your allegation before I contact my lawyer.
examples.zh: 建议你在我联系我的律师之前撤回指控。

examples.en: After all your promises you can’t withdraw now.
examples.zh: 你既然答应了就不能收回前言。

examples.en: The house is within eyesight.
examples.zh: 这幢房子在视线范围之内。

discriminations.intro: 这两个词在过去时里，均表示“在一段时间之内”。在将来时里，within 表示“在一段时间之内”，in 表示“在一段时间之后”。

examples.en: He came back within/in an hour.
examples.zh: 他在 1 小时之内回来了。

examples.en: He will come back within an hour.
examples.zh: 他将在 1 小时之内回来。

examples.en: He will come back in an hour.
examples.zh: 他将在 1 小时之后回来。

examples.en: Do you think it possible to learn a foreign language well without learning a single word by heart?
examples.zh: 你认为有没有可能不背一个单词而学好一门外语？

examples.en: This gold medal has not only witnessed the growth and transformation of the athlete, but has also shown the struggle and perseverance of Chinese athletes.
examples.zh: 这枚金牌不仅见证了该名运动员的成长和蜕变，更体现了中国健儿的奋斗和坚守。（浦东）

examples.en: They want to kill the wolf.
examples.zh: 他们想要把狼杀死。

examples.en: These women doctors have saved many children’s lives since they worked in the hospital.
examples.zh: 自从这些女医生在医院工作以来，她们救了很多孩子的生命。

examples.en: I wonder why nobody is willing to compete against him so far.
examples.zh: 我不知道为什么至今没有人愿意和他竞争。

examples.en: The Great Wall is one of the seven wonders of the world.
examples.zh: 长城是世界七大奇观之一。

examples.en: We are having such a wonderful time at his birthday party.
examples.zh: 在他的生日聚会上，我们度过了美好的时光。

examples.en: Tables are made of wood.
examples.zh: 桌子是木头做的。

examples.en: Mr. Smith has recently built a wooden bridge over his pool in the garden.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生最近在他花园里的泳池上建了一座木桥。

examples.en: a ball of knitting wool
examples.zh: 一团毛线

examples.en: Word came that the Chinese government rented helicopters to carry out rescue operations immediately after the earthquake hit New Zealand, which made Chinese people very proud.
examples.zh: 消息传来说，新西兰发生地震后，中国政府立即租用直升机实施救援，为此中国人感到十分自豪。

examples.en: Can I have a word with you in private?
examples.zh: 我能和你私下谈谈吗？

examples.en: Is the saying that we should devote our limited life to the unlimited work of serving the people out of date?
examples.zh: 我们应该将有限的生命投入到无限的为人民服务中去，这一说法过时了吗？

examples.en: It is by working hard that he has achieved what others can’t.
examples.zh: 正是通过努力工作，他才取得了他人所不能取得的成就。

examples.en: Each position will work the muscles in a different way.
examples.zh: 每种姿势都会以不同方式来锻炼肌肉。

examples.en: Why don’t you put the problem aside fir a while and work at it later.
examples.zh: 你为何不把这个问题先放一边，晚点再来处理？

examples.en: She is flexible and willing to work on any project that is assigned to her.
examples.zh: 她很灵活，愿意从事任何分配给她的项目。

examples.en: The three parties will meet next month to work out remaining differences.
examples.zh: 三方将在下个月会面，以解决余下的分歧。

examples.en: The workers were asked to go back to work at once.
examples.zh: 工人们被要求立刻回去工作。

examples.en: a theatre workshop
examples.zh: 戏剧工作坊

examples.en: Shanghai attracts a lot of visitors from all over the world every year.
examples.zh: 上海每年吸引很多来自世界各地的游客。

w.name: We all have our places in the world.

examples.en: a worldwide market
examples.zh: 世界市场

examples.en: earth worm
examples.zh: 蚯蚓

examples.en: This is a worn suit.
examples.zh: 这是一套旧衣服。

examples.en: So long as we have enough food and fuel, we shall have nothing to worry about.
examples.zh: 只要有足够的食物和燃料，我们就不必担心。

examples.en: She worried that she was out of her element.
examples.zh: 她担心自己的处境不佳。

examples.en: Is your life full of worries?
examples.zh: 你的生活充满令人苦恼的事吗？

examples.en: There's really no reason to be worried about what will happen tomorrow.
examples.zh: 确实没有理由为明天的事情担心。

examples.en: Unusual weather indicates that our living environment is getting worse, which is the warning to us from nature.
examples.zh: 不寻常的天气表明，我们的生活环境正在恶化，这是大自然对我们的警示。

examples.en: You’re doing worse than I expected.
examples.zh: 你做得比我预料的还要糟糕。

examples.en: The worst time to look for a job is when you feel desperate and must have a new one immediately.
examples.zh: 找工作最糟糕的时候，就是当你感到绝望并且必须立即换新工作时。（闵行）

examples.en: We should only buy the books that are worth reading several times.
examples.zh: 只有值得读几遍的书才应该买。

examples.en: The thieves stole one million’s worth of jewellery.
examples.zh: 穷贼偷走了价值 100 万英镑的珠宝。

examples.en: The guarantee could be worthless if the firm goes out of business.
examples.zh: 如果厂家倒闭，保修单就会变得毫无用处。

examples.en: Do you think it worthwhile to gain fame and wealth at the cost of health?
examples.zh: 你认为以健康为代价来获取名声和财富值得吗？

examples.en: Jenny’s suggestion is certainly worthy of consideration.
examples.zh: 珍妮的提议无疑是值得考虑的。

items.explanation: 只作表语，后接名词或动名词（表被动）。注意：1. worth 前只能用 well 修饰，不能用 very。2. worth 作表语时，不能单独使用，但可用 worthwhile 代替。

examples.en: The vase is worth 100 dollars.
examples.zh: 这个花瓶值 100 美元。

examples.en: It is worth visiting Paris. (= Paris is worth visiting.)
examples.zh: 巴黎值得一游。

examples.en: The film is well worth seeing again.
examples.zh: 这部电影非常值得再看一遍。

items.explanation: 作表语、定语（常为前置定语），后接不定式（表主动）。

examples.en: The visit to Paris is worthwhile.
examples.zh: 去巴黎旅游是值得的。

examples.en: It is worthwhile to explore new and fringe industries.
examples.zh: 开发新的边缘产业是值得的。

items.explanation: 作表语，后接介词 of 或动词不定式。

examples.en: He is worthy of remembrance. (= He is worthy of being remembered. = He is worthy to be remembered.)
examples.zh: 他值得纪念。

examples.en: They said it would be fine.
examples.zh: 听说天气会很好。

examples.en: My wound is still painful.
examples.zh: 我的伤口还在痛。

examples.en: So badly was he wounded that he should be send to hospital immediately.
examples.zh: 他伤得很严重，应该马上送医院。

examples.en: She is wrapping a birthday present.
examples.zh: 她正在包一份生日礼物。

examples.en: wrappings for Christmas gifts
examples.zh: 圣诞礼物包装纸

examples.en: The ship was wrecked on the rock.
examples.zh: 船触礁失事了。

examples.en: the wrecks of Titanic
examples.zh: 泰坦尼克号的残骸

examples.en: A fishbone got stuck in his throat, and after a long wrestle, he managed to swallow it down.
examples.zh: 一根鱼骨鲠在他喉咙里，他挣扎了许久，总算把它咽下去了。

examples.en: She wrestled with her attacker.
examples.zh: 她和袭击她的人扭打在一起。

examples.en: Grandfather has many wrinkles on his face.
examples.zh: 祖父脸上有许多皱纹。

examples.en: The machine is equipped with a soft gripper, a force-sensing wrist and an external camera.
examples.zh: 该机器配有一个柔软的抓手、一个压力感应手腕和一个外部摄像头。

examples.en: I wrote to let him know that I had arrived in Beijing.
examples.zh: 我写信告诉他我已到达北京。

examples.en: Who is the writer of the book War and Peace?
examples.zh: 谁是《战争与和平》这本书的作者？

examples.en: It is wrong to play tricks on others.
examples.zh: 捉弄别人是不对的。

examples.en: to know right from wrong
examples.zh: 能辨别是非

examples.en: I feel it my duty to warn you against smoking.
examples.zh: 我觉得有义务警告您不要吸烟。

examples.en: Watch out for sharp bends and adjust your speed accordingly.
examples.zh: 当心急转弯并相应调整车速。

examples.en: When it comes to art, I'm completely at sea.
examples.zh: 说到艺术，我完全是门外汉。

examples.en: With the rise of e-commerce, the way Chinese people do shopping has experienced great changes in the past decade.
examples.zh: 随着电子商务的兴起，中国人购物的方式在过去十年中经历了巨大变化。

examples.en: The hotel is within easy reach of the city center.
examples.zh: 宾馆就在离市中心很近的地方。

examples.en: The hotel is within easy reach of the city center.
examples.zh: 宾馆就在离市中心很近的地方。

examples.en: Each candidate must answer all the questions without exception.
examples.zh: 每个候选人无一例外都必须回答全部问题。

examples.en: an X-ray diagnosis
examples.zh: X光诊断

examples.en: He had been X-rayed, weighed, and measured.
examples.zh: 他做了X光检查，称了体重，又量了身高。

examples.en: Can you still buy cloth by the yard in Britain?
examples.zh: 在英国买布仍旧以码为单位吗？

examples.en: a farm yard
examples.zh: 农庄的院子

examples.en: He sat up and stretched and yawned.
examples.zh: 他坐起身，伸伸懒腰，打了个哈欠。

examples.en: She kept giving great yawns.
examples.zh: 他连连打着大哈欠。

examples.en: By the time he comes back next year, the stadium will have been set up.
examples.zh: 等他明年回来，这个体育馆就建好了。

examples.en: The yearly conference will be held next month.
examples.zh: 年会下个月举行。

examples.en: I get a physical examination yearly.
examples.zh: 我一年做一次体检。

examples.en: I'd like to find out if they're termly or yearly.
examples.zh: 我想问清楚它们是(学)期刊还是年刊。

examples.en: The bright yellow flowers are quite lovely.
examples.zh: 明黄色的花儿可爱极了。

examples.en: be dressed in yellow
examples.zh: 穿着黄色衣服

examples.en: — Are you ready? — Yes.
examples.zh: — 你准备好了吗？— 是的。

examples.en: You will achieve nothing unless you follow the advice which Professor Li gave you yesterday.
examples.zh: 除非你听从李教授昨天给你的忠告，否则你将一事无成。

examples.en: The girl hasn't finished the project herself yet.
examples.zh: 这个女孩自己还没有完成这个项目。

examples.en: Do you have any low-fat yoghurt?
examples.zh: 你有没有低脂的酸奶？

examples.en: Where are you planning to celebrate the New Year's Eve this year?
examples.zh: 今年除夕你计划在哪里过？

examples.en: She must be at least forty, but she likes dressing up as a young girl.
examples.zh: 她至少有40岁了，但她喜欢打扮成一个年轻的姑娘。

y.name: A young idler, an old beggar.
trans: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。

examples.en: Now, many youngsters are keen on seeking tour pals on the Internet.
examples.zh: 现在，很多年轻人热衷于在网上征求旅伴。

examples.en: You should consult your parents before you decide which college or university is best for you.
examples.zh: 你在决定哪所大学最适合你之前应该征询父母的意见。

examples.en: a friend of yours
examples.zh: 你的一个朋友

examples.en: Only when you devote yourself to what you are doing can you do it well.
examples.zh: 只有全身心投入正在做的事情，才能把它做好。

examples.en: "Help yourselves to some chicken," she said to the children.
examples.zh: 她对孩子们说：“你们随便吃些鸡肉吧。”

examples.en: The youth of today are very fond of dancing.
examples.zh: 现在的年轻人很喜欢跳舞。

examples.en: A zebra has stripes.
examples.zh: 斑马身上有条纹。

examples.en: All cars should stop at the zebra crossing.
examples.zh: 所有车辆都要在斑马线前停下。

examples.en: Economic growth is at zero.
examples.zh: 经济无增长。

examples.en: The zip has stuck.
examples.zh: 拉链卡住了。

examples.en: Legoland Shanghai Resort, located in Jinshan District, will consist of eight themed zones and a theme hotel.
examples.zh: 坐落于金山区的上海乐高乐园度假村将由8个主题片区和1家主题酒店组成。

examples.en: Please take me to the zoo.
examples.zh: 请带我去动物园。
